After a one-night stand gifts him X-ray eyes, every rough stone he scans spills jade—and secrets. With Chaya's help, he's become an antiques appraiser and earned enough money to cover his sister's medical expenses.
69412b148a1b6393bf0a8f31.title: Nothing Can Hide from Me

694220bcee891b2360087914.synopsis: Cecilia Yeager is reborn on the day of her murder. To survive and get revenge, she agrees to marry Raymond Hawthorne. But on her wedding day, her groom is reported dead. This time, Cecilia must fight to claim her rightful place. Gavin, the mysterious bodyguard assigned to protect her—who hides a shocking secret that could destroy them all or save them both.
694220bcee891b2360087914.title: Sassy Wife & Mischievous Guard

69422153ede97efabc0f97b1.synopsis: The ice-cold CEO Chris Preston finds himself in danger due to corporate rivalries. Desperate and with nowhere to turn, he is introduced to a legendary master, only to discover she is a six-year-old girl named Momo who needs hugs and ice cream. Standing no taller than his knee and clutching a worn-out doll, Momo seems out of place. However, when she effortlessly takes down top assassins with a lollipop and her bunny doll, Chris is forced to accept this absurd reality...
69422153ede97efabc0f97b1.title: Little Guardian? No, That’s My Big Boss!

69426f2c776d01014f056a25.synopsis: In Golden Feather: Temptation Game movie, at the Golden Feather Academy, after being rejected, Queen Celine offers her playboy stepbrother Leo a night with her if he can seduce and destroy the boy who refused her—the president's son, Logic. But when Leo's fake pursuit turns real, Celine loses control of Leo forever...
69426f2c776d01014f056a25.title: Golden Feather: Temptation Game

6943c6a9d3f874f0cb082c91.synopsis: Nina Yeats, battling a debilitating illness, becomes entangled with a monster, Jack Xavier, while trying to fulfill her late mother's last wish. Exploiting her vulnerabilities, Jack seems inescapable, yet Nina refuses to yield. As the icy facade of this devilish figure begins to crack, Jack finds himself unexpectedly bending to Nina's will. Nina discovers that Jack is not as fearsome as he seems, and slowly, she finds herself drawn to him.
6943c6a9d3f874f0cb082c91.title: Yielding to Her Charm

6943c6c6932f94d04d0517fd.synopsis: In her past life, Janie Sutton silently loved Austin Sterling for seven years but ended up in an unhappy marriage. Reborn into her high school days, she decides to focus on herself instead. However, Austin is also reborn and suddenly starts to court her relentlessly. Will she give him a second chance, or just leave him?
6943c6c6932f94d04d0517fd.title: Please Love Me in This Life

6943c6f440c54ca3700d3c30.synopsis: Julia Cullen has spent over a decade serving in the court, living her life for others. It wasn't until she was deeply hurt that she realized true love comes from those who accept her as who she's and support her journey to become her best self.
6943c6f440c54ca3700d3c30.title: The 'Puppet' Emperor & His Clever Strategist

6943c717d1f8f8d4f105ff89.synopsis: Abandoned as a child, Sylvia is taken in by Yale and raised like a princess, but she mistakes his care for love. Years later, after being sent abroad by the Shepherd family, she returns to find them trapped in a scheme. To repay Yale, she becomes Theo's secret lover, unaware that he has loved her quietly for years. Through his unwavering devotion, Sylvia finally learns what true love really is.
6943c717d1f8f8d4f105ff89.title: Careful, You're Dangerous

6943ec019fe03efcc5069ef3.synopsis: As a child, Victoria nearly died in the freezing streets. It was Arthur Hope who saved her and adopted her. Years later, she reinvented herself abroad as Phoenix. But her world is shattered when she receives the heartbreaking news of Arthur's passing. Determined to pay her respects, she returns home, only to be confronted by spiteful uncles and ungrateful siblings. Finally, Victoria decides it's time to end this charade once and for all.
6943ec019fe03efcc5069ef3.title: Spicy Sister

69449f2795b99db0dd02c040.synopsis: Happy Holidays, Hollywood! The first annual ReelShort holiday shoot is here. Your favorite lead stars come together to reflect on their journeys in verticals, share dream collaborations, and spread festive cheer in this must-watch holiday special.
69449f2795b99db0dd02c040.title: ReelTalk EP 53-Happy Holidays, Hollywood

6944b6fbcb2b107b860152e3.synopsis: Josephine helped build the Walker Group from the ground up, sacrificing her health and fertility for her husband, Cameron. When the company goes public, she discovers his affair with his secretary, Ivy, who is now pregnant. After one final betrayal, Josephine files for divorce. As Ivy plots to steal the company, Josephine strikes back, reclaims her empire, and rebuilds her life with Finn, the man who loved her all along.
6944b6fbcb2b107b860152e3.title: My Husband Betrayed Me, My Life Became Mine

6944c157d9fba745670a0931.synopsis: Reporter Nina successfully gains the trust of crime lord Leon Mann and takes him down. Three months later, Nina encounters Leon again at a TV network's gala, only to find he has transformed into Chase Kane, with a spotless reputation. Through investigation, Nina confirms that Chase is indeed Leon and suspects he seeks revenge. As she navigates this elaborate deception, Nina feels dwarfed by the cunning Leon, but with no other choice, she must risk everything for a desperate counterattack.
6944c157d9fba745670a0931.title: Forever Your Prisoner

6944c2df99168e41550ee057.synopsis: Framed by Noble Consort Sheffield, Josephine died in a palace fire with her newborn prince. Reborn with a mysterious fertility system, she returns to the inner court determined to change her fate. Battling scheming concubines, a calculating emperor, and a ruthless empress dowager, she climbs the ranks through strategy, alliances, and the children she bears. In the end, Josephine helps Princess Serena claim the throne and secures ultimate power as Empress Dowager.
6944c2df99168e41550ee057.title: Empire of Secrets

694512cf4fc99caad6072095.synopsis: After ten years abroad, Eleanor Vance returns home and happens to save a kid from her son’s fiancée, Tara Reed. Beaten, disfigured, and robbed of her most treasured heirloom, Eleanor hides her scars—and her true power. Playing the meek mother-in-law, she gathers evidence of Tara’s corruption and cruelty. At the family banquet, just as Tara celebrates her upcoming wedding to William Shawn, Eleanor reveals herself as the new CEO of Shawn Group. One by one, she tears down the liar’s empire.
694512cf4fc99caad6072095.title: You Kicked the Wrong Woman

694512e61429aa9289039897.synopsis: Aiden Reed, a social elite and eligible bachelor, finds himself reborn in 2002 on his way to college registration. Armed with foresight, he actively expands his network and seizes the e-commerce wave by founding Rocket 101 Delivery. Meanwhile, Aiden is torn between choosing the treasure girl, Isla Sutton, and his first love, Sophia Shaw...
694512e61429aa9289039897.title: Back to 2002: I Built My Empire

694518d010b7c5bc87065fff.synopsis: Legendary gambler Henry Smith is framed by his nemesis and fellow gambler, Lip Orville, and forced into hiding after Lip kills his brother, David. On the run and out of options, he’s saved by Sophia and assumes a new identity——Carl, a janitor at an underground casino (a speakeasy officially) in Chicago. But when Lip returns, now allied with the mafia, and the infamous mob boss, Don Bazzini, Carl is dragged back into the dangerous world of gambling. At the same time, Carl/Henry begins plotting his revenge.
694518d010b7c5bc87065fff.title: The Last Gambling God

694523451c6f6ec24705e29e.synopsis: Mocked her classmates, Jessie Stark gains x-ray vision suddenly and can spot priceless antiques, predict stocks, and even see illnesses. From hustling in backstreet markets to dominating high-society auctions, Jessie turns her gift into a fortune—all while dodging rivals, outsmarting bullies, and untangling a web of secrets involving Gordon Graham, Leo Lawson, and a mysterious tycoon who knows more about her power than she does.
694523451c6f6ec24705e29e.title: With X-Ray Eyes, Desire Ignites

6945b6f11429aa92890398aa.synopsis: There was a time when Nina believed her happiest moment would be walking down the aisle with Evan, her college sweetheart. But betrayal shattered that dream, teaching her that true love and forever were rare illusions. After their divorce, she vowed never to give her heart away again. Then Damon—Evan’s youngest uncle—stormed into her life, refusing to let her run. She tries to keep her distance, not wanting ties with her ex’s family, but Damon’s relentless pursuit leaves her breathless.
6945b6f11429aa92890398aa.title: Swapped My Ex for His Billionaire Uncle

6947f405bcbab02e330b5133.synopsis: Clarissa Ainsworth unexpectedly discovers that Isabelle is not her biological sister, that her real sister, Celeste, was switched at birth and endured years of abuse. Determined to make things right, Clarissa brings the timid Celeste home, helping her establish her identity while navigating Isabelle's numerous schemes. As Clarissa delves deeper into the mystery, she uncovers that her great-uncle Walter is the mastermind behind the sinister switch. Ultimately, she ensures Walter faces justice for his actions.
6947f405bcbab02e330b5133.title: By Your Side, I Fear No More

6948e3a32622c78abe0c6040.synopsis: When Leo begins his 'job' at a nightclub, he unwittingly crosses paths with the supervisor and inadvertently aids the charming general manager. This sets off a chain of events, all secretly orchestrated by an unseen mastermind from the moment Leo stepped into the club. As he pieces together the clues and delves deeper into the mystery, Leo uncovers a truth that leaves him completely astounded...
6948e3a32622c78abe0c6040.title: Love Under Fire

6948e3f9b1c3533af20c104f.synopsis: In The Melon Seller Is the King movie, bentley, the true power behind Apex Constructions, hides his identity to raise his son right, posing as a night-market fruit vendor while sending Sam to learn the hard way on a construction site. But when a ruthless bully, Hunter, the spoiled son of Bentley's own subordinate, targets Sam, steals his girlfriend, and crushes him at every turn, Bentley steps in. His secret is revealed, yet the bully still dares to strike until Hunter's father arrives, and the truth finally hits home.
6948e3f9b1c3533af20c104f.title: The Melon Seller Is the King

6948e4319d0ddf2a960b1c04.synopsis: To save his reputation, CEO Raymond Hawk makes a deal with "Hotel Queen" Zoe Jonald: a fake marriage. Zoe thinks it’s just business… until she uncovers the secret Raymond has kept for ten years. When their contract ends and she tries to walk away, he makes it clear their arrangement is far from over. Now, a simple deal turns into a dangerous game of love, secrets, and a past that refuses to stay buried.
6948e4319d0ddf2a960b1c04.title: Married on Paper, Claimed for Life

694910830d4fda7998038ecd.synopsis: Once the formidable underground king of the Northeast Provinces, Linden Holt has traded his notorious past for a quiet life as a butcher. But when the young thugs demand protection money, his loyal lieutenant, Dominic Walden, arrives just in time with a team of bodyguards to send a clear message. Linden confides that his retirement was meant to provide a stable life for his son, Felix. However, a sudden call reveals that Felix has landed in hot water. Will the retired kingpin be forced to re-enter the fray and reclaim his throne to protect his family?
694910830d4fda7998038ecd.title: Dad Was a Street King

6949f275f5d8d98f16004ce2.synopsis: After 30 years of a childfree marriage, Sarah's life implodes when her husband James’s illegitimate son storms in demanding an inheritance. Betrayal turns to shock when Sarah reveals her own secret, 25-year-old twins. As Sarah strikes back with precision, James and his mistress scheme blindly. Fake paternity tests, hidden debts, and a wedding turned bloodbath expose every lie. No one walks away clean.
6949f275f5d8d98f16004ce2.title: She Played the Long Game

6949fae39dc8a604b9098059.synopsis: Clara Sterling isn't just lucky — she's cursed. Or rather, anyone who harms her is. As the treasured "lucky star" of the Sterling Group, she hides her identity on campus. But on her graduation day, her brother's girlfriend, Sophie Crawford, bullies her out of jealousy. After recovering, Clara is done hiding. At the gala, Clara will reveal herself as the true Sterling heiress. It's time for the world to see the monster behind the fame.
6949fae39dc8a604b9098059.title: Harm Her, Harm Yourself

6949fb14eac1be121b0cf6a1.synopsis: When Sheila Collin comes to visit her billionaire brother Nathan Collin, his fiancée Megan mistakes her for a poor nobody and unleashes torrents of abuse. Little does Megan know, Sheila is the real big boss of the Collins Group. At a lavish birthday gala, the truth unravels, sealing the arrogant fiancée's fate.
6949fb14eac1be121b0cf6a1.title: Don’t Mess With Her

6949fb5b1f537d4e930d3542.synopsis: Leo, the prodigious heir of the Divine Healer, descends from the mountains to find his engagement abruptly canceled by his fiancée, Isabelle, who dismisses him as a mere country boy and relegates him to the morgue. To everyone's astonishment, Leo revives the CEO, Eleanor, in the morgue, leaving the entire hospital in awe. With his unparalleled medical and martial arts prowess, Leo swiftly carves out a remarkable reputation in the city, navigating complex relationships with Isabelle, Eleanor, and other intriguing women.
6949fb5b1f537d4e930d3542.title: The Healer’s Romance

6949fbe9394c02d17000fac1.synopsis: Legendary pilot Hilary Archer awakens decades in the future—trapped in the body of a 9-year-old girl, Naomi. On a turbulent Zenith Air flight, a catastrophic engine failure leaves the crew incapacitated. As the plane plummets and panic erupts, only Naomi remembers how to fly. Dismissed as a scared child, she must reclaim her past-life skills, battle passenger disbelief, and defy a raging storm to perform an impossible landing and save everyone on board.
6949fbe9394c02d17000fac1.title: Reborn as a Genius Pilot

694a5e0212fdc2623f00fbbd.synopsis: Nora, after three lifetimes of failed attempts to change the Prime Minister's household, encounters an apocalyptic warrior destined for an animal reincarnation. She boldly offers her place to the warrior. As the new Nora takes charge, she swiftly reshapes the household by punishing the corrupt servants and hateful siblings. As the two Noras join forces, what kind of explosive drama awaits?
694a5e0212fdc2623f00fbbd.title: The Heiress of Blood

694a5e2badfd9f446d026959.synopsis: Originally Urania, a celestial goddess, Seraphina is thrust into the modern world as a Morrow heiress after a failed breakthrough. To reclaim her divine status, she must complete the unfinished business of her mortal counterpart. Upon returning to the Morrow family, she is enraged to find her parents being humiliated and swiftly takes a stand, showing no mercy.
694a5e2badfd9f446d026959.title: Not Your Ordinary Heiress—She’s a Goddess

694a7051cfaa1f0d7e00d662.synopsis: In CEO and the Country Girl movie, when her sister betrays her and a ruthless CEO targets her family farm, fiery small-town cowgirl Avery Rogers clashes—and sparks—with Tyler Sinclair, the corporate heir sent to take her land. But as lust and loyalty collide, a small-town cookout—Tyler’s bold bid to save Avery and her father’s legacy—turns enemies into something dangerously close to lovers, and turning their worlds upside down.
694a7051cfaa1f0d7e00d662.title: CEO and the Country Girl

694aea21e7b4a4d2ab0d7d5f.synopsis: In The Words movie, based on the novel by Ashley Jade. 4 years ago, rocker bad-boy Phoenix broke nerdy good-girl Lennon's heart and stole her song to escape his abusive father. Now he's a famous rockstar, spiraling into drugs and alcohol, she's hired to keep him sober for 8 weeks on tour. Can Lennon and Phoenix heal old wounds, or will their past stand in the way of their second chance at love?
694aea21e7b4a4d2ab0d7d5f.title: The Words

694b2440aef92798df032b95.synopsis: In My Sister is The Warlord Queen movie, abandoned by their parents, the Blackwood sisters, Catherine and Grace, grew up with only each other to rely on. As adults, both built successful lives. But at Grace’s engagement party, Catherine shows up straight from an undercover mission, still dressed as a janitor, and becomes the target of ridicule from Grace's in-laws and former classmates. When her sister is betrayed and humiliated by her fiancé, Catherine reveals her true identity as the Warlord Queen, and makes everyone regret underestimating them.
694b2440aef92798df032b95.title: My Sister Is the Warlord Queen

694b47fd5977a6baf30ae692.synopsis: Seven months pregnant with her second child, Natalie finds that her husband of ten years had once legally married another woman. The betrayal shatters her world. Determined to leave, she prepares to return to her powerful birth family only to suffer a premature labor. Delayed treatment costs her unborn child's life. With her last hope extinguished, Natalie cuts all emotional ties and is taken back into the elite family she once walked away from.
694b47fd5977a6baf30ae692.title: She Rises Where Love Dies

694b5960182cb6b56500f676.synopsis: To fulfill a thousand-year vow, the Goddess Selena created a magical puppet to withstand the cruelty of her reincarnated lover, Seth. When the puppet finally shatters, Seth is consumed by a gut-wrenching realization of the truth. Selena, however, has already found a soulmate in Christian, leaving the three of them trapped in a whirlpool of obsession and fate. After surviving life-or-death trials, Selena lets go of her fixation on the past. She then uncovers Christian's own heart-wrenching secret spanning cycles of reincarnation.
694b5960182cb6b56500f676.title: Never Promise Forever

694b5a7da99ea818ed0bd7de.synopsis: After her boyfriend stages a car accident to kill her, modern woman Skye awakens in another world as Zoe, the new empress of the Kingdom of Legumid. Surrounded by deadly court intrigue, including a powerful minister who looks exactly like her betrayer, and an emperor feared as a tyrant, Zoe uses wit and courage to survive. Fighting for her life and the throne, she earns the emperor's unwavering devotion, and together they defy fate to escape a tragic destiny.
694b5a7da99ea818ed0bd7de.title: She Returned as Empress

694b8951cbd1a2b15405f2bd.synopsis: Millie, the governor's daughter, survives a massacre but loses her memory. Rescued by Weston, she enters a cold three-year marriage she believes is salvation until her memories return. The marriage was a lie, designed to hide Weston and his first love's crimes against her family. Millie escapes and joins forces with Julian, a powerful commander who has loved her for years, reclaiming her past and exacting revenge.
694b8951cbd1a2b15405f2bd.title: Burned, Betrayed, Becoming

694b91f8eb29f601ef08937a.synopsis: Sheila and Sawyer dedicated their lives to raising their son, Ryan, only to be taken advantage of by him and his wife, Luna, under the guise of "boundaries", which led to Sawyer's untimely death. After a profound awakening, Sheila reclaims her assets, reveals the truth, and severs ties with her ungrateful son, ultimately donating her wealth to charity.
694b91f8eb29f601ef08937a.title: Since You Asked for Boundaries

694b921487e645610a0572b1.synopsis: Neil Ford, a corporate CEO and avid angler, meets a tragic end at the hands of his wife Vivian and her lover Jensen during a fishing trip. Cast into the lake, he transforms into a fish and awakens to a Shock-to-Evolve system. While Vivian schemes to swiftly claim Neil's inheritance, she faces resistance from his parents. Now, with the lives of Neil's parents on the line, he has to farm points and protect his family.
694b921487e645610a0572b1.title: Reborn as a Fish

694b927e3862391fa5023540.synopsis: Deceived by her first love, Winter believes her husband, Simon, married her for money and turns her back on both him and their daughter. She never realizes Simon has been secretly supporting her, while the man she trusts is stealing his research and her fortune. When the truth comes out, Simon leaves, their daughter chooses another mother, and Winter is left with nothing but regret.
694b927e3862391fa5023540.title: The Walls Between Us

694b929b8252bf363700d09b.synopsis: Just before their thirtieth wedding anniversary, Patricia discovers her husband William is proposing to his first love, Linda, who claims she's terminally ill. Doubting the story, Patricia enlists their son to investigate, revealing Linda's deception at the wedding. With the truth uncovered, Patricia decisively ends her marriage, leaving William in deep regret.
694b929b8252bf363700d09b.title: After the I Do

694c357b064f1471500ea852.synopsis: After witnessing her mother's murder at the hands of gods, Aria believes one thing: gods are heartless. One day she kills a mysterious golden lamb to feed her starving family—unaware that it's a sacred creature of Olympus. She comes face-to-face with her mother's killer, the Immortal Champion of Olympus - Kairos, who brings her back to Olympus to face justice. Through her journey, she learns of her real identity, the strength that she holds, and the heartbreaking truth behind Kairos' violent history. Together, they face danger, overcome trauma, and learn to accept their Fates that bind them together for eternity.
694c357b064f1471500ea852.title: The Daughter of Zeus

694cdb318524a8ab070e019c.synopsis: Orphan Erin Bourn, consumed by jealousy, uses a mysterious candy to swap bodies with the privileged Sep Pena. Erin seizes Sep's life, reveling in her family, love, and opportunities, while the real Sep is unjustly declared insane and confined to a mental institution. As the deceitful heiress becomes ensnared in her own lies, Sep, armed with the trust and aid of her loyal friend, orchestrates a daring fight to reclaim her identity.
694cdb318524a8ab070e019c.title: Trapped in Her Skin, Switched by Fate's Spin

694dec05fda650e8820eb4ec.synopsis: Quinn Addams, a Martial Warrior at Level Eight, is tricked by his master to leave the sect and fulfill an engagement. However, the Nolan family dismisses him as a cultivation reject, pushing their ailing daughter, Rossa, into the marriage in place of their favored daughter, Chloe. As the Nolan family heaps humiliation upon him and attempts to break the betrothal, they remain unaware that this "weak" reject is in fact a master swordsman, hiding his true power.
694dec05fda650e8820eb4ec.title: The Swordsman's Rise

694dec24a6ca10d77e0e5c5f.synopsis: After three years in a coma, Vivian wakes to find her life stolen. Her husband Zane and the maid's daughter, Claire, have seized her company, erased her identity, and tormented her daughter, Lily. Stripped of everything, Vivian must play a dangerous game. Using her wits and hidden allies, she exposes the betrayal, unveils the deception, and fights to reclaim her empire, her name, and her child's future.
694dec24a6ca10d77e0e5c5f.title: Mother's Justice

694e2700ece4a728ad09824b.synopsis: Sadie has always been a good girl, but she falls for Ethan, her sister's rival. To please him, they indulge in many secret, scandalous encounters. After a passionate camping trip, Sadie discovers the shocking truth: Ethan's love was a revenge scheme against her sister. Sadie is heartbroken and makes the painful decision to walk away.
694e2700ece4a728ad09824b.title: He Loved Her Sister First

6952227b0e44c1fbe20f2d4c.synopsis: He’s her Hot Boss. She’s his employee. But when she sends him a pic of her boobs by mistake, desire, scandal, and secrets turn the office–and her heart–upside down.
6952227b0e44c1fbe20f2d4c.title: Help! My Hot Boss Has My Nudes!

695247078c28ccad9e0a5ff9.synopsis: After her husband David Jones dies unexpectedly, Gina Clark finds herself fighting on all fronts: Sylvia, the pregnant mistress, demands a share of the inheritance; David's greedy family closes in; and even her own daughter, Eva, grows distant. But Gina has two powerful weapons—the gold David secretly converted, and a recording that could ruin everyone.
695247078c28ccad9e0a5ff9.title: Buried in His Lies

69533f4e68989593f20bdcef.synopsis: In the movie Wrong, based on the novel by Jana Aston, Sophie Tisdale has a foolproof plan to lose her virginity before senior year ends...until someone informs her that her partner-to-be has a bet on whether he can film taking her v-card. That someone being Luke, her gorgeous coffee shop regular....slash her new pelvic examiner. How wrong is it to have a thing for your campus gynecologist...and why doesn't Sophie really seem to care?
69533f4e68989593f20bdcef.title: Wrong

69533fa40d738245c80f63ab.synopsis: Reborn after Felicia’s past-life bullying—where her identity was stolen and it ultimately led to her death—Arya is determined to claim her rightful place as a mafia heiress. She sets out to outwit and humiliate Felicia at every opportunity, protect her friends, move deftly under the radar while unleashing her past-life combat skills, when everyone gonna realize she is the real mafia heiress？
69533fa40d738245c80f63ab.title: Out of My Way! The Reborn Mafia Queen Is Here

6953403c4fa672d60903468b.synopsis: Natalia has been betrayed and pushed off a cliff by her uncle's family three times! Each time, she's saved by Kieran, a nine-tailed fox, and then killed by him. This time, she impulsively kisses Kieran, hoping to change her fate. But she accidentally consumes his core and inherits his powers. Now it's her chance to turn things around.
6953403c4fa672d60903468b.title: Oops, I Snagged That Fox's Heart

695346540d806d7bcd0d780d.synopsis: Elite operative Henry is assigned as the personal bodyguard to Paige, a cold-blooded CEO at the center of corporate warfare. As assassination attempts and boardroom traps collide, Henry’s battlefield instincts and business savvy become her strongest shield. What begins as protection turns into an alliance, as the two join forces to dismantle a powerful enemy plotting their downfall.
695346540d806d7bcd0d780d.title: Danger & Desire

695349e215a2e6782f094634.synopsis: After returning home, Lee Group CEO Esther is publicly humiliated by a woman claiming to be her son's wife. She soon discovers her son's affair and his plan to use her welcome-back party to legitimize his mistress. Esther stays silent and strikes back at the party, stripping her son of succession and naming her daughter-in-law Rachel as the new heir.
695349e215a2e6782f094634.title: Mistress, You Picked the Wrong Mother

695354a7f72be7b70f08a886.synopsis: Forced to marry into Wildmare, Princess Yetta expects a brute husband and a life of hardship. But the "worthless" stones are pure jade, the "broken" carts hide endless herds, and her rugged husband, Alistair Belmont, is no tribesman—he is the Emperor of the mighty Daurevia Empire. As her sister flaunts a royal wedding, Yetta steps into a gilded cage of secrets, where every lie unravels a truth more dazzling than the last.
695354a7f72be7b70f08a886.title: The Bride Hides a Crown No One Sees

695354ec1526979a8b0b1b3e.synopsis: While delivering takeout, Joseph Grant inadvertently witnesses a woman stealing confidential files from the Azure Group. Initially mistaken for a creep by the staff, Joseph clears his name with the help of Serena Jenning. Impressed by his ability to resolve the ensuing company crisis, Serena asks Joseph to pose as her boyfriend. Meanwhile, Joseph's admirer, known as Black Widow, is unwilling to back down, sparking a fierce rivalry between the two women.
695354ec1526979a8b0b1b3e.title: The Delivery Guy They Mocked Is a Legend

695368d179dc994a5a0c4fa9.synopsis: Bonnie was born into wealth and privilege, but thanks to Isabel’s schemes, she married the wrong man, suffering disfigurement, betrayal, and the ruin of her family. Reborn, she quietly sets her sights on the seemingly lowly adopted son of the Nail family. Only she knows that this boy, now overlooked, is destined for greatness. Power, wealth, and influence await him.
695368d179dc994a5a0c4fa9.title: His Secret Heiress

69537e8be0479ae9a50e4bb3.synopsis: Abandoned and left with nothing, Emily sets her grandmother’s house on fire and runs straight into Sawyer Lewis, the bloodied heir of a powerful family. He takes her in, planning to use her to overturn a ruthless power game. But Emily refuses to be anyone's pawn. As she strikes back and breaks every rule, Sawyer finds himself falling for the very chaos he tried to control. Together, they burn their enemies down and save each other in the process.
69537e8be0479ae9a50e4bb3.title: Falling for the Thorned Rose

6953836fb6b562d4da001ebf.synopsis: Banished from the heavens for meddling in divine gossip, the god of wealth reincarnated as Penny, a newlywed rural girl who was unwelcome by her in-laws and ultimately killed by her husband's childhood sweetheart. Now reborn, Penny decides to rewrite her fate. However, the Shane family discovers they can hear her thoughts! Initially skeptical and dismissive of Penny's warnings, they gradually realize the truth as her thoughts repeatedly prove accurate, turning their world upside down.
6953836fb6b562d4da001ebf.title: Hey There, I Can Hear Your Heart!

6953870e168b78cd2209fa5b.synopsis: In Husite, Sebastian is untouchable, protected by his wife Victoria, childhood friend Phoebe, and sister Lyla. However, on his twenty-ninth birthday, tragedy strikes when Lyla is brutally assaulted to death. To Sebastian's horror, Victoria takes the stand to defend the criminal, and Phoebe pressures him to sign a letter of forgiveness. Reeling from this double betrayal, Sebastian dials a mysterious number said to solve any problem.
6953870e168b78cd2209fa5b.title: Betrayed, Then Unstoppable

6953875732b03e71e508b1e8.synopsis: In her past life, she and her husband grew up as adoptive siblings, became spouses, and spent a lifetime together until old age. When both are reborn, she believes fate has given them a second chance only to discover that he has always had a woman he couldn't forget. This time, he abandons her without hesitation. Left behind, she is adopted into another family and chooses to walk a completely different path, starting a new life without him.
6953875732b03e71e508b1e8.title: Reborn to Shine

6954bfc3a3563a69c30871ad.synopsis: Eleanor Chase marries Duke Vincent Jordan only to discover his entanglements with a powerful concubine and a flirtatious sister-in-law. Despite his disdain for her traditional ways, Eleanor deftly deals with family drama, concubine's provocations, and the sister-in-law's schemes. As the rightful mistress of the house, it's her duty to manage the Duke's affairs, including the Duke himself!
6954bfc3a3563a69c30871ad.title: Hubby, Let’s See Who Rules This House

695619e797ec9754e20d31eb.synopsis: On the day of her wedding to Lucas Kirk, Angelina Alvarez, daughter of a billionaire, faces shocking accusations about the paternity of her unborn child. Defying medical advice, the Kirk family pressures her into an amniocentesis. Thankfully, her father's medical team intervenes, ensuring the child's safety and leaving the Kirk family full of remorse. Empowered by her newfound independence, Angelina inherits her family's fortune and embarks on a journey to live life by her own rules.
695619e797ec9754e20d31eb.title: Humiliated at My Wedding

69561b183274f2937c0bac80.synopsis: At 8, Samuel meets Sage, a girl who heals his heart and his legs at a sanatorium. Sixteen years later, as the head of the Grant family, Samuel vows to find her. But after years of searching, she's nowhere to be found until the Smith family's second daughter, forced into marriage, unexpectedly enters his life. A journey of lost love, unexpected marriage, and a touch of humor awaits.
69561b183274f2937c0bac80.title: We Met Long Before the Wedding

69561b675ada4908ca07a82e.synopsis: After being transported into a book, Claire finds herself framed into marrying Sean—the man originally meant for her sister. Adaptable by nature, she channels her energy into securing wealth, knowing money is the true source of power. But on their wedding night, Sean drops a bombshell: he has an incurable disease. What follows is a marriage of convenience between a gold‑digger and a reckless noble, where Claire masterfully transforms the young lord from a playboy into the perfect "henpecked" husband.
69561b675ada4908ca07a82e.title: Trapped in the Book, Married to My Enemy

69561c1c165b1f1beb0140fd.synopsis: Shaw Claude, the family outcast, has suffered a decade of humiliation in a graveyard. In his darkest moments, the seemingly frail gravekeeper reveals her true identity and helps him awaken his powers. As Shaw ascends to immortality, the demons arrive. An epic showdown across the realms of mortals, demons, and immortals has now begun!
69561c1c165b1f1beb0140fd.title: Despised No More: The Dragon's Ascension

695634fdff4538cc4c03777b.synopsis: Dustin Curran felt like a spare son. He was sent to his grandfather in the countryside right after his birth, while his parents raised his adopted brother by their side. When he returned home after his grandfather passed away, he was immediately cast into the Clearwind Sect, where he improved his cultivation. One day, his parents suddenly showed up and demended him to wed Linda Collins, who was terminally ill. But Dustin is no longer the spare son they dismissed. They begged him to leave the sect, only to regret it.
695634fdff4538cc4c03777b.title: He's Not A Spare Son

6959fd84ca1efc57bf008edc.synopsis: After burying her mother, Mia is abandoned by her relatives and left to fend for herself. A twist of fate awakens her ability to understand animals, leading her into the world of billionaire Julian Ford, who brings her into his powerful family. With her rare gift and kind heart, Mia helps the Fords overcome crisis after crisis, gradually winning everyone over, including her cold, disabled uncle. The girl no one wanted becomes the family's most treasured miracle.
6959fd84ca1efc57bf008edc.title: Animal Whispering Led to My Uncle Team!

6959ff61906534418c0d2861.synopsis: In Nanny to My Hot Bully movie, Abbi is Felix's rival... and nanny. Things take a complicated turn when she moves into his house to care for him and his sister and Felix and Abbi realize their feelings for each other. Can Abbi hide her feelings for Felix to keep her nannying job?
6959ff61906534418c0d2861.title: Nanny to My Hot Bully

695a08034eab773058020d85.synopsis: After cryptocurrency guru Kevin Kirk's tragic leap in 2025, he finds himself transported back to 2021, inhabiting the body of Ziggy, a down-and-out crypto enthusiast. Realizing he's returned to a pivotal moment before meeting his girlfriend Luna and on the eve of the infamous May 19th crash, Kevin senses a chance to amend past regrets. However, as he guides Ziggy to success, he uncovers an unexpected truth about his time travel...
695a08034eab773058020d85.title: Reborn Before Bitcoin Fell

695a3cf8e3267b6f1b0527e4.synopsis: Forced into a marriage with Leon Reed, Diana Quinn enters the Reed family with a vast dowry. On her wedding day, she's greeted not with respect, but with a cold husband, his lover, and a family plotting to seize her fortune. But she is no delicate flower—she's a battle-hardened warrior with iron resolve. Slapping down schemes and threatening the imperial court, she turns her dowry into a weapon and the mansion into her battlefield.
695a3cf8e3267b6f1b0527e4.title: The Iron Bride of the Marquis House

695a3d11cad75777ce0cb159.synopsis: On her son's wedding anniversary, mahjong-obsessed Grace leaves her granddaughter Coco alone in the kitchen. When Coco video-calls her mother, Rachel, she senses danger, but the call cuts off. Grace ignores repeated calls, and Rachel‘s husband Luke dismisses her concerns while out with his first love. By the time Rachel arrives, Coco has died from gas poisoning, exposing a tragedy born of neglect and blind obedience.
695a3d11cad75777ce0cb159.title: Unanswered Calls, Lingering Regret

695a3d4eb8fe2034fe00eca0.synopsis: Oliver Logan is the wealthiest man in the world, but even his vast fortune can't hold onto Chloe Stone. Confident in Oliver's love, Chloe brazenly uses his money to support her lover. Once Oliver sees her true colors, he finally awakens to the truth. Now, he's going to tell them he's marrying someone else and ensure they lose everything!
695a3d4eb8fe2034fe00eca0.title: Peace Out, I'm Marrying Someone Else

695a41a4fb85e456cf0c3824.synopsis: Jean attended a family gathering arranged by her father, Chairman Taylor. But Jean was mistakenly identified as her dad's mistress by his girlfriend, Vivian. Vivian publicly humiliated Jean. Later, Jean joined her dad's company undercover to investigate. Vivian claimed Chairman Taylor would marry her. While everyone was flattering Vivian known as Chairman's fiancee, Jean quietly gathered evidence of Vivian's corruption and brought her to justice.
695a41a4fb85e456cf0c3824.title: Don't Mess With the Heiress

695b1f55ad96ed0d6b0dbdb7.synopsis: After an unexpected encounter where ordinary youth Ben angrily confronts the God of Wealth, he is gifted with the Wealth Eye. This divine ability allows him to identify priceless antiques and amass wealth overnight, while also seeing through deceptions and plots. Teaming up with the cold but brilliant CEO Claire, he battles rivals and unravels deep-seated family conspiracies. Through his journey, Ben ultimately discovers the true meaning of wealth and completely transforms his destiny.
695b1f55ad96ed0d6b0dbdb7.title: Through the Eyes of Wealth

695b236dd498342ee30bcd7c.synopsis: Vanessa Lewis, a merchant's daughter married into the prestigious but hypocritical Hayes family. After a life spent giving everything—only to be betrayed, discarded, and left to die—she awakens reborn on the day her household is exiled. This time, armed with foresight and her hidden wealth, she refuses to play the victim. As the Hayes family struggles on the bitter road to exile, Vanessa turns the tables, exposing their greed and arrogance while securing her own survival.
695b236dd498342ee30bcd7c.title: When the Fallen Prince Met the Unbroken Woman

695b33abd5add69e910e85cc.synopsis: Best friends Summer and Faye are unexpectedly thrust into the world of a novel, assuming the roles of the devoted wife to the shrewd Adrian Watson and the stand-in lover for the possessive Julian Watson. While they seem ensnared in unrequited love, they secretly revel in the opulent lifestyle of the elite. But, the return of Mia Piper, another key heroine, shatters their tranquil existence. To escape the looming tragic fate, they devise a daring plan to fake their own deaths. Unbeknownst to them, their "deaths" push Adrian and Julian to the brink of despair. Then, a chance encounter brings the four back together again...
695b33abd5add69e910e85cc.title: Love Wasn't the Plan

695b36c00ac5fd03aa06a06d.synopsis: Best friends Summer and Faye are unexpectedly thrust into the world of a novel, assuming the roles of the devoted wife to the shrewd Adrian Watson and the stand-in lover for the possessive Julian Watson. While they seem ensnared in unrequited love, they secretly revel in the opulent lifestyle of the elite. But, the return of Mia Piper, another key heroine, shatters their tranquil existence. To escape the looming tragic fate, they devise a daring plan to fake their own deaths. Unbeknownst to them, their "deaths" push Adrian and Julian to the brink of despair. Then, a chance encounter brings the four back together again...
695b36c00ac5fd03aa06a06d.title: Love Wasn't the Plan

695b8ef7b071a807260e63d9.synopsis: Lina is the first scholarship student in Saint Toria Academy. Sponsored by the board member, Ms. Sterling, Lina resides with her and forms a close bond with her son, Chase. At school, Lina smartly earns money by solving her classmates' problems for a fee. However, a new scholarship student, Celine, is getting jealous.
695b8ef7b071a807260e63d9.title: Before Love, Become Yourself

695cc956a48d21b3e10bb2ed.synopsis: After being murdered by the daughter he raised, the billionaire Richard Sutton learns a devastating truth: she was never his real child. Reborn in 2005, he vows to reclaim his empire, expose the ruthless Lauren Sutton, and find his true daughter Jocelyn Hayes—now a struggling intern within his own company. This time, Richard must outsmart the impostor who stole his life… before she takes everything from him again.
695cc956a48d21b3e10bb2ed.title: My Daughter, My Killer

695cd825cc5310bb510fea0f.synopsis: Fed up with her entitled longtime maid, businesswoman Leah hires a new housekeeper, Hope. Instead of leaving, the old maid escalates, harassing Hope, hiding behind past favors, and dragging Leah's mother-in-law into the conflict. As the household descends into chaos, only Hope stays, quietly supporting Leah when everything else falls apart.
695cd825cc5310bb510fea0f.title: The True Housekeeper

695cded9949a9a81b10ac56f.synopsis: The female CEO Eleanor has tried to find her birth mother for 20 years and finally got some news. Unexpectedly, a human trafficker Victor wanted to scam Eleanor for her money. So they let Janet replace her real mother who was imprisoned and abused. Because of birthmark inconsistency and memory deviation, Eleanor started doubting the fake mother. She found out about their trap and finally saved her real mom. And those bad people also got punished...
695cded9949a9a81b10ac56f.title: Mom, I'm Here for You

695dbb2265bdd5f6190e9580.synopsis: Celine Samuel, the chairwoman of Samuel Group, is about to marry Harry Chase. When she humbly goes to pick up Harry's mother at the airport, she's mistaken for his mistress—while Harry's glamorous mistress Amy is embraced as the future daughter-in-law. Now, Celine must endure public humiliation from Harry's mother, who has no idea she's insulting the real boss.
695dbb2265bdd5f6190e9580.title: The Bride They Never Expected

695dbc8948c136a15305c7e7.synopsis: Lola has been serving loyally by Nancy Sinclair's side. Together like sisters, they overcame countless obstacles, with Nancy eventually becoming the Empress of the Zhouland and Lola rising to the Court Lady. After a diligent career in the palace, Lola finds herself unexpectedly transported to a new life as the daughter of the Sinclair family's maid. To her astonishment, the true daughter from the countryside is the spitting image of the Empress. However, unlike the confident Nancy she knew, this young woman is timid and overshadowed by the fake heiress. Determined to help her doppelgänger, Lola sets out to empower this new Nancy. Together, they confront the manipulative impostor, challenge biased parents, and embark on a bold new chapter of life!
695dbc8948c136a15305c7e7.title: Lady-in-Waiting vs. Lady Fake

695dbd24bea58dde9e0cb55a.synopsis: After dying on the ancient battlefield, General Nydia Gerwen wakes up as a modern heiress. Forced to marry Hayden Jackson—the city's most notorious playboy—she does what she knows best: she tames her wayward husband like a new recruit, crushes her scheming family, and turns the business world into her new battlefield. From war zones to wedding vows, this general fights for her throne in the modern age.
695dbd24bea58dde9e0cb55a.title: General's Husband, Playboy's Cage

695dbd77d662b15bdc0dfcfd.synopsis: Princess Serena is sent to marry into the rival kingdom of Karnak—only to be captured by the bandit, Killian Young. She fights her way into the royal palace, but discovers the emperor bedridden… and identical to Killian, who enters the palace in disguise. With the powerful regent Victor Ewing lusting after her, Serena must play a dangerous game of seduction and strategy. From bedchamber to throne, she becomes the bait—and he, the shield.
695dbd77d662b15bdc0dfcfd.title: My Bandit Lover is the Emperor

695dc6ce6b14fea44b0897ac.synopsis: Blessed with rare fertility, Sylvia Sims was destined to marry Hugh, the adopted heir of Marquis Ethan McCarthy. Yet on their wedding day, Hugh demanded to take a concubine alongside her. Refusing to share her husband, Sylvia boldly called off the marriage—and instead wed the Marquis himself. Enraged, Hugh schemed to ruin them, only to be stripped of his title in disgrace. Meanwhile, Sylvia joyfully conceived the Marquis's own heir, securing a legacy of love and power.
695dc6ce6b14fea44b0897ac.title: My Ex Dumped Me... So I Become His Stepmom

695dc6e90ff82ae5f60db17a.synopsis: Thea, the Reed family's heiress, discovers her fiancé, Henry, has been letting his friend Lynn eavesdrop on their private moments. Henry accuses her of overreacting. After pressure from his parents, Thea gives him one last chance. But Henry, along with his friends, continues to humiliate her. When he learns Thea has secretly married the most influential man in the city and realizes he's just a pawn in the Grants' game, he's shattered.
695dc6e90ff82ae5f60db17a.title: No More Nice Girl

695df77a79838e53230c58b9.synopsis: After cultivating for three thousand years, Immortal Sovereign Finn returns home only to find loan sharks threatening his daughter. He crushes them instantly, but learns his child has been poisoned. To save her, Finn raids a medicine guild for the legendary Frost Lotus, subdues a famed healer, and hunts down the traitor who ruined him five years ago. Once dismissed as dead, he rises again, protecting his family and making Riverton's elites kneel.
695df77a79838e53230c58b9.title: An Immortal Dad's Wrath

695df7bcef0654eb5a0d7350.synopsis: Dumped for her poor background, Sabrina Shaw is struck by lightning, awakening x-ray vision via her grandma's bracelet. She dives into the high-stakes jade gambling world, uncovering rare treasures one after another, outwits her enemies, and seizes control of Bennett Jewelry and the Jade Association. Her legendary comeback culminates when she unveils the mythical Imperial Green at the grand Jade Expo.
695df7bcef0654eb5a0d7350.title: Queen of Seeing Through Lies

695df7f07f6b51dccd0f40d9.synopsis: Ethan Hayes gets a second chance at life after a tragic past. Reborn with mystical powers, he is determined to rewrite his destiny. Now, he must use his newfound abilities to protect his family from deadly threats, settle scores from his previous life, and face a shadowy organization lurking in the city's underworld.
695df7f07f6b51dccd0f40d9.title: To Shield My Family, I Became A God

695df81e7b6daf462601de1b.synopsis: As Cecilia, the daughter of the wealthiest family, prepares to give birth, she announces that her husband, Nathan, will succeed her as CEO. However, she remains unaware that Nathan has been unfaithful and is expecting a child with his lover...
695df81e7b6daf462601de1b.title: The Pregnant Heiress Takes It All

695df8a7595ca78ce009dbb3.synopsis: Sally Saunder is forced to marry Quentin Sterling. Trapped in a gilded cage, she makes a shocking discovery: Quentin is actually Chase—the boy she once saved from death, now returned under a stolen identity to destroy the family that ruined his. As Quentin's obsession with Sally deepens, she is torn between the gentle memory of her childhood protector and the dangerous, vengeance-driven man he has become.
695df8a7595ca78ce009dbb3.title: He Came Back for Me

695e03a10b6e495cfa0c7cda.synopsis: A group of female friends reunite for a New Year's Eve celebration but old tensions resurface and past rivalries reignite, causing the night to descend into chaos and sparks and revelations to fly like fireworks.
695e03a10b6e495cfa0c7cda.title: Friends, Foes & Fireworks

695e03f0759bd4478f0599e8.synopsis: Four sisters, as different as the cities they were named after, return home to mourn their mother’s alleged suicide and discover a secret that could tear them apart.
695e03f0759bd4478f0599e8.title: Sister Cities

695e05160a41e2a8af04ff5f.synopsis: With the threat of having to close her father’s candy store, Wendy and her 5-year-old daughter travel to the big city in the hope of making enough money to save it.
695e05160a41e2a8af04ff5f.title: Christmas in the City

695e0726f68e932d050911cd.synopsis: A young woman from a privileged life falls for a soup kitchen owner after discovering a Dear Santa letter written by his 7-year-old daughter.
695e0726f68e932d050911cd.title: Dear Santa

695e0776cca0ba06860950db.synopsis: Suspicious of her sister Audrey's sudden death, Samantha Monroe marries her brother-in-law to uncover the truth. Facing a harsh and stingy mother-in-law, Samantha uses her wit and resilience to fight back, determined to expose the truth and seek justice.
695e0776cca0ba06860950db.title: After Becoming His Bride

695e0787a466a47b7a007048.synopsis: Shawn gave Joyce Lynn and Lynn Tech his genius. They gave him a dismissal letter in return. With the help of Rachel, the investor, Shawn turns his exile into a revolution. Now, the woman who wronged him watches as the empire she built is dismantled, line by line of code.
695e0787a466a47b7a007048.title: Hacked by Fate

695e42b65394a9a4140357bd.synopsis: CHARIOT is a twisty, claustrophobic thriller that AIN'T IT COOL NEWS calls "Intense," "Incredibly powerful," and "Almost pitch perfect!" Starring Anthony Montgomery (STAR TREK: ENTERPRISE).
695e42b65394a9a4140357bd.title: Chariot

695f15727f0230b5d50e04f3.synopsis: Sheila and Sawyer dedicated their lives to raising their son, Ryan, only to be taken advantage of by him and his wife, Luna, under the guise of "boundaries", which led to Sawyer's untimely death. After a profound awakening, Sheila reclaims her assets, reveals the truth, and severs ties with her ungrateful son, ultimately donating her wealth to charity.
695f15727f0230b5d50e04f3.title: Since You Asked for Boundaries

695f17baf52a835e5306ca5c.synopsis: Elena is chair of the Cooper Group. She handed the company over to her husband, Dalton. Elena returns to board of directors after a 5-year absence, but no one at the company recognizes her anymore. Elena is met with a workplace full of gossip, bullying, and rumors. Many speculate that "Dalton's wife" is some old hag. Flora, Dalton's secretary, has repeatedly, unsuccessfully tried to seduce him. One day, Flora sees Dalton and Elena sharing affection, and believes Elena to be his mistress. Then, she finds out Elana is pregnant. Wanting to be Dalton's mistress herself, Flora sets her sights on tormenting Elena, and forcing her out of the picture.
695f17baf52a835e5306ca5c.title: Now You Know Who I Am

695f47a4d7b8047ce006c029.synopsis: A family of homesteaders is taken captive by a gang of outlaws in this cat-and-mouse Western thriller. Their survival comes to rest in the hands of Irene, a loud-mouthed 12-year-old girl who's got an uncanny knack for shooting guns.
695f47a4d7b8047ce006c029.title: Homestead

695f49840e2a1c138b0aa589.synopsis: Alex has always loved Rachel but never made an attempt to ask her out. He finally gets a chance but unfortunately life had other plans.
695f49840e2a1c138b0aa589.title: One More Time

695f4b97e2429b3f87054b76.synopsis: On her wedding day, Evelyn is shockingly replaced by her best friend and accused of murder by her fiancé, leading to her wrongful death. Now reborn, her first mission is to gather evidence while continuing to attend the wedding as the bride. Only this time, she launches a counterattack instead. The wedding is now a public apology event for the deceitful couple.
695f4b97e2429b3f87054b76.title: To Love, To Loathe, To Return

695f4e499302a867700b9c4c.synopsis: An estranged woman joins her sister’s family in their house after her husband is found mysteriously murdered. She vows her innocence while determined to take her sister’s family and make it her own.
695f4e499302a867700b9c4c.title: Twisted Sister

695f6a86d2b152adb302b7e6.synopsis: Desperate to be financially stable enough to get their daughter back from foster care, two grifters try to con a lonely entrepreneur out of his Bitcoin fortune but get in deep trouble when they find he is not who he claims to be.
695f6a86d2b152adb302b7e6.title: Bitcoin Baby

695f6b771f2e2e4c5d0e74b2.synopsis: While investigating the brutal murder of her parents, a young woman is kidnapped, raped, and left for dead. On All Hallows Eve, she comes back dressed as a blood-thirsty pussycat keen on taking the souls of the men who destroyed her world.
695f6b771f2e2e4c5d0e74b2.title: Kitty Kills

695f6bad2d9546e4590a0197.synopsis: Nest of Vampires follows an MI5 agent who travels from London to rural England in search of the people who murdered his wife and kidnapped his only daughter. During his investigation, he uncovers a ruthless vampiric cult.
695f6bad2d9546e4590a0197.title: Nest of Vampires

695f6cd75a66f7163101ed47.synopsis: Heel'd, courageously delves into the darkest corners of humanity, exploring the painful consequences of religious prejudice and domestic violence. Can Angela escape the circle of violence and destruction?
695f6cd75a66f7163101ed47.title: Heel'D

695f6cf89f47fcc5bf066bcf.synopsis: Amidst the hills of Tuscany, three friends embark on a vacation that turns into an unexpected romantic adventure. They discover love with three sisters running a picturesque bed and breakfast, igniting the fury of their grandfather.
695f6cf89f47fcc5bf066bcf.title: Love Wine & Salt: A Tuscan Romance

695f92e88a4689f33701658b.synopsis: Nora was called a murderer's daughter and she was Ryan's kept woman. Ryan looked down on her and didn't want his family or friends to meet her. Ryan's uncle Paul was saved by Nora a long time ago, and he had loved this poor girl for many years. In his past life, Nora killed herself after knowing Ryan had a fiancee. In this lifetime, Paul would be Nora's loyal knight. Paul decided to help her shine in her career and earn respect again. Ryan only got to regret, but Nora would only choose Paul.
695f92e88a4689f33701658b.title: His Only Exception

695f9f352067503c6509418e.synopsis: In her first life, Anna Young tricked Cyrus Lewis into marriage, only to lose him and their son Leo to her gambling debts. Reborn at the start of her mistakes, Anna is determined to rewrite her destiny. Now, she must use her foreknowledge of the 1980s economic boom to build an empire from scratch, while desperately trying to win back the trust of the family she once destroyed. But her vengeful rival, Cindy Yates, won't make it easy.
695f9f352067503c6509418e.title: Mama's Second Chance

695f9f537c6ad272200e3daa.synopsis: Three years ago, Hades Cross was dispatched on a mission abroad and became a legend among the mercenaries. Now, returning home, his new mission is to investigate the Styx Syndicate. Hired as Diana Chase's personal bodyguard, Hades finds that the danger escalates with every step he takes.
695f9f537c6ad272200e3daa.title: The Reaper's Contract

695f9f7ae5b9528f24048b6f.synopsis: Sophia helped her husband Eric rise from an employee to General Manager of an airline. Sophia trusted Eric and would hand over her company to Eric. But Eric couldn't wait to use Sophia's airline Platinum VIP card to please his secret mistress, Donna. Later, Donna met Sophia who was inspecting the plane undercover. Sophia recognized her own VIP card, and knew her husband cheated on her with Donna. Donna, in order to show off, insulted Sophia badly. Eric sided with his mistress and asked Sophia to apologize.
695f9f7ae5b9528f24048b6f.title: She Was More Than the Woman in Uniform

695f9fd19593f02ef50c1ff9.synopsis: Ashamed of his market-selling wife, Shannon, Barrett divorces her for money and ambition. After inheriting a vast fortune, Shannon unexpectedly becomes CEO of Paxwell Group. When Barrett later seeks a partnership with the company, she gives him a chance until the board reveals her true identity, leaving him utterly stunned.
695f9fd19593f02ef50c1ff9.title: From Veggie Vendor to Billionaire

695f9fe569e5d5341100c0dc.synopsis: Clara, true heiress of the affluent Sinclair family, was switched at birth by a nanny and grew up in hardship in the countryside. Just as she was found by the Sinclairs, the false heiress Yasmin, desperate to hide her true origins, kills her own parents and frames Clara for the murder, resulting in a three-year prison sentence. Upon her release, Clara finds her family absent, celebrating Yasmin's birthday instead. Determined to reclaim her rightful place, Clara vows to expose Yasmin's deceit and rebuild her life, skillfully turning the tables to reclaim her ultimate destiny.
695f9fe569e5d5341100c0dc.title: I'm Reclaiming What's Mine

695fa01ec5979870f8091d2e.synopsis: After three years of abuse, Sasha divorces her domineering CEO husband and leaves endurance behind. Focused on her career, she rises fast as admirers gather around her. While her ex rages over the child he believes she lost, Sasha becomes a woman completely out of his reach. When he finally swallows his pride to win her back, he learns it may already be too late.
695fa01ec5979870f8091d2e.title: Too Late, Mr. CEO

695fa088474222253805e0ab.synopsis: Camille gained 120 pounds, saving her fiancé Astor, only to discover he faked his death to marry his sister-in-law Tina. After a stunning transformation, she returns with a powerful new ally: Charles Lester, the CEO who worships her. Together, they crash Astor's wedding, unveiling Camille's true identity as the hidden daughter of the "Godfather." Now, it's time for payback—and a billion-dollar "wedding gift" they'll never forget.
695fa088474222253805e0ab.title: Little Princess Came Back Radiant

69607a5875040ae49106f808.synopsis: In Love in the Ashes of us movie, Nina and Easton have been in love for ten years. She stands by him through everything, from his days as an unknown student to becoming a billionaire. But just as Easton reaches the height of his success, Nina catches him getting too close with his business partner, Candice. With Candice stirring the pot, Nina finally gives up on him completely. One day, the three of them board the same flight. Mid-air, the plane experiences a sudden emergency. During the crash landing, Easton chooses to protect Candice—leaving Nina, who is pregnant with twins, in critical danger...
69607a5875040ae49106f808.title: Love in the Ashes of us

69607a80f63b8b86be040acb.synopsis: Lila is five when her uncle Harold and aunt Karen abandon her. Jonathan, a kind billionaire, finds her and takes her home. He adopts her, and from that day, the house feels brighter. Lila brings luck and warmth. Noah, Jonathan’s son, has not spoken for a long time; with Lila by his side, he finally finds his voice. At an auction, she helps Jonathan win a hidden treasure chest. She even “talks” with the family dog and follows the hint to help Noah find his missing violin. When danger rises, Lila “forces” Harold and the schemer Vivienne to tell the truth. The lies fall apart. She helps the family get out of harm’s way, exposes the schemes, and leaves Harold, Karen, and Vivienne with nowhere to hide.
69607a80f63b8b86be040acb.title: Daddy I'm Your Lucky Star!

69607aa7d673539a86043fab.synopsis: In Sisterhood of Lies Pledge for Revenge movie, after Ashlyn dies in a sorority hazing “accident,” her identical twin sister June takes her place to get revenge on the real killers — Ashlyn’s back-stabbing bestie and her frat-bro boyfriend.
69607aa7d673539a86043fab.title: Sisterhood of Lies: Pledge for Revenge

6960be97385a8c9eb00c6986.synopsis: Ethan, the world champion of Go, met two gods on hills. They were playing chess. After taking over one round of the game for a god, 49 years had passed on Earth. They gifted him a Divine Peach, which turned him into a ten-year-old boy. Ethan returned home as a child, but was blocked by bodyguards, bullied by his grandson, and despised by his son-in-law. He solved the Exquisite Go Game to prove his identity and used the peach pit to wake up his wife. But there was another hidden story behind the family crisis.
6960be97385a8c9eb00c6986.title: Grandpa 2.0: Invincible at Ten

6960d2746ad45507a601e978.synopsis: After the death of chip genius Professor Lewis, his son Sawyer goes into hiding and is saved by Vivian, the heiress of Jones Group. Twelve years later, as the head of the company, Vivian joins the race to advance chip technology. When their paths cross again, they team up to fight back against their enemies, protect the nation's future, and find love amidst the chaos.
6960d2746ad45507a601e978.title: The Heiress's PhD Boyfriend

69645c72db46493aef007fb1.synopsis: Sarah Curren, an emergency room doctor, receives a call from her husband Harrison about a "canceled flight" during a surgery break, unaware he's actually at a hotel with her sister-in-law Mandy. Later, Harrison is hospitalized in a coma due to expired medication, revealing the truth to Sarah. Heartbroken, she also discovers her miscarriage was caused by Harrison and Mandy. Determined to reveal their betrayal, she exposes the scandal at Mandy's wedding to Harrison's brother...
69645c72db46493aef007fb1.title: I Found My Husband's Secret

69646638f794cfea3008e4ce.synopsis: Zane asked to divorce Sherry because his first love Bella came back. But he didn't know his wife was a hidden heiress. Her real name is Lilian. After divorce, Sherry took back everything she gave to Zane. Without Sherry's secret support and help, Zane's company and business were hard to maintain. He regretted it, but his wife would never come back.
69646638f794cfea3008e4ce.title: I Loved Her, I Lost Her

696466ba1cb873b1e004fb33.synopsis: Framed by her fiancé Justin and stepsister Kelly, Vivian Lee becomes the nation's most hated woman. But little do they know—her delivery-girl life was just a disguise. Now she’s back, ready to reveal she's the true heiress of the Lees. From livestream takedowns and family showdowns, to training the timid Ryan Shaw into a formidable heir, Vivian plays a ruthless game of power and payback.
696466ba1cb873b1e004fb33.title: She Owns Me Tonight

69648b16461885c1300eb2c3.synopsis: Verity Hall, the formidable Queen of Ado City, left three years ago to develop a cure for her daughter Rowena's rare disease. Upon her return, she discovers her husband has conspired with the maid, Julia, and their illegitimate daughter, Sylvia, to take over her household, subjecting Rowena to daily abuse that leaves her mentally unstable. Heartbroken, Verity decides to reclaim her identity and attend a banquet to settle old scores and exact her revenge.
69648b16461885c1300eb2c3.title: Touch My Daughter, Then Die

6965a5603ff2f6b33a044f8a.synopsis: Evan appears to be a plumber who left school to support his ailing father, but in reality, his father is a wealthy tycoon. During a repair job, he meets Serena, a school beauty, and after learning she's been disowned by her family, he offers her shelter. Then, the two decide to pretend to be a couple to handle their respective issues. Meanwhile, Tyler, who has feelings for Serena, retaliates by targeting Evan and undermining Serena's family business. It's not until Evan's supposedly ill parents reveal themselves that Tyler and Serena's father realize their mistake. Ultimately, Evan and Serena achieve both love and career success.
6965a5603ff2f6b33a044f8a.title: My Plumber Boyfriend Is a Hidden Heir

6965a64bfb953edfbf09caba.synopsis: Ethan, heir to a business empire and leader of Dragon Hall, rescues Sarah Sowle during a period of self-imposed exile in the city—an encounter that sparks a deep connection between them. Five years later, Sarah arrives with their daughter, Evie. Learning he has a child, Ethan is determined to make things right. Yet their path is fraught with hardship. But through Ethan's quiet but unwavering intervention, the trio overcome these threats to forge the peaceful family life they long for eventually.
6965a64bfb953edfbf09caba.title: Daddy Is Not Who You Think

6965acbc7413b7d7040ff2aa.synopsis: In her past life, Ellie was shamed as a bastard by her biased father and ultimately murdered by his beloved mistress. After death, she learns her world was a novel, and she was only a disposable character. Reborn in her mother's womb, Ellie plots from before birth. Using foresight and cunning, she wins the trust of the head of the Grant family, exposes a poisoning scheme, and drives her enemies out, securing justice and a future for herself and her mother.
6965acbc7413b7d7040ff2aa.title: Before I Was Born, I Planned Revenge

6965c0a7758134dd0c00abde.synopsis: Lena, a rich heiress, entered the Sutton Group as Eric's fiancée, with hiding her true identity. It was a childhood arranged marriage. Lena appeared to be addicted to gaming and neglecting her duties, but actually, she used business resources and connections of her family to clear all obstacles for Eric, helping his company go public, and elevating him to be a business tycoon. However, Eric was unaware of this. He blindly trusted his scheming assistant Sophie, and ignored Lena's care and kind reminders...
6965c0a7758134dd0c00abde.title: Oops, You Fired the Wrong Woman

6965c0f6b9f49d05e20f9fe9.synopsis: Wynne Sloan had it all: a business empire and a decade-long marriage to Frank Quinn—until a "car accident" took her unborn child and her ability to have more. She soon uncovers Frank's affair with her own sister, Yvonne, and realizes the crash was no accident. From CEO to betrayed wife, Wynne masterminds a cold, calculated takedown. She strips Frank of his titles, fortune, and sanity, while sending Yvonne where she belongs: behind bars.
6965c0f6b9f49d05e20f9fe9.title: A Recipe for Revenge

6965f51ccb7d531f4e05c0c0.synopsis: On the day the Stone family's second daughter is to be married, the long-dead eldest daughter returns, now inhabited by Ellie, a thousand-year-old immortal. Sent to repay a love debt, Ellie is bound to Sebastian, a cold and powerful heir who resents her across lifetimes. As she restores the fallen Stone clan and earns his love, Ellie finally breaks her love trial only to give up immortality to save him.
6965f51ccb7d531f4e05c0c0.title: Seduced by My Proud Fiance

69662532f776f773200f40a4.synopsis: Betrayed by the very father who doted on her, Nora Graham discovers his affection was a cruel lie to elevate her half-sister. After his ultimate betrayal leads to her family's ruin, death grants her a second chance. Reborn with hardened resolve, Nora returns to the glittering, cutthroat world of the Graham mansion. No longer the naive heiress, she plays the part of the dutiful daughter while quietly dismantling the conspiracy from within.
69662532f776f773200f40a4.title: Poison in the Honey

696701e9670f8577df040c8f.synopsis: On the eve of my son's engagement, I fly to Jefferton and buy the largest villa as a gift for my future daughter-in-law. By chance, I run into a woman bidding for the same mansion, only to discover she is my son's fiancée. Worse still, I uncover her secret: she cheated on my son, is pregnant with another man's child, and plans to pass it off as his. She flaunts her powerful backer, never realizing the man she's bragging about… is me.
696701e9670f8577df040c8f.title: I Sent My Son's Fiancée to Jail

6968442b73758d30a207bac3.synopsis: Reincarnated back to 1995, Wendy marries the aloof Charles Gould, heir to the Gould Garment Factory, to avoid a tragic fate orchestrated by her cousin Rachel. Unbeknownst to her, Charles has secretly loved her for years. Their relationship humorously transitions from a contractual agreement to a genuine commitment. As Wendy starts her own clothing business, Charles quietly supports her ambitions. Together, they navigate family conflicts and corporate rivalries, ultimately leading GGF to a successful IPO and crafting their own tale of romance and entrepreneurial success.
6968442b73758d30a207bac3.title: Tailor Wife & Her Protective Boss

69685874f215dd101d0d5356.synopsis: For sixteen years, Angelica has lived with a guilt she never deserved — her mother died giving birth to her. Neglected by her father, Martin, and despised by her brother, Christopher, she holds on to the only warmth he ever showed her. But when their cousin Madison moves in, even Christopher turns on her, wishing she were the one who had died. And in a way, he gets his wish when Angelica is diagnosed with cancer. But after her death, it’s Christopher’s world that begins to fall apart.
69685874f215dd101d0d5356.title: Dear Brother, You Loved Me Too Late

6968674a59095c2b4e0e5bd7.synopsis: In Ms. CEO's Baby Daddy Is the Merchant of Death movie, Connor Reed, the most powerful arms dealer in the world, saves a Charlotte Hayes and spends the night with her while he is undercover. Four years later, while still hiding, Charlotte shows up... with their child. Now Connor must keep both of them safe... without revealing his true identity.
6968674a59095c2b4e0e5bd7.title: Ms. CEO's Baby Daddy Is the Merchant of Death

69686b97f06795856c02c968.synopsis: To save her mother, whose body is turning into snake scales, Leah sells herself and is fatefully bound to Sean, the Serpent Lord, bearing nine serpent eggs. While Sean protects her, he is forced into a heavenly trial and leaves her behind. Alone, Leah returns home, only to be framed as a demon and nearly killed by her village. Sean returns in time to save her and discovers she is the daughter of his long-lost benefactor.
69686b97f06795856c02c968.title: The Serpent Lord Wraps Her Close

696886a296680e20b203d1f7.synopsis: In his previous life, Keith attempted to assassinate his enemy to avenge his parents, but was instead killed by his subordinates, dying with regret. Upon opening his eyes, he finds himself reborn at the age of ten and unexpectedly awakens the 'Golden Eyes' — an ability to see through the essence, value, and truth of all things. Now, it's his chance for revenge.
696886a296680e20b203d1f7.title: The Boy with Golden Eyes

6968a2ced0d13fab3f05b848.synopsis: The rich heiress Isabelle stole Natalie's fiance on her wedding. Natalie's father was too mad and fainted. Isabelle demanded that nobody go to treat Natalie's father. Natalie decided to take revenge. She went to seduce Isabelle's father Dominic. Dominic knew what Natalie was up to, but he still couldn't resist this young girl. He fell in love with her and married her. Natalie became Isabelle's stepmom and would take everything from Isabelle.
6968a2ced0d13fab3f05b848.title: Vengeance in the Veil

69698269996bd9e2d300c73a.synopsis: 18-year-old Blair Beaumont is the genius heiress of the richest family in the U.S. After spending three years preparing to take over the family business, she's ready to return home and announce herself the next successor. But Blair's world shatters once she sees her mother, once beloved in the household, now being beaten and branded a 'homewrecker' by Blair's three older brothers. Even her father has turned against her, replacing his wife with the family maid as 'Mrs. Beaumont.' What happened during Blair's absence? Can she expose the truth behind her family's betrayal and get justice for her mother?
69698269996bd9e2d300c73a.title: The Heiress Is Back, Three Brothers on Their Knees

6969829c8497ab0bef0e7956.synopsis: In The Vampire Prince's Bride movie, Scarlett was a lonely orphan, living in the streets when the Vampire Lord Sean saved her. Moved to pity, Sean took her home as his Thrall and lover, swearing a Blood Oath and promising to keep her safe. Their happy, loving days came to an end when the sexy, dangerous human girl Chelsea swooped in, seducing Sean away. Not only did Sean Turn Chelsea into a vampire, he let Chelsea drink from Scarlett as well. Obsessed with his new lover, Sean missed the night of their Blood Oath, leaving Scarlett to die. Humiliated and hurt, Scarlett finally chooses to live for herself, risking her life to leave Sean behind and sever their bond as Thrall and Master. As her life hangs in the balance, Vampire Prince Alder suddenly appears to save her. Grateful and intimidated by his kindness, Scarlett doesn't realize her new prince charming is someone she's helped before.
6969829c8497ab0bef0e7956.title: The Vampire Prince's Bride

6969a9bc23851a301804aa16.synopsis: Claire, daughter of a military family, was invincible on the battlefield. After her death, she finds herself in the body of the wife of Sebastian, CEO of Fowler Corp. To secure her independence, Claire agrees to a one-year marriage contract with him, promising to play the role of his wife in exchange for a house and a job upon divorce. Throughout the year, Claire not only outmaneuvers those who threaten her but also charms Sebastian's siblings. Sebastian gradually becomes captivated by her and embarks on a journey to win her heart.
6969a9bc23851a301804aa16.title: Battlefield to Boudoir: She Rules Them All

6969e8c4ea4252c16601e757.synopsis: A thousand years ago, Evangeline sacrificed herself to protect Alexander, the Nine-Tailed Deity, from Archfiend in the celestial realm. Grieving, Alexander facilitated her reincarnation, vowing to reunite with her. In the present, college student Selena is rescued from a car accident by a mysterious Nine-Tailed Deity. Using a mystical coin, she discovers Alexander, now the CEO of Halo Corp. As Alexander searches for the reincarnated Evangeline, their lives become entangled, but altering mortal fate brings divine repercussions...
6969e8c4ea4252c16601e757.title: Fated With My Fox CEO

6969ec89b489868c71008815.synopsis: In The Billionaire's Fake Wife movie, when an explosion destroys Dr. Jen Connor’s lab, billionaire heir Roman Johnson rescues her and her comatose sister. Jen offers Roman one impossible deal: she'll pose as his sweet, old-fashioned fiancée for one weekend, so his cold, powerful father may restore the foundation funding she desperately needs. But inside the lavish Johnson estate, Jen faces ruthless tests from staff, family and Roman’s venomous ex-fiancée Kim, who begins to suspect the truth. As romantic tension builds between Jen and Roman, so does the risk of discovery. What starts as a lie becomes dangerously close to real love, just as Kim uncovers the secret Jen hoped would stay buried.
6969ec89b489868c71008815.title: The Billionaire's Fake Wife

6969fa8232c1974a260d2379.synopsis: CEO Mr. Hall is hailed as the perfect husband until Cici returns with a child and blows up his spotless image. When he tries to win her back, she shuts him down cold: the child is hers, and he's the one she walked away from. Only after meeting two pint-sized versions of himself does he realize the truth. Chasing his ex? He'll have to get in line.
6969fa8232c1974a260d2379.title: Pampered by My Ex-husband

696a07eef57823b522077b99.synopsis: At eighteen, May witnessed her childhood love Alvin take a bullet for her and vanish into the sea during a cruise ship abduction. To uncover the truth, she agrees to marry into the wealthy Grant family. On the eve of her wedding, she encounters a motorcycle mechanic with altered memories, Miles — who is, in fact, the presumed-dead heir of the Suttons, Alvin.
696a07eef57823b522077b99.title: Phantom of His Heart

696a07eff57823b522077b9b.synopsis: In a marriage marked by neglect, Regina is sidelined by her husband, Marlon. Three years in, Marlon is diagnosed with a terminal illness with only ten months to live. Suddenly, his mistress arrives with his only child, confident of securing her place. Just as she believes victory is hers, Regina returns with a surprise — an heir from a fateful night with Marlon's brother, Jared. As Regina prepares to reclaim her position as the lady of the Stanton family, the true father of her child opens her door up at night...
696a07eff57823b522077b9b.title: His Brother's Wife

696a07f3f57823b522077ba1.synopsis: After losing her mother as a child, Lillian is taken in by the powerful James family following her father's sudden death. A single night with Sam James, the family’s second son, seems like a mistake until she realizes it was carefully orchestrated. As his obsessive pursuit closes in, the truth behind her adoption and her buried past begins to unravel, leaving Lillian trapped between desire, deception, and a fate she never chose.
696a07f3f57823b522077ba1.title: His Carefully Planned Sin

696a07f4f57823b522077ba3.synopsis: Framed and betrayed by her own family, Maya Lane loses everything. Given a second chance, she returns with a single goal: vengeance. Navigating the cutthroat worlds of high society and entertainment, she forms an unlikely alliance with media mogul, Liam Hart. Together, they will expose the lies of her Keira and scheming father Gordon, turning their gilded world upside down. Betrayal runs in the family, but so does her will to survive and conquer.
696a07f4f57823b522077ba3.title: Schemes of the Heart: Mr. Hart's Game

696a07f5f57823b522077ba5.synopsis: Ethan, young master of the Summers family, awakens a unique martial soul, only to be scorned as the weakest of its kind, facing constant humiliation. Unwilling to succumb to fate, Ethan sets out on a solitary journey, overcoming numerous trials and unlocking the true potential of his devouring martial soul.
696a07f5f57823b522077ba5.title: The Forsaken's Revenge

696a07f6f57823b522077ba7.synopsis: Reborn with memories of her past life, Caroline sets her sights on the Crown Prince before fate can slip away again. She plans to take his bloodline, disappear, and raise the child alone. Six years later, she returns to the capital in search of her son, only to collide with the very man she abandoned. What she never expected was that the once-invincible Crown Prince had developed a fear of women… and has been searching for her ever since.
696a07f6f57823b522077ba7.title: The Princess of My Phobia

696a07f8f57823b522077ba9.synopsis: Nine Dragons with a Coffin transported Luke Hayes to the Otherworld. By the time he came back, his wife had been cast aside by her family, and his daughter had suffered abuse. To protect them from future harm, Luke fed them dragon meat. Now both his wife and daught got power to protect themselves.
696a07f8f57823b522077ba9.title: My Wife and Daughter Got Superpower

696a07f9f57823b522077bab.synopsis: Alex, once a humiliated salesman, has his life turned around after saving CEO Evelyn. He gains the ability to see through jade, skyrocketing him to fame and fortune in the high-stakes world of antiques and gems. But his success draws the wrath of rival Logan. As Alex discovers his growing powers, he teams up with Evelyn to fight enemies and protect his family in a dangerous world where every move could make or break them.
696a07f9f57823b522077bab.title: Eyes of Fortune, He Sees Everything

696a07faf57823b522077bad.synopsis: Noah Collins, a modern judge's assistant, wakes up as the son of the Chief Justice in Astralon—with only 72 hours to live. To survive, he must rely on a mysterious "Codex System" and his "Eye of Judgment" to solve cases, uncover royal secrets, and outwit corrupt officials. With his enigmatic wife Grace Sinclair at his side, every trial becomes a desperate fight for time.
696a07faf57823b522077bad.title: The Lawyer in a Fool's Body

696a07fbf57823b522077baf.synopsis: Betrayed and murdered in her past life after being used to bear the Crown Prince's heir, Erin is reborn with vengeance in her heart. Disguised as a palace maid, she infiltrates the Eastern Palace to destroy those who wronged her. As she carefully sets her trap, Crown Prince Spencer falls into an obsession she never intended. Keeping him just out of reach, Erin turns desire into a weapon, each step closer to him drawing her nearer to revenge.
