696a07fbf57823b522077baf.title: Reborn as His Deadly Temptation

696a07fcf57823b522077bb1.synopsis: Julia, Mystic Grandmaster, failed her ascension and was reborn as a rich heiress sharing her name. Betrayed by her adoptive father and a scheming fake heiress, she turned their tricks against them. Forced to help restore her power, Noah, the Hale heir, started falling for Julia. Together, they navigated schemes, danger, and mutual love.
696a07fcf57823b522077bb1.title: Power Never Felt So Sweet

696a07fef57823b522077bb5.synopsis: Vivian Whitmore, a brilliant CEO with a perfect life, survives a car accident only to uncover a shocking betrayal: her fiancé is her stepfather's illegitimate son. He's plotting to steal everything from her and even plans to commit her to a mental hospital. Refusing to be defeated, Vivian hires a bodyguard and fights back, determined to reclaim what is rightfully hers.
696a07fef57823b522077bb5.title: Underestimate Her at Your Peril

696a0801f57823b522077bb9.synopsis: Elizabeth time-travelled into a novel world as the Villainess and got a System. The System also gave her a Golden Finger, which allowed her to change the novel storyline. Every time she changed the plot, the fate of those roles in the novel world also changed. The original male lead Wyatt and female lead Ivy became unlucky. Elizabeth knew a guy Adrian who was reborn...
696a0801f57823b522077bb9.title: Storybound? Now Let me Modify Your Fate

696a0802f57823b522077bbb.synopsis: Reborn as the neglected true heiress of a powerful family, Supreme Seer Zenna Wynn is mocked, exploited, and set up to fail. When her aunt demands her blood and the fake heiress schemes to disgrace her, Zenna casually reveals her true power, ancient martial arts, lost medicine, and shadow empires, forcing the world’s elite to bow and leaving her family speechless.
696a0802f57823b522077bbb.title: The Real Heiress Returns

696a0803f57823b522077bbd.synopsis: Adam Foster travels back from the future and becomes the son of a fallen official. He loses his family, title, and hope overnight. But fate throws him a lifeline—a cosmic glitch has bound him to a colossal warehouse at Yobor from his own time. Armed with modern resources, knowledge, and sheer audacity, Adam begins his impossible comeback. From turning trinkets into treasure to outsmarting the corrupt elite, he builds an empire where none should exist.
696a0803f57823b522077bbd.title: From NYC with Warehouse

696b289594c277d99106fa63.synopsis: Framed by her boyfriend and sent to prison, Annette Switt is offered a way out: save a tycoon's life with her blood. She seizes the chance, only to return home and discover his betrayal. Heartbroken, she marries the powerful Alexander Fletcher in a swift, convenient arrangement. But when revenge turns to real connection, they join forces to take down those who wronged her—and find an unexpected family along the way.
696b289594c277d99106fa63.title: Not His Blood, But His Heart

696da6119b837c8d4808cea7.synopsis: Thea, the Reed family's heiress, discovers her fiancé, Henry, has been letting his friend Lynn eavesdrop on their private moments. Henry accuses her of overreacting. After pressure from his parents, Thea gives him one last chance. But Henry, along with his friends, continues to humiliate her. When he learns Thea has secretly married the most influential man in the city and realizes he's just a pawn in the Grants' game, he's shattered.
696da6119b837c8d4808cea7.title: No More Nice Girl

696de7e99c5fff9ff00b2a6e.synopsis: Marian Sutton, daughter of the Marquis, is ordered by the emperor to marry Prince Harlan. But when Harlan rescues his cousin Scarlett from drowning, Marian's grandmother insists on a dual marriage. Betrayed and poisoned by Scarlett and Harlan, Marian is given a second chance at life. Reborn on the day of the marriage decree, she boldly rejects Harlan and chooses the notorious Prince Julian, the capital's infamous playboy.
696de7e99c5fff9ff00b2a6e.title: Married to a Rogue Prince

696deaacb2d7a4c5400e3865.synopsis: Chester Wilson, the most gifted assassin from Villains Valley, crosses paths with Isabel Evans, who is being hunted by Black Dragon, and is forced to unleash his deadly skills. When he returns to his family, he finds his mother murdered, his grandmother kidnapped, and his inheritance stolen by his stepmother and half-brother. To reclaim his birthright, Chester must navigate a web of family treachery, criminal power plays, and his own vow of vengeance.
696deaacb2d7a4c5400e3865.title: The Exiled Heir Returns

696df1a4a91fc430190002a6.synopsis: Livia Dawson used to have loving parents and a sweet home. She was a little princess. But after she had a younger sister, everything changed. They stopped loving her like they used to. Just because she turned the AC down by one degree for her sister, they locked her up in a fridge. Maybe her death will finally wake them up.
696df1a4a91fc430190002a6.title: When Love Is Unequal

696e08a9d5d6b4de4c019938.synopsis: For six years, Evelyn has stood by her husband Adrian, only to be betrayed when he forces her to sign a waiver and causes her parents' deaths. And it's all to protect his true love, Serena. Resolute in her quest for justice, Evelyn joins forces with Nathan, another victim of Adrian's schemes, to orchestrate a plan that leads to Serena confessing her crimes live and Adrian's company collapsing. As her ex-husband begs for forgiveness, Evelyn turns away with a new love, smiling, knowing that some loves are not worth waiting for.
696e08a9d5d6b4de4c019938.title: Loving You Was My Mistake

696ee3251057f8544e02f079.synopsis: Eleanor bought a big villa for her daughter-in-law Diana. One day, she excitedly brought her old best friend Marian, who is also Diana's mother, to visit the villa. But they were stopped outside by a strange woman. Who was she? Before the two old friends could figure it out, the woman pointed at Eleanor's nose and scolded her as a thief...
696ee3251057f8544e02f079.title: Bad Son-in-Law, Go to Jail

696ee82be40b37a68d064457.synopsis: Billionaire Stella discovers her son has hidden his mistress inside a giant teddy bear while plotting to strip his sick wife of everything and seize the family fortune. To protect her daughter-in-law, Stella pretends ignorance and strikes back in silence, punishing the mistress and her own son in a ruthless game of mansion warfare, until she and Luna spring the final trap.
696ee82be40b37a68d064457.title: The Bear Hid My Husband's Secret

696ee9bbab0b1f0ce302625f.synopsis: Holding onto Ethan's marriage promise, Cynthia was his secret lover for five years. But when pregnant Kelly returned, he dumped her. Cynthia joined Reese Group, cutting ties. Ethan's late regret failed to win her back. While he and Kelly faced retribution, Cynthia found true love with Jerome.
696ee9bbab0b1f0ce302625f.title: I Was His Secret. Now I’m His Regret.

696ef1dd2ab7cd033304a49a.synopsis: Abducted as a child, Vera wins her freedom on a stormy night and returns to her wealthy birth family. Faced with a scheming fake heiress and open favoritism, she hides her strength and plays the underdog, exposing lies, proving her intelligence, and steadily reclaiming her identity and inheritance in the modern city.
696ef1dd2ab7cd033304a49a.title: Playing Weak, Winning Big

696f1b4c3549fc132b0af4c1.synopsis: In her past life, Jennifer mourned a husband who was never dead. After he faked his death, stole his brother's identity, and conspired with his lover to kill Jennifer and her child, she is reborn before the tragedy. This time, she ends the cursed pregnancy herself and rejects a life of false widowhood, choosing instead to marry the powerful regent everyone fears.
696f1b4c3549fc132b0af4c1.title: No Mercy in Her Second Life

696f1e47156b55004c0245d7.synopsis: Howard was once the Undefeated Boxing King. However, during a crucial match, he was drugged by his opponent, leading to a devastating loss. In the violent aftermath, he tragically lost his beloved daughter. His wife left him, and he was expelled from the boxing association. He had to scrape by as a food delivery man. Then he met a single mom Nancy and her daughter Mia, and they got along well. Later, a rich man wanted Mia's kidney for his own daughter, but Howard saved Mia...
696f1e47156b55004c0245d7.title: 24 Hours to Save Her

696f1ffecdf5fdf0e4045fc1.synopsis: The billionaire Adrian died in an accidental fire. His wife Helen tried hard to keep his family fortune. Adrian's family didn't want a woman to take charge. Helen did not care about the gossip of relatives. But one day, Adrian's younger brother Nathan came back at his brother's funeral, holding Adrian's will in his hand. Nathan claimed that his brother had left everything to him and he was the true heir of the Vaughn family. But what surprised Helen even more was that Nathan looked exactly like Adrian... Is he really her husband's brother?
696f1ffecdf5fdf0e4045fc1.title: Return to Claim Her

696f3a363ca2dd51190c85a1.synopsis: The richest CEO Isabel found her husband Adrian cheated on her with a college student called Roxanne. And this ungrateful student's school fees were even sponsored by Isabel. Plus, Adrian had poisoned her for a long time, trying to steal her assets. Isabel set up a trap and ruined them in the end.
696f3a363ca2dd51190c85a1.title: Empress of Revenge

696f50227b2ac71c520a9a70.synopsis: The orphan Emma was abandoned by her foster parents. Then she met the dying Andrew. After Andrew adopted her, he became healthy again and earned more money, even his mom's disease was cured. Andrew found Emma was his lucky girl who could help him achieve great success in the business world. Andrew exposed his uncle's scheme and reclaimed his family fortune with Emma.
696f50227b2ac71c520a9a70.title: From Orphan to CEO's Daughter

696f5885ec301804d9068d41.synopsis: Clara David, the daughter of the premier royal purveyors, is driven by vengeance after her parents are slain by bandits wielding imperial guards' tokens. Believing the Emperor to be the culprit, she transforms into an enchanting courtesan and enters the palace. Unexpectedly, she finds herself drawn to a mysterious palace guard, unaware that he is the Emperor in disguise. But is the Emperor truly the culprit behind her parents' murder?
696f5885ec301804d9068d41.title: Scarlet Revenge: The Emperor's Love

69701887c4f8492dc30528bf.synopsis: Olivia Beckett’s perfect life is unraveling—her family’s broke, college is slipping away, and her high school sweetheart has turned violent. Enter Sebastian “Bash” McDaniels, a rising boxer working nights at a bar to escape his past. When he rescues Olivia from her ex, their connection sparks, but as danger closes in, Bash must choose between his dreams and saving the girl who could break him.
69701887c4f8492dc30528bf.title: Fix You

69704426b77b005a70066257.synopsis: After being cast down from the immortal realm, Marcus Langley awakens in the body of a cowardly heir to a declining ancient martial clan. With his wife Claire Lynn—a rare Phoenix cultivation vessel—by his side, he must hide his true power, outsmart ruthless rivals, and restore his family's glory.
69704426b77b005a70066257.title: The Ascending Heir

69704ca936009eebeb0da2f0.synopsis: Seven years undercover to repay a mistaken debt, AI prodigy Olivia hides her power to uplift her mediocre husband, only to be betrayed when he moves his mistress and their love child home. This is the final nail in this marriage. She immediately divorces him and flash-marries her nemesis, leaving her ex in deep regret.
69704ca936009eebeb0da2f0.title: All Clear at Last

69706d6fc607e726e000ee5c.synopsis: On the seventh day of her marriage, Alexis walks in on her husband and stepmother having an affair. Yet she's accused of cheating and pushed down the stairs. Given a second chance, Alexis has another plan. She swaps their birth control for powerful laxatives and seals their room with glue. Then, she triggers an online frenzy for a missing husband search. As the media and rescue teams swarm in, Alexis leads them to break into the marital suite.
69706d6fc607e726e000ee5c.title: Trending Scandal: Stepmom Stole My Man

69707c3bcc6e6179150feb17.synopsis: After three years of abuse, Sasha divorces her domineering CEO husband and leaves endurance behind. Focused on her career, she rises fast as admirers gather around her. While her ex rages over the child he believes she lost, Sasha becomes a woman completely out of his reach. When he finally swallows his pride to win her back, he learns it may already be too late.
69707c3bcc6e6179150feb17.title: Too Late, Mr. CEO

6970a21ed8a92c79400e4595.synopsis: Howard was once the Undefeated Boxing King. However, during a crucial match, he was drugged by his opponent, leading to a devastating loss. In the violent aftermath, he tragically lost his beloved daughter. His wife left him, and he was expelled from the boxing association. He had to scrape by as a food delivery man. Then he met a single mom Nancy and her daughter Mia, and they got along well. Later, a rich man wanted Mia's kidney for his own daughter, but Howard saved Mia...
6970a21ed8a92c79400e4595.title: 24 Hours to Save Her

6970aa300aa62316ec0b16e6.synopsis: David Bennett thought he had found happiness in his remarriage to Madeline. But when his ex-wife, Evelyn Hart, reappears, the façade of his new life begins to crumble. Dark secrets surface. As David's company teeters on the brink of collapse, Madeline prepares to dump him. In his darkest hour, only Evelyn steps forward, offering not just financial salvation but a chance at redemption.
6970aa300aa62316ec0b16e6.title: The 500,000 Divorce

6970ac7e54d4d813bb045cad.synopsis: Sophie, the daughter of the richest man, hid her identity and pretended to be an orphan. After two years of marriage, she fully supported her husband in starting his own business. When she went for a prenatal checkup, she bumped into her husband accompanying his childhood sweetheart and her son. The little boy actually called her husband "Dad". She decisively proposed a divorce. After the divorce, she returned to her family's company and met her ex-husband on a party. Her ex begged for mercy on his knees...
6970ac7e54d4d813bb045cad.title: The Heiress's Mask: Love Betrayed

69718267ae82b0ebe30b74e1.synopsis: To save her mother, whose body is turning into snake scales, Leah sells herself and is fatefully bound to Sean, the Serpent Lord, bearing nine serpent eggs. While Sean protects her, he is forced into a heavenly trial and leaves her behind. Alone, Leah returns home, only to be framed as a demon and nearly killed by her village. Sean returns in time to save her and discovers she is the daughter of his long-lost benefactor.
69718267ae82b0ebe30b74e1.title: The Serpent Lord Wraps Her Close

697188f3db9a25de570dc156.synopsis: Amidst her divorce from Quentin, Nora unexpectedly travels back in time, awakening in the body of a 300-pound woman who narrowly escapes a murder attempt. To survive, she transforms into a formidable bandit leader on a mountain, where she raises four children. With their clever help, she captures Quentin, who once again becomes her husband as they rule over the mountain stronghold.
697188f3db9a25de570dc156.title: Kidnapped a Prince to Be My Husband

6972c116134e8c31690e1c3d.synopsis: In The Hitwoman movie, Madeline Archer, assassin, doesn't want bloodshed—but if she stops killing, her little sister dies. When Maddie is forced to take a contract on Hayden Kent, she runs into two problems. One, he's the District Attorney. And two–he was her first and only love. And he wants her back.
6972c116134e8c31690e1c3d.title: The Hitwoman

6972cc1f658e4f63f202b994.synopsis: In Their Brother Lost in Space movie, Timothy, adopted by the wealthy Snyder family, grows up devoted to his three older sisters — until the day their biological son, Matthew, returns and turns them against him with lies and manipulation. Cast out and blamed for things he never did, Timothy still repays their kindness: he saves them, sacrifices for them, and even secretly volunteers for Project Hail Mary, a mission to save humanity by sending one person with a rare gene into find a new planet. Only after he's gone, do the Snyders discover the truth about Matthew's schemes and Timothy's sacrifices. Thirty years later, Timothy succeeds on Planet Artemis, honored as a hero while his grieving family lives with the cost of their betrayal.
6972cc1f658e4f63f202b994.title: Their Brother Lost in Space

6972e034ad37b2666b06810f.synopsis: Accidentally transported into a book as a minor character doomed to die, Genny refuses to accept her fate. She's determined to change her story, but she's certainly not planning to give birth to snake babies for a Serpent King!
6972e034ad37b2666b06810f.title: Pregnant by the Serpent King

697316e4f933ea73ab0f317f.synopsis: Damien admired Renee. Used as a stand-in by Damien for three years, Sylvia didn't know she was Renee's long-lost sister. Renee got Sylvia back and started fighting for her, guiding Sylvia to success and true love.
697316e4f933ea73ab0f317f.title: The Real Heiress in the Shadows

69733e76828d32a9ff027743.synopsis: Marina Sinclair is unloved by her family. Framed by her sister and thrown into jail, she's shamed by her father, cursed by her mother, and blamed by her brother. After cutting ties for good, she unexpectedly becomes the cherished obsession of Damien Yates, the untouchable "Golden Scion" of the city. Only then does she realize: Damien has always been the light in her darkest days — silently guarding, healing, and loving her. To him, she's always been exclusive.
69733e76828d32a9ff027743.title: Love That Saved Me

6973445043e1b6a62f0f9d2a.synopsis: To save her mom, Sylvia Warren's engaged to Ethan Fletcher. Seeing no future, she sets her sights higher—on the true power in the Fletcher empire: his uncle, Sean Fletcher. Her plan is simple: seduce Sean, secure her freedom. But Sylvia doesn't know that she's the girl Sean has been searching for all along. Every "accidental" encounter was his design. Sylvia must discover if the man she targeted as her ladder out is her ultimate trap... or her only salvation.
6973445043e1b6a62f0f9d2a.title: My Uncle's Secret Obsession

697431381b25d77b200efa7b.synopsis: After a brutal betrayal in his past life, Harvey Lee is reborn three days before the apocalyptic game "Primordial World" merges with reality. Knowing currency will soon be worthless and only in-game assets will matter, he liquidates everything to pour a staggering billion dollars into the game. Branded a madman, Leo ignores them all. As the world descends into chaos and mythical forces invade, he emerges not as a victim, but as the server's top player, armed with divine artifacts and the power to reshape the new world order. This time, he'll write his own rules.
697431381b25d77b200efa7b.title: Primordial Server: The $1 Billion Reboot

69747f968c01e3bb6e058fab.synopsis: Everyone assumes Winter is blindly devoted to Nicholas, enduring humiliation as his secretary. In truth, she stayed only to honor a dying promise to her late lover, protecting Nicholas for seven years. While Nicholas turns a blind eye to her suffering, Winter repeatedly risks her life for him. By the time he finally falls for her, she has already given up and walks away.
69747f968c01e3bb6e058fab.title: Seven Years as Your Stand-In

6976c4fbc50a61d501014dda.synopsis: Livia Dawson used to have loving parents and a sweet home. She was a little princess. But after she had a younger sister, everything changed. They stopped loving her like they used to. Just because she turned the AC down by one degree for her sister, they locked her up in a fridge. Maybe her death will finally wake them up.
6976c4fbc50a61d501014dda.title: When Love Is Unequal

6976d3a7553621c7bf0ecc45.synopsis: Victor, the iron-blooded ship king, held immense power in his hands. When he reached his fifties, he considered retirement, intending to marry the young and beautiful Jessica. He not only planned a grand wedding, but also wanna transfer his company worth 80 million to his fiancee. However, Jessica had an affair with her childhood sweetheart Frank. She tried to poison Victor to death, intending to seize his property after marriage. But Victor had already known their scheme. He set up a big trap for Jessica...
6976d3a7553621c7bf0ecc45.title: Bridal Betrayal: Poison and Trap

6976d69742f90b95a305f0d7.synopsis: Marian Sutton, daughter of the Marquis, is ordered by the emperor to marry Prince Harlan. But when Harlan rescues his cousin Scarlett from drowning, Marian's grandmother insists on a dual marriage. Betrayed and poisoned by Scarlett and Harlan, Marian is given a second chance at life. Reborn on the day of the marriage decree, she boldly rejects Harlan and chooses the notorious Prince Julian, the capital's infamous playboy.
6976d69742f90b95a305f0d7.title: Married to a Rogue Prince

697701eca170427fdc0c2255.synopsis: Oliver Logan is the wealthiest man in the world, but even his vast fortune can't hold onto Chloe Stone. Confident in Oliver's love, Chloe brazenly uses his money to support her lover. Once Oliver sees her true colors, he finally awakens to the truth. Now, he's going to tell them he's marrying someone else and ensure they lose everything!
697701eca170427fdc0c2255.title: Peace Out, I'm Marrying Someone Else

69770e81a4e43888c903e8a4.synopsis: Lila Cobb once saved Alexander Vaughn, the hottest hockey player. One night of passion between them left her unexpectedly pregnant. Eight months later, Lila was cast out of her family and gave birth to a premature baby boy. Struggling to pay the hospital bills, she worked herself to the bone. Meanwhile, Alexander has been searching for Lila all along, determined to give her and their child all the love he has. But will he be able to find them before it’s too late?
69770e81a4e43888c903e8a4.title: Puck Me Baby One More Time

69770f5f0575988220032621.synopsis: In Backstage Romance with the Popstar movie, Rockstar Dexter Hayes thinks he found his next hit when he dumps his loyal assistant Casey for rising star Scarlett Hart. What he doesn’t know is that Casey is living a double life as Echo, the mysterious super-producer who built his career and secretly owns his label. As the truth unravels, can Dexter and Casey can find their way back to the music, and to each other?
69770f5f0575988220032621.title: Backstage Romance with the Popstar

69770f8ddeaf17de7608b2e0.synopsis: She’s a stripper trying to escape her past and survive. He’s the billionaire who never forgot her. She never thought she’d see him again after high school—until he walks into her club and proposes. Now she must hide their marriage from everyone who could destroy them both… and find out if he truly loves her, or just loves owning her.
69770f8ddeaf17de7608b2e0.title: A Vegas Happily Ever After

697721ffdf767dfc4d0bab9d.synopsis: In He's Done Being Nice movie, I'm Jason Hayes, and today, I am reborn. In my past life, I was weak. In this one, I choose to be the villain. From a humble waiter to the king of the underworld, Jason fights back against every bully and outmaneuvers the most powerful figures, including the father-in-law of a crime lord. His ironclad rule: touch what's mine, and you won't survive. Only when he stops stepping aside does Jason learn a brutal truth: the world makes way for those who refuse to move.
697721ffdf767dfc4d0bab9d.title: He's Done Being Nice

6977374154169a71e104df3e.synopsis: Miles devoted his life to molding Wendy into a business queen, only to be betrayed and killed. Meanwhile, Wendy believed she could have had a perfect life with the charming Jack instead. Given a second chance at life, Miles decides to dump Wendy and court someone else. But Wendy is also reborn, convinced her rise to power has nothing to do with Miles. But as life resets, she finds a different reality: Miles no longer revolves around her, and he has a new love. And Jack turns out to be a scumbag.
6977374154169a71e104df3e.title: Her Turn to Fall

697742e8f13df5e030004041.synopsis: Ethan paid an advance of 8,000 bucks for a reception fee to secure a 100 million order. But when he went to the finance department for reimbursement, he was informed only 1,000 bucks could be reimbursed according to the group's regulations. Feeling aggrieved, Ethan went to the chairman to seek justice, only to find that even his 100 million order had been snatched away. He was so mad and went to the client to split the meal expenses. At this point, his fate started changing...
697742e8f13df5e030004041.title: Zero Sum

69784f4366e67d15310ddd34.synopsis: After serving 800 years in Hell, Alison is reborn into the wealthy Carter family—only to discover she's the discarded real heiress. Her mother is being poisoned, her identity stolen by an impostor son. Disguised as a maid's daughter, Alison returns with a mystical "Book of Karma" that delivers instant justice. Now, she must expose the lies, protect her mother, and reclaim her rightful legacy—one revenge at a time.
69784f4366e67d15310ddd34.title: My Boss Is the Lord of the Netherworld

6979a0f449f2f3910804c59f.synopsis: Business mogul Eliza Reed returns home with plans to rescue her husband Julian's faltering company, only to discover his suspicious closeness with his secretary, Quinny. Julian insists Quinny is just like a sister to him, yet she possesses Eliza's personal belongings and her late mother's heirloom. Confronted with her husband's favoritism and betrayal, Eliza awakens to the truth and finally decides to divorce him.
6979a0f449f2f3910804c59f.title: More Than Just His Sister

6979bf43a11b08657d04265b.synopsis: Sylvia, born with an irresistible charm, seemed to have it all as a glamorous CEO wife, but her jealous cousin kills her. Reborn on her wedding day, Sylvia lets her cousin switch grooms and marries the short-lived William Zimmer instead. But William not only survives, he thrives, and the Zimmer family prospers like never before. Meanwhile, Sylvia's ex loses everything without her, and her cousin suffers a far worse fate than before.
6979bf43a11b08657d04265b.title: Perfume Revenge: Change a Husband

697acf188e0538b68909d923.synopsis: In her previous life, Vivian sacrificed everything for love but died tragically because of the scumbag Gavin and homewrecker Claire. Reborn on her wedding day, when Gavin publicly humiliated her, Vivian exposed his evil intention to seize her family fortune in front of everyone and revealed her own identity as the head of the Cloud Group. Gavin was enraged, but the man Ian he had insulted turned out to be a big shot. Vivian and Ian joined forces to drive their enemies away and got together.
697acf188e0538b68909d923.title: My Kidney for Your First Love?!

697acf5c6c9010b34703bc93.synopsis: Dr. Rowan Lawson spent a decade crafting a miracle cure for Dawn Summers, only to watch her gift the triumph — and her heart — to another man. When her new lover deliberately destroyed the serum to force him out, and Dawn stood by in silent approval, Rowan's devotion finally froze over. He vanished from her world and returned as the medical world's most formidable and elusive legend: Dr. Z.
697acf5c6c9010b34703bc93.title: Heartless Frost, Dr. Z's Awakening

697b046e346e25652a0635a2.synopsis: CEO Stella hires Emily, a capable college student, as her baby's nanny. But her mother forces an old family friend, Grace, into the house, claiming friends trump outsiders. Grace abuses her position, frames Emily, and even moves in her thieving family. When Emily is injured and silenced, Stella returns early, uncovers the betrayal, and exposes the truth. Grace is held accountable, and Stella finally makes things right.
697b046e346e25652a0635a2.title: Don't You Play Me for a Fool

697b04b1a0ab978933053c13.synopsis: Six years ago, jewelry genius Sydney left her career to become a wife. When her husband Chris chooses his nephew over their daughter, Sydney is devastated. After a miscarriage and help from Steven, she plans to divorce Chris and reclaim the family jewelry design rights. Chris accuses her of causing his brother's death, but Sydney, with Steven's support, wins the divorce and takes control, starting a new chapter.
697b04b1a0ab978933053c13.title: Her Revenge Sparkles

697b09d39e99a88a98081b5a.synopsis: Ether Gasper is the secret head of the HiddenOrder, a mysterious international organization. But to fulfill her grandfather's last wish, she comes back with her loyal bodyguard and marries into a business deal with Kray Shepherd. Yet on her wedding night, Kray is off playing the field. She confronts him, only to be threatened with Julius' life. This marriage is a contract, but her bodyguard is not. He's picked the wrong guy to hurt.
697b09d39e99a88a98081b5a.title: Defying the World for Her Bodyguard

697b0b1bf950eb9045044fc4.synopsis: She quietly marries into a top family, only to be mocked as a trophy wife. On their wedding night, she's left alone, so she buys a city landmark. As her husband ignores her, she takes control when a family crisis hits and exposes a conspiracy. With a snap, she flips the boardroom and dominates the racetrack. When old secrets resurface, everyone realizes that she's not just a gold digger. She's the queen back for revenge.
697b0b1bf950eb9045044fc4.title: Snatched a Feisty Heiress

697b18480d3af7ffc3086450.synopsis: Elaine Carver is reborn on the day her brother, Ryan, demands she buy him a luxury car. In her past life, this single act buried her under crippling debt and led to her death. Now armed with foresight, she watches coldly as Ryan runs up an astronomical bill at the dealership. When the final invoice—a staggering 100 million—is presented, Elaine refuses to pay. Her family is left in shock. This time, Elaine is fighting back, and they are about to face the full consequences of their greed.
697b18480d3af7ffc3086450.title: Sister's Rebirth

697b1b1c3ff58feee100e247.synopsis: Reeling from her husband’s infidelity, Kate seeks solace in what she thinks is a counseling session, only to end up in a passionate night of mistaken identity with Chris, a captivating young painter. But morning brings a scandalous revelation: not only is her new lover the elusive art prodigy CH Skywalker, he is also the son of her best friend, Linda. As a vengeful ex-husband and jealous rivals conspire to expose their secret, Kate finds herself trapped in a web of forbidden desire and betrayal.
697b1b1c3ff58feee100e247.title: In Love With My Bestie's Son

697b1c0a08ac71f4440d45c3.synopsis: Qianrin borders are under attack. Gretta Ely, heartbroken by Crown Prince Hades Maverick's intention to wed someone else, requests a diplomatic marriage decree. Hesitated, the emperor still appoints her as Princess of Qianrin. She will marry in seven days. Meanwhile, the crown prince, unaware of her decision, remains confident that his childhood sweetheart would never leave him.
697b1c0a08ac71f4440d45c3.title: The Princess Who Walked Away

697b247d72205da95501bcf1.synopsis: In Kissed by Claw and Fang movie, Ivy, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car-- a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private highschool. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Sebasian, the werewolf heir, and Zane, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities: one as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love? Ivy later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything.
697b247d72205da95501bcf1.title: Kissed by Claw and Fang

697b24bc7b22e7c7a60b80c7.synopsis: Christy Lane, famous violinist, is forced to betray the love of her life. Pregnant and destitute, an illness slowly robs her of her ability to perform. All she has left now is an instrument she can no longer play--and a seven year old daughter, determined to bring Daddy back.
697b24bc7b22e7c7a60b80c7.title: When Love's Sorrow Plays Again

697b24d9f7ba087a7d0356e6.synopsis: In In the Palm of His Hand movie, College senior Shelby Yates accidentally saves the life of billionaire ex-mafia CEO Matteo Franconi. He immediately falls in love with her and pressures her to marry him. Is he as dangerous and cruel as he seems? Or is there a soul inside the man worthy of her love?
697b24d9f7ba087a7d0356e6.title: In the Palm of His Hand

697b24f847c106823209fc33.synopsis: The richest man in the world's missing one last thing — his childhood sweetheart. He's determined to marry her, but never realizes she's right beside him! He searches everywhere for the girl who captured her heart. When will he realize he's already married to his Mrs. Right?
697b24f847c106823209fc33.title: Find Your Way Back to Me, My Childhood Sweetheart

697b266242ad1e259f0e16db.synopsis: In Tutoring My Rival Boy movie, Life isn't easy for Chris Blanning, valedictorian at a snobby private school. It's hard enough dealing with bullies already, but when his scholarship isn't enough to cover tuition, he's got to tutor his worst enemy — Lucien Alaric, the spoiled bad boy he just saw trying to seduce their teacher into changing his grades! Even worse, Lucien's figured out his deepest, dirtiest secret in return. All he can do is keep his friends close, and enemies closer — but maybe Chris is getting a little too close...
697b266242ad1e259f0e16db.title: Tutoring my Rival Boy

697c2095df5bfc16ff08c8aa.synopsis: In Mafia Mamma's Hot Lover movie, betrayed housewife Maria’s life is upended when she unexpectedly inherits a vast mafia empire at her grandfather’s funeral, transforming from a dismissed “middle-aged housewife” into the “Godmother” of the St. Clair crime family. As she navigates her new role—seeking peace in a world of violence—she rekindles a forbidden love with Richard, her childhood crush and the family’s trusted advisor. But Richard is secretly the long-lost heir of their greatest rival, torn between blood and loyalty. Forced to publicly oppose each other while secretly allying, they must survive assassinations, family treachery, and their own hearts to expose the true mastermind behind the conflict, end the bloody feud, and claim both power and love.
697c2095df5bfc16ff08c8aa.title: Mafia Mamma's Hot Lover

697c440480c01bcab305abcb.synopsis: A 21-year-old cowboy goes to San Francisco to find his mother, who abandoned him as a newborn baby. He meets fascinating and funny characters in San Francisco who change his life forever.
697c440480c01bcab305abcb.title: San Francisco Cowboy

697c5883e79d30dfa10f9692.synopsis: In Final Game Saving My Brother movie, after prison, Rowan Collins learns he has a twin brother—Vincent Collins, the legendary gambling king. To protect his brother's empire, Rowan must become him, stepping into a world of high-stakes deception. Betrayed by his past and hunted by rivals, he must outplay them all in a dangerous game of revenge—and fulfill his vow to end gambling for good.
697c5883e79d30dfa10f9692.title: Final Game: Saving My Brother

697c59f38deb032b910b9a93.synopsis: Rowan Ashford is reborn as the villain in a novel—a cross‑dressing, arrogant heir fated to be executed by the male lead, Adrian Collins. To survive, she must publicly humiliate him while secretly improving his affection for her. In a dangerous game of pretense and desire, can Rowan rewrite her fate and win the heart of the future king?
697c59f38deb032b910b9a93.title: After I Became the Emperor's Bully

697c76fc38d0ab25720dd6c1.synopsis: Vivian, a 200-pound mother of three, is neglected by her husband and bullied by his childhood friend who covets her place. But fate intervenes when the soul of an Empress awakens within her. The ancient ruler wastes no time—shedding weight, reclaiming beauty, and seizing her own destiny. As a dazzling new Vivian emerges, her husband scrambles to win her back. But her eyes are set on a far grander prize: building an empire of her own.
697c76fc38d0ab25720dd6c1.title: Reborn Queen in the Modern World

6980047ec87618a7a501a286.synopsis: Miles devoted his life to molding Wendy into a business queen, only to be betrayed and killed. Meanwhile, Wendy believed she could have had a perfect life with the charming Jack instead. Given a second chance at life, Miles decides to dump Wendy and court someone else. But Wendy is also reborn, convinced her rise to power has nothing to do with Miles. But as life resets, she finds a different reality: Miles no longer revolves around her, and he has a new love. And Jack turns out to be a scumbag.
6980047ec87618a7a501a286.title: Her Turn to Fall

69800c1506e9b2d065070cfd.synopsis: Reborn as Molly, a noblewoman falsely accused of infidelity, she's poisoned by her husband's concubine. But when a modern-day scientist wakes up in Molly's body, everything changes. Armed with science and vengeance, Molly plans to take back control, divorcing the cold prince Yale and making everyone who betrayed her pay. With the Emperor and Empress on her side, she rises to power, leaving Yale and his concubine in ruin, no love, just victory.
69800c1506e9b2d065070cfd.title: The Ugly Consort's Comeback Plan

698015e513444cd32800d2cb.synopsis: When the proud Evelyn rejects wealthy Adrian's charity, the desperate Natalie seizes the chance he offers: secure Evelyn's acceptance, and he'll fund her education. Natalie succeeds, but the price is becoming Adrian's kept woman—a substitute for the one who refused him. As she navigates a gilded cage of obligation, a startling shift begins: Adrian's fascination with the woman he couldn't have transforms into a longing for the one he took for granted. Now, Natalie holds a power she never sought—the key to his regret.
698015e513444cd32800d2cb.title: Her Rejection, My Chance

6980162e3470e79a1b0eeebd.synopsis: In the Dine Dash Destroyed Movie, Joyce Pike takes her mother-in-law, Grace, to her husband's fancy restaurant invested by her, only to discover they serve pre-made meals. Seeking justice, she faces humiliation from her husband's mistress. But Joyce is ready to fight back.
6980162e3470e79a1b0eeebd.title: Dine, Dash & Destroyed

69804663c2270306c90d5c2d.synopsis: Billionaire Gavin Sullivan and his secretary Louise make their biggest mistake when they bully a seemingly ordinary woman over a parking spot. Unbeknownst to them, Lana Harper is the brilliant, low-key scientist behind the epoch-making Hodon-I discovery. As they escalate their ridicule, Lana's formidable credentials begin to surface, setting the stage for a reckoning that will redefine power and prestige.
69804663c2270306c90d5c2d.title: Her Research Report, Your Ultimate Regret

698066ead18d5eba78052618.synopsis: Betrayed by the Empress Dowager, Emperor Robert was humiliated and captured by his enemies. Just as his maid Rose was about to be hurt, a modern soul entered his body. With a new system unlocking his power, Robert escaped, rescued his allies, and came back to his kingdom to reclaim his throne.
698066ead18d5eba78052618.title: The Fallen Monarch's Rise

69807208dfd5be3b22078e6d.synopsis: Esther Jennings discovers her fiancé, Channing, is cheating with her stepsister, Ember, and worse, she's pregnant. Heartbroken, Esther seeks revenge by marrying the ruthless Carl Shepherd, the infamous "Devil of Riverton." In exchange for his power, she agrees to be his wife, but they vow to keep things strictly business. As Esther fights back against her betrayers, the line between pretense and real feelings blurs, and love grows in the ashes of revenge.
69807208dfd5be3b22078e6d.title: I Ditched Him for His Rival

698154d6ce6e410acf018d2e.synopsis: Fresh out of prison, Christian discovers his ex-wife stole his fortune, took a younger lover, and left him for dead. A mysterious rune awakens a "10x Cashback System." Every dollar he spends on women returns tenfold. From luxury gifts to public humiliation, Christian flips the script, crushes his enemies, wins the hearts of powerful women, and rises from discarded ex-con to untouchable king of excess.
698154d6ce6e410acf018d2e.title: Spend and Conquer

6981604db05653c56e03fb24.synopsis: In her previous life, Vivian sacrificed everything for love but died tragically because of the scumbag Gavin and homewrecker Claire. Reborn on her wedding day, when Gavin publicly humiliated her, Vivian exposed his evil intention to seize her family fortune in front of everyone and revealed her own identity as the head of the Cloud Group. Gavin was enraged, but the man Ian he had insulted turned out to be a big shot. Vivian and Ian joined forces to drive their enemies away and got together.
6981604db05653c56e03fb24.title: My Kidney for Your First Love?!

698169175598d45c840cac17.synopsis: Hired to ruin a wedding, Nora Scott is offered a deal by the billionaire, Asher Parker: a one-year contractual marriage for a life-changing sum. Unknowingly, she's the spitting image of his fiancée, heiress Cathy Sinclair. This is no coincidence—it's part of a scheme by Cathy's stepsister, Nydia Sinclair, to steal the family fortune. Asher, who only wanted a convenient wife to thwart his family's plans, finds himself drawn to the enigmatic woman wearing his lover's face.
698169175598d45c840cac17.title: The Wedding Crasher: Contract Love

69816dbd94f0ea768b0ee25b.synopsis: In a time of chaos, a single mistake bound two men in hatred. Victor, a ruthless assassin, stole his enemy's daughter and raised her as "Orphan". Douglas, an honorable inspector, took Victor's son and named him "Drifter". Raised on opposite sides of a bitter feud, destiny reunites them as adults—and Drifter falls helplessly in love with Orphan, the woman he was born to hunt. But as the truth unravels, they must choose: will the sins of their fathers destroy their future, or can their love rewrite a legacy of vengeance?
69816dbd94f0ea768b0ee25b.title: The Oath and the Orphan

698197b71313383107003cfe.synopsis: This is the Age of Titans. Evan Ford arrives in this world through transmigration. The abyss has torn open, unleashing a tide of monsters upon reality, leaving humanity in ruins. In times of crisis, humans can awaken Titans to resist the monsters. But when Evan Ford undergoes his awakening, he unlocks the Tower of Ten Beasts, which houses ten god-tier ferocious beasts. Watch as Evan Ford rises to dominate the Age of Titans!
698197b71313383107003cfe.title: Age of Titans: I Awakened the Ten Beasts

6981b964881261d0b50e119b.synopsis: Nina sacrificed her freedom to help her sister Valerie escape an arranged marriage, only to be trapped in a brutal marriage with the Ashford family. Ten years later, Valerie controls a powerful underground empire, while Nina suffers abuse and infertility. When they reunite, the sisters team up for revenge. Nina exposes the Ashford family's crimes, rebuilds her career, and finds love with Brian. Together, they fight to take back their lives.
6981b964881261d0b50e119b.title: You Messed With the Wrong Sisters

6981ba545edafcb6960db82e.synopsis: The big shot Alan traveled back to the famine year and became a broke punk. He relied on his mute wife Nina and his sister-in-law Mary for survival. At the beginning, he faced multiple crises, including no food in the house, Nina and her sister being sold by their father, and thugs coming to collect debts. Later, he hunt in the mountains to support his family, earned money by selling herbs, and even cured Nina's muteness. He met Lily, the owner of a pharmacy, and got a deal on medicinal herbs. He even helped villagers to collect herbs and increase their income.
6981ba545edafcb6960db82e.title: Famine & Fortune: My Silent Wife's Golden Touch

6981d26bcc13551def05b58b.synopsis: Time-traveled into a romance novel world meant for women, I became the villain who died pathetically. But romance is not my play, revenge is. I'll teach you guys how to behave yourself. If you don't work hard in cultivation, you'll end up being wiped out! You're calling for help? Then I'll send his entire family to hell! What should I do if I encounter a master and can't defeat him? I'll simply call, "Daddy!" My dad will kick his ass. As a villain, without morality, you won't be guilt-trapped!
6981d26bcc13551def05b58b.title: From Romance to Revenge

6981f51641d57dcdff04d8f4.synopsis: Escaping an arranged marriage, the Master of the Jade Hall from the Underworld is reborn in the body of a princess betrayed and murdered by her fiancé. After a drugged night with the Regent Prince, Jade sheds her timid persona and takes the palace by storm. Instead of being the delicate flower the prince imagined, she wields a whip in one hand and a knife in the other, sending enemies fleeing. The prince may think she's meek, but even the ghosts in the palace are terrified of her wild side!
6981f51641d57dcdff04d8f4.title: The Wrath of the Queen of Hell

6981f5438c9423cec40a58c6.synopsis: In Ex-Convict Janitor and His Heiress movie, Nick Hale, who just got out of Dragon Prison, takes a mission from a dying cellmate, Don Rossi, protect his sister, Jade. Nick hides himself as a simple dojo janitor. However, when a rival challenges Jade to a life-or-death duel in seven days, he decides to step in. In the ring, Nick is going to shock everyone with his power.
6981f5438c9423cec40a58c6.title: Ex-Convict Janitor and His Heiress

6981f577c7e068509c080d12.synopsis: In her past life, she was a billionaire business queen, betrayed and poisoned by her husband, brother, and sister-in-law. Only in her final moments did she discover that the nephew she raised was actually her husband’s love child. Now, she's back at her 23rd birthday, ready for revenge. She kicks out the white lotus, freezes her brother's assets, and cancels her engagement to the scumbag fiancé. Cold, ruthless, and out for blood, she'll make every betrayer pay the price.
6981f577c7e068509c080d12.title: You're in for a Wake-Up Call, Betrayers!

6982b061ed85e3869107a582.synopsis: Amelia Sutton wakes up as the disposable character in the novel she read. Forced by her infertile husband, Carey Abbott, to bear a child to secure his title, Amelia makes a daring choice: she picks the future Emperor—the blind musician, Ansel Sinclair. Using her knowledge of the story, she turns from a pawn into the player, becoming the obsession of the man destined to be a tyrant.
6982b061ed85e3869107a582.title: Marry Me, In the Name of No Mercy

6982bd2d44e728684406f6d3.synopsis: Yvette, orphaned daughter of a fallen general, once married Crown Prince Jeremy and suffered endless humiliation. Reborn on the day of the imperial marriage decree, she refuses to repeat her fate. This time, she chooses the Emperor's injured brother, Prince Yale. Miraculously awakened, Yale gives her respect and protection, and love grows between them, while Jeremy, recalling the past, realizes too late he has lost her forever.
6982bd2d44e728684406f6d3.title: My Nephew, The Crown Prince

6982bd61ba37326b560f2747.synopsis: Reborn on the apocalypse day, Albert drops a billion and unlocks god mode. While others fight to survive, he steamrolls the world.
6982bd61ba37326b560f2747.title: Pay to Win: Apocalypse Reset

6982c0bf734764dc370435a5.synopsis: Carl Daniels gets a ring to the Wasteland. A Boss in reality, he becomes a black‑market wheeler‑dealer, trading spicy snack sticks for tech to rule the apocalypse.
6982c0bf734764dc370435a5.title: Doomsday Smuggler: Trading Snacks for Power

6982c0c2734764dc370435a9.synopsis: Reborn as a ruthless entrepreneur, making millions a day seems like no big deal. He rakes in life-saving money through the game, but suddenly, his superpowers spill over into real life! What's going on here? Is the world about to crash down because of it?!
6982c0c2734764dc370435a9.title: Game to Glory

6982c1d252591c5394091518.synopsis: Specters come to the world. While others fight for specros, Caleb Miller uses his trillions to buy up every Spectral Scenario and rule the Specter Realm.
6982c1d252591c5394091518.title: Owning the Specter Realm: Start with a Five-Finger Discount

6982c2e8c7a932870f03d55a.synopsis: Evan makes gods kneel with Forbidden Curses!
6982c2e8c7a932870f03d55a.title: Forbidden Curse: Rise of the Godslayer

6982eaf9e43a3dd2260ab471.synopsis: Reborn as Molly, a noblewoman falsely accused of infidelity, she's poisoned by her husband's concubine. But when a modern-day scientist wakes up in Molly's body, everything changes. Armed with science and vengeance, Molly plans to take back control, divorcing the cold prince Yale and making everyone who betrayed her pay. With the Emperor and Empress on her side, she rises to power, leaving Yale and his concubine in ruin, no love, just victory.
6982eaf9e43a3dd2260ab471.title: The Ugly Consort's Comeback Plan

6982f80fdd4450529f0ac765.synopsis: Sophia, the eldest daughter of the richest Watson family, was kidnapped ten years ago to save her brother Joey. During the escape, she was hit by a car, lost her memory and was rescued and brought up by Old Peter. As an adult, Sophia had to work as a maid for Mrs. Watson to pay for Peter's surgery. Joey and his mother, Mrs. Watson, didn't recognize Sophia and even bullied Joey's fiancée, Sarah, for framing her. Will Mrs. Watson finally be able to reconnect with her biological daughter, Sophia?
6982f80fdd4450529f0ac765.title: The Lost Heiress of a Billionaire Family

6982f814dd4450529f0ac76d.synopsis: Cassie finds out that her sister Lisa is having an affair with her richest boyfriend, Eric. But instead of feeling ashamed, Lisa says Cassie and her mother Helen are a drag because they were born poor. The injured mother nearly died of a heart attack. In order to get back at her sister and her ex-boyfriend, Cassie decides to marry the richest man, Johnny Brisson, and becomes her sister's mother-in-law and her ex's stepmother.
6982f814dd4450529f0ac76d.title: Married The Richest Man After Being Dumped

6982f81bdd4450529f0ac777.synopsis: Hank comes back from the army, finds he can't fit in, has to find a job as a car wash man, and his life is a mess. At the same time, his daughter was sick, but he did not have any money; he had to rely on the help of other men to save his daughter. Hank was rejected by his wife, abandoned by his life, and humiliated by others. There was a rage in him that wanted to change... when he accidentally acquired the power of perspective.
6982f81bdd4450529f0ac777.title: Extreme Gambling Game

6983037d3cb3286b940d97ee.synopsis: In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a community-wide meeting to judge him.
6983037d3cb3286b940d97ee.title: Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village

69840a5f797bc850ea08ed3d.synopsis: In her past life, Evelyn Sinclair was framed by her impostor "sister", locked away in an asylum, and met a tragic end. Reborn, Evelyn's motto is simple: she deals with problems with just action, no talk. When the impostor schemes against her, she retaliates. When her brother picks a fight, she has him arrested... But Lawson, the charming heir who proposed a purely transactional alliance, has become an unexpected complication. Now that her revenge is complete, why won't he leave her side?
69840a5f797bc850ea08ed3d.title: Mad Heiress Unleashed

69840aae74a8087cf002ad7e.synopsis: Henry, a salvager in the dangerous Mynara Sea, is swept away by a storm and gains the legendary Trident of the Sea King, unlocking a supernatural power to see treasure locations. With his newfound abilities, he navigates the treacherous waters, forms alliances with loyal Milo and merchant heiress Sophia, and rises to become the wealthiest and most powerful King of the Sea, determined to conquer the world’s oceans.
69840aae74a8087cf002ad7e.title: The Ocean's Gaze

69840ae27d5c7e868c0e7ae2.synopsis: Mason, a small worker in an antique shop, broke a vase, saved a Divine Dragon, and unexpectedly received the magic power Divine Vision! From then on, counterfeits and fakes could no longer hide. He helped his beautiful boss Clara resolve the crisis, becoming the best appraiser. Big shots from the capital lined up to give money to him! Mason constantly rose and became famous...
69840ae27d5c7e868c0e7ae2.title: Appraiser's Ascension

69840c1593ee7cb2c706be3e.synopsis: After two years at war, Andrew Garrison returns—not to his wife Lesley, but to his sister-in-law Evelyn. Unbeknownst to the Garrison family, Lesley is no helpless wife: she's the student of a renowned healer. While Andrew and Evelyn indulge in their affair, Lesley quietly revives the "deceased" heir Edward and seizes control of the household. In a mansion filled with lies and betrayal, she turns from the scorned woman into the master player.
69840c1593ee7cb2c706be3e.title: Dumped? She's Upgrading!

6984126daf663917f007a406.synopsis: Ethan, raised as an illegitimate child, lives with his mother until his estranged father, Matthew Lewis, reappears on his 18th birthday. Matthew, a feared kingpin, brings Ethan into his world, but it's a family built on cold deals, not love. To save his mother's life, Ethan agrees to serve the underworld. Thrust into a brutal world of crime and loyalty, he fights for those he loves and rises to make the entire underworld tremble. No regrets, no turning back.
6984126daf663917f007a406.title: From Pushover to Underworld Big Shot

698547cf937ed69992046f6d.synopsis: Sydney, secretly the heiress of Lawrence Group, marries Jackson Johnson and buys a house with her own money. But three months into her pregnancy, her mother-in-law, Gloria, moves in, claiming Sydney's home for her son, Jordan. What begins as a battle over family greed and entitlement turns into a war for Sydney's dignity. Justice may be delayed, but it's never denied.
698547cf937ed69992046f6d.title: My Mother-in-Law Wants My House

69857e7ef17e736a77090401.synopsis: All Damon Hayes wanted was to stay hidden in his new cultivation world, quietly enduring his humble job as a night soil collector. That plan was shattered the day he awakened the Intelligent Cultivation System. Instead of a godly tool for ascension, it became his personal guide to hell—stealing from a Demonic Sect Elder, offending the Demonic Saintess, and painting a target on his back for every powerful being in the realm. Now, as a forbidden technique descends upon him and the Saintess sharpens her blade, Damon has just one question for the system: “Was keeping a low profile really that hard?!”
69857e7ef17e736a77090401.title: The Lazy Immortal's Nightmare

69857f83b18aa925de0a090e.synopsis: Maya Nolan, once an abducted heiress, is now the world's top hacker and head of an assassin organization. But she's back for revenge. She infiltrates the Kane household under false pretenses, only to engage in cat and mouse game with her nemesis, the DarkNet Lord, Sebastian. In this crafted vendetta, who will be the ultimate mastermind?
69857f83b18aa925de0a090e.title: Who's Playing Whom?

6985800557e59287390ca4b1.synopsis: Daniel transmigrates into the body of a degenerate gambler, only to wake up and realize his own wife has just poisoned him. Salvation arrives in the form of the "Daily Intelligence System", which grants him crucial foresight each day. Seizing this second chance, Daniel completely reforms, and leverages modern knowledge to introduce advanced firearms, single-handedly turning the tide of battle and earning a noble title. Yet, his greatest challenge comes not from war, but from a rift in time itself, threatening to separate him from the wife he has grown to cherish.
6985800557e59287390ca4b1.title: Did You Just Poison Me, Wife?

6985986605b93e2be30a8c36.synopsis: Reborn as a five-year-old, Talia only wants to protect her mother. But her charm and secret talents soon win over powerful elders and silence the doubters. With a tycoon father, an even richer stepfather, and a future billionaire husband, she grows up as the family's darling, proving that even the smallest star can shine the brightest.
6985986605b93e2be30a8c36.title: Hey Mommy! Time for a New Daddy!

6985aa19b22a3493e806a571.synopsis: Determined to bear a child for her husband, Kyle Baker, Lauren Horton undergoes a risky heart surgery. Little does she know, Kyle is having an affair with intern Grace. During her surgery, Grace makes a critical mistake, but Kyle abandons Lauren on the operating table and leaves with Grace. But soon, he's going to regret it.
6985aa19b22a3493e806a571.title: My Husband, My Killer

69893d5e7adbe9e0af02c669.synopsis: "I'm Jason Hayes, and today, I am reborn. In my past life, I was weak. In this one, I choose to be the villain." From a humble waiter to the king of the underworld, Jason fights back against every bully and outmaneuvers the most powerful figures, including the father-in-law of a crime lord. His ironclad rule: touch what's mine, and you won't survive. Only when he stops stepping aside does Jason learn a brutal truth: the world makes way for those who refuse to move.
69893d5e7adbe9e0af02c669.title: He's Done Being Nice

69894eda02c476566206e5bb.synopsis: They butchered his clan when he was just a boy. A shadow killer pulled him from the ashes and spent fifteen years forging the orphan's grief into a sword, dressed in vengeance. Now, the blade is aimed at the one who erased his past!
69894eda02c476566206e5bb.title: He Who Rises for Blood

69894f2c3428950d97075ec6.synopsis: Evelyn Grant exposes Max Lang using the Grant family for power while cheating with Serena Rivers. She exacts revenge at her wedding and later finds true love with Adrian Preston.
69894f2c3428950d97075ec6.title: Burn at Her Wedding

69894f5dbc0ab958110f10f9.synopsis: Two decades ago, the esteemed Big Nine clans conspired to annihilate the Reid family. Craig Reid, the only survivor, was rescued by a sagacious master who recognized his potential. Under her guidance, Craig's extraordinary talent propelled him to the zenith of earthly cultivation, poised for ascension. Yet, the anticipated heavenly tribulation never came. His master, sensing that Craig's destiny was tangled with unresolved karma, expelled him from the sect. Now, Craig crosses paths with Zoe Zimmer and finds himself drawn into her battle against one of the Big Nine. Maybe this is the key to his long-awaited breakthrough.
69894f5dbc0ab958110f10f9.title: Crimson Storm: Lone Avenger

6989507a210388144101a21e.synopsis: When lawyer Elaine is accused of harboring her son who assaulted a neighbor, she must prove her only "son" is actually her dog, Cole. But the conspiracy deepens: fake DNA reports, a sudden pregnancy, and even her long-lost father return to torment her. Trapped in a web of lies and public shame, Elaine fights not just for her reputation, but to expose a ruthless scheme targeting single women.
6989507a210388144101a21e.title: The Prey's Counterattack

698950ac954a6db7f10123db.synopsis: While Bluewave Holdings' CEO Matthew is away, his deputy Zoe holds the company together until an intern, Melody, falsely claims she's pregnant with his child to grab power. Her deception escalates into workplace sabotage and a damaged deal. When Matthew returns, he exposes the truth, and amid the fallout, he and Zoe finally see that trust has grown into love.
698950ac954a6db7f10123db.title: The Impostor's Diadem

69897fe76ccc6463510d1af6.synopsis: After an accident, modern weapons expert Wendy awakens in ancient times in the body of a notorious lovestruck girl and must marry by twenty or face prison. She chooses the shy yet handsome Prince Zeller, but when war descends, she turns genius into firepower, forging weapons, saving the kingdom, and turning a forced match into true love.
69897fe76ccc6463510d1af6.title: The Prince and His Precious Vixen

698980a71775764b9a05a761.synopsis: After catching her fiancé cheating, Faith survives a car accident and is rescued by Grandma Zimmer, who mentors her into the Vice CEO of Zimmer Group. The spoiled heir Sam falls for her at first sight. Their arranged marriage sparks chaos, comedy, and unexpected romance.
698980a71775764b9a05a761.title: The Heir's Daily Confession

698a91d9056e74e3a406858d.synopsis: Victoria Bennett has it all: wealth, status, and Adrian Sinclair, a billionaire heir obsessed with marrying her. But her world is built on a lie. On the eve of their wedding, Victoria makes an unforgivable choice to pacify Ethan's suicidal threats, shattering Adrian's trust forever. At the altar, Adrian replaces her with Madeleine Lang.
698a91d9056e74e3a406858d.title: The Last Time I Forgive

698aa5b145e941c96d02e26a.synopsis: Grace Shaw, drugged while saving a man overseas, has a one-night stand with a stranger, Nathan Fenton. Back home, Nathan returns to break off an engagement. But he didn't know his fiancée was Grace. To reclaim her family's company, Grace forces him to stay engaged. Neither knows the other's true identity. Secrets and missed chances keep them apart until the truth surfaces, the past is revealed, and love finds its way back.
698aa5b145e941c96d02e26a.title: One-Night Stand With the Right Man

698aa7692b6093d39b007d83.synopsis: Sugar was adopted by the Millers but got abused and regarded as a demon due to her supernatural abilities. Actually, she was the granddaughter of Lord Underworld. Her dad knew about Sugar's background and rushed to find the Millers. By then, Sugar had been sold to a research institute. Her dad rescued Sugar in time and brought her back home. Sugar cured her Grandma, helped Uncle Chase stand up, and resolved the crisis of Uncle Jasper. Finally, she smashed the scheme of Lord Julian and reunited with her Grandpa, Lord Underworld.
698aa7692b6093d39b007d83.title: The Girl Who Healed Death

698aa797e37e04d9f60ca689.synopsis: On his engagement day, Bentley catches his fiancée's mother Cynthia in bed with her childhood friend Derek York. Before he can expose them, he's killed in a staged accident. Reborn on that same fateful day, Bentley has a new weapon: a live broadcast. He secretly administers an aphrodisiac to the illicit couple, streaming their compromising moment to the entire guest list. However, Bentley's quest for vengeance delves even deeper. His investigation uncovers a sinister plot involving Derek and his father. Bentley seizes this chance to decisively eliminate Derek, leaving his fiancée's family in regret...
698aa797e37e04d9f60ca689.title: Airing Their Dirty Laundry

698ac6b65204afad3507202d.synopsis: My little sister fell into a deathlike trance when she was six. I buried her with my own hands, thinking she was gone forever. But ten years later, she walked back into my life—just in time to save me from hell. Now the powerful family torturing me is about to learn the hard way: mess with my sister, and you answer to a goddess.
698ac6b65204afad3507202d.title: My Sister Is the Phoenix

698ac6feaefc0e37bc078596.synopsis: Empress Dowager Selena Hale is poisoned and reincarnated as Clara Satin, the illegitimate daughter of the Prime Minister. Shockingly, she becomes the concubine of her own adopted son, the reigning Emperor Saul Rex. Obsessed with his "mother," Saul conducts a three-year ritual to summon her spirit, unaware it now resides within Clara. Initially determined to escape the palace, Clara finds herself gradually drawn to Saul...
698ac6feaefc0e37bc078596.title: Entwined by Fate, Reborn to Love

698ac72855539fb4b50f1f81.synopsis: Fayne Carter wakes up as a despised live-in son-in-law, constantly humiliated by his cheating wife and her lover. Just when he's about to snap, he unlocks a game-changing system: spend on his "wife" and get 10x cash back. But Fayne quickly discovers a loophole—any married woman qualifies. From his mother-in-law to his rival's wife, he starts spoiling them all, stacking millions while turning the tables on everyone who once looked down on him.
698ac72855539fb4b50f1f81.title: Bugged Love: Spoiling His Wives

698ac752905a24e1b40a03da.synopsis: Maeve Astor, the time-traveling Princess Imperial of Zhouland, spends a decade transforming her husband, Alex Roy, from a penniless guy into a business tycoon. She even donates her kidney to him. Yet, during his sister's engagement party, Alex brazenly arrives with his mistress and their love child. Maeve finally awakens and secretly initiates a financial reckoning. She leaves behind three explosive documents that will bring her betrayers to their graves.
698ac752905a24e1b40a03da.title: He Begged, She Left

698af4a70cf40cc901023963.synopsis: Six years ago, Nina had a one-night affair with Dragon Sovereign Jayden, resulting in twins, her daughter Talia raised by her, and their other daughter taken by Jayden to the dragon clan. Six years later, Nina returns, determined to find Jayden for her daughter's treatment. When the twins are mistaken for each other, misunderstandings pile up, but through their matchmaking, Nina and Jayden are reunited, and all truths finally come to light.
698af4a70cf40cc901023963.title: Fated to Love the Dragon Again

698af5d5d250ba389b084f7a.synopsis: Ethan Lance, at Deity Transformation Stage, descends the mountain to find his disciples ruling the city.
698af5d5d250ba389b084f7a.title: Any Global Tycoon Is My Disciple

698af62315bf0d110a06acbe.synopsis: Ethan Lance, at Deity Transformation Stage, descends the mountain to find his disciples ruling the city.
698af62315bf0d110a06acbe.title: Any Global Tycoon Is My Disciple

698b070947fa4ef43f04a872.synopsis: A duke's daughter once propelled her husband to become a legendary general, only to face betrayal and execution at the hands of him and his mother. Reborn from the ashes, she returns with a steely resolve and a heart of ice. Methodically, she dismantles those who wronged her: vanquishing her cunning half-sister, executing her malicious stepmother, reclaiming her mother's stolen dowry, and ensuring her treacherous husband and his favored concubine meet their end by her sword.
698b070947fa4ef43f04a872.title: From General's Scorned Wife to His Final Judgment

698b081c2eb059d87c0e5ff4.synopsis: Evelyn, a modern food delivery worker, catches her boyfriend cheating and storms off, only to be whisked by her glowing jade pendant into the imperial palace of the Everlasting Kingdom. Using pizza, she cures Emperor Elliot's eating disorder and avoids danger. Discovering her delivery box preserves items across time, she trades ancient goods for cash to help her mother. Traveling between eras, she aids Elliot in palace and battlefield crises and sparks a romance that spans time itself.
698b081c2eb059d87c0e5ff4.title: Delivery to the Emperor

698bef948a4eb4de720d8482.synopsis: Nick Hale, who just got out of Dragon Prison, takes a mission from a dying cellmate, Don Rossi, protect his sister, Jade. Nick hides himself as a simple dojo janitor. However, when a rival challenges Jade to a life-or-death duel in seven days, he decides to step in. In the ring, Nick is going to shock everyone with his power.
698bef948a4eb4de720d8482.title: Ex-Convict Janitor and His Heiress

698c6c746633251c22050abc.synopsis: The Sterling curse strikes again—Arthur Sterling is poisoned. Berry fights to save him, but trouble arrives when Arthur’s jealous adopted daughter, Joanna, returns from abroad, teaming up with a girl claiming to be the family’s “Chosen Girl” to take Berry down. With Paxton and new ally Drake by her side, Berry survives the chaos—and emerges as the one true heiress.
698c6c746633251c22050abc.title: Little Heiress, Big Daddy 2

698c6cb93a6e97d8d703baf3.synopsis: Ethan Hayes travels back to the millennium with X-Ray vision. He finds Philip's artifact and Emperor Kane's porcelain. With Grace, he fights smugglers to retrieve lost treasures.
698c6cb93a6e97d8d703baf3.title: REBORN 2008: X-RAY VISION

698c6ce5c0f7679f8807f8cd.synopsis: When the evil cultivator Evan was cultivating with some ladies in the Immortal Realm, he fell into the mortal world and was transported to the body of a timid man with the same name. The original owner was imprisoned by his paranoid and spoiled fiancee, not allowed to leave the bedroom, and suffered humiliation. His two sisters-in-law also despised him for lacking masculinity, causing him great suffering. On the night when Evan was possessed by the evil cultivator, his spoiled fiancee came. This once timid fiance suddenly became a badass...
698c6ce5c0f7679f8807f8cd.title: The Devil in Disguise

698c6d6db14ad8ff000cfd92.synopsis: He was just a nobody dock worker. After an accident unlocks a power in his eyes, he starts seeing through every shipping container. What starts as stealing from the rich turns into a full-blown war against pirates and the mob. He's building an empire one secret at a time. This isn't just luck—it's the ultimate underdog story, powered by vision and guts.
698c6d6db14ad8ff000cfd92.title: The Unsealer

698da2dcadd4b743a80e2b5f.synopsis: Vivian, a 200-pound mother of three, is neglected by her husband and bullied by his childhood friend who covets her place. But fate intervenes when the soul of an Empress awakens within her. The ancient ruler wastes no time—shedding weight, reclaiming beauty, and seizing her own destiny. As a dazzling new Vivian emerges, her husband scrambles to win her back. But her eyes are set on a far grander prize: building an empire of her own.
698da2dcadd4b743a80e2b5f.title: Reborn Queen in the Modern World

698db830f71689fad4024f1d.synopsis: In her previous life, Evelyn was the spoiled Collins heiress. Her fiance Bill suddenly got back a girl named Lila, claiming Lila was the true Collins heiress who had been lost. On the wedding day, Lila's birth parents switched the wedding car, making Evelyn marry Bill's brother Victor, who had jinxed five wives. Evelyn forced Bill to marry her, but all she got was three years of cold marriage. Bill died and wanted to be with Lila in the next life. After rebirth, when the wedding car stopped, Evelyn chose Victor, becoming Bill's sister-in-law.
698db830f71689fad4024f1d.title: The Second Life Vow

698dba8acbc92f415300583b.synopsis: Star astronaut Maya discovers her husband in bed with a TV reporter. His excuse? A fake twin brother. She plays along, boards her shuttle to explore a black hole—and returns a different woman.
698dba8acbc92f415300583b.title: Orbiting Betrayal

698dbac16d6b6726930483a8.synopsis: CEO Elaine Langley finds her husband Kevin Hayes gifted her villa to mistress Fiona Monroe. Elaine exacts revenge on the betrayers.
698dbac16d6b6726930483a8.title: She Fled Hell Only to Marry Fate

698f5880288ee1b4750751f5.synopsis: Yvette, orphaned daughter of a fallen general, once married Crown Prince Jeremy and suffered endless humiliation. Reborn on the day of the imperial marriage decree, she refuses to repeat her fate. This time, she chooses the Emperor's injured brother, Prince Yale. Miraculously awakened, Yale gives her respect and protection, and love grows between them, while Jeremy, recalling the past, realizes too late he has lost her forever.
698f5880288ee1b4750751f5.title: My Nephew, The Crown Prince

6991360de9a7e6fa700a8514.synopsis: A submissive husband is secretly the billionaire chairman. Unaware, his wife scorns him and neglects their daughter for a deal. David Collins reveals the truth to make them pay.
6991360de9a7e6fa700a8514.title: The Forgotten Husband

699136c188f643587c0785a6.synopsis: After five years of marriage, Grayson's ex shows up with a child. Nancy catches her husband, Grayson, cheating and doesn't hesitate. She divorces him on the spot while revealing she's moved on and expecting again. Grayson regrets everything and begs for a second chance, but Nancy's heart is won by Samuel, her longtime secret admirer, who is younger than her. In the end, his devotion finally earns her love and happiness.
699136c188f643587c0785a6.title: Goodbye, Liar

6991371b5b3b38697f0aa016.synopsis: During seven years of marriage to Ethan Grant, Vivian Whitmore has endured endless neglect as her husband openly favors his "dream girl", Angela. On their child's full-month celebration, Vivian reaches her breaking point. She announces divorce before all the guests, reveals the baby isn't Ethan's, and pulls her investments—plunging the Grant empire into chaos. The truth exposed and her revenge served, Vivian walks away with her child, leaving Ethan drowning in regret he can never undo.
6991371b5b3b38697f0aa016.title: I Took It All Back

699162c39ba5fa692c0b9368.synopsis: Two decades ago, the esteemed Big Nine clans conspired to annihilate the Reid family. Craig Reid, the only survivor, was rescued by a sagacious master who recognized his potential. Under his guidance, Craig's extraordinary talent propelled him to the zenith of earthly cultivation, poised for ascension. Yet, the anticipated heavenly tribulation never came. His master, sensing that Craig's destiny was tangled with unresolved karma, expelled him from the sect. Now, Craig crosses paths with Zoe Zimmer and finds himself drawn into her battle against one of the Big Nine. Maybe this is the key to his long-awaited breakthrough.
699162c39ba5fa692c0b9368.title: Crimson Storm: Lone Avenger

699163d1565822437b0a35aa.synopsis: Elaine Carver is reborn on the day her brother, Ryan, demands she buy him a luxury car. In her past life, this single act buried her under crippling debt and led to her death. Now armed with foresight, she watches coldly as Ryan runs up an astronomical bill at the dealership. When the final invoice—a staggering 100 million—is presented, Elaine refuses to pay. Her family is left in shock. This time, Elaine is fighting back, and they are about to face the full consequences of their greed.
699163d1565822437b0a35aa.title: Sister's Rebirth

6991fdca4641e509290a004f.synopsis: Solar storms strike the Inferno, trapping 8 billion people in a deadly survival game. Betrayed and killed the ones he trusts, Alex is reborn with the 100x Resource Multiplier System. Unlimited resources. Infinite upgrades. This time, he’ll kill the big Boss and claim victory!
6991fdca4641e509290a004f.title: Doomsday Game: Unlimited Shelter Upgrades

6991fe8e2af7111d3a0eb3bd.synopsis: While others break through the 10th level of Energy Refining stage, Ether Reed stands at the 9999th level. Techniques revered as imperial treasures are kindling to him, and legendary artifacts are simply his household items. Even the sacred beasts, worshipped by all, eagerly compete to guard his house. Enter a world where the extraordinary is just everyday life for Ether Reed.
6991fe8e2af7111d3a0eb3bd.title: Already Invincible at Energy Refining

699480c623c5511b8f0cf7f4.synopsis: By day, Brooklyn is a broke college student from the trailer park. But online, she’s Echo—a fearless gamer gunning for the $50,000 Blackgrove Reign tournament prize, her one shot at freedom. To win, she has to dethrone Thorne, the reigning champion. What she doesn’t know? Thorne is really Ethan—the hot, cocky frat king who also happens to be her TA… and her best friend’s older brother. After they butt heads in real life, Ethan discovers Brooklyn is Echo and enters the game to toy with her—only to find himself drawn to her skill, fire, and spirit. Online, they become unstoppable partners. Offline, they’re bitter rivals. When will Brooklyn realize Ethan is Thorne, and can these sworn enemies stop fighting long enough to see they’re perfect for each other?
699480c623c5511b8f0cf7f4.title: Outplayed

6994c7def370c522ef066652.synopsis: In The Billionaire and the Baby Trap movie, to get out of her loveless marriage, Elara needs to get pregnant, but her husband refuses to touch her. One fateful night, she finds herself in Cole's arms, not knowing he's a secret billionaire CEO -- and her husband's uncle. When will Elara realize Cole's identity -- and that he's just the Mr. Right she's been looking for.
6994c7def370c522ef066652.title: The Billionaire and the Baby Trap

6995279a2cf4914de40f37a3.synopsis: A duke's daughter once propelled her husband to become a legendary general, only to face betrayal and execution at the hands of him and his mother. Reborn from the ashes, she returns with a steely resolve and a heart of ice. Methodically, she dismantles those who wronged her: vanquishing her cunning half-sister, executing her malicious stepmother, reclaiming her mother's stolen dowry, and ensuring her treacherous husband and his favored concubine meet their end by her sword.
6995279a2cf4914de40f37a3.title: From General's Scorned Wife to His Final Judgment

69990ddfa1b763a13b0e97fe.synopsis: Isaac Kane is a single father with a dark secret: he was once the most feared killer on the planet. After making a vow to his dying wife to never kill again, he now spends his days as a down-on-his-luck single father. But when his daughter is kidnapped by a major crime family, he must break his vow... and kill his way through the Russian Mafia, while re-taking his place as a near-mythic killer that haunts the nightmares of the wicked.
69990ddfa1b763a13b0e97fe.title: Return of the Reaper

6999c0e37b131be77a0c302c.synopsis: While Bluewave Holdings' CEO Matthew is away, his deputy Zoe holds the company together until an intern, Melody, falsely claims she's pregnant with his child to grab power. Her deception escalates into workplace sabotage and a damaged deal. When Matthew returns, he exposes the truth, and amid the fallout, he and Zoe finally see that trust has grown into love.
6999c0e37b131be77a0c302c.title: The Impostor's Diadem

6999c2c5813f9ac02b04931d.synopsis: On his wedding night, Adrian wakes up and finds that his bride's in his cousin's bed. Humiliated. Mocked. But Adrian's not the fool they remember. He's armed with a system that turns black sheep into legends—poetry, martial arts, medicine, business. He masters it all overnight. His secret weapon? Claire Collins. The noble lady who was forced to marry him. Except she's lived this life before—and this time, she chose him.
6999c2c5813f9ac02b04931d.title: Smile and Endure? Not This Time

699a3b6b850d2b8e8208155f.synopsis: Maria’s perfect life crumbles when she discovers her fiancé's affair. Determined to take control, she confronts betrayal, finds herself drawn to Alec, her long-lost ex and now a billionaire. As their paths collide, old feelings awaken, and Maria discovers that love can be unexpected, passionate, and impossible to ignore.
699a3b6b850d2b8e8208155f.title: Cancel the Wedding, Queen Moves On

699aeec3639423343608c5b1.synopsis: Billionaire heiress Tessa Chandler hides her identity to marry for love, supporting Victor Walkers and his entire family. Once they’re living in comfort, gratitude turns to abuse, escalating after she gives birth. But when her powerful mother arrives and sees the truth, the ungrateful family’s luck runs out.
699aeec3639423343608c5b1.title: The Three-Year Trial

699c01467466f67723080afb.synopsis: Fayne Carter wakes up as a despised live-in son-in-law, constantly humiliated by his cheating wife and her lover. Just when he's about to snap, he unlocks a game-changing system: spend on his "wife" and get 10x cash back. But Fayne quickly discovers a loophole—any married woman qualifies. From his mother-in-law to his rival's wife, he starts spoiling them all, stacking millions while turning the tables on everyone who once looked down on him.
699c01467466f67723080afb.title: Bugged Love: Spoiling His Wives

699c01cdca499949fd019b54.synopsis: Ethan Hayes travels back to the millennium with X-Ray vision. He finds Philip's artifact and Emperor Kane's porcelain. With Grace, he fights smugglers to retrieve lost treasures.
699c01cdca499949fd019b54.title: REBORN 2008: X-RAY VISION
