69df53b59eb806ddd80723eb.synopsis: Mrs. Gallagher receives a massive relocation payout and plans to split it between her two biological sons. But Mr. Henderson warns that her sons may not be truly devoted, unlike her adopted girl. He suggests testing their loyalty. The test proves her sons are greedy, while her adopted eldest girl is genuinely loving. Yet, clinging to the traditional belief of raising sons as a retirement plan, Mrs. Gallagher gives the payout to her sons and rotates living with them. Her daughter graciously accepts this. However, Mrs. Gallagher faces severe mistreatment from her sons and daughters-in-law, and it is the eldest girl who defends her every time. Through these ordeals, she gradually realizes that raising sons as a retirement plan is no guarantee. Blood isn't the only family bond, and only a grateful heart deserves true devotion...
69df53b59eb806ddd80723eb.title: Mom's Relocation Payout

69df53b69eb806ddd80723ed.synopsis: Housewife Audrey Hayes suffers endless torment from her mother-in-law Edith Miller and husband Derek Miller for giving birth to Audrey. Favoring boys over girls, Edith relentlessly bullies Audrey Hayes, knowing she has no family backing. Meanwhile, her deadbeat Derek leeches off his parents, games all day, cheats repeatedly, and cowardly ignores their conflicts. Pushed to the limit after catching Derek with a prostitute again, Audrey Hayes demands a divorce but gets trapped in battles over property and custody. Later, her biological mother Josephine Kingsley steps in, empowering her to start over. She fights back, reclaims her life, and wins the house and Audrey's custody, while her toxic ex-in-laws finally get what they deserve.
69df53b69eb806ddd80723ed.title: A Mother's Rebirth

69df5f70827a5e662a0c672b.synopsis: Disguising herself as ugly, Clara marries elite heir Jace to honor her mother's wish. She thinks he loves her true self, but she's just his pawn to defy his family and shield his first love. After three years of abuse, she divorces him, unveils her beauty, and shocks everyone. Jace begs for a second chance, but Clara is done. Is his belated love too late?
69df5f70827a5e662a0c672b.title: Love After Lies

69df5fd2827a5e662a0c677f.synopsis: Grace spent fifteen years loving a family that never loved her back. Then her cousin stole her college spot, her fiancé, and her wedding—so Grace walked out, vanished into the desert, and became a legend.
69df5fd2827a5e662a0c677f.title: Burn the Past, Guard the Nation

69df6020827a5e662a0c67a9.synopsis: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.
69df6020827a5e662a0c67a9.title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal

69e06ab4fef68f21b602f27e.synopsis: College junior Gabriel dumps his gold-digging girlfriend, only to be dragged home by a stunning CEO. His dad married a billionaire, making the CEO and the campus belle his stepsisters! They suspect he is after the Tatum family fortune, but Gabriel suddenly awakens the Foresight System! With its power, he rises to the top!
69e06ab4fef68f21b602f27e.title: Dumped, My Step-Sisters Want Me

69e077e0e7501eebf60c5835.synopsis: Audra Valecrest, a 9-9-6 corporate drone, dies and wakes up as the Empire’s vicious Second Princess in a world ruled by women. The original princess abused her four S-rank mates and was obsessed with Damien Vale, a little schemer, until she was poisoned. But this time, Audra gets a luxury-spending system: spend on her mates to unlock 10x cashback and special powers. She saves the badly wounded General Hawthorne Adrian Hawthorne, calms the raging White Tiger War God Rhett Valecrest, rescues the merfolk marshal Nereus Blackwell at sea, and wins over Lucien Ashbourne, the scheming nine-tailed fox council president. As she puts First Princess Celia Valecrest and every villain in their place, she awakens her SSS golden bloodline, stops the Empire’s beast transformation crisis and rebellion, then rises as Queen to rebuild the Empire with her four lovers.
69e077e0e7501eebf60c5835.title: Villain Princess, Four Lovers

69e07a2ccc56265d4b029700.synopsis: In his past life, James's wife cheated on him and always spent time with her first love. Reborn, James decided not to marry Jane. This time, he tossed the marriage application paper away and left for college, building a fortune through grit and sharp instinct. Yara's sincerity healed what Jane broke. When James rose to the top, Jane realized her chance was gone forever. That man would never come back. He had met his true love.
69e07a2ccc56265d4b029700.title: Reborn: This Time I Won't Marry You

69e07a3498c748e19c0ff351.synopsis: Two years ago, Sarah Cole's life was destroyed by her ex-husband's powerful family. Her mother died disgraced, and Sarah disappeared. Now she returns as a world-class surgeon. When the Hayes family faces a life-or-death crisis, the only doctor who can save them is the woman they once crushed. Looking at her former father-in-law, she asks coldly, "My ex father-in-law, right? Need my help?" The media erupts, but one thing is clear. The old Dr. Cole is gone. She came back for revenge.
69e07a3498c748e19c0ff351.title: Scalpel of Revenge

69e07a3736efb1d52f0bd7be.synopsis: In his previous life, James Lewis married his three childhood sweethearts one by one, only to be trapped in miserable marriages and labeled a jinx who doomed his wives. In this life, he rejects them all and turns to marry Vivian Shaw, the illegitimate daughter of a wealthy family in the Northern City. Little does he know that the future aloof business tycoon has been his secret admirer for years. Post-wedding sweetness strikes hard, with face-slapping revenge dialed to the max!
69e07a3736efb1d52f0bd7be.title: Childhood Sweethearts, Get out of My Way

69e07c8e75b7bc26be0f6839.synopsis: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.
69e07c8e75b7bc26be0f6839.title: Exiled to Emperor

69e0b7f139a61953f9025ea7.synopsis: In the Love Under Fire movie, When a disciplined former Secret Service agent is forced to partner with a reckless global pop star after his daughter is kidnapped by her obsessive ex, their race across the Philippines ignites a volatile romance- one that forces them to choose between control, trust, and the people they love most.
69e0b7f139a61953f9025ea7.title: Love Under Fire

69e0c0b34f69687e830a8270.synopsis: Kyle, once deemed unable to cultivate, was forced into a deadly succession trial as a disposable pawn. His parents were killed protecting him. After three years in hiding, he returns, awakened by a mysterious black tome through his unyielding will, inheriting a forbidden power. Reborn through suffering, Kyle rises step by step to the peak of strength, no longer the boy they discarded, but a force that challenges so-called invincibility.
69e0c0b34f69687e830a8270.title: Unworthy No More

69e0c9727142f8a98f08222e.synopsis: Life on the road. She drives the truck while her husband rests in the cargo hold. But every time, he comes out more exhausted, eats meals in secret, and never lets her near the back. Curious but trusting, she keeps driving—until one day, a strange woman's voice drifts from the trailer. She looks. And finds her husband has been hiding a woman inside all along.
69e0c9727142f8a98f08222e.title: The Secret Cargo

69e0e6d3172c5aa059024658.synopsis: A female general watches her husband die taking an arrow meant for her. As she falls from a cliff, she swears: if given another life, she will love him better. Then she wakes up—five years earlier, on the day of their engagement. This time, she marries him without hesitation. Armed with memories of the future, she foils her brother's schemes, dismantles a rival's plots, and mends every rift with her husband and his mother. Together, she helps him rise to the highest office—while earning the empire's highest honor for herself. The swords of the past become the foundation of their happiness.
69e0e6d3172c5aa059024658.title: Die For You, Kill For All

69e1a219b0e4eed2b00bf311.synopsis: Reborn on the very day Valerie Stanton breaks off their engagement and humiliates him publicly, Miles Sterling awakens the Goddess Conquest System. He opens lucky chests, crushes Felix Vance and the security guards with ease, and turns Valerie’s attitude around instantly. After unlocking a $50 million black card from a chest, he exposes her desperate funding crisis. Valerie begs and fawns over him for a loan, her favor skyrocketing. Dominating the system step by step, Miles rises to the very peak of success!
69e1a219b0e4eed2b00bf311.title: Reborn: Female CEO at My Feet

69e1a21bb0e4eed2b00bf317.synopsis: Reborn on the very day Valerie Stanton breaks off their engagement and humiliates him publicly, Miles Sterling awakens the Goddess Conquest System. He opens lucky chests, crushes Felix Vance and the security guards with ease, and turns Valerie’s attitude around instantly. After unlocking a $50 million black card from a chest, he exposes her desperate funding crisis. Valerie begs and fawns over him for a loan, her favor skyrocketing. Dominating the system step by step, Miles rises to the very peak of success!
69e1a21bb0e4eed2b00bf317.title: Reborn: Female CEO at My Feet

69e1a3085752c3c76803bf49.synopsis: Money-obsessed, reborn Sophie saves Sebastian, the golden boy of the Kingson family, who poses as a frail man. When his cover is blown, she takes a massive payout and runs. Devastated, the obsessive man vows to win her back at all costs.
69e1a3085752c3c76803bf49.title: Runaway Gold Digger and Obsessed Heir

69e1a61570dbe63c34019be3.synopsis: Cole was the heir of the Lancaster family. He was the only son of his late parents. He learned martial arts in the mountains for years. He returned to inherit the family business. At his birthday party, he made a crazy wish. He just wanted to sleep and played video games. Everyone thought he was a total loser. They mocked him, and his fiancee dumped him. Cole ignored the insults. His parents' killer finally showed up. Cole revealed his true power. He was a hidden big shot, the Godfather. He lured the enemy out and took revenge for his parents. When his fiancee begged him back, he said no.
69e1a61570dbe63c34019be3.title: Loser? Call Me Godfather!

69e1d9966a3cf0904c08ec99.synopsis: Cleo, daughter of the famed “Cockfight Sage,” steps back into the arena to save her gambler husband, Jared Foster. She fights her way through elite opponents to clear a crushing debt, only to uncover the truth: her senior brother killed her father and tried to wipe her out. In the final match, Cleo takes him down and walks away—for good—proving the only winning move is to stop playing.
69e1d9966a3cf0904c08ec99.title: Rooster’s Reckoning

69e1e948944e29afc505c503.synopsis: A modern special forces soldier, Arthur Lancaster, dies and reincarnates as the worthless Third Prince of Valorian Dynasty. Framed for assault by Crown Prince Victor and his scheming sister-in-law Isabella, Arthur awakens a modern military arsenal and strikes back. The arrogant Viperian army provokes Valoria with matchlock guns. After Victor’s humiliating defeat, Arthur steps up to defend his nation’s honor. Overconfident in their weapons, the Vipers wage war under a false pretense. Unleashing tanks, warplanes and carriers, Arthur crushes their expansion. In the final battle, nuclear fire wipes out the Viperians and levels their island realms.
69e1e948944e29afc505c503.title: Ancient Prince, Modern Arsenal

69e1ea74eb4417c18d0069be.synopsis: Sold out by her blood, killed by the sister they chose over her. Vera died in a prison cell, taking the blame for a crime she didn't commit. Now reborn eight years earlier, she walks away from the family fortune—and builds her own, just to watch them beg.
69e1ea74eb4417c18d0069be.title: Born Again to Break Them

69e1eb64e5cdd30ee90604ec.synopsis: Evan Cooper runs a butcher shop in Silverport with his cousin Nolan. He was slaved away at this shop, helping make over $2 million a year—yet only earned $80,000. Sick of being exploited, he risked a $200,000 debt to open his own honest, fresh meat shop and quickly won loyal customers. His greedy cousin Nolan used rotten, tainted meat to cut costs, leading to a $3 million ruin, a broken family, and total disgrace. When relatives tried to frame Evan, his parents stood by him. Evan went on to secure huge contracts, took over a meatpacking plant, paid off all debts, and brought his family to Silverport. Nolan, however, was left crippled and homeless, crushed by his own greed. A brutal, inspiring story: integrity wins, greed destroys.
69e1eb64e5cdd30ee90604ec.title: Betrayal. Beef. Billions.

69e1ed80181157a0e307870d.synopsis: In 1972, orphan Bruce unlocks his grandfather's geomancy secrets. Mastering Psychic Geography, he puts his cruel uncle, snobby Captain Nolan, and arrogant Sea City experts in their place. Rising from a lowly worker in the Production Brigade to an elite geological consultant, Bruce saves the county, marries his true love, and achieves ultimate success.
69e1ed80181157a0e307870d.title: Orphan Rises from the Ashes

69e1f3d8a2af2266a40dc7da.synopsis: After a decade in prison taking his father’s fall, Desmond Kensington comes home to save his mother—only to be tormented relentlessly by his cruel stepmother Veronica and her illegitimate son Roland. Biding his time in silence, he leverages sharp wit and bold resolve to seize the security division, Metropolis Club and Pinnacle Capital, tightening his grip on the core of the Kensington Group. Hiding his fearsome alias Lord Nonus, he allies with Elena to uncover the truth behind his elder brother’s death, lay bare Veronica’s twisted plots, and settle every past score. From a disgraced prison outcast to a dominant tycoon, he strikes with ruthless force to uproot decay, make all wrongdoers pay, and climb to the pinnacle of power to rule the business world.
69e1f3d8a2af2266a40dc7da.title: Heir’s Wrath

69e203c59c99c9b9df07a870.synopsis: Aria Sinclair endured six years of a loveless marriage to Christopher, CEO of Sterling Group. When she discovers that he has been emotionally manipulated by Savannah Prescott, a woman posing as his first love and secret pen pal, she chooses to walk away. But Aria is no ordinary ex-wife. Hidden behind her seemingly humble identity is the Prescott heiress and the world-renowned jewelry designer known only as K. As she rises from the ashes of a broken marriage, she reclaims her lost fortune, exposes Savannah's lies, and confronts the dark family conspiracy that cost her adoptive father his life.
69e203c59c99c9b9df07a870.title: Scorched Vows

69e203c79c99c9b9df07a874.synopsis: Top modern assassin Sylvia Lockwood dies and wakes up in the body of a woman with the same name. Her father died in battle. To survive in The Lockwood Family, her mother disguised her as a boy since birth. Sylvia longs to be a woman, but fears they will be killed if exposed. She plans to flee. Instead, she catches the eye of Valerian Blackwood, the ruthless and powerful lord of The Empire of Aethelgard. Taken to his manor, she begins a life of pecking and matching wits with him to survive.
69e203c79c99c9b9df07a874.title: Chosen by the Regent–Season 3

69e2210a4e0b0a84af08df40.synopsis: College junior Gabriel dumps his gold-digging girlfriend, only to be dragged home by a stunning CEO. His dad married a billionaire, making the CEO and the campus belle his stepsisters! They suspect he is after the Tatum family fortune, but Gabriel suddenly awakens the Foresight System! With its power, he rises to the top!
69e2210a4e0b0a84af08df40.title: Dumped, My Step-Sisters Want Me

69e338710a2a37e91b0874fd.synopsis: With her mother deceased and father deployed, Penny Sterling suffers abuse from her uncle, Frank Dixon. After she faints from hunger, Sarah Granger saves her, and Penny's lucky nature rewards Sarah and Amos Granger with unexpected food. Locked out for returning late, Penny stays with the Grangers. Frank then kicks Penny out upon hearing her father, David Sterling, is dead and his stipend stopped. Sarah adopts Penny for 5 pounds of white flour, dividing her household to do so. When Mayor Higgins delivers David's death benefits, a greedy Frank tries to snatch Penny back. Penny then discovers rare herbs and saves Elite Physician Dr. Elias Hawthorne. Just as Rachel Granger plots with traffickers, a recovering David returns to rescue his daughter. He recognizes Dr. Hawthorne as Penny's granddad. The reunited family decides to start anew in the city.
69e338710a2a37e91b0874fd.title: Welcome Home, Penny

69e338780a2a37e91b08750d.synopsis: When Maya Sterling's husband Leo dies at the construction site, he leaves a $2 million death benefit. Seeking comfort from her family, Maya faces abuse from her mother and brothers, who favor boys over girls. Labeling her a jinx, they demand her only home. Leo's boss, Victor Hawthorne, intervenes, suggesting she fake leukemia to test their loyalty. Their true greed surfaces. Heartbroken, Maya reclaims her money and cuts ties completely. Her brothers soon fall into gambling debts, their wives flee, and her mother becomes paralyzed from stress. Maya embraces a new life, leaving her family to regret their cruelty.
69e338780a2a37e91b08750d.title: My Sister's Death Benefit

69e338790a2a37e91b08750f.synopsis: Billionaire CEO Victoria Sterling marries barber Garrett Fletcher, but is betrayed by him and the nanny, Stella Moore. Driven by patriarchal sexism, they sell her newborn daughter, fake her death, and swap in the boy, Zachary Fletcher, to gain her trust and steal her fortune. Victoria Sterling endures 23 years of humiliation while secretly guiding her sold daughter to become the richest woman in the country, Morgan Sterling. At the company handover, mother and daughter unite to expose the truth, ruining the four Fletchers. Garrett Fletcher is jailed for money laundering and murder, Stella Moore is sentenced for child trafficking, Zachary Fletcher is arrested for embezzlement, and Mrs. Fletcher suffers a stroke. Mother and daughter finally reunite, and the villains face justice.
69e338790a2a37e91b08750f.title: Never Marry a Gold-Digging Social Climber

69e3387a0a2a37e91b087513.synopsis: Grace Bennett remarries Ethan Foster, bringing her daughter Emma. But she faces relentless bullying and suspicion from Mrs. Foster and Chloe. Enduring it all, Grace uses sincerity and wisdom to resolve family conflicts. She saves Chloe from a romance scam, cares for Mrs. Foster, and uses her $30 million savings to help Ethan make a comeback after his bankruptcy. Ultimately, her kindness moves everyone. Mrs. Foster and Chloe apologize, bringing true harmony to the family.
69e3387a0a2a37e91b087513.title: A Perfect Wife

69e3387c0a2a37e91b087517.synopsis: Victoria Gallagher founded the company after building from the ground up, making her brother Oliver Gallagher Manager. But Oliver began abusing one's power by stealing credit, withholding wages, claiming fraudulent reimbursement, and cheating with a mistress. He even conspired with outsiders to forge Victoria's signature to embezzle assets. Their mother, favoring boys over girls, blindly defended him with death threats. Pushed to the limit, employees gathered evidence to report him. Ultimately, Victoria ended up choosing justice over family. She fired Oliver and handed him to judicial authorities, putting the company back on track.
69e3387c0a2a37e91b087517.title: Never Hire Family

69e3387e0a2a37e91b08751d.synopsis: Busy CEO Chloe Mitchell hires nanny Peggy Barnes for her daughter Ruby, unaware that Peggy and her husband David Foster are having an affair. The cruel pair abuse Ruby and plot to frame Chloe so she will leave with nothing. Chloe fights back with hidden cameras, exposing their crimes at her mother-in-law's birthday gala. Ultimately, David, Peggy, and cousin Frank Miller are jailed for kidnapping and abuse. Chloe then quits her job to help Ruby heal from Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.
69e3387e0a2a37e91b08751d.title: The Nanny: A Crow in Swan's Feathers

69e338800a2a37e91b087521.synopsis: To steal the $500,000 bride price, stepmother Agnes Miller forces Elena Carter to marry the abusive Jared Dixon as a substitute bride for her daughter Brittany. Elena suffers horrific abuse from the in-laws: hard labor, starvation, and infertility after a botched postpartum recovery. When the Dixons scheme to find another woman for a son, Elena flees with her daughter Emma. She faints on the street but is saved by her long-lost biological mother, the wealthy Valerie Sterling. Making a fierce comeback, Elena demands a divorce and the bride price back. Discovering her mother is a Big Boss, the Dixons shamelessly kiss up to her. But when Elena tests them with a fake bankruptcy, they instantly turn on her. In the end, Elena gets her divorce, and the abusers will finally face justice.
69e338800a2a37e91b087521.title: The Substitute Bride Is an Heiress

69e3399c7a24716e530946a9.synopsis: Elena Davis and her husband Jason Miller share a daughter, Penny. Elena faces constant extortion from her brother Tommy Davis and her mother Karen Davis, who favors boys over girls and abuses Grandma. To make things worse, Jason cheats with his mistress Samantha Reed and demands a divorce. But Elena finds an unlikely ally in her mother-in-law, the powerful businesswoman Eleanor Miller, who treats her like her own. Samantha soon fakes a pregnancy, steals confidential files, and even attempts to murder Eleanor by triggering an asthma attack with Aspirin. Elena swiftly exposes the deadly scheme, landing Samantha in jail. In the end, Elena divorces Jason, becomes besties with Eleanor, and starts a beautiful new life with Penny and Grandma.
69e3399c7a24716e530946a9.title: Besties with My Mother-in-Law

69e3399f7a24716e530946af.synopsis: CEO Eleanor Sterling hides her Chairman identity and returns to Sterlingville to join the dance troupe, fulfilling her dying mother's wish. The Mayor's wife Samantha Crawford poses as the investor, colluding with members to frame Eleanor. Eleanor endures the bullying, revealing the truth before the show: she is the real investor and Riverton's wealthiest person. Samantha Crawford's corruption and Richard Sterling's wanted fugitive status are exposed, and they are taken away by the police. Eleanor performs one last dance for her mother, who passes away with a smile.
69e3399f7a24716e530946af.title: Dance Queen Stuns the Village

69e339a27a24716e530946b7.synopsis: Victoria Sterling, a listed company Board Chair, hides her identity for love to marry divorcee Declan Gallagher and gives birth to their daughter, Sophie. The matriarch, favoring boys over girls, teams up with his ex-wife Natalie Parker to abuse Sophie, while Declan cheats and plots to steal Victoria's fortune. Victoria poses as a cleaner to test her family. After seeing their greedy and selfish true colors, she decisively divorces him and reveals her true identity. Ultimately, the vicious matriarch suffers a stroke, Declan is jailed, and his ex-wife's son, who isn't biologically his, is diagnosed with leukemia. Victoria takes her daughter and starts a new life.
69e339a27a24716e530946b7.title: Exposing the Matriarch and My Husband

69e339a47a24716e530946bb.synopsis: When CEO Stella Sterling visits her hometown, she finds her adoptive mother, Mildred Sterling, still favoring boys over girls. Her brother Wyatt Sterling and his wife Sierra Brooks only want her wealth. They scheme to force Stella to buy them a house and hand over her company, even staging a kidnapping of Stella and Mildred to extort her assets. To ensure Mildred's backing, Sierra fakes a pregnancy. But Stella is one step ahead. Her bodyguards arrive just in time to turn the tables. Ultimately, Sierra Brooks, Wyatt Sterling, and Caleb Brooks are arrested for kidnapping and fraud. Stella cuts ties with Mildred, renames herself Nova Sterling, and leaves her bloodsucking family behind for good.
69e339a47a24716e530946bb.title: My Bloodsucking Family

69e339a57a24716e530946bf.synopsis: After Camilla gets Declan Vance drunk, they have a shotgun wedding, and he divorces his former spouse, Audrey. Camilla abuses her stepdaughter Mia, mistreats her spouse's mother, and conspires with her secret lover, Ezra. She lies about carrying Declan's baby, which is actually Ezra's biological child. She scams Declan for money and cars, even forcing him to sign IOUs. Eventually, the affair is exposed, Declan gets injured, and he divorces Camilla. Encouraged by Audrey and his daughter, Declan comes to his senses, leading to the family's reconciliation.
69e339a57a24716e530946bf.title: New mother Moves In: Losing Everything

69e339a67a24716e530946c1.synopsis: Samantha Sterling deeply loves Felix Thorne. Believing he has breast cancer, she sells her jewelry and borrows money for his surgery. However, his family runs a pig-butchering scam, stealing her money and forcing her to sign an insurance policy. In despair, Samantha realizes she is the runaway heiress of Sterling Enterprises, whose father is gravely ill. She returns to become CEO, exposes the fraud, and leaves the scammers reaping what was sown. The mother-in-law is arrested, the brother is beaten for gambling debts, and Felix dies of terminal breast cancer. Ultimately, Samantha reunites with her former fiance, a top oncologist, and gets her life back on track.
69e339a67a24716e530946c1.title: Honey, You're the One With Breast Cancer

69e339aa7a24716e530946cb.synopsis: Serena Sterling, Crown City's wealthiest heiress, is abducted by traffickers after falling into a trap while helping a lost girl. Her early escape attempts fail, and she gives birth to a daughter, Summer, and a son, Hunter Miller. Serena later helps Summer escape but is caught by Blissfield villagers and nearly killed. Just in time, Summer returns with her Granddad, Richard Sterling, and a rescue team. Together, they save Serena and free the other trafficked women in Blissfield. Ultimately, Serena exposes the dark conspiracy orchestrated by her sister, Monica Sterling.
69e339aa7a24716e530946cb.title: Escape From the Mountains

69e339ab7a24716e530946cd.synopsis: After discovering her husband Declan Caldwell's affair and divorce plot, Madeline Pierce vows revenge. She teams up with Julian Lancaster, husband to Declan's mistress Jessica Blair. Using a Lancaster Enterprises contract, Madeline tricks Declan and turns Jessica against him. Desperate to hide his scandal, Declan kidnaps Madeline, but Julian rescues her. Ultimately, Declan is jailed for kidnapping and rape. Julian makes a proposal to Madeline, and they become a couple.
69e339ab7a24716e530946cd.title: The Marriage Defenders

69e33b05276d97ac770bdb8e.synopsis: After losing their parents in a crash, 20-year-old Hannah Gallagher and 5-year-old Ethan Gallagher had only each other. Tragically, George Gallagher secretly sold Ethan. Hannah spent years searching for him. Later, Ethan, now known as Ethan Sterling, learned about his past and posted a missing person notice to find his sister. His cousin, Morgan Gallagher, impersonated Hannah. Ethan believed her, but Morgan soon showed her true colors by endlessly demanding money. Suspicious, Ethan launched a secret investigation, uncovered the truth, and rescued Hannah. The siblings were finally reunited.
69e33b05276d97ac770bdb8e.title: Hannah, Ethan Is Bringing You Home

69e33b07276d97ac770bdb92.synopsis: On her way to work, Dr. Stella Fletcher is hit by Esther Boone riding a tricycle the wrong way. Ignoring her own injuries, Stella saves Esther. However, Esther and her family falsely accuse Stella for a payout, getting her fired. Even her husband Preston Walsh and mother-in-law turn against her. Luckily, Miles Sterling clears her name with footage, getting her job back. Preston then seeks a divorce and smears Stella online. With Miles helping, Stella proves Preston is the cheater and wins in court. Afterward, Miles reveals Stella once saved his life, confesses his feelings, and they find happiness together.
69e33b07276d97ac770bdb92.title: Biting the Hand That Feeds

69e33b0a276d97ac770bdb9a.synopsis: Audrey Kensington, Chairwoman of Crestview Group, brings her multi-million dollar fortune to marry down to unemployed Derek Lawson, hoping to give her daughter Lily a complete family. Instead, it becomes a nightmare. Beatrice Lawson barges in late at night demanding to share Derek's bed, striking Audrey when she objects. The next day, Beatrice deliberately feeds Lily spoiled food. Later, Audrey catches Derek buying contraceptives with the home-wrecker Vanessa Sinclair. She exposes them in the community group chat, sparking outrage. After Beatrice sneaks Lily away, Audrey threatens mutual destruction, only to learn Lily was sold. Audrey rescues her abused daughter, files for divorce, and wins custody. When Derek and his mother kidnap Lily again for blackmail, Audrey finds her and calls the cops. Finally, the villains are punished, and Audrey starts anew with Lily.
69e33b0a276d97ac770bdb9a.title: A Mother's Boundaries

69e33b0d276d97ac770bdba0.synopsis: On the day of her grad school entrance exam, 22-year-old Emma Miller is dragged away by her father, Richard Miller, who claims her mother is gravely ill. At the hospital, Emma discovers her mother, Helen, isn't sick but is giving birth. Driven by patriarchal tradition, Richard forces Emma to quit school to care for her new brother. Devastated, Emma runs away. Six years later, as Emma gets engaged to Oliver Wright, her parents show up with her brother, Toby Miller. They make unreasonable demands, even causing a pregnant Emma to miscarry. Ultimately, with her mother-in-law's support, Emma and Oliver heal their rift and find happiness.
69e33b0d276d97ac770bdba0.title: Mom's Second Baby Before My Exam

69e33b0e276d97ac770bdba4.synopsis: To save her sick daughter, desperate single mom Elise Chandler spends a fateful night with her drugged benefactor, CEO Nathaniel Reed. But when her greedy family steals the lifesaving money and she discovers she is pregnant, Elise hits rock bottom. Cornered at the hospital by her degenerate gambler ex-husband and terrible parents, Nathaniel swoops in, knocking the trash out with one punch and paying all her bills. Learning the truth, he publicly declares that the baby she is carrying is his! Watch as he fiercely defends her, crushing the scumbags, and keeping the mother and daughter under his wing with endless love, turning a debt of gratitude into a match made in heaven.
69e33b0e276d97ac770bdba4.title: My Ex Rejected Me, He Protected Me

69e33b10276d97ac770bdba8.synopsis: After losing her parents in a crash, Victoria Thorne inherited Thorne Group and raised her sister, Penelope Thorne. She mistakenly believed Julian Croft's mother, Theresa Croft, donated a kidney to save her. She later discovered Mrs. Croft's donation was a lie by Julian Croft, aimed at plundering an heirless estate and seizing Thorne Group's wealth. To expose Julian Croft, Victoria Thorne feigned compliance with his family's outrageous demands while secretly gathering evidence, ultimately revealing the truth and bringing them to justice.
69e33b10276d97ac770bdba8.title: Taking Down My Scumbag Ex's Family

69e33b11276d97ac770bdbac.synopsis: Victoria, Silverton's wealthiest woman, disguises herself as a cleaning lady to attend her daughter Eleanor's wedding to Summit Group GM Spencer. Eleanor books rooms at their family's seven-star hotel but forgets to reserve one for her mother. Mrs. Montgomery arrives and bullies the simply dressed Victoria. At the wedding reception, Victoria shocks the Montgomerys with a billion-dollar dowry, only to catch Spencer cheating with his secretary, Cassidy. Cassidy lies to her father, Richard Sinclair, claiming Victoria is just a cleaning lady. When Richard arrives, he recognizes Victoria as the benefactor who saved his company and kneels to apologize. Furious, Victoria threatens to throw them in the ocean to sleep with the fishes, terrifying the villains.
69e33b11276d97ac770bdbac.title: The Billionaire Matriarch and the Wicked In-Laws

69e33b13276d97ac770bdbb0.synopsis: Victoria Sterling, The Wealthiest Woman, hides her identity to marry Julian Lockwood. Trusting him completely, she lets him manage her company. But Julian betrays her, having an affair with his secretary, Jessica Mercer, and fathering an illegitimate child, Leo Lockwood. The conflict erupts when Victoria's daughter, Ella Lockwood, is bullied by Leo at school. Adding insult to injury, the other parents accuse Victoria of being a mistress. When Victoria rushes to the school, the actual mistress, Jessica, arrogantly poses as Julian's wife and incites the parents to attack her. Furious, Victoria summons Julian. At the Anniversary Gala, Julian denies the affair until Victoria presents undeniable proof, publicly humiliating him. The truth is finally exposed, and Julian and Jessica are sent to prison.
69e33b13276d97ac770bdbb0.title: A Ten-Year Marriage Scam

69e33ce5811cc491f405c7be.synopsis: Victoria Sterling works tirelessly to support her husband's family, only to find Martha abusing her daughter. When they scheme to buy Thomas a house with her money, Victoria fights back. She sends them all to prison and starts a new life with her daughter.
69e33ce5811cc491f405c7be.title: Deadbeat Tries to Steal My Fortune

69e33ce7811cc491f405c7c2.synopsis: Martha Lewis's husband Robert Sterling is killed in a construction accident. Pregnant, she also loses her daughter Sophie. Fifteen years later, she supports her son Matthew Lewis marrying into her family, the Sterling family, while secretly suffering from black lung disease. Rejected by her son, she runs a bun stall and meets Sophie, now CEO of the Sinclair Group. Matthew Lewis tricks her into selling her house to pay his debts, then deceives her into working as a maid for the Sterling family. Humiliated, she discovers the father-in-law resembles Robert Sterling. Sophie Sinclair uncovers the truth and seeks a reunion. At Lily's birthday gala, Cynthia Sterling insults Martha Lewis. Sophie Sinclair defends her mother, canceling a massive contract. The truth prevails: Robert Sterling had amnesia, and Cynthia Sterling's plot is exposed. As Martha Lewis falls gravely ill, Matthew Lewis repents, and she forgives everyone.
69e33ce7811cc491f405c7c2.title: Son, I Am Not a Maid

69e33ce8811cc491f405c7c6.synopsis: After eight years as a housewife, Eleanor Caldwell finally lands a job just as her daughter Emma starts school. Then tragedy strikes: her mother, Martha Caldwell, is critically hospitalized. Eleanor misses her father's desperate calls due to a broken phone. That same night, Eleanor rushes an injured Emma to the hospital, narrowly missing her father. Unable to reach her, the father notifies Eleanor's husband, Gideon Stanton. Shockingly, Gideon and The Stanton Matriarch conspire to hide the news, robbing Eleanor of her final goodbye. Believing Eleanor deliberately ignored her dying mother, her furious father demands she face Clan rules and Clan discipline at his wife's funeral three days later.
69e33ce8811cc491f405c7c6.title: A Parent's Funeral

69e33ce9811cc491f405c7c8.synopsis: Sisters Caroline and Isabella Foster are abused by their stepdad, Robert Sterling, while their mother, Diane Sullivan, remains oblivious. To pay his lover's debt, Robert attempts to sell Isabella. Caroline is hospitalized trying to save her. Later, Caroline witnesses a fleeing Isabella get critically injured in a car crash. Robert intercepts all of Caroline's desperate calls to Diane. Isabella tragically dies, leaving Caroline utterly disillusioned with her mother. Discovering Robert's affair, Caroline teams up with Simon Gallagher to expose him. Robert is brought to justice, and a remorseful Diane reconciles with Caroline.
69e33ce9811cc491f405c7c8.title: Ma Was Wrong

69e33ceb811cc491f405c7cc.synopsis: After elite spouse Victoria catches her husband Bradley Sterling cheating, she plots revenge. When pregnant mistress Jessica Harper arrives to taunt her, she mistakes elegant Victoria for Bradley's mom. Victoria plays along, controlling Jessica with a 'bride test' and demanding to meet her parents. Eager for wealth, Jessica arranges this at her father's birthday, where Victoria publicly exposes her affair and pregnancy. Victoria then pretends to plan their wedding while gathering evidence. At the ceremony, she airs surveillance footage, forcing Bradley to surrender all assets. Victoria wins the divorce and keeps her wealth, leaving the duo utterly disgraced.
69e33ceb811cc491f405c7cc.title: Testing the Fake Bride

69e33cef811cc491f405c7d6.synopsis: While delivering packages, Chloe Wright suspects her husband Gavin Wright is with another woman. Despite a lipstick stain, Gavin smooth-talks his way out. Chloe uses spyware to gather proof, but when confronting the supposed mistress, Gavin's colleague Jason clears things up, making Chloe feel guilty. Later, overhearing Gavin and Jason, she realizes she was played and plans a divorce. Tracking Gavin to a hotel, she catches him with sugar mama Valerie Montgomery. Valerie accuses Gavin, but he reveals a recording proving she harassed him. The truth out, Gavin apologizes and offers to leave with nothing, leading to their reconciliation.
69e33cef811cc491f405c7d6.title: My Husband's Secret Lies

69e33cf0811cc491f405c7d8.synopsis: On 28-year-old Natalie Carter and 30-year-old Bradley Lawson's wedding day, mother-in-law Martha Dawson demands Natalie transfer the deed of her dowry house to her brother-in-law. Martha uses Natalie's pregnancy to blackmail her, while Bradley urges her to be the bigger person. Pretending to agree, Natalie strikes back by calling off the wedding. Furious, the Lawson family causes a scene at her neighborhood and the company, spreading malicious rumors. Natalie calmly fights back, recording evidence and calling the cops. After her brother-in-law is jailed for attempting to seize the house, Bradley and Martha try to force her to drop the charges. However, their threats are caught on a security camera, leading to their arrest. Ultimately, Natalie reveals her pregnancy was a misdiagnosis. The Lawson family gets what they deserve, leaving Natalie free from the toxic family to start a brand-new life.
69e33cf0811cc491f405c7d8.title: My Mother-in-Law Forced Me to Transfer the Deed on My Wedding Day

69e33cf2811cc491f405c7dc.synopsis: The adopted son of the Hayes family, Lucas Hayes, and his girlfriend Mia Bates scheme to steal the family fortune. They clash with the independent biological daughter, Audrey Hayes, while her jealous ex-colleague Amber Larson joins the plot. After Mia sparks a fight at a family dinner and frames Audrey for theft, forcing her to resign, Audrey fights back. During an argument at the real estate office, Audrey exposes Lucas. The shock lands Arthur Hayes in the hospital with stomach cancer, finally opening his eyes to his adopted son's true nature. When Lucas demands a million-dollar marital home online, Mrs. Hayes reveals his birth father once stole Arthur's job. The resulting backlash gets Lucas and Mia fired. Mrs. Hayes then sets a trap, claiming the will only leaves them 500,000 USD. Desperate, Mia unplugs Arthur's oxygen tube and is arrested. Lucas gets one year in prison, and Mia gets two. Amber is also jailed for scamming Lucas. Ultimately, Arthur recovers. Audrey receives a three-million-dollar property and marries Simon Vance, the doctor who helped her. Peace finally returns to the Hayes family.
69e33cf2811cc491f405c7dc.title: My Backstabbing Adopted Brother

69e33cf4811cc491f405c7e2.synopsis: Eleanor Crawford unexpectedly won 300 million dollars in the lottery. She planned to split it among her sons, but they only abused her when she stayed with them. Only her grandson Leo quietly cared for her, even confronting his parents to defend Grandma. Heartbroken by her ungrateful sons, Eleanor gave up on them. Before passing away, she gave the winning ticket to Leo. Disgusted by his parents, he kept it a secret. Ultimately, Leo chose not to claim the 300 million dollars, donating it all to charity instead.
69e33cf4811cc491f405c7e2.title: Take the Lottery Ticket, I Just Want Grandma!

69e34829d9183c558303f7e6.synopsis: To root out a traitor, The Dragon Lord of Eldoria, Arthur Pendelton, lived incognito as a kept man in The Stanton Family for five years. Despising his lack of ambition, his wife Samantha Stanton humiliated him with $30 million at their divorce. At The Stanton Family Ascension Ceremony, the elites ruthlessly mocked him. At the breaking point, he revealed his true identity: Hall Master of the Martial Hall and The Dragon Lord of Eldoria! The Riverton elites fell to their knees begging for mercy, leaving his ex-wife drowning in regret. Yet, a darker conspiracy emerged: Vice Hall Master of the Civil Hall, Reginald Thorne, had colluded with foreign enemies to frame The Dragon Lord. After five years in the shadows, Arthur launched a thunderous counterattack. Now ruling both Civil and Martial Halls, he crushed the traitors to protect Eldoria.
69e34829d9183c558303f7e6.title: Unrivaled

69e4d66aca45e80a830235fb.synopsis: Transmigrated as the lovesick villainess, Lynn has her husband's black card, but she'd rather blow it at a host club. James is certain it's just a ploy. Until she signs the divorce papers with a smile, pivots to her career, and her family, and is surrounded by different guys. Too late, James realizes the woman who only ever saw him has gone. But an old video and a secret become the final bargaining chips. In their marriage war, who actually let go first?
69e4d66aca45e80a830235fb.title: Ex's Fortune, My Fame

69e4d66eca45e80a83023605.synopsis: 30 years of marriage without love in the last life smothered her heart. After being reborn, the first thing she does is to send a divorce application. But that woke the husband up. He goes to a remote place to chase his wife, only to find her devoted to the national research. That's when a spy crisis breaks out. To protect her, he takes the blame. Are they rekindling their love or saying goodbye? Will she accept him again?
69e4d66eca45e80a83023605.title: The Exiled Heart

69e4d9e93af8912485044ab0.synopsis: Betrayed and brutally tortured to death by the Emperor, the Crown Prince, a powerful general, and the principal graduate in her past life, Rosalind Ashcroft is reborn on the eve of the imperial selection. She allies with head eunuch Lucian Thorne after discovering his fake identity. One by one, she strikes down her enemies: she destroys the new principal graduate Benedict Fairfax, schemes to overthrow the Crown Prince, and turns the Emperor and the general against each other. As they bond through blood and fire, Lucian is revealed to be a former royal. Together, they tear the palace apart, send their foes to hell, and seize the ultimate throne.
69e4d9e93af8912485044ab0.title: The Eunuch’s Secret Queen

69e4db8e62581d903c0df223.synopsis: The traitors killed Lord Damien. But death couldn't hold him. Reborn as a different child, he hides in plain sight. His sister? His past love. His enemies? Everywhere. His ace? Memories of a lifetime in hell. Now the family secrets crumble. The traitors tremble. The mighty prodigy is rising.
69e4db8e62581d903c0df223.title: A Boy's Hand, the Dead's Wrath

69e588fc8e2712ecdc063911.synopsis: To avoid being sold off by her aunt, destitute orphan Chloe Winters tries to manipulate Silas Thorne—her aunt's lover and the second-in-command of Port City's top gang—to fund her escape abroad. Silas sees through her scheme and forces her to stay. Trapped in a dangerous world, Chloe plays the obedient pet until she glimpses the villain's true heart: Silas risks his life to protect her in a gang shootout and secretly secures her study abroad application. Betrayed and ambushed, Silas vanishes into the sea before giving it to her. Heartbroken, Chloe leaves the country, only to unexpectedly reunite with an amnesiac Silas. Embracing her hidden feelings, they share a peaceful life until a cartel attack forces them back to Port City. There, the illusion shatters: Silas's amnesia was nothing but a calculated ruse for his ultimate revenge...
69e588fc8e2712ecdc063911.title: Tempting the Mafia Boss

69e596d22ca5ff658c0852cd.synopsis: At the engagement, Dante Cross, the true Crown Prince of the Cross family, fights his way back to steal the bride. Aria Thorne fakes a loving marriage while hiding a knife. Pinning her armed wrist to the mirror, he demands: Look closely. Who is giving you pleasure right now?
69e596d22ca5ff658c0852cd.title: Claimed by the Devil

69e59e18f141c3af82068143.synopsis: Reborn into betrayal, Theo Lee, the rightful heir of the Lee family, was deceived by his girlfriend, Michelle, and two others, leading to his tragic demise. Now, back from the dead, Theo's done pretending. He dumps his manipulative girlfriend, reconnects with his real parents, kicks out the fake heir, and takes down his scheming step-sister. This time, Theo is taking back everything that's rightfully his, no more compromises.
69e59e18f141c3af82068143.title: Lost Heir's Comeback Plan

69e5f3a5a332f649ee088e77.synopsis: In a world of Familiar Taming, Max was betrayed by his family, who stole his rare Obsidian Kirin and drained his blood as a living sacrifice. Reborn with the Divine Familiar System, Max seeks revenge. He sells the disloyal Obsidian Kirin and buys the dying Divine Vermilion Bird. With the system's guidance, he rises to become the ultimate beast master, step by step, determined to take back his power and dominate the world of familiars.
69e5f3a5a332f649ee088e77.title: The Reborn Beast Tamer

69e5f3a8a332f649ee088e7d.synopsis: A legendary specter wakes up in hell on earth. The problem? A glitchy System keeps labeling him "Human". To survive an S-class zombie apocalypse, he calls the government to surrender, only to be made mayor of the last city. But when he tries to rebuild civilization by turning his undead men into construction workers and massage therapists, he accidentally wakes up an ancient evil from an interdimensional asylum.
69e5f3a8a332f649ee088e7d.title: Designated Human

69e5fd3d9d561ff43905a5d0.synopsis: Haunted by his brother’s murder, elite soldier Lucas Hayes infiltrates The Lockwood Family to protect his sister-in-law, Cynthia Sinclair. Fighting corporate sabotage, poisoning, and dark forces after a secret energy formula, Lucas resolves multiple crises. What begins as hostility slowly turns to quiet devotion as Lucas faces down danger after danger. When he unleashes his global connections to turn the tide, his fearsome true identity—The Judge—is laid bare. In a final, explosive reckoning, he crushes the conspiracy, avenges his brother, and vows to protect Cynthia forever.
69e5fd3d9d561ff43905a5d0.title: The Judge

69e5fd439d561ff43905a5de.synopsis: Haunted by his brother’s murder, elite soldier Lucas Hayes infiltrates The Lockwood Family to protect his sister-in-law, Cynthia Sinclair. Fighting corporate sabotage, poisoning, and dark forces after a secret energy formula, Lucas resolves multiple crises. What begins as hostility slowly turns to quiet devotion as Lucas faces down danger after danger. When he unleashes his global connections to turn the tide, his fearsome true identity—The Judge—is laid bare. In a final, explosive reckoning, he crushes the conspiracy, avenges his brother, and vows to protect Cynthia forever.
69e5fd439d561ff43905a5de.title: The Judge

69e6368af5d1c8622c099106.synopsis: In Lady CEO's Fatal Contract movie, after a heart transplant, Violet learns her donor, Eve, died at the hands of her boyfriend, Liam, a famous artist. Seeking proof, Violet signs a BDSM contract to become his servant, but Liam doesn't abuse her—he protects her with a tenderness that terrifies her. When her ex-husband uncovers her lie and blackmails her, Liam quietly makes him disappear. Now Violet faces an impossible truth: she came to destroy a monster, but he may be the only one who truly owns her.
69e6368af5d1c8622c099106.title: Lady CEO's Fatal Contract

69e6dc445706198256042a0b.synopsis: After surviving a fall from a cliff caused by her best friend, amnesiac Mia Sinclair is adopted. Ten years later, she faces severe bullying until Connor Sinclair rescues her. When Mr. Brooks falls critically ill, Connor uses a DNA test to reveal Mia's true identity. But danger still lurks as Mia confronts a cheating boyfriend, her toxic best friend, and deadly traps.
69e6dc445706198256042a0b.title: The Unstoppable Heiress Returns

69e6dc455706198256042a0d.synopsis: Mother-in-law Irene Sullivan stabs gambler Conrad Pierce in the chest after he refuses to halt his divorce from her daughter, Mia Gallagher. But Conrad survives—and time-travels back to 1994! Armed with future knowledge, he sets out to conquer the world. Conrad saves his friend Dustin Boyd and discovers fraudster Vito Moretti is posing as a tycoon to marry Mia. Conrad rushes to the Gallaghers to expose Vito's scam. He then partners with Ruby Sullivan and Dustin to sell cordless city phones, though Vito's sabotage puts their business at risk. Using his past-life skills, Conrad fixes a limited-edition sound system for Southport City's wealthiest man. This connection helps him win big on the World Cup finals in Macau. With his first pot of gold, Conrad expands his empire, eventually becoming the richest man in Southport City. Later, Irene and her secret lover, Otis Caldwell, steal Conrad's office buildings. Conrad traps them, forcing Otis to confess and face justice. Using the newly emerging DNA paternity test, Conrad discovers Irene is not Mia's real mother—Irene and Dominic Hawthorne actually kidnapped her! When Mia's biological father dies abroad, leaving her a massive inheritance and an ancestral estate, Irene plots to kill her for the money. Conrad intervenes just in time, exposing Irene and Dominic and sending them to prison. With the truth revealed, Conrad and Mia finally get their happy ending.
69e6dc455706198256042a0d.title: Back to 1994

69e6dc475706198256042a11.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Raymond Crawford killed his best friend for gold and adopted his young sons, Arthur Gallagher and Desmond Gallagher. Discovering the truth, Arthur faked his death to escape. He founded Torrent Group, waited in the shadows for twenty years, and returned with five hundred tons of gold to launch a full-scale commercial assault on Vanguard Corporation. Blinded by lies, Desmond ended up taking the enemy as a father and even attacked Arthur under Raymond Crawford's coercion. Ultimately, Arthur used the gold for short selling Vanguard Corporation, acquired 60% of its shares, completely crushed Raymond Crawford, and avenged his parents.
69e6dc475706198256042a11.title: a fortune lost will always return

69e6dd789403562a630f1989.synopsis: Once glorious in Northridge, the Hastings family fell overnight when their firstborn son fell into a massive gambling trap set by the Kingsley family. Stripped of their empire and with their father humiliated, Miss Hastings, Emma Hastings, and her sister Mia were forced into living under someone else's roof. At rock bottom, she met Wyatt Brooks, a mysterious rent-a-cop. He used his culinary and tech skills to support her in making a comeback, stepping up whenever she fell into traps set by the Kingsley family. But her pitiful sister Mia Hastings was actually a mole for the Kingsley family, a betrayal that pushed the Hastings family back into the abyss. As the mystery behind Wyatt Brooks unraveled, an 18-year blood feud surfaced. Hunted by the Kingsley family, how will business partners Emma Hastings and Wyatt Brooks fight back and reclaim everything?
69e6dd789403562a630f1989.title: Pure Vitality

69e6dd7a9403562a630f198f.synopsis: Blind pianist Grace takes a gig at Arthur Mercer's home, only to overhear his murder by his wife Daphne Walsh and her lover Felix Thorne. When Daphne discovers Grace isn't fully blind, she poisons her, making her truly lose her sight. Felix's brother, Ian Thorne, deeply loves Grace but knows nothing of the crime. After Nora Hughes is killed for knowing too much, a deadly battle over dirty money erupts in a warehouse. With Ian, Grace, Daphne, and her sister held captive, lies and betrayals unravel. In the end, everyone must make the ultimate choice between greed and humanity.
69e6dd7a9403562a630f198f.title: Echoes in the Dark

69e7261269f4aa93ee085485.synopsis: Waking up as 24, Evelyn finds herself married to her crush and has twins! But she's only 18! Threats of divorce, family drama, child abuse... She decides to change. Start with the CEO crush!
69e7261269f4aa93ee085485.title: Spoiling My Husband and Twins!

69e7261669f4aa93ee08548d.synopsis: After a fatal accident, modern-day veterinarian Harper Davis wakes up as Maeve, a disgraced disciple of the Stormcloud Sect, her Core shattered and her Spirit Power gone. In the Matriarchal World where females reign supreme, she is ridiculed, betrayed, and left for dead. But she has one advantage no one expects: the Underdog System. With its help, Maeve binds four powerful and stunning Beast Mates, a wolf, a wyrm, an elk, and a phoenix, and begins her rise from the ashes.
69e7261669f4aa93ee08548d.title: Beauty and the Beast Mates

69e727f49dd5a1fb0106a4d0.synopsis: Sterling Group CEO Nathaniel suspects his wife Olivia is cheating when a smart cat feeder records a stranger in their home. After catching her and his old friend Franklin together, he plays along. He secretly buys an apartment, installs hidden cameras, and sets a trap. At the Spring Festival dinner, he publicly exposes their conspiracy, transforming from a betrayed husband into a mastermind of revenge!
69e727f49dd5a1fb0106a4d0.title: The Footage That Broke a Marriage

69e727fd9dd5a1fb0106a4e6.synopsis: When the apocalypse hits, Alex sacrifices his lifespan to shelter humanity in the bunker for 30 years. Yet, he is betrayed by his adopted daughter Evelyn and the ambitious Diana. They fake footage of a peaceful surface to incite the masses and send Alex to the gallows. Blinded by lies, the people destroy the bunker for a promised oasis, only to walk straight into a deadly trap set by Diana and the Giants. As the Giants begin their massacre, regret washes over the survivors. Will Alex, armed with secret mecha tech, let go of his grudge and save humanity once again?
69e727fd9dd5a1fb0106a4e6.title: Thirty Years of Protection and Betrayal

69e776b5e26e2e226c0175bc.synopsis: Nathan, an ordinary male nurse, discovers he has the rare Sun-Forged Physique and is chosen by a martial master. With x-ray vision and overwhelming strength, his life flips overnight. He rises fast, making money, turning heads, and crushing anyone who stands in his way. In the end, he crushes the ultimate boss and becomes one of the richest and most powerful men alive.
69e776b5e26e2e226c0175bc.title: Nurse by Day, Hero by Night

69e776efbf1743903a01e938.synopsis: Eight years of agony. Endless betrayals. Then a second chance. Madeline Hayes awakens at the start of her nightmare, and she's not the same naive girl anymore. She cuts off her so-called uncle, trashes his precious first love, and gets her revenge cold and clean. But when she turns to leave for good, the man who once broke her now clings to her, red-eyed, begging her to stay.
69e776efbf1743903a01e938.title: Reborn, Not Yours

69e827a9733786f94900002f.synopsis: A nobody delivery driver, Wyatt Fletcher, suddenly discovers he is the long-lost heir to the Winslow family — the owners of Starlight Media, a struggling live-streaming empire. Surrounded by scheming rivals like Vaughn Sterling and betrayal within the company, he must rise from the bottom, take control of the failing group, and outplay everyone who once looked down on him. No longer an errand boy, he becomes the boss — and he’s ready to rewrite the rules of the industry.
69e827a9733786f94900002f.title: Wrong Heir, Right Throne

69e82d465e22182d7b0588cb.synopsis: Broke medical student Audrey unexpectedly awakens God-tier X-Ray Vision. After saving a dying billionaire heir, she uses her superpower to uncover hidden treasures and dominate the stock market, transforming into the richest woman. Pursued by elite bachelors, she handles them all with grace. Who says girls are meant to be weak? Watch Audrey rise as a badass queen!
69e82d465e22182d7b0588cb.title: The Visionary Queen

69e82d84293cb253560fd2b4.synopsis: Simon unexpectedly awakens a system that helps him raise seven extraordinary nephews. With Sawyer dominating the stock market, Mason healing with silver needles, Joy winning mansions, and Skylar rewriting reality, Simon rises from being overlooked to exposing corporate conspiracies and winning the Smith heiress's heart. He becomes the youngest major shareholder in a family empire. When his family returns, they're stunned by his success and new mansion.
69e82d84293cb253560fd2b4.title: The Nephew Mastermind

69e836e2cda47bca1300cceb.synopsis: Celeste Monroe taught the Bancroft family medicine. Matriarch Bancroft wished for Celeste's visit before dying. Yet, her descendants disrespect Celeste, using Mr. Bancroft to suppress her, unaware that he learned everything from her!
69e836e2cda47bca1300cceb.title: After Her Last Will

69e836e4cda47bca1300ccef.synopsis: Destroyed by those she trusted, top star Aurora dies knowing her greatest rival, Pierce, was the only one who truly loved her. Reborn, she's on one mission: to court Pierce, crush her enemies, and rewrite her fate.
69e836e4cda47bca1300ccef.title: Red Carpet, Hot Kiss

69e836e7cda47bca1300ccf5.synopsis: The security guard Theo might seem ordinary, but he possessed business talent, which had amazed countless business giants. It was not until the truth was revealed that everyone realized that this ordinary security guard was actually a top business tycoon in the past. However, when his family didn't know the truth, his son bullied him and his adopted daughter...
69e836e7cda47bca1300ccf5.title: Glory in the Shadows

69e836e8cda47bca1300ccf9.synopsis: Five months pregnant, Penny Bennett miscarries after her husband, Cameron, locks her in a lily-filled room to please his pregnant first love, Melanie. But he forgot Penny's severely allergic to lilies. Realizing she never had Cameron's heart, Penny leaves. When Cameron gets the divorce papers, he finally panics.
69e836e8cda47bca1300ccf9.title: Locked Out of His Heart

69e8447c6540d07eb10f8a2f.synopsis: Blind for six months. The day Eleanor's sight returns, she watches her daughter-in-law get killed by her own twin sister, who then takes the victim's place. Now, she must play along with the killer, act the loving mother, and destroy her from within.
69e8447c6540d07eb10f8a2f.title: The Stand-in Daughter-in-Law

69e8447d6540d07eb10f8a31.synopsis: Journalist James got betrayed by Travis and was killed by Dominic while investigating an underground casino. Three years later, his daughter Hailey becomes a master of gambling skill. To save her gambling addict aunt and track down the killer, she sneaks into her enemy's underground casino...
69e8447d6540d07eb10f8a31.title: Fold or Die: Gamble Queen Rises

69e867662d4a53728b07a050.synopsis: Vanessa, head of the Horton family, goes abroad to find a cure for her daughter, Hazel. She returns to discover Hazel has been tortured into madness by her gold-digging husband and her fake adopted sister, Fiona. Furious, Vanessa becomes the Queen of Slaps, crushing the scumbags to avenge Hazel.
69e867662d4a53728b07a050.title: Furious Mom: The Last Slap

69e87052f038a4a668029b1d.synopsis: On her wedding day, Adelaide Sterling arrives at the altar — only to find her groom running off with her half-sister. Instantly, she makes a split-second decision — marry Zachary Blackwood, the notorious "Hellion Prince". Known for his wild ways and late nights at the Elysium Theater, Zachary is every noblewoman's nightmare. But Adelaide is no ordinary bride. While others whisper, she sharpens her sword — and her plan. And when enemies close in, it is Adelaide who leads armies, crushes conspiracies, and forces her crownless king to kneel — not in defeat, but in devotion.
69e87052f038a4a668029b1d.title: Taming the Hellion Prince

69e875b2681084065204494e.synopsis: Elias, the Commander of the Wyvern Order, hides his true identity while searching for his lost daughter, Lisa. Working as a delivery driver in Porthaven, he encounters a fried rice stall serving the same recipe he taught his daughter. After helping vendor Alyssa deal with a thug, Elias is invited to her wedding, only to discover her fiancé's infidelity. In a twist, he learns that Alyssa is actually his daughter, Lisa.
69e875b2681084065204494e.title: My Dad, His Nightmare

69e875b56810840652044954.synopsis: True heiress Juliet gives the Thorn family everything, only to be sold out by her brother. Fate plays its hand: she flash-marries Maxwell Davenport, the CEO who spoils her rotten. Every sweet kiss heals a wound. Every cruel betrayal from the Thorns fuels her fire. By the time they realize Juliet was their only treasure, it's too late.The whole family is on its knees. And she's not looking back.
69e875b56810840652044954.title: Fake Heiress Stole My Family? I have Mr. CEO!

69e87a6319c78a7efd0ce134.synopsis: Jessica is duped by an online scam, dreaming of quick riches. She sends her husband's $500,000 savings to fraudsters, ignoring police warnings. Believing she's wealthy, she divorces and sells their house, even mocking anti-fraud experts. But when the scammers disappear, Jessica realizes her greed has shattered her family.
69e87a6319c78a7efd0ce134.title: The Lies She Believed

69e87a6419c78a7efd0ce136.synopsis: In her previous life, Samantha Brooks, CEO of Crestview Corp, made one fatal mistake: she trusted the wrong man. And when she died alone and broken, she learned the truth: the one man the world feared, the cold, untouchable tycoon Harrison Whitmore, had spent a lifetime watching over her from the shadows. Now, Samantha is back. Armed with memories of betrayal and the knowledge of who truly loved her, she has one goal: revenge. This time, she will protect her legacy, expose the frauds, and claim the love she was blind to see.
69e87a6419c78a7efd0ce136.title: Wrong Love, Right Ruin

69e87a6719c78a7efd0ce13c.synopsis: Adrian returns as The CEO, while vain Simon disowns Momma! The wealth Simon craves means less to billionaire Adrian than Mommy's smile. True success is never letting Mommy cry!
69e87a6719c78a7efd0ce13c.title: Her Smile Above All Riches

69e87adb7de81098f80bcee4.synopsis: Tucker, a seasoned detective in his past life, is reborn in ancient times as an eight-year-old low-ranking official. When the Righteous Magistrate System awakens, he quickly solves a kidnapping case, outwits corrupt gentry, and defeats bandits. Using the system's rewards, he gains martial arts skills and wisdom. Watch as he uses his newfound powers to serve the people, punish evil, and leave his mark on history!
69e87adb7de81098f80bcee4.title: Age 8, Justice Straight

69e87b17b19a7b26c708ce4e.synopsis: Betrayed by her stepfamily and banished by her father, Blair Langley returns to take back what's hers. Seeing her stepsister with her fiancé, Christian Sterling, she realizes her perfect chance for revenge has arrived.
69e87b17b19a7b26c708ce4e.title: Seduce My Sister's Man to Revenge

69e8933d22d3ca290d09ca02.synopsis: When Epoch of Beasts becomes reality, the world turns into a living hell. Grinder Gideon leads humanity through countless battles, collecting seven Spire Keys to resurrect his grandmother. But right before the world reboots, his girlfriend Chloe and best friend Tyson betray and kill him. The mastermind, Nightwraith King, then descends to plunge the world into an eternal Icebound Deathscape. Unexpectedly, Gideon is reborn 12 hours before the apocalypse. Armed with past memories, he uses his knowledge of the game to win. Before the servers shut down, he spends wildly, drawing the server's only SSS-Rank Spirit Pet, Nine-Tailed Sacred Fox and forms an early pact with her.
69e8933d22d3ca290d09ca02.title: Fox Queen & My Apocalypse Payback

69e8b0c803296ee24b09d3d4.synopsis: Mary Fowler, who has dwarfism and stands only four feet tall, kindheartedly adopted an abandoned baby girl, Mia. Over the next 18 years, Mary tirelessly raised Mia, who eventually got accepted into a top university. However, when the Mayor's son, Frankie Miller, tries to force Mia into marriage, Mary is severely injured while protecting her. Just in time, Mia's biological father, Robert Pierce, CEO of Pierce Corporation, steps in to claim his daughter and punish the evildoers. At Mia's grand college celebration party, she faces bullying from classmates, but Mary stands fiercely by her side. Ultimately, the truth prevails, the villains face justice, and mother and daughter happily reunite—proving that a mother's love isn't measured in height, but in the size of her heart.
69e8b0c803296ee24b09d3d4.title: My Pocket-Sized Mama

69e8b3d21942c155d907fcb9.synopsis: The five sisters of House Vance lead The Vance Legion, achieving distinguished service in battle. During a campaign, Cordelia is ambushed and left mentally impaired. After the Thorne scion Corbin breaks off their engagement, she secretly regains her senses and feigns madness to unmask her attackers. She soon discovers the shocking truth: Dravon conspired with her sister Beatrix and Corbin to assassinate her. Their goal? To seize The Dragon Jade of House Vance, command the Legion, and conquer the realm. Biding time in the ashes, Cordelia unravels their deadly plot, eliminates the traitors, and rises again to lead her army and defend the nation.
69e8b3d21942c155d907fcb9.title: Daughters of House Vance: Biding Time in the Ashes

69e8b3d61942c155d907fcc1.synopsis: In 1990, gambling addict Arthur Hayes is reborn thirty years in the past. His previous life was ruined by his addiction, costing him his family. This time, he vows to rewrite his destiny. Making his first fortune flipping antiques, he buys the failing Star Foods Factory and creates Pinnacle Cola. He signs Ricky as a spokesperson, acquires nationwide soda plants, partners with real estate moguls, and turns the small factory into Pinnacle Group in just one month. But he must fight off hostile foreign takeovers, greedy in-laws, his lingering first love, and deadly revenge from former gambling buddies. Armed with future memories and business wits, Arthur protects his family and builds an ultimate business empire.
69e8b3d61942c155d907fcc1.title: Pinnacle

69e8b3d81942c155d907fcc7.synopsis: Successful Madeline Hawthorne invests $1 billion in Virtue Creek to fulfill Grandfather Hawthorne's dying wish. Returning for his 10th memorial, she faces emotional blackmail from her aunt, uncle, and cousin, who try to force her into marriage for a hefty bride price. When Madeline Hawthorne's true identity is exposed, her family and the Town Supervisor greedily demand more. Even a student she sponsored joins the ungrateful wretches, plotting to traffic her to Myanmar. Ultimately, evil gets its due, and they all pay the price!
69e8b3d81942c155d907fcc7.title: Return After Ten Years

69e8b4c27aafe1dcda02c5fb.synopsis: Aria Vance, the once-powerful High Arbiter of The Celestial Tribunal, gave up her authority to live a quiet life for her sister. When Vesperians ravage The Solarian borders and establish The Obsidian Syndicate to wreak havoc in The Southern Lands, Scarlet begs Aria to return. Aria declines to protect her sister's peace. She believes Elara Vance is happily married into The Hawthorne Family, unaware she is brutally abused. Her husband, Dexter Hawthorne, defects to the Vesperians and offers Elara to The Iron Duke's son to secure an alliance. Scarlet uncovers the truth and alerts Aria, prompting her long-awaited return! At a banquet, Aria is humiliated by the Hawthornes, the duke's son, and Evelyn Kraven, head of The Obsidian Syndicate. Scarlet and The Iron Duke intervene, and Aria reclaims her title as High Arbiter! Desperate, Evelyn threatens Elara's life, forcing Aria to sacrifice her own life force to save her sister. Still doubting Aria's identity, Evelyn summons The Crown Tribunal. Drawing The Phoenix Blade would prove her identity, but the damaged weapon might shatter. Pushed to her limits, Aria draws the blade, proving who she is but destroying the sword! Aria executes the Commander of the Crown Tribunal, who is backed by The Duke of the South. Meanwhile, Sovereign Blackwood, Evelyn's master and Aria's nemesis, attacks. With her blade broken, Aria is outmatched until her allies sacrifice themselves as human shields. Their blood awakens The Phoenix Blade, allowing Aria to slay Blackwood. The Duke of the South then arrives to suppress Aria, taking the Sovereign of Solaria hostage, only to be betrayed by The Kraven Family. The Kravens challenge Aria with The Dragon Leyline at stake. Empowered by the fallen and wielding The Genesis Blade, Aria emerges victorious. Driven into a corner, the duke reveals his ultimate trump card: backing from The Paragon Sanctum to usurp the throne. In a shocking twist, Aria is revealed to be the long-lost daughter of the Sovereign of the Paragon Sanctum...
69e8b4c27aafe1dcda02c5fb.title: The Peerless Paragon

69e8b4c47aafe1dcda02c5ff.synopsis: On his birthday, Carter Brooks inexplicably falls into an infinite time loop, shot dead in a bathroom stall by the person in the clown mask. Waking up on the couch, Carter assumes it's a dream. He enters the bathroom a second time, sensing danger, but the killer strikes again. On his third reset, Carter realizes he must lose his pursuer to escape this terrifying time loop. But as he and Audrey Evans try to get into a car, a truck crushes them. Waking up a fourth time, he decides to investigate everyone. While Audrey and Brock Thorne argue, a clown mask falls out of Brock's bag. With each reset, Carter gathers more clues. During a scuffle, he discovers the killer is a woman, realizing she is a hired gun working for a mastermind. He uses her phone records across multiple resets to eliminate suspects. Eventually, clearing everyone around him, Carter is forced to capture the killer for information. Exploiting an 11 PM office power outage, he finally knocks her out and interrogates her. His colleagues arrive, reacting differently to her unmasked face. While Carter questions Oscar Wright about selling shares, the killer suddenly breaks free and murders everyone. Furious, Carter beats her down but kills himself before midnight to revive his friends. In the next reset, he captures her again. Just as he thinks it's over, a sudden death proves there are two killers: one driving the truck, the other shooting him. Carter must simultaneously subdue both to break the cycle. After another reset, his clues point to Brock. During their confrontation, the killer knocks everyone out. Brock reveals his true colors, confessing he orchestrated everything to seize The Skyborne Project. Nearing midnight, Carter tries to get himself killed, unsure if the time loop works past 12 AM. When an arrogant Brock refuses, Carter forcibly kisses Audrey, provoking Brock into killing him before the clock strikes. Once Brock and the killers are brought to justice, Carter goes to retrieve security footage as evidence. Suddenly, it dawns on him: there is another accomplice. At that moment, a Security Guard smirks, a dagger slipping from his sleeve.
69e8b4c47aafe1dcda02c5ff.title: Outsmarting the Clown Killer

69e8b66bf752cd2e6707ae72.synopsis: In 1944, The Northern Reaper attends an Ashton auction to win the Resurrection Herb for his poisoned brother, Lincoln Thorne. The auction rule to Light the Sky Lantern unexpectedly engages him to The eldest Miss Carmichael, Serena Carmichael. Amid conspiracies by The Crawford family, The Hawthorne family, and foreign spy Agent Blackwood, The Reaper uncovers a plot of stolen treasures and biochemical weapons. He must protect his love and save the city from a toxic lab. Ultimately, he destroys the villains and marries Serena Carmichael in a chaotic era.
69e8b66bf752cd2e6707ae72.title: Lone City 1944

69e8b7cffb25288a540dc0fe.synopsis: After being murdered, single CEO Clara Hayes is reborn in the 80s. She outsmarts traps set by the Vance family, including assault, her stepmom stealing her marriage, poisoning, framing, and rumors that her menstruation is unclean. Clara Hayes reunites with her partner and empowers local women to help restore the historic manor. She uncovers dark secrets, realizing her stepmom is her biological sister and her father is an imposter. In the end, she chooses to perish together with the villains. Clara Hayes then awakens in the modern era, knowing her brief presence forever changed their destinies.
69e8b7cffb25288a540dc0fe.title: The Woman in the Historic Manor

69e97e12abb5d0a019058c3a.synopsis: Susan Caldwell had a bleak life before 50. The son she sacrificed to raise sold her to that upstart for $100,000 just for money. In her darkest hour, Robert Lockwood stepped up. She mistook him for a regular worker at the site, but he recognized her as his savior who gave him life-saving wontons 20 years ago. To protect her, he married her instantly while posing as a laborer, taking her away from the mess. Later, dressed elegantly at a family banquet, she was humiliated and pushed down by her own son. Suddenly, Robert arrived powerfully as the CEO of Lockwood Group, stunning everyone who bullied her. At 50, her life finally entered its true spring.
69e97e12abb5d0a019058c3a.title: Spring at Fifty

69e97e15abb5d0a019058c40.synopsis: In 2023, Jason dies -- betrayed by his wife. Then he opens his eyes. It's 1983. The morning of his wedding. When his future in-laws demand an extra TV on top of the already outrageous bride price, Jason doesn't beg or borrow. He walks away. Calls off the wedding. And starts over. With thirty years of restaurant experience from his past life, he turns ditch-dwelling crawfish into a culinary craze, builds a vegetable empire from nothing, and takes on corrupt officials, ruthless rivals, and the family who once destroyed him. Along the way, he finds a new love -- the broadcaster Valerie Stratton -- and a brand new reason to live.
69e97e15abb5d0a019058c40.title: Redo in '83

69e9b1a3b19a7b26c708ce7f.synopsis: Replaced by the true heir Justin, the adopted son Caleb is given an empty zoo by the Sterling family. He accidentally activates the Jurassic System, hatches a Triceratops, and goes viral with the help of streamer Kira. When the Sterling family tries to seize the property, Caleb drives them away with a T-Rex and later thwarts a poacher attack. Unlocking more dinosaurs like the Diplodocus, he partners with the Caldwell Group to expand, eventually buying out the Sterling Group to build the world's first Jurassic Dinosaur Park.
69e9b1a3b19a7b26c708ce7f.title: Geez! I Have a Dinosaur Park!

69e9b5a0b3436643670a5433.synopsis: Reborn as her Grandmother by a sickbed, she escapes an arranged marriage and falls for General Hayes. Using her modern wits, she helps him conquer all odds to live happily ever after.
69e9b5a0b3436643670a5433.title: The Lady and the General

69e9b5a2b3436643670a5437.synopsis: The Cross Family of Northbay is massacred, but Gideon Cross survives. After learning The Seventy-Two Earthly Shifts, he returns eighteen years later for revenge. He soon rescues Valerie Pierce from Lord Drake's goons, and she later discovers Gideon is her fiance. When Malcolm Graves, the richest man in Northbay, seeks Drake's help, Drake sends his goddaughter, Nadia. Her assassination attempt fails, and Gideon toys with her instead. After crashing Malcolm's birthday with a coffin, Gideon defeats experts from The Apex Roster. He is nearly killed by Drake's poison master, Trent, but Valerie saves him, revealing herself as the Commander of the Dragon Order. When Jagger, the original assassin, is hospitalized, Gideon stops Malcolm and Drake's hitmen from silencing him. Impressed, Drake sends Nadia to seduce Gideon. While dining, they are harassed by the Governor's drunk nephew, Preston Hale, at a restaurant owned by Malcolm's daughter, Evelyn Graves. Feigning loyalty to Drake, Gideon fights The Valdorian Delegation for Northbay. Malcolm and the Governor's wife, Beatrice Hale, conspire to kill him. Gideon crushes the delegation, but an envoy fatally overdoses on enhancers. Framed, Gideon is trapped by Beatrice's Golden Snare until Valerie exposes Beatrice as an enemy spy. Drake then plans to marry Nadia to Preston. Meanwhile, Evelyn overhears Malcolm ordering Madam Blanche to poison Valerie. Gideon saves Valerie just in time. At the engagement, Gideon takes three strikes from Drake to free Nadia. When Drake breaks his word and tries to kill him, Gideon fights back. To survive, Drake exposes Malcolm's treason. Gideon chases the fleeing Malcolm but is lured away, allowing Malcolm to kidnap Valerie, Nadia, and Evelyn. Facing Malcolm alone, Gideon shifts into The Great Trickster, defeats him, and avenges his family. Yet, torn between three beautiful women, Gideon faces his toughest choice yet.
69e9b5a2b3436643670a5437.title: Watch My 72 Shifts

69e9b5aab3436643670a544b.synopsis: Fifteen years ago, Lydia gave up her billionaire adoption spot to her twin, Diana. Years later, ruthlessly bullied by elites, Lydia attempts suicide and barely survives. Diana returns victorious, only to find her beloved sister fighting for her life in the Intensive Care Unit. Devastated, she seeks vengeance, becoming the bait to personally punish the monsters who pushed Lydia to the edge!
69e9b5aab3436643670a544b.title: Cheating Death: The Avenging Twin Goes on a Rampage

69e9b5abb3436643670a544f.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Caroline Hawthorne secretly weds a poor country boy, David Miller. A year later, her disapproving father, Mr. Hawthorne of Hawthorne Enterprises, tracks them down. Just as the couple is happily caring for their adorable boy and girl twins, Mr. Hawthorne barges in. Ignoring their desperate pleas, he forcefully takes Caroline and the twin boy away, renaming the boy Mason Hawthorne. David is left alone in the country to raise their little daughter, Emma Miller (Emmy).
69e9b5abb3436643670a544f.title: Where did Mom go

69e9ceb2081f34529d08f1bc.synopsis: In the kingdom of Aethelgard, where men bow and women rule, Princess Valerie, the ruthless Goddess of War, seeks revenge. To humiliate the enemy who once bested her on the battlefield, she takes the legendary Valdorian Warlord as her consort. But the seemingly submissive man at her side is not who he claims to be.
