He is Caspian Vale, the twin brother of her enemy, and a Blood Proxy forced since childhood to bear every wound, every poison, every agony meant for his sibling. Chained by a dark blood pact, Caspian hides behind his brother's name, waiting for the one thing that can set him free: the mythical Icebloom. But what begins as a game of deception slowly turns into something neither expected...
69e9ceb2081f34529d08f1bc.title: Her Hidden Blade

69e9d01b27d59bed110a3101.synopsis: A female general watches her husband die taking an arrow meant for her. As she falls from a cliff, she swears: if given another life, she will love him better. Then she wakes up—five years earlier, on the day of their engagement. This time, she marries him without hesitation. Armed with memories of the future, she foils her brother's schemes, dismantles a rival's plots, and mends every rift with her husband and his mother. Together, she helps him rise to the highest office—while earning the empire's highest honor for herself. The swords of the past become the foundation of their happiness.
69e9d01b27d59bed110a3101.title: Die For You, Kill For All

69e9d67108db954e5e0d868e.synopsis: Thomas, a traditional medicine graduate, awakens as a rogue in Calvin Village. He uses modern medicine to outsmart his uncle Edwin, rescue Caroline, and start a successful business. After exposing the corrupt officials and curing a plague, he saves the emperor from an invasion. Who knew someone so weak could turn out to be a hero?
69e9d67108db954e5e0d868e.title: Reborn: I'm the Legendary Healer

69e9d79a733786f9490000a1.synopsis: In Unrivaled Beneath the Heavens movie, in his past life, Gideon was the undisputed legend of the martial world — until Empress Aurelia Thorne betrayed and killed him. Reborn as Kaelen, he enters the prestigious Lancaster family as a humble live-in son-in-law. But peace is an illusion. When his wife's brother, Darius, murders Kaelen's foster parents and kidnaps his sister, vengeance becomes his only path. Yet darker hands lurk in the shadows. Gavin, the Empress's brother, assassinates Darius and frames Kaelen, and sets the ultimate trap: the Nine Ennead Gauntlets. But this time, no empress, no scheme, no heaven will stop him.
69e9d79a733786f9490000a1.title: Unrivaled Beneath the Heavens

69e9d8c67a80ef7aec0ec7a9.synopsis: Right after finishing a mission, the Strategy Queen Victoria Sinclair learns from the system that her modern-day best friend, Lucy Lancaster, was murdered. Seeking revenge, Victoria returns to the 21st century as the true heiress of the Vance family. She replaces the fake heiress, Felicity Vance, to marry the disfigured eldest son of the Prescott family, Julian Prescott. Her new task: make Julian fall in love with her. Everyone expects the Prescott family to reject the country-raised Victoria. Instead, she wins Julian's deep devotion and becomes the general manager of Prescott Corporation, making sure the scumbag who killed her friend, Felix Prescott, finally pays the price.
69e9d8c67a80ef7aec0ec7a9.title: Jerk Killed My Bestie, I Avenge

69e9db9659c9a7ef9c0aba19.synopsis: Heiress Caroline Sterling's wedding is sabotaged by her fiancé Nathan Prescott's jealous sister, who questions her unborn child's paternity. A risky amniocentesis confirms the baby is a Prescott. Caroline's father announces the baby as a girl, causing the Prescotts to reject her. Planning to divorce after the baby is born, Caroline shocks the Prescotts on divorce day when they realize she has a son, not a daughter. She leaves to claim her fortune, leaving the Prescotts heirless.
69e9db9659c9a7ef9c0aba19.title: Fake Heiress? I'm the True Boss

69e9db9759c9a7ef9c0aba1b.synopsis: Hidden for a century, the ageless Celeste emerges to save her descendant, Claire Winslow. Returning to the Winslow family, she finds Patriarch Richard Winslow dying. Hindered by suspicious relatives, she uncovers a trap set by her nemesis Severin Blackwood and a shocking bloodline secret. Celeste must use her ancient skills to root out traitors and restore the family!
69e9db9759c9a7ef9c0aba1b.title: Hidden Blood, Hidden Wrath

69eadde1df79a48dcb0f67de.synopsis: After seeing gambling ruin many families, Ray Cooper, the Gamble Demon, vowed to eliminate the vice. He defeated top gambling legends and retired, living as a foot masseur. Years later, his sister-in-law's casino debt pulls him back. Vice still thrives. Disguised as a scruffy worker, Ray returns to underground casinos, using gambling as his weapon to clean up the vice.
69eadde1df79a48dcb0f67de.title: Don't Mess with That Masseur

69eadde7df79a48dcb0f67ec.synopsis: Jeremy, a fortune teller from the 21st century, is transported to ancient times and becomes a fake eunuch. Initially planning to stay under the radar, his life changes when he's caught by the princess while pretending to serve her. Forced into a relationship, Jeremy wins the princess's heart. Using his strategic genius, he rises through the ranks in the palace, eventually becoming the first-ever "Lord of Leisure."
69eadde7df79a48dcb0f67ec.title: The Eunuch's Gambit

69eb235540c196bed1003c3e.synopsis: When poor student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton & Amber Collins, and the elegant Audrey Sterling utterly captivated. After all—who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth? Adapted from a hit web novel.
69eb235540c196bed1003c3e.title: X-Ray Eyes, Billionaire Rise

69ee13d31ad3f9b22e0acdea.synopsis: In The Vanished Racing Legend movie, ten years ago, racing legend Jack, "The Turbo King" vanished after winning a championship. Now living under a new name as a mechanic, he rekindles his racing spirit during a desperate rescue. To protect America’s Blake Racing Team, he drives a battered Aveo into a deadly showdown with the arrogant European powerhouse, Imperium. Jack faces old enemies in the high-stakes “Purgatory Cup,” saving his best friend’s son, and uncovering the truth behind his lost decade.
69ee13d31ad3f9b22e0acdea.title: The Vanished Racing Legend

69ee144b9145b171320d315a.synopsis: The night before the State Championship final, cheerleader Jessica invites the Maple Giants football team to party with her at the bar. Katlyn, as the team's manager, puts her foot down and demands they get a good nights rest instead of going out and drinking. The next day, the Maple Giants win the championship, only to be greeted with terrible news — Jessica went out alone last night, was assaulted and broke her legs. The team, led by Logan, pins the blame on Katlyn, claiming that if she hadn't stopped them from going to Jessica's party, Jessica would still be safe! Logan demands that Katlyn suffers the same fate and breaks her leg. While trying to escape, Katlyn falls off the roof and dies. The football team even frames her as a bully. Katlyn suddenly wakes up the night before the Championship Final! Not about to waste her second chance at life, Katlyn swears to herself she'll never help these dumb jocks again. Instead, she'll watch and enjoy as they bring about their self-destruction!
69ee144b9145b171320d315a.title: Reborn to See the Football Stars Ruin Themselves

69eec35f4bc5cb71330647f1.synopsis: In Got Dumped. Got LadyAid movie, Gavin is a broke delivery guy, and his girlfriend has dumped him for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78k. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to power. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back.
69eec35f4bc5cb71330647f1.title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.

69eed7874eaee13cfb03b52d.synopsis: Edward, a powerful Alpha, plans to reject his fated mate to make his savior Katherine his Luna. But during the deadly Soul Fire Ritual, he gradually falls in love with his true mate, Scarlett—only to destroy her. After her death, he discovers the truth from her diary: Scarlett was the real one who saved him all along. Katherine lied to him and it was all a set up. Now, with everything lost, will fate give Alpha a second chance to redeem himself and win her back?
69eed7874eaee13cfb03b52d.title: Luna Reborn: Alpha's Second Chance

69eedad16efacf0b460c5a19.synopsis: Facing her husband's deadly trap, heiress Elise hires Silas, a mysterious and elite bodyguard. She is a dying phoenix; he is a blade in the dark. Using the Tate family as their chessboard, everyone assumes he is just her pawn. Little do they know, this is a high-stakes gamble of lives and hearts.
69eedad16efacf0b460c5a19.title: Love, Bound & Blooming

69eefd088924136e2a02c409.synopsis: Billionaire heiress Briana hides her identity to support her husband Dylan. Pregnant again, she leaves their daughter in his care, but he locks the child in a car in order to help his ex! Rushing to save her daughter, Briana goes into emergency labor. When Dylan shows no remorse, Briana decides it's time to leave and take back everything.
69eefd088924136e2a02c409.title: They Locked Her Daughter in the Car

69eefd7fc9e41a3f6c0e8546.synopsis: Top fighter Damian returns as Lord Hades to protect his fiancée, Sterling Group's CEO, Vivian Sterling. After revealing his true identity to NSB Captain Avery, they share an unexpected night of passion. Damian defeats global assassin Marilyn, exposes Vivian's friend Sylvia as a mole, and continuously thwarts the Blackwood family's plots to steal an anti-cancer project. He survives sniper fire, subdues Don Carmine of the Azure Gang, and easily crushes the assassin Clyde Barnes.
69eefd7fc9e41a3f6c0e8546.title: The Unbeatable Guardian

69eefd85c9e41a3f6c0e8556.synopsis: Top fighter Damian returns as Lord Hades to protect his fiancée, Sterling Group's CEO, Vivian Sterling. After revealing his true identity to NSB Captain Avery, they share an unexpected night of passion. Damian defeats global assassin Marilyn, exposes Vivian's friend Sylvia as a mole, and continuously thwarts the Blackwood family's plots to steal an anti-cancer project. He survives sniper fire, subdues Don Carmine of the Azure Gang, and easily crushes the assassin Clyde Barnes.
69eefd85c9e41a3f6c0e8556.title: The Unbeatable Guardian

69ef02307b1e0f3f6900ac92.synopsis: What is betrayal? Paisley learned it the moment her best friend stabbed her — literally. What is a vampire? She learned that too… when one saved her life. Once a normal high school girl, Paisley’s world shattered when Charlotte — the person she trusted most — betrayed and killed her. But death wasn’t the end. In her final breath, she made a pact with Lucifer himself, rising again with the power of darkness burning in her veins. Now reborn between life and death, Paisley hunts those who wronged her, guided by demons and protected by supernatural allies—vampires, werewolves, and creatures of the night. But vengeance isn’t the only thing awakening in her heart. The connection between her and Lucifer grows deeper, entangling passion, power, and damnation. When the “Sin Eaters” threaten to destroy everything she’s become, Paisley must choose between revenge and her new destiny—as the Bride of Hell. BETRAYAL AND VAMPIRE — an Anime dark romance of revenge, desire, and rebirth. Love can kill. Or resurrect.
69ef02307b1e0f3f6900ac92.title: Betrayal and Vampire

69ef02327b1e0f3f6900ac98.synopsis: After centuries of silence, she rises again. Buried in blood and betrayal, Scarlett has returned from death — resurrected by the only soul who ever truly loved her, Alexa. Once sisters by choice and bound by destiny, their story was written in curses, torn apart by betrayal, and sealed beneath centuries of dust. But now, the dead walk again—seeking vengeance. As Scarlett reclaims her power, she and Alexa wage war against the Salvatore brothers and the ancient vampire Edgar, the Original who cursed their bloodline. Shadows tighten around them, weaving together witchcraft, prophecy, and the unbreakable chain of the sire bond. In a world ruled by immortality, love becomes both weapon and weakness. Old wounds burn brighter than ever, forcing Scarlett to face one haunting truth—revenge comes with a price, and sometimes that price is love itself. REVENGE AFTER CENTURIES — a saga of resurrection, betrayal, and revenge that defies time. Some loves never die. Some hatreds never fade.
69ef02327b1e0f3f6900ac98.title: Revenge After Centuries

69ef22c5b36ddb3bde05ca76.synopsis: Eighteen years ago, Miles' family was massacred over two legendary medical books. The two-year-old was sent to a mountain and adopted by an old master. Now, Miles returns with a Marriage Pact. On his way, he saves Melanie and Scarlett, healing Melanie's facial scars. Arriving at the Prescott family, he faces disdain and a broken engagement, only to notice Robert is on the verge of death. Wielding the Peerless Immortal Skill to control life and death, and his family's medical skills to reverse fate, Miles begins his journey...
69ef22c5b36ddb3bde05ca76.title: Miracle Healer's Love Story with Ms. CEO

69f01be703d257056a0c1c49.synopsis: Reborn as a post-apocalyptic underling, Finn binds the "Wife Pampering System" and chooses three women everyone despises: a paralyzed S-rank, a mutant, and a dying clone. Laughter turns to shock as Finn's serum awakens their powers, telekinesis, super strength, and instant teleportation. Together, they crush enemies, but Colonel Zeller's missile strikes and city-wide hunt threaten to wipe them out. Survival just became war.
69f01be703d257056a0c1c49.title: Oops, I Leveled Up the Apocalypse

69f024cf72189b81f30776c0.synopsis: After witnessing Reginald murder his wife, Lottie feigned muteness to survive. Years later, she fell for her rescuer Julian, but they were separated by her mother. When her family fell, Lottie sought Julian, only to have her identity stolen by Natalie. To escape Reginald, she married Julian. Pregnant and mistrusted, she fled, later returning disguised as a kidnapper. Their conflict ultimately exposed the truth, allowing them to take down Reginald together.
69f024cf72189b81f30776c0.title: The Mute Bride's Revenge

69f033572f640f82b604a29f.synopsis: In The Wolf Assassin Pregnant and Dangerous movie, a pregnant werewolf assassin must reclaim her sealed powers when captured by the Belmonts, a family who traffics pregnant women and sells their babies to the highest bidder. As her own labor approaches, she battles to save herself, her unborn child, and dozens of other captive mothers.
69f033572f640f82b604a29f.title: The Wolf Assassin: Pregnant and Dangerous (updating)

69f033582f640f82b604a2a1.synopsis: Leo is a mute teen boy working as a janitor in a fight school. When the girl he secretly loves becomes a demon gang’s target, his powers are awakened, revealing his true identity as the immortal warrior Leonidas, once a Spartan King. Now Leo must step out of obscurity to protect the one girl who protected him and face the ancient evil that’s been hunting him for thousands of years.
69f033582f640f82b604a2a1.title: Immortal Warrior Reckoning (updating)

69f05a032d36237c2b0136ba.synopsis: Fifty-year-old cleaner Joyce Abbott is kicked out by her greedy son and daughter-in-law. In despair, she impulsively marries a security guard, Richard Sterling. Little does she know, her sweet new husband is secretly a billionaire! Even more shocking, his daughter, Stella Sterling, is Joyce's biological child she lost in the ruins 30 years ago. When her snobby in-laws return to humiliate her, her security guard husband steps up to protect her, sparking a heartwarming journey of sweet revenge and family reunion.
69f05a032d36237c2b0136ba.title: Late Love With A Tycoon

69f158afd8c0deda7f0c4bc4.synopsis: Eight years of agony. Endless betrayals. Then a second chance. Madeline Hayes awakens at the start of her nightmare, and she's not the same naive girl anymore. She cuts off her so-called uncle, trashes his precious first love, and gets her revenge cold and clean. But when she turns to leave for good, the man who once broke her now clings to her, red-eyed, begging her to stay.
69f158afd8c0deda7f0c4bc4.title: Reborn, Not Yours

69f17b3c90e0574aa5021b63.synopsis: One simple like on her fiancé’s social post costs Sama Hayes her entire salary! For a decade, she devoted herself to building his career—only to be bullied and marginalized by the newcomer Chloe Miller. The moment Sama hands in her resignation without hesitation, Jason Parker spirals into panic… yet she will never look back again. She quits her job, sells her property, and walks away gracefully, soaring to dazzling new heights in her career. When her scheming ex sets her up out of spite? She hits back hard, taking him straight to court with a live-streamed trial! Watch the ruthless independent heroine dump the worthless man, outwit the scheming rival, and dominate the business arena against all odds.
69f17b3c90e0574aa5021b63.title: No More Waiting for a Faithless Man

69f1bafcc88faab6300cffe4.synopsis: Wolf Agent Evelyn accidentally time-traveled, waking up in a poor village. She became the stepmother to three kids after their father, Arthur, went missing. Left to raise them alone, Evelyn unlocked the Emotion Exchange System. Soon, she had her family feasting on meat during a famine and earning money by selling candied haws. But peace never lasted long. With new dangers threatening the family of four, how would Evelyn and the children survive?
69f1bafcc88faab6300cffe4.title: The Agent Mom: Survive the Famine

69f1baffc88faab6300cffea.synopsis: The night before her arranged wedding, Harper Sullivan bedded a hot stranger. At the family banquet, a teasing voice remarked that she looked familiar. She looked up, only to find the revered "Mr. Lucas" was the man from last night. Now, by day, she plays the obedient wife. By night, clingy Mr. Lucas whispers that it's her turn to call him darling.
69f1baffc88faab6300cffea.title: Forbidden Steps

69f1bb38cbc5d826c1041bf8.synopsis: Sarah Palin, Patient Zero in the mental hospital, takes a job at OmniMed after recovering. When her tormentor, Morgan Hunter, turns workplace bullying into a vicious campaign, Sarah fights back. But Sarah is thrown back to the mental hospital...
69f1bb38cbc5d826c1041bf8.title: Patient Zero's First Day of Work

69f1bb39cbc5d826c1041bfc.synopsis: Lucas Hayes and his wife Chloe go for a routine checkup. The results come back: advanced liver cancer. But Chloe misreads the report — she believes Lucas is the one dying, not her. While Lucas scrambles to raise the $50,000 surgery fee, Chloe refuses the hospital's arranged liver donor and lends the $50,000 to her younger brother to get a car. "Lucas doesn't deserve to spend that much", she tells herself. Then Lucas places her real diagnosis in her hands. But the money, the one thing that could have saved her, is already gone...
69f1bb39cbc5d826c1041bfc.title: The Test She Failed

69f1c67a3161569bac056c98.synopsis: Poor college student Eleanor Vance has a one-night stand with Preston Sinclair, CEO of Sinclair Corp., and secretly has his son. To escape an arranged marriage set up by George and Brenda, she moves to the city for college with her baby. At the opening ceremony, Eleanor is mocked for breastfeeding in public, and her baby accidentally lands in the arms of Mr. Elias Sinclair during his school inspection. Convinced the boy is his grandson, he takes him back to the Sinclair family. Eleanor's hometown friend Melody Vance claims to be the mother and infiltrates the family. To silence Eleanor, Melody pays George and Brenda to drag her back to the countryside to get married. Overcoming many hurdles, Eleanor returns to school and is hired by Preston as the baby's nanny. As they grow closer, Preston falls for the kind, resilient Eleanor and questions her true identity. In the end, Melody's lies are publicly exposed. Eleanor and her son reunite with Preston, the villains face justice, and the family is finally whole.
69f1c67a3161569bac056c98.title: The Stolen Motherhood

69f2cff5a10838ffa605da0d.synopsis: Trapped in the Summer Heat is a 54-episode English short drama of family ethics & realistic tragedy. Set in extreme summer heat, it tells a heartbreaking story that 5-year-old Lily is locked in a scorching car by her father Ryan for hours, because Ryan chooses to stay with his mistress Sienna and her son Miles. Lily eventually dies of heatstroke. Her mother Marin frantically searches for her daughter, confronts her husband’s coldness and betrayal, and ushers in a broken ending and cruel truth. The drama focuses on three realistic pain points: marriage betrayal, parental neglect, and fatal danger of leaving kids in hot cars, with high emotional tension and dense conflicts, which is a realistic short drama with strong warning significance and payment appeal.
69f2cff5a10838ffa605da0d.title: The Godfather's Redemption and Betrayal

69f30e50e725ee20ad0c6808.synopsis: Reborn at the Consort Selection Ceremony, Nine-Tailed Fox Princess Aveline chooses Darius, a Lv. 1 Wildcat, over her past-life betrayer. She stuns her clan with a Supreme All-Element Beast Core. Using her past memories, she helps Darius evolve and claims the Four Great Divine Beasts—Black Turtle, Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, and White Tiger, as her Beast Consorts to fight her sister Valeria and Malakor the Evil Dragon. From territorial wars to the battle for the throne, Aveline rallies her forces to become the new Queen of the Demon Realm, rewriting her tragic destiny.
69f30e50e725ee20ad0c6808.title: The Fox Queen and Her Strong Husbands

69f31f2fab2d426c400326ba.synopsis: At the sacred mate ceremony, Alpha Mavrik publicly abandons his fiancée Juniper for his new lover Rosette, humiliating her as a mere breeding tool. Unknown to him, Juniper is the direct heir of the First Wolves, holding the pack’s supreme power and wealth. She secretly tears off their engagement and turns to the Moon Goddess. At the auction and her awakening party, Mavrik keeps bullying her, even destroying her late mother’s robe and flaunting his bond with Rosette. But Juniper has long awakened. She rejects Mavrik and chooses her true mate—Alpha Ryker Darkmore, who once saved her life and guarded her for years. Finally, the arrogant Mavrik loses everything and meets his tragic end. Juniper regains her glory, bonding with Ryker and living a peaceful, happy life.
69f31f2fab2d426c400326ba.title: True Mate's vengeance

69f326eb9904b895410dae27.synopsis: Simon is transported to the Journey to the West world. Three years later, he's king of Queensgate and unlocks a system, only to find it rewards mundane life skills. When the Pilgrimage Cataclysm hits, the Bodhisattva orders him to help Gareth Abbott survive. Humiliated, Simon cooks a meal, which somehow turns ordinary objects into magical powers. Even schoolbooks hide top-tier cultivation secrets. A mortal just trying to survive, but the world won't let him.
69f326eb9904b895410dae27.title: A Mortal Among Immortals

69f4c7f4843c9ba3b80c4285.synopsis: Jason gave everything for his dream girl, Mia — only to catch her cheating with a wealthy rival. On the verge of a breakdown, he awakens the Trillion-Dollar Subsidy System, which rewards him with luxury homes and supercars for completing tasks. He rises from rock bottom, humiliates the cheating woman and her lover, then saves his father by confronting his own cousin, gaining hotel equity and launching his business empire. Along the way, he protects a childhood friend and helps a woman named Sophie, steadily expanding his wealth until he becomes the richest man in Cloudhaven.
69f4c7f4843c9ba3b80c4285.title: Cashback Over Crushes

69f7696e9d97ba20aa0edcbd.synopsis: Audrey Harrington, the adopted daughter of the Harrington Estate, is betrayed and murdered by the trueborn child, Stella Harrington, and the rest of House Harrington. Reborn, Audrey vows revenge. Calculating her every move, she reclaims the steward's power only to strategically let it go, plunging House Harrington into financial ruin. She then exposes Stella Harrington's schemes, completely humiliating her. Meanwhile, she allies with His Highness Rowan Lancaster to uncover the dark secrets of House Harrington. Ultimately, Audrey exposes their crimes, leading to the family's exile. Free from their grasp, she finds her happily ever after with Rowan Lancaster.
69f7696e9d97ba20aa0edcbd.title: Not My Clan, Not My Problem

69f76a2f3015f535b4055418.synopsis: Eighteen years ago, Miles' family was massacred over two legendary medical books. The two-year-old was sent to a mountain and adopted by an old master. Now, Miles returns with a Marriage Pact. On his way, he saves Melanie and Scarlett, healing Melanie's facial scars. Arriving at the Prescott family, he faces disdain and a broken engagement, only to notice Robert is on the verge of death. Wielding the Peerless Immortal Skill to control life and death, and his family's medical skills to reverse fate, Miles begins his journey...
69f76a2f3015f535b4055418.title: Miracle Healer's Love Story with Ms. CEO

69fa0a977e9368c0730c1459.synopsis: In the Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen movie, after her Moonshadow Pack was slaughtered by rogues, Arya, the werewolf warrior, hides her immense power to honor her mother's dying wish. She marries Alpha Micah, and hides her strength. But then, Alpha Micah breaks his vows and returns from war with a new mate, Vera, and demands that Arya share her Luna title with her. Faced with Vera, Micah, and his family's cruelty, Arya can no longer bear it. She leaves Micah and unleashes the immense power of the White Wolf, reclaiming what is hers with the help of Lowe, the Lycan King. After separating from Micah, Arya discoveres that Vera not only stole Micah from her, but is also the traitor who slaughtered her parents and the Moonshadow Pack. Arya rushes to the battlefield to face her betrayers, and in the process, finds love in Lowe, the Lycan King.
69fa0a977e9368c0730c1459.title: Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen

69fa0a987e9368c0730c145b.synopsis: A prince torn from his throne. A peasant girl who risked everything to save him. Years later, he returns as king, only to be betrayed, beaten, and forced to fight for love, honor, and revenge.
69fa0a987e9368c0730c145b.title: Prince, Thief, to Warrior King

69fa1e880683f8510b02930c.synopsis: War hero Harrison returns from war to discover his sister has died by her fiancé, Karter's hand. Harrison infiltrates Karter's banquet wearing his worn fatigues, announcing to Karter that his punishment will arrive in 3 days. Eventually, he reveals his true identity as the Director of FBI, and achieves his ultimate revenge.
69fa1e880683f8510b02930c.title: The Warlord Returns

69faa3678195eaab9507003d.synopsis: Beaten into a fool after a failed courtship, Dylan is saved by a gorgeous woman. She never hides her own body while bathing or sleeping, and slowly falls for the fool Dylan. Suddenly, Dylan hits his head and receives the Astral Hermit legacy! Cured of his foolishness, he awakens X-Ray Vision and other magical powers, like medical skills. Mastering all skills, he kicks off a legendary life! He met a rich heiress and a hot doctor. Will he entangle with these women?
69faa3678195eaab9507003d.title: Fool No More: X-Ray Vision

69faa3a3d0f105e060066c52.synopsis: Sixteen years ago, Eleanor Fletcher's husband faked his own death and abandoned her — all for wealth and status. Left alone to carry the Blackwood family, she did the unthinkable: she married the family's adoptee, Silas, giving the household a new future. Sixteen years later, Silas has risen to become the most powerful minister in the court. Together, he and Eleanor share a deep and unbreakable bond — until the past comes crashing back. Caleb — the husband who supposedly died — returns with another woman and her children, demanding his birthright. But he has no idea what he's walking into...
69faa3a3d0f105e060066c52.title: Ex Left for Gold, She Married the Throne

69faa3a4d0f105e060066c54.synopsis: Dying of cancer, Serena Vance let her husband cheat. But in the end, she's run over by his mistress and dumped like trash. Reborn, cancer gone, the mistress never appears. Now she's back as design queen, joins Grant Group, and crushes it. No more doormat. Only boss.
69faa3a4d0f105e060066c54.title: Dead to Love

69faa3a5d0f105e060066c56.synopsis: Maya Hayes is a straight-A student with one goal: study hard, escape her violent father, and never look back. But when she stumbles into a tattoo parlor — fleeing a beating — she comes face-to-face with Oakridge High's resident rebel, Jude Sinclair. Soon, the well-behaved scholar and the rich kid with a broken past are thrown together as desk mates. Late nights turn into shared secrets. Insults give way to understanding. Bit by bit, they begin to see through each other's armor — and find something real underneath. Together, they make a pact: break free, fight back, and burn down everything that tries to keep them down.
69faa3a5d0f105e060066c56.title: The Rebel and the Scholar

69faab23fdb63161f2087bf6.synopsis: When Tessa Reed reunites with Nathan Vance, she’s the humble contractor, while he stands tall as her arrogant client. It’s just like their college days: she pined for him silently, yet the cold, coveted campus heartthrob only had eyes for his perfect moonlight girl. As Nathan gets closer, Tessa falls for him again, until she hears him mock her as a poor girl he could never love. Heartbroken, Tessa walks away. Panicking, a tearful Nathan chases her into the rain to beg for her heart.
69faab23fdb63161f2087bf6.title: Pride Fell For Me

69faadb86f782eff4301a833.synopsis: A top CEO from 2026 dies — and wakes up in 1993 as Ivory Dawson, a disfigured woman betrayed by her cheating husband and a ruthless homewrecker. Stripped of her dowry and thrown out to die, she refuses to stay down. A modern smartphone can change everything. Toxic mother-in-law, brainwashed son, and a scumbag husband, she's fighting them all back.
69faadb86f782eff4301a833.title: Beauty & Billions: She Strikes Back

69fab2df0fd3bf50d305f3ee.synopsis: Invincible Grandmaster Arthur descends into the mortal world. He sparks a fiery romance with his childhood sweetheart while captivating a martial arts goddess and a wealthy heiress. Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.
69fab2df0fd3bf50d305f3ee.title: The Immortal's Return

69fab2e00fd3bf50d305f3f0.synopsis: College student Jason time-traveled to the Cultivation World. After cultivating for 10,000 years to become a Sage, he returns to Earth to find only one day has passed! Before he left, his father died, his adopted brother forced his mother into debt, his buddy Derek stole his patent money, and his crush Alyssa was stolen by his rival. Now back, Jason ruthlessly crushes those bullies! He dismantles loan sharks, saves the head of Reed Group, and helps his secret admirer Zoe make a stunning comeback. Facing hidden enemies on Earth, he uses his 10,000 years of cultivation power to crush everything in his path.
69fab2e00fd3bf50d305f3f0.title: Sage in the City: 24-Hour Comeback

69fad8547b11a0bb350e64a4.synopsis: Invincible Grandmaster Arthur descends into the mortal world. He sparks a fiery romance with his childhood sweetheart while captivating a martial arts goddess and a wealthy heiress. Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.
69fad8547b11a0bb350e64a4.title: The Immortal's Return

69fadaf3e0888b65da0dc7e2.synopsis: Mia Hayes quits school to work in a factory cafeteria to pay her mom's medical bills, only to be bullied for being mute. After an unexpected encounter with aloof CEO Oliver Voss, Mia discovers she is pregnant. Miraculously, Oliver can suddenly read her mind! Hearing her inner thoughts, he fiercely protects and spoils her. Mia finally has someone to rely on, but a new crisis is looming...
69fadaf3e0888b65da0dc7e2.title: Cold CEO Reads My Silent Mind

69fae1475d993aaf0d039292.synopsis: Heir Rowan Kingsley survives a cliff fall, rescued by poor farmer Theodore Palmer and his daughter Nora. The Palmers sacrifice everything to send him abroad. Nora hides her own college acceptance to support him. Five years later, Rowan returns to repay the family who saved him.
69fae1475d993aaf0d039292.title: True Love Prevails

69fae3db71ec89999c062a98.synopsis: Amnesiac John Miller and his daughter Mia keep a low profile at Sinclair Group until John accidentally provokes Zachary Sinclair. Brutally harassed, John's fate takes a turn when Zachary recognizes a unique charm. The shocking discovery transforms Zachary from bully to bewildered son: his victim is Jonathan, the father he never knew.
69fae3db71ec89999c062a98.title: The Father They Never Knew

69faeb5bc5ebabd7cd07a9d2.synopsis: In her past life, Karol Eisen married Prince Harold Jackson by royal decree. She gave him her heart, only to discover he loved someone else. After a life of neglect and abuse, she died in despair. Reborn, she swears never to repeat her tragic mistakes!
69faeb5bc5ebabd7cd07a9d2.title: Too Late for Us

69faf2dc3fb84d2dda0de3f4.synopsis: On the fifth day of the New Year, delivery guy Dylan Hardy wins a prize and becomes the Acting Money God for a day. Endless jackpots. Enraged in-laws. No one believes in his luck and chaos keeps happening in his life. Little do they know, he's the actual Money God!
69faf2dc3fb84d2dda0de3f4.title: Cash, Chaos, and a Temporary God

69faf3cb91487102090d1d1e.synopsis: In her past life, Harper Prescott was killed by her parents and sister after helping them win the family inheritance. Reborn, she decides to get a new dad—her deadbeat uncle! But Gramps can hear her every thought. Guided by her inner voice, Richard Prescott finally sees his eldest son's worth and exposes the ruthless hypocrisy of his second son, Derek Prescott. This time, Harper will get her happily ever after!
69faf3cb91487102090d1d1e.title: Cutie's Secret Voice

69faf9b835cf4a063b0a624d.synopsis: College student Jason time-traveled to the Cultivation World. After cultivating for 10,000 years to become a Sage, he returns to Earth to find only one day has passed! Before he left, his father died, his adopted brother forced his mother into debt, his buddy Derek stole his patent money, and his crush Alyssa was stolen by his rival. Now back, Jason ruthlessly crushes those bullies! He dismantles loan sharks, saves the head of Reed Group, and helps his secret admirer Zoe make a stunning comeback. Facing hidden enemies on Earth, he uses his 10,000 years of cultivation power to crush everything in his path.
69faf9b835cf4a063b0a624d.title: Sage in the City: 24-Hour Comeback

69fb39df898b05ee150222cd.synopsis: Valerie looks like a nobody, but she's the secret daughter of crime lord Arthur Morgan. To save her mother, she's thrown into the underworld, a pawn in a deadly game. But she survives. Feeding intel to the police, she orchestrates a bloody trap, watching the syndicate destroy itself. When the smoke clears, she walks away from the bloodshed, aces her exams, and rewrites her destiny.
69fb39df898b05ee150222cd.title: Rise of the Hidden Heiress

69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.synopsis: Seraph was a princess cherished by her family her entire life, until her sister was murdered. When her husband and best friend helped the killer escape justice, she was forced to grow up overnight.
69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.title: Your Love Broke My Heart

69fbee1b5eaaefa5610e5f19.synopsis: Thrust into the body of a novel's villainess, Gemma Sinclair knows her scripted fate is grim. Initially, she vows to keep a low profile to survive. But when the cheating sc*mbag and his fake sweetheart dare to cross her line? Sorry, not this time. Now, she's fighting back. She will keep her husband, smash their lies, and destroy their plots.
69fbee1b5eaaefa5610e5f19.title: 70s Reborn: The Villainess Strikes Back

69fbf3647af8964bc00a85cf.synopsis: Dossey Hope, intellectually disabled since childhood, was deceived by her parents into taking the fall for her sister and went to prison, where she secretly learned martial arts. Upon her release, her parents attempted to commit her to a mental hospital. At that moment, Nathan Gannon, heir to the wealthiest family in the Capital, suddenly proposes marriage.
69fbf3647af8964bc00a85cf.title: Fool Me Once

69fc32ee5ba48485ef0d2898.synopsis: After three years of wrongful imprisonment, Claire Hayes emerges from the Eternal Penitentiary as the Fury of the Midnight Ward. On the day of her release, she pins the cold, untouchable Warden — Vincent Vance — against a water cell wall and kisses him. Not out of love, but survival. He holds the key to her future. Together, the Fury and the Warden will burn every enemy who ever wronged her. And along the way, the cold man who never bends... discovers that for her, he will break all his own rules.
69fc32ee5ba48485ef0d2898.title: The Fury and the Warden

69fc3afbfdb63161f2087c2e.synopsis: In Got Dumped. Got LadyAid movie, a broke delivery guy, Gavin, is dumped by his girlfriend the day she graduates for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78K. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to mansions, a restaurant empire, and a law firm. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back. She ends up in jail. Gavin walks away with Paige's heart, a fortune, and no regrets.
69fc3afbfdb63161f2087c2e.title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.

69fc66ba27c436701c0aa300.synopsis: The true heiress, Stella, was unloved. On her deathbed, her parents celebrated the fake daughter's birthday. Only her aunt and uncle said goodbye. Reborn, she chooses them. They worry they're powerless, but she'll reclaim everything her father, Edward, stole. At the family party, she challenges him: whoever secures the order becomes head. The loser is erased. He takes the bet. The contract? It goes to her uncle.
69fc66ba27c436701c0aa300.title: True Heiress: Trading Up My Family

69fc82d7d30acc2a0b072463.synopsis: Seattle's relentless rain brings a chilling nightmare to Marilyn's doorstep: her husband's secret mistress has been brutally murdered. Overnight, the illusion of her perfect marriage completely shatters. Four months pregnant and seemingly blindsided, Marilyn is thrust into a terrifying police investigation where her husband, David, is named the prime suspect. Yet, as Detective Sarah Green digs deeper into the dual tragedies, eerie inconsistencies begin to surface—most notably, a ghostly figure caught on a neighbor's security camera in the dead of night. Everyone has a deadly motive, and no one is truly innocent. Trapped in a twisted game of cat and mouse, how far will a desperate widow go to survive? In a city where the truth is obscured by deception, the most chilling question remains: who is the real puppet master orchestrating this bloodbath?
69fc82d7d30acc2a0b072463.title: My Husband's Mistress is Dead

69fc8a25105a230d0c0da6bd.synopsis: Penny Stirling transmigrates into a romance novel as the loyal sidekick and lackey to the villainess Evelyn Sterling. In the original plot, Evelyn meets a ruinous end after crossing the lead couple—and Penny is dragged down to the same tragic fate right alongside her. Now, the Overseer tasks Penny with fixing Evelyn's foolish obsession with love. She helps Evelyn expose the scumbag. While completing her mission, she sticks close to Miss Sterling, achieving both career success and massive wealth!
69fc8a25105a230d0c0da6bd.title: Saving My Villainess Boss

69fc8a93a90184a23e042ccd.synopsis: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.
69fc8a93a90184a23e042ccd.title: The Husband Delivered by Fate

69fc8ab8802fea273d001ccb.synopsis: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.
69fc8ab8802fea273d001ccb.title: The Husband Delivered by Fate

69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.synopsis: In My Boss Loves Me Too Much movie, Ella planned to challenge herself by taking a new job after years of managing crises, but her world is turned upside down when her new boss, Christian, drags her in a fake marriage! What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes something far more intense. Every touch, every kiss, draws Ella deeper into his world. But what she doesn’t know is that Christian has been playing a dangerous game all along, determined to make her his forever.
69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.title: My Boss Loves Me Too Much

69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.synopsis: Our iconic enemies-to-lovers is back and better than ever! Go behind the scenes of Taming My Bullies 2 and discover how Meg's signature look comes together. Cam also gives the inside scoop on filming some of the shirtless swimming scenes, while the director breaks down the inspiration behind key shots and what it really takes to bring this story to life.
69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.title: ReelTalk EP 76-Backstage: Taming My Bullies 2

69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.synopsis: Four breakout stars from ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series come together for an intimate Pride Month special short video, sharing their most genuine crush confessions through cinematic monologues inspired by real emotions, memories, and love stories. Set against dreamy summer nights, camcorder footage, and coastlines, Crush Confessions captures the quiet ache of longing, youth, and the moment every love song finally starts to make sense.
69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.title: ReelTalk EP 77-Love Whisper

69fd0e2ced0c035c1a0f2e52.synopsis: Spend a day shopping with Cam! Follow along as he searches for Hironos at Pop Mart, shows off his nerdy side, and opens about his journey from modeling to acting. This is a side of Cam you won't want to miss!
69fd0e2ced0c035c1a0f2e52.title: ReelTalk EP 78-Day in the Life of Cam: Pop Mart & Untold Stories

69fd0e6cfa888249920d5ef5.synopsis: BroTalk is BACK! The Big Four from Taming My Bullies are taking over the pool. Cam Porras is hosting a pool party with friends (Travis Owens and Grant Garcia) when a mysterious lifeguard (Luke Dodge) crashes the fun and starts enforcing strange beach rules. Plus, stick around as the cast answers the burning questions fans have been buzzing about.
69fd0e6cfa888249920d5ef5.title: ReelTalk EP 80-BroTalk: Pool Party

69fd7b4738f9bd5d450845a6.synopsis: Cora Montgomery, heiress of a mystic arts family, dies in the modern world — and wakes up in ancient Valoria as Valerie Blackwood, the unwanted daughter of a powerful merchant clan. On her first day in this new life, her own father buries her alive as a sacrifice to secure the family's fortune. But lightning strikes the grave. She claws her way out. Armed with the Five Mystic Arts, Valerie dismantles her enemies one by one. And to survive the political storm, she makes a deal: a six-month marriage of convenience with the cold, guarded Crown Prince Callum. But what begins as a contract becomes something neither expected...
69fd7b4738f9bd5d450845a6.title: The Mystic Healer Who Rules the Realm

69fd7b4838f9bd5d450845a9.synopsis: Abigail married honest Timothy in her past life, toiling hard as he rose to Culture Bureau Director. Her cousin Vanessa wed wealthy Harrison Lockwood, yet fell into poverty after the family went bankrupt and killed Abigail out of spite. Reborn, Abigail finds Vanessa has taken her original match. She chooses to marry Harrison instead. The two start a marriage of convenience, which later turns into love, and Abigail helps revive the declining Lockwood family.
69fd7b4838f9bd5d450845a9.title: Reborn Swap Bride in the 70s

69fda53b9e256a13e106cd46.synopsis: Lane Stone, CEO of Stone Enterprises, thought he had it all: a devoted wife, a loving daughter, and a warm home. He supported his wife's career while raising little Mia himself. Even without her mother around, he never stopped adoring his sweet Mia. But when Mia becomes gravely ill, her mother walks away, not to her daughter's bedside, but to care for her ex-boyfriend's son. That betrayal ignites a fury in Lane. He will make everyone pay.
69fda53b9e256a13e106cd46.title: Forgotten Daughter

69fda53c9e256a13e106cd49.synopsis: A thousand years ago, Celeste Monroe sealed a world-destroying demon, tasking her servant Enoch Seaton to guard it forever. Seeking her lost memories, she returns to the Seaton family at Ophelia's request. Though treated with polite hospitality as the Progenitor's descendant, she is clearly unwelcome...
69fda53c9e256a13e106cd49.title: The Last Demon Slayers

69fda53d9e256a13e106cd4c.synopsis: Carly Tubert dropped out of high school to support her boyfriend, Jacob Celis, and spent seven years building the Rosewood Group into a global empire while secretly funding his education and career. Returning to propose, she finds Jacob dumping her publicly for another. After meeting Wendel Group CEO Clement, Carly reveals her billionaire status, ready to watch Jacob regret his decision.
69fda53d9e256a13e106cd4c.title: The True Queen Returns

69fda62bf596069ae30b9691.synopsis: Twenty years ago, a car crash tore Sebastian away from his parents. He was adopted by the CEO of the Carrington Group. Twenty years later, he returns. Not as the lost child they remember, but as the most powerful man in the room. All he has to prove who he really is — is a pendant, broken in half twenty years ago. One piece with him. One piece with the mother who never stopped waiting. When the two halves finally meet, the truth comes crashing down. The boy they thought was gone forever has come home — not just to reunite, but to protect. And this time, nothing will tear them apart again.
69fda62bf596069ae30b9691.title: The Lost Son Comes Home

69fda62df596069ae30b9694.synopsis: When security guard Ethan Mercer saves a drugged heiress, Elena Hawthorne, she marries him. But the Hawthorne family sees him as nothing but a kept man who married up for money. Ethan doesn't fight back, but as crisis after crisis strikes the Hawthorne family, Ethan begins to unlock abilities he never knew he had. And somewhere along the way, the woman who married him out of gratitude falls for him for real.
69fda62df596069ae30b9694.title: The Unwilling Heir to an Immortal

69fda62ef596069ae30b969a.synopsis: Taught to protect herself, Kiera Thorne disguises as a man. By chance, she has a one-night stand with Vance Group's Boss, Rhys Vance, and gives birth to Mila Thorne. Six years later, Kiera joins Vance Group as Rhys's male secretary. The Vance family discovers Mila but fails to track them down due to Kiera's disguise. After hilarious misunderstandings, Rhys and Kiera reunite and live happily ever after.
69fda62ef596069ae30b969a.title: Mr. Secretary, Mrs. Vance

69fda62ff596069ae30b969d.synopsis: Ethan, the Supreme War God, hides his true power to help his wife, Evelyn, rise. But on the day she's crowned War God, she divorces him and mocks him at every turn. Vowing to reclaim every ounce of power he bestowed upon her, Ethan makes a startling discovery: the girl who once saved his life was never Evelyn, but Aria. Now, he is determined to elevate Aria to the pinnacle of glory, leaving Evelyn with nothing but regret.
69fda62ff596069ae30b969d.title: Supreme War God Strikes Back

69fda631f596069ae30b96a0.synopsis: In Kingsford, Sydney Gage is the revered business Queen, while Ruben Cloud is a scruffy security guard. Ruben's son, Oliver, and his wife secure a rare chance to meet Sydney at a party, only to bump into Ruben on duty. To their horror, Ruben publicly declares his intention to court Sydney. But as Oliver freezes in embarrassment, Sydney steps up, links arms with Ruben, and stands proudly by his side.
69fda631f596069ae30b96a0.title: My Security Guard Dad Dates a Queen!

69fdbda2dc0ca9e97a077ead.synopsis: Betrayed by the Emperor, Leon Thorne, the Prince Regent of the Solarian Empire, reincarnates as a timid high schooler. Shedding his cowardly shell, he crushes the bully Chad Keller and meets Elise Mercer, a classmate identical to his past-life fiancee. After destroying her cursed necklace to dispel its dark magic, he settles the debts of his gambling brother, Jared Thorne. When the Sanctum, including Dexter Cross, targets the Mercer fortune, Leon unleashes his Prime Grandmaster powers. He obliterates their assassins, dismantles the syndicate, and wins the loyalty of Riverton's wealthiest man, Edward Langdon, ultimately redeeming his past regrets.
69fdbda2dc0ca9e97a077ead.title: From Throne to Classroom: The Warlord Reborn

69fecf5b20ab8d80080befaf.synopsis: Mafia Camorra family boss Michael is assassinated, forcing his 20-year-old only daughter, Gloria, to take over the family business. While dealing with internal and external threats to the clan, she falls in love with Theo, her late father's close friend and a 34-year-old former FBI agent turned bodyguard. After spotting her own photo inside Theo's pendant, she becomes convinced that he loves her back—only to later discover that the photo is actually of her mother. As their romance intensifies, Theo's past as an FBI agent leads Gloria to suspect he may have been involved in her father's murder, plunging their relationship into crisis.
69fecf5b20ab8d80080befaf.title: Mafia Heiress’s Forbidden Obssession

69fefeb3b4d30b630703f079.synopsis: Retired Warrior King Jayson Hinds mistakenly ends up on a blind date with Tamara Britton, a CEO avoiding a forced marriage. After an unexpected night together, Tamara proposes a contract marriage to evade marrying Abe Krause. But there's always more trouble coming their way...
69fefeb3b4d30b630703f079.title: Ex-Warrior King & His Heiress

6a013787ef6f60bc790f8dea.synopsis: Savannah Sterling, the sole heiress of the realm's wealthiest family, suffers a brutal betrayal in her past life. Her fiancé Carter Grayson and his adopted sister Lily seize her family's fortune, torture her parents to death, and bury her alive. Reborn on her 20th birthday—the day she was fated to draw Carter's name in a marriage lottery—she smashes the lottery box and auctions her hand in marriage instead. Mysterious Eastern trade magnate Felix Harrison, who has secretly loved Savannah for 12 years since she helped him as a homeless orphan, bids an unprecedented 1.99 billion gold to win her. Humiliated Carter and Lily kidnap and torture Savannah to force her into marriage. At the engagement banquet, Felix exposes their crimes, ruining the Graysons. Carter is sentenced to lifelong imprisonment in the frozen Ice Cells, while Savannah marries Felix, finally escaping her tragic past and finding true happiness.
6a013787ef6f60bc790f8dea.title: Crown of Thorns and Roses

6a01392b10aef811d40edc80.synopsis: Beatrice Ashcroft, daughter of a duke, was betrayed by her husband Jasper — who faked his own death and left her to rot. She died with nothing but hatred in her heart. Then she opened her eyes. Back to the day before it all began. This time, she knows every lie, every scheme, every face behind the masks. And she knows exactly how to destroy them all. But revenge is a lonely road — until she meets Nicholas, a mysterious commander with secrets of his own. He is not what he seems. He is the emperor, traveling in disguise. And he is about to become her most powerful weapon...
6a01392b10aef811d40edc80.title: The Duke's Daughter Strikes Back

6a0165d3d296326d110c1224.synopsis: Maya Hayes is a straight-A student with one goal: study hard, escape her violent father, and never look back. But when she stumbles into a tattoo parlor — fleeing a beating — she comes face-to-face with Oakridge High's resident rebel, Jude Sinclair. Soon, the well-behaved scholar and the rich kid with a broken past are thrown together as desk mates. Late nights turn into shared secrets. Insults give way to understanding. Bit by bit, they begin to see through each other's armor — and find something real underneath. Together, they make a pact: break free, fight back, and burn down everything that tries to keep them down.
6a0165d3d296326d110c1224.title: The Rebel and the Scholar

6a016b9302e127d1610ca819.synopsis: After witnessing Reginald murder his wife, Lottie feigned muteness to survive. Years later, she fell for her rescuer Julian, but they were separated by her mother. When her family fell, Lottie sought Julian, only to have her identity stolen by Natalie. To escape Reginald, she married Julian. Pregnant and mistrusted, she fled, later returning disguised as a kidnapper. Their conflict ultimately exposed the truth, allowing them to take down Reginald together.
6a016b9302e127d1610ca819.title: The Mute Bride's Revenge

6a017e1b1c1dd49c430ae6b6.synopsis: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. Emma killed a mafia prince to save her best friend, and now the city wants her dead. There’s only one place left to turn: Carter Reed - the most feared man in the city and the man her dying brother trusted with her life. Carter promised to protect her from monsters, even from himself. But the more time she spends under his protection, the more Emma realizes she’s falling for a monster. And the more Carter wants the one woman he swore to never touch. Will they give in, or will their enemies catch them first?
6a017e1b1c1dd49c430ae6b6.title: Carter Reed

6a0188ad9ed9b087a70f47ba.synopsis: Timothy, exiled prince and secret heir to the deadly Reaper legacy, now lives as a street beggar after his throne is stolen by his treacherous brother. When Winnie, a daring noble heiress, publicly proposes and elopes with him, she thinks she's saving a pauper, but Timothy has secretly mastered unmatched martial arts and lethal poisons. As the empire reels and assassins close in, he waits for the perfect moment to reclaim his throne and rule with unstoppable power.
6a0188ad9ed9b087a70f47ba.title: Don't Mess with That Beggar S2

6a01896f2a7c88e6fa0ae09c.synopsis: Timothy, exiled prince and secret heir to the deadly Reaper legacy, now lives as a street beggar after his throne is stolen by his treacherous brother. When Winnie, a daring noble heiress, publicly proposes and elopes with him, she thinks she's saving a pauper, but Timothy has secretly mastered unmatched martial arts and lethal poisons. As the empire reels and assassins close in, he waits for the perfect moment to reclaim his throne and rule with unstoppable power.
6a01896f2a7c88e6fa0ae09c.title: Don't Mess with That Beggar S2

6a019d79a24318e13e0c5201.synopsis: Battle queen Chloe died saving trafficked Nora, then woke up in her body. Nora was exiled and sold by her own father to the Naka Valley, just so her stepsister could steal her fiancé. Now, Chloe unleashes hell, ruthlessly reclaiming everything stolen from Nora!
6a019d79a24318e13e0c5201.title: Reborn Heiress: Total Takeover

6a019e7d82816f7b63008443.synopsis: Reincarnated as the Bingley family's abandoned wife, Cordelia is betrayed, slaved for them, then cast out. When her ex returns to steal her fortune after faking his death, she divorces, takes her inheritance, and vanishes. At a royal banquet, the Bingleys realize: the kingdom's most powerful Regent is Cordelia's new man, who truly loves her and has the power to back it up.
6a019e7d82816f7b63008443.title: Divorce the Fake, Marry the Throne

6a019e7e82816f7b63008445.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Paul Hayes gave up his sister to someone else to save her life. Later, he lies in a coma, guarded by his loyal fiancée. But when he wakes up, his fate is about to change. His sister, now a powerful business tycoon, has finally found him. She's ready to turn the world upside down for her brother.
6a019e7e82816f7b63008445.title: Ascension of the Exiled

6a019e7f82816f7b63008447.synopsis: Born poor, Sansa Miller tends to her sick mother and disabled father. As a living lucky charm, she brings bullies karmic payback and rewards kindness, inspiring good. She forgives cruel neighbors, making them repent. She befriends a vendor who once stole her stall. Then a crisis hits. And her estranged grandpa finally sees her pure heart. Filled with regret, he makes amends and reunites the family.
6a019e7f82816f7b63008447.title: The Lucky Koi Girl

6a019e8082816f7b63008449.synopsis: Warlord Leah Irwin runs a car wash incognito. She clashes with Wyatt Fraser, whose underling is her son-in-law. Ordered to bully Leah and her daughter, they push Leah too far. She unleashes her wrath to defend her family and cleanse the whole city!
6a019e8082816f7b63008449.title: Furious Warlord Mom

6a019e8182816f7b6300844b.synopsis: Forced to take her stepsister's place and marry Tristan Lynn, the notoriously cruel and supposedly impotent Mr. Lynn, Maya Harper flees her wedding—only to accidentally jump right into Tristan's car. Unaware he is the very groom she is running from, she begs him for help. The aloof Tristan plays along and takes her home. A year later, Tristan looks at an exhausted Maya in bed and smirks, "Still think I am impotent?"
6a019e8182816f7b6300844b.title: Runaway Bride Fell For Him

6a019e8282816f7b6300844d.synopsis: 18 years ago, the Knox matriarch drained Isabella Knox's Rh-negative blood to save Theodore Knox and abandoned her. Kenneth Hayes, a man with the same rare blood type, saved and raised her as Bella Hayes. 18 years later, Bella starts working at Knox Group...
6a019e8282816f7b6300844d.title: Distant Blood Love

6a019f1d30eabd647906e6ab.synopsis: The whole Faxon Village is waiting for the National Exams' results at the ancestral hall. But Mason and his daughter can't get in because of a baseless report. Not only do they face baseless bullying from villagers, they also receive countless slanders from their own family. However, when Janet reveals her final scores, the whole village is in shock!
6a019f1d30eabd647906e6ab.title: Top Scholar's Reckoning

6a019f1e30eabd647906e6ad.synopsis: Engaged for four years, Roberta Depp's fiancé changed girlfriends like clothes. She faked tears but secretly cheered, marrying into wealth with no wifely duties is a steal! After a wild one-night stand with a hot stranger, she thought she'd never see him again. Yet at a family dinner, the man sat at the head of the table. Guess who just slept with her fiancé's uncle?
6a019f1e30eabd647906e6ad.title: Addicted to My Fiancé's Uncle

6a019f1f30eabd647906e6af.synopsis: Marcus Hale gifts his girlfriend his prized patent, securing her an award from the Zenith Group. But at the ceremony, she turns on him and orders his legs broken to impress a richer man. As the beatdown starts, Zenith's CEO freezes. She recognizes the bloodied young man. He's her son, who lost years ago. Now, hell will break loose.
6a019f1f30eabd647906e6af.title: Return of the Heir

6a019f2030eabd647906e6b1.synopsis: Dylan Wilson time-travels to Valoria, becoming the goofy Marquess of the Wilson family. He wants a lazy life but finds himself engaged to Princess Valerie! To stay carefree, he tries everything to annul the marriage. However, he accidentally turns into the pillar of the state and the God of War! With titles piling up, Dylan is in despair. Why is annuling this marriage so hard?!
6a019f2030eabd647906e6b1.title: The Unwanted Goofy Son-in-Law

6a019f2030eabd647906e6b3.synopsis: Over a century ago, Celeste Monroe sealed her memories in Empyrean Estate, guarded by her servant Joan Karlin and pet dog Alex. Time passed, and the Karlin family became the wealthiest in the south. Yet its current head, Liam, is sterile. Now, Celeste returns to retrieve her memories, only to learn Joan has passed away. Alex, revered by the Karlin family as a divine beast, is dying.
6a019f2030eabd647906e6b3.title: The Sterile Heir and the Beast

6a019f2230eabd647906e6b7.synopsis: Duke Snook gives his all to Chloe Fletcher. But on New Year's Eve, she humiliates him by bringing her first love home. She acts the loving girlfriend, devours his dinner, seizes his mansion, then steals everything! Reborn on that fateful night, Duke vows to make them pay. He reclaims everything that belongs to him and leaves Chloe's family with absolutely nothing.
6a019f2230eabd647906e6b7.title: Eve of Vengeance: Reborn to Rise

6a019f2330eabd647906e6b9.synopsis: The Young Marshal claims, 'My wife is a naive country girl, do not bully her!' The socialites she upstaged cry, 'Who is bullying who?' He adds, 'My wife is gentle and knows nothing about medicine or guns!' Her cured patients and dead enemies scream, 'Are you blind, Young Marshal?' 'My wife is perfectly obedient, my word is law!' he boasts heroically—while kneeling on a washboard. The adjutants of the Warlord mansion sigh, 'Please keep some dignity, Young Marshal!'
6a019f2330eabd647906e6b9.title: My Wife Ran Away Again

6a019f2430eabd647906e6bb.synopsis: After Helly Riggs gave Ethan Wright her savings 3 years ago, he has returned in glory as the CEO of Apex Group. Hoping to share his wealth with her, he is met with the Riggs family's scorn and their plan to remarry her off. The tables turn instantly when Ethan reveals his identity as a big shot, leaving the family to face the crushing weight of their regret.
6a019f2430eabd647906e6bb.title: From Mocked to Millions

6a019f2430eabd647906e6bd.synopsis: On the train home, Oliver Chase watches as Sharon Kingsley ruins his wife and son's only meal, then demands money. Battling severe combat-related PTSD, Oliver tries to keep the peace. But when Sharon threatens to smash a bottle over his wife, his repressed trauma explodes in a blood-red rage...
6a019f2430eabd647906e6bd.title: When the Reckoning Takes the Train

6a019f4a7af4c87e2302da84.synopsis: After June and her parents die in a freak accident, she finally sees her family's true colors. Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.
6a019f4a7af4c87e2302da84.title: Queen of Letting Go

6a01ab308d0d811f4e0eeac5.synopsis: I'm Luke, dropped into a wraith apocalypse. While others cower, I see only irresistible succubi. I steal a kiss from the Scarlet Bride, turn Wraith Queen Carmine into my pampered loli, and seduce the Gloom Weaver Empress into my wife. Scarlet & Ivory Twin Wraiths, the Gloom Lion Sovereign, even SSS-level wraiths, all fall to me. Apocalypse? Wraiths? I am the true chaos, the ultimate threat.
6a01ab308d0d811f4e0eeac5.title: My Demon Harem Runs This Endgame

6a028e182a7c88e6fa0ae0eb.synopsis: Humanity shrinks to mere centimeters, turning the world into a deadly jungle. University student Mark awakens the Infinite Evolution System, gaining power by consuming biomass and rival abilities. Alongside the brilliant yet guarded Winter, he faces mutated beasts, treacherous awakened foes, and a sinister cult. As the secret of the Xeno-Core unfolds, Mark must gather the scattered cores to save humanity and survive.
6a028e182a7c88e6fa0ae0eb.title: The Shrinkocalypse

6a02bf5a631c8645a00bc6c9.synopsis: Sofía is short on money and desperate to pay her mother's expensive medical bills. Her relatives agree to help her on the condition that she marries the billionaire Samuel, who is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it won't be long before the infamous Samuel wakes up from his coma and discovers he's engaged to a complete stranger.
6a02bf5a631c8645a00bc6c9.title: Wake Up, My Billionaire Husband

6a02ed06ab20a7f49c084c9f.synopsis: Trapped in an arranged marriage with Luca, the cold and dangerously seductive heir to the New York mafia, Aria, the innocent little princess of the Chicago mafia, must decide whether giving her body—and perhaps her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance of survival.
6a02ed06ab20a7f49c084c9f.title: Bound by Honor

6a030bfee910f8b87a032fa6.synopsis: Engaged for three years, I once believed Lorenzo—the man who took a bullet for me—was my salvation. Until that night, after toying with me in the car, he tossed me like trash onto rival gang territory. The three years of devotion were all an act. To protect his so-called ""sister-in-law"" Sophia, he stole my pregnancy medication, letting me hit the table and miscarry. To vent for Sophia, he locked me in a water tank at an underground club and let everyone bid: ""The Saint of House Valenti, starting at one dollar."" My heart died. I shattered the glass, grabbed his archrival Antonio's hand, soaked in blood: ""Take me away. I'll help you kill him."" When I returned, a black datura was tattooed on my lower back. Lorenzo knelt and begged me to come home. I drew my blade and slit his flesh: ""This cut is for the child you killed.""
6a030bfee910f8b87a032fa6.title: Sacrificial Saint

6a040f9bc605bc3d130a7c1d.synopsis: Emily Douglas is a cultivation prodigy. At eight, she became a disciple of the Celestial Seer and trained at the Heavenly Sect. In just 81 days, she became invincible. But her master reveals a shocking truth: one day in the sect equals a year in the mortal world. Though she looks eight, Emily is actually 88! Returning home, she finds her cousin is now an old man, and her friends have aged. Their reunion sparks an incredible journey.
6a040f9bc605bc3d130a7c1d.title: Bow Down, My Great-Aunt Is Back!

6a040f9cc605bc3d130a7c1f.synopsis: Starving beggar Zoey eats the Crown Princess' funeral offerings and gets caught by the ruthless Crown Prince! Luckily, she can understand plants, and they tell her how to save the princess. Now she's the Crown Prince's whole world!
6a040f9cc605bc3d130a7c1f.title: That Beggar's Dad Is the Crown Prince!

6a040f9dc605bc3d130a7c21.synopsis: After transmigrating into a famine-stricken world, an agronomist takes over the body of Jena, a woman despised for nearly selling her niece. Determined to rewrite her fate, Jena leverages her modern expertise to cultivate sweet potatoes, dumps her toxic partner, and lifts her family out of poverty. Her farming revolution ends the famine. She becomes the Harvest Deity!
6a040f9dc605bc3d130a7c21.title: From Wicked Aunt to Famine Savior

6a040f9ec605bc3d130a7c23.synopsis: Billionaire Blake Thorne returns on Chinese New Year's Eve to surprise his wife, only to find her pregnant. He reveals his true wealth, leaving her family in regret as he cuts all ties.
6a040f9ec605bc3d130a7c23.title: Billionaire's Return

6a040f9fc605bc3d130a7c25.synopsis: Labeled a tea boy, apprentice Jed Simon is kicked to the curb by his wife. Little do they know, he suddenly gains X-ray eyes! Determined to play no more nice, Jed starts gambling stone and cutting more and more imperial green! Look who's rising to the top now?
6a040f9fc605bc3d130a7c25.title: Careful, He's Got X-Ray Eyes!

6a040f9fc605bc3d130a7c27.synopsis: In Ian's last life, Kyle used his inner voices to manipulate his family and ultimately kill him. Reborn, Ian is abandoning his toxic family for revenge! Hearing Kyle's manipulative voice, Ian laughs. No one can hurt him this time!
6a040f9fc605bc3d130a7c27.title: I'm Done Hearing Your Voice

6a040fa0c605bc3d130a7c29.synopsis: Born poor, Lily Vance studies relentlessly. Trusting her father that education is the best escape, she aces her exams and earns everyone's respect.
6a040fa0c605bc3d130a7c29.title: From Rags to Top Scholar

6a0424e5cacb6cc3f60176d5.synopsis: Helen, Chairwoman of Radiance Corp, is mocked for her plain look at her father's birthday party. But she once dropped out to work and supported her siblings. Then her three prominent kids arrive to defend her. Later, her son's fiancée Kelly bullies her on a flight. Helen exposes Kelly at a meeting, punishing the wicked and rewarding the kind flight attendant Emma, bringing peace to her family.
6a0424e5cacb6cc3f60176d5.title: Hidden Billionaire Mom's Elite Kids

6a0531be0131488d3c02ae9c.synopsis: Veteran Robin Spacey returns to his village with newfound powers. From a magic cream that hooks a female CEO to mystic eyes that make a widow's son call him Dad, his rise is unstoppable. Join this country boy as he crushes bullies, builds a business empire, and wins the hearts of beauties!
6a0531be0131488d3c02ae9c.title: The Soldier's Divine Legacy

6a0531bf0131488d3c02ae9e.synopsis: Down on his luck, Caleb McGovern awakens the "Make-It-Real" System, where any fake becomes reality! When a scam text from a stock genius's "illegitimate son" pops up, Caleb plays along and receives $10 billion! He even buys a supreme combat skill for just $9.99, gaining the strength to fight 10 men at once! Now, reality bends to his will. His word is law! He can turn any fake into reality!
6a0531bf0131488d3c02ae9e.title: Real or Fake? I Decide

6a0531c00131488d3c02aea0.synopsis: Gavin Wright spent three years funding his girlfriend Mandy Parker. On their wedding day, Mandy, now at the elite Sewell Group, tests him by demanding a massive bride price and publicly insulting him. Fed up, Gavin Wright cancels the wedding. Little does she know, he is the Sewell Group CEO's long-lost child. The next day, Mandy is shocked to find he is now the Sewell Group's Mr. Wright, her direct boss.
6a0531c00131488d3c02aea0.title: My Ex Is My Boss

6a0531c10131488d3c02aea4.synopsis: Branded a gold digger, Audrey Aris flees Norwick. Two years later, she returns pregnant, backed by her elite scientist husband. With his support, she exposes lies, clears her name, and uncovers her true identity. She founds Nova Capital to empower female entrepreneurs, transforming from an outcast into an admired leader.
6a0531c10131488d3c02aea4.title: Shattered & Reborn, Your Turn to Fall

6a05405e58a1ffb47e005e00.synopsis: Silas Hayes died betrayed. Then he woke up — back on the eve of an Anomaly Tide. This time, he has one goal: protect his little brother Cody, and stay far away from the people who sold him out. Then he finds a stray dog in an alley. Scrawny. Pitiful. Begging for scraps. He names it Grim. Except Grim isn't a dog. He's an S-Rank Anomaly — the Shadow Wolf — capable of tearing through reality with a single howl. And Silas accidentally binds him with a power he didn't know he had: the Absolute Contract. Now he can tame any Anomaly. And here's the thing — his "weak" little brother Cody is not what he seems to be either...
6a05405e58a1ffb47e005e00.title: My Pet Is an S-Rank Nightmare

6a05db5311d6e19d88047587.synopsis: On her anniversary with her fiancé, Jay Neale, co-pilot Joyce Blair accidentally sleeps with Elliot Neale. Wracked with guilt, she tries to distance herself, unaware that Jay is cheating with her stepsister, Abigail! On their wedding day, Jay dumps Joyce for Abigail, turning her into a laughingstock. Devastated, Joyce is stunned when Elliot steps forward to propose.
6a05db5311d6e19d88047587.title: Captain, Mayday for Love

6a05db5411d6e19d88047589.synopsis: Modern office worker Finn Morgan accidentally transmigrates into the body of the Stanley family's deadbeat son-in-law, who was an abusive gambler plotting to steal the family's fortune. Now, with a math Ph.D. and expertise in medicine, Finn reforms to protect his wife, Elena. But it looks like this is a lot of work.
6a05db5411d6e19d88047589.title: The Househusband's Hustle

6a06477801cfe98f60076ded.synopsis: Based on the novel by L. Steele. After her fiancé cheats on her, Vivian flash marries a hot silver fox… only to realize he’s her ex’s dad. The deal is simple: two weeks of marriage, a CEO title for Quentin and enough money for Vivian to save her sick dad. But as her ex keeps humiliating her and his dad keeps saving her, Vivian's fake marriages starts to cross very real lines.
6a06477801cfe98f60076ded.title: The Imperfect Marriage

6a0671cb10666b879b076b3a.synopsis: In Stableboy movie, openly gay city kid Evan Brooks is sent to a Midwest ranch with one condition: compete on the high school rodeo team or lose his dream of culinary school in Paris.
6a0671cb10666b879b076b3a.title: Stableboy

6a068936bc8399208400d1a2.synopsis: Betrayed and cast out by his scheming cousin George, culinary prodigy Ryan starts from scratch with just $30,000 and a dream. Across from his nemesis, he turns his tiny restaurant into a powerhouse, dazzling the city with his unmatched skills. With the loyal Nina by his side and powerful allies backing him, Ryan rises from underdog to culinary titan, while George's treachery boomerangs, leaving him ruined and humiliated.
6a068936bc8399208400d1a2.title: Dish Slap: Revenge Served Hot

6a06bab46594b8844c073b9e.synopsis: Jackson and Elena endured poverty and scorn to care for their ailing father. Hoping for a better future, Jackson enlisted in the army. For a decade, Elena stayed behind to raise their three kids and care for the old man. Now, Jackson returns as the Grand Marshal of Northgard, reuniting with his family to finally give them the happy life they deserve.
6a06bab46594b8844c073b9e.title: Back with Glory, No More Laughs

6a06bab56594b8844c073ba2.synopsis: Kate Zimmer returns home to find her dad swindled into crushing gambling debt. Scammers bully him, scheming to take their house. Breaking a promise to her late mom, Kate takes the poker table, using sleight of hand to crush the cheats. After winning, she uncovers the dark truth behind her mother's death and sets out for revenge.
6a06bab56594b8844c073ba2.title: Vow Broken, Debt Paid

6a06bab66594b8844c073ba4.synopsis: Lost 20 years ago, Ragnar Hayes is adopted by Emperor Dennings of Aldoria. Returning as the Duke of Southmarch, he seeks his birth parents but faces mockery from his fiancée, Natalie, and greedy relatives. However, when his true imperial identity is exposed, they are left in shock.
6a06bab66594b8844c073ba4.title: The Beggar's Duke

6a06bab76594b8844c073ba6.synopsis: Frank and his wife spent 20 grueling years searching for their lost daughter. They are finally vindicated when she returns home as a successful CEO. But as they reunite, trouble comes knocking on their door.
6a06bab76594b8844c073ba6.title: When Life Gives You Bitterness

6a06bb6351a5d1e3b304e6a5.synopsis: Lydia dies and finds out she's the tragic ex in some trashy novel—ran off pregnant, died young, and her kids? Just there to make the heroine's perfect kids look good. Her son Cole ends up a thug in prison. Her daughter wrecks her hand going for first violin, loses it, gets dumped. Meanwhile the heroine steals her man and lives happily ever after. Lydia's pissed. Then she wakes up—18 again, but Cole's 17. Fine. She's gonna fix this. Game on.
6a06bb6351a5d1e3b304e6a5.title: Reborn as My Kids's Saviour

6a06bb6451a5d1e3b304e6a7.synopsis: 14 years ago, favoring her grandson Tristan, Dowager Venere drains Elora's frostblood to save him and casts the girl out. Rescued by farmer Thomas Finch, she's raised as Elora Finch. Now, she returns to Venere Manor as a maid. Her mother, Lady Venere, desperately searches for her lost daughter, unaware that the maid she scolds and humiliates is her precious daughter!
6a06bb6451a5d1e3b304e6a7.title: Blood and the Veil: The Maid Returns

6a06bb6551a5d1e3b304e6a9.synopsis: On her deathbed, Empress Rosa clings to life over an unfulfilled wish, while her three sons ruthlessly vie for the throne. Meanwhile, Celeste arrives to help the Empress. Dismissed by the skeptical princes, Celeste enters the palace, where the dying Empress miraculously revives, kneels, and addresses her as her lady...
6a06bb6551a5d1e3b304e6a9.title: The Empress's Final Wish

6a06bb6651a5d1e3b304e6ab.synopsis: Eighth-gen Donovan cook Ethan spent a decade turning Crest into a top restaurant, only to be paid just $3,000 a month. Right before New Year's Eve, his friends Olivia Monroe and Avery Kane fired him, manipulated by apprentice Wyatt Blake. Wyatt thought he could easily replace Ethan, but the guests hated his food and demanded refunds. Facing total ruin, Olivia and Avery begged Ethan to return. But Ethan had finally seen their true colors.
6a06bb6651a5d1e3b304e6ab.title: Betrayal Served Hot

6a06c76b9171ea7a5d0bc052.synopsis: After saving Zach's life, Malese Accola marries him, only to suffer four years of neglect. Zach's heart belongs to his childhood sweetheart, Kayla, who torments Malese with impunity. Kayla steals her work, then causes her miscarriage, and Zach enables it all. Devastated, Malese divorces him and flees abroad to chase her art dreams. Her absence finally opens Zach's eyes to his true love and Kayla's venom. He chases her across the globe, but she won't look back. Meanwhile, powerful CEO Joseph Cohan, Malese's secret admirer, gives her the love she deserves...
6a06c76b9171ea7a5d0bc052.title: Never Look Back

6a0808d427a430a82600d199.synopsis: Christine catches her fiancé Jack cheating with his childhood sweetheart. In her past life, she revealed the other woman’s HIV diagnosis—so Jack livestreamed her rape and torture, then had her murdered. Now fate gives her a second chance. Standing outside that same door, listening to the filthy sounds inside, she tears up the report and walks away. This time, she won’t save anyone......
6a0808d427a430a82600d199.title: Fatal Wedding

6a0808d627a430a82600d19d.synopsis: Ten years ago, Amelia was framed for a fire by her adoptive sister Lucy and sent to a remote island prison. Her parents, her brother, and even her fiancé Louis all helped send her away. Now she’s out. Gaunt, scarred, and broken, she returns home—only to find her family celebrating Lucy’s birthday. Lucy smiles sweetly and asks for Amelia’s fiancé as her gift. No one objects. Then a phone call comes: Professor Lucas, who once believed in her art, offers her a new life in Paris. One month. She only has to endure one more month. But will they let her go?
6a0808d627a430a82600d19d.title: Broken Strings, Unchained Melody

6a0808d927a430a82600d1a5.synopsis: Chloe thought escaping a dark wizard's obsessive cage meant a second chance at life.Instead, her newfound “family” betrayed her, kidnapping her to be sacrificed in an illegal life-draining ritual.Now, suspended over a vat of corrosive potion,with her face melting away, her only hope rests on a man whose life she once saved……
6a0808d927a430a82600d1a5.title: Reigning with the Devil

6a0808da27a430a82600d1a7.synopsis: Seven days before Awakening Day, Seraphina's mother asked her to choose a blood-bond partner from the candidates.In her previous life, she chose Kaelen, the heir of the Golden Dragon lineage. But Kaelen abandoned her for a commoner woman named Elara. Three years later, when Seraphina finally found him, he personally drove his sword through her heart.The three knights who had sworn undying love for her had been helping Kaelen cover up his betrayal all along.
