Just as all hope is lost during the sacrificial ceremony, Hades descends in overwhelming force, punishes everyone who has wronged her, and takes her back to the Underworld under his protection.
6a390a35f7ae1d26f00331c5.title: Chained by Hades, the Underworld King

6a39e60d9206d01df60805df.synopsis: Given a second chance at life, orphan sisters Ivy and Poppy return to the day of their adoption. Remembering her tragic past, Poppy maliciously chooses the impoverished Jones family, believing playing the "poor girl" is the secret to winning the wealthy Lockwood heir's heart. Forced into the toxic Lockwood household, Ivy refuses to be a victim again. While Poppy relies on deception and manipulation to steal the life she covets, Ivy focuses on true independence, standing up to her bullies, and forging her own path. Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell is a gripping tale of resilience, self-reliance, and breaking toxic cycles.
6a39e60d9206d01df60805df.title: Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell

6a39e9db461360e5580eb9c2.synopsis: Seo Hae In, MK Group heiress who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hae In hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life. However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Seo Si Eun, the daughter of the Hae In family's maid, arrives at school posing as the MK Group heiress. Si Eun quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hae In finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.
6a39e9db461360e5580eb9c2.title: Fake Queen Bee, I'm the true Heiress!

6a3a76742e8c28bfcc06a974.synopsis: When Veya and the hypocritical woman who brazenly interfered in her marriage were both poisoned, her husband and five-year-old son unhesitatingly gave the only antidote to the mistress. Reborn with the memory of her desperate and tragic death, Veya decided to sever this rotten marriage and launch a ruthless counterattack against the usurper and her betraying family.
6a3a76742e8c28bfcc06a974.title: No One Choose Me

6a3bad90b4b6b0605300f8cf.synopsis: Betrayed, drained, and slain by the Crown Princess in his past life, now, Cillian is reborn — and seizes the Crown Princess's Nether Power. Dismissed as a broken prince, he secretly wields the Omni Cauldron. Fifteen acupoints unlocked. Divine Seed condensed. His enemies fall before they understand. This life, he doesn't seek revenge — he seeks ashes. The dynasty will burn. The throne awaits. And beyond it, his true destiny.
6a3bad90b4b6b0605300f8cf.title: Reborn: I'm the Devourer

6a3d1836ade141bc9d0a7026.synopsis: Best friends Ella and Leah married the Harper brothers, firefighter Charles and doctor Noah. On their third anniversary, Charles’s first love locks Ella inside a burning room. When Ella begs Charles for help, he brushes her off to find his ex's cat. Leah rushes in to rescue Ella and calls Noah to save Ella and her baby, but is met with mockery. Heartbroken and betrayed after years of miserable marriages, the best friends decide to file for divorce from the Harper brothers together.
6a3d1836ade141bc9d0a7026.title: Brides in Smoke

6a3d730b0112aac7e20ddfff.synopsis: After Carl Oliver, The American Sniper and King of Guns, heroically dies saving a little boy named Spencer from a car explosion, his spirit is magically transferred into Spencer's 9 year old body. Now Carl, while inside the body of a 9 year old boy, must save his new family's gun range from unscrupulous relatives, evil rivals, and even deranged killers.
6a3d730b0112aac7e20ddfff.title: American Sniper: The Kid of Guns

6a3d9547091cd749a8093d65.synopsis: In Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten movie, Genius hacker Abby was the Governor's adoptive daughter, enduring years of abuse to help him seize power. Yet, right before her 18th birthday, her adoptive father sells her to a lecherous businessman for $5 million. In despair, she uses DNA matching to find her biological father—America's top tycoon, Dominic Mancini. Back in the lap of luxury, Abby not only inherits trillions but also has three elite adopted brothers, each a titan in his own right, to protect her. At her grand coming-of-age ceremony, Abby makes a magnificent return as the sole heir, publicly unmasking her adoptive family's cruelty and making those who once bullied her pay dearly. Reborn from the ashes, she will begin her brilliant life at the pinnacle of power.
6a3d9547091cd749a8093d65.title: Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten

6a3d980baaf954b86307ecc4.synopsis: In Rise of the Caged King movie, once a business elite, Silas is framed for murder by his rival Chase and his own wife Marina. Sentenced to 60 years, Silas endures brutal humiliation from prison bullies until he meets Grayson, a legendary mafia godfather in hiding. Grayson trains him in lethal combat and helps reduce his sentence in exchange for a future favor of revenge. Meanwhile, young Ella suffers Marina’s abuse while secretly discovering the truth: her mother’s affair and her father’s innocence. Three years later, Silas is released. He crashes Marina’s engagement party like a ghost from the past, ready to strike. Armed with a father’s love, he begins his war to reclaim his life and rescue his daughter from hell.
6a3d980baaf954b86307ecc4.title: Rise of the Caged King

6a3d99936928d9c1f409ed59.synopsis: After years of torment and abuse from her mafia family, Francesca Adolfi is given a second chance at life when she's sent back to age fourteen, the day she was brought back to her birth father. But this time, she's not going to make the same mistakes. This time, she chooses to ally herself with the Adolfi's disgraced eldest son, Enzo, and help him retake his place as heir. And by saving him, maybe Francesca can save herself too.
6a3d99936928d9c1f409ed59.title: Mafia Princess Returns

6a3e50f72620b17637021bb8.synopsis: Hyper-calculated top 10 tennis pro Adrian Vale believes absolute control is always possible—until he meets Luca Reyes, a wildly unpredictable rookie who plays purely on volatile instinct. Viewing Luca as an anomaly to be "solved," Adrian aggressively leverages his wealth and influence to bring the chaotic newcomer under his wing. Fiercely rebellious, Luca initially rejects him. However, mounting financial ruin and family troubles force Luca to accept the help, igniting an intense psychological tug-of-war that will push both men to their absolute breaking point.
6a3e50f72620b17637021bb8.title: Match Point

6a3f6334d0f8b4f17e00e2a2.synopsis: After his mother’s death, billionaire heir Vincent became reckless, cold, and impossible to control. But everything snaps when his father Arthur brings home a mysterious woman who looks exactly like Vincent’s late mother — and even gives her his mother’s priceless jewels. Convinced Evelyn is a manipulative gold digger, Vincent sets out to expose her. But inside an abandoned greenhouse wrapped in vines, he uncovers her darkest secret… and a dangerous attraction neither of them can resist.
6a3f6334d0f8b4f17e00e2a2.title: Tempted by My Step Son

6a4358c4abdd23a03d0d6563.synopsis: Ever since their parents married, Becca has hated her stepbrother, Samir. For two years, she's blamed him for stealing her family,
6a4358c4abdd23a03d0d6563.title: The Heat After the AC Died

6a436a53dd3183e90b0a24fd.synopsis: To win dignity for his people, commoner Clint awakens the Kung Fu Boost System —one day of training gifts him one year's power. Defying all odds, he rises from a nobody to the ultimate backbone of kung fu!
6a436a53dd3183e90b0a24fd.title: Rise of the Kung Fu King

6a43729bfd4df5cb34078482.synopsis: At Asgard Academy, underdog Elena is relentlessly bullied for her pathetically weak magic. Ice-cold, stoic Professor Cassius notic
6a43729bfd4df5cb34078482.title: The Professor’s Forbidden Dragon Prey

6a4387feb66c41e77c0b918d.synopsis: College student Luke Hayes gains a new superpower weekly. His first, a life countdown, helps him save Ashley Sinclair from suicide. Luke uses his shifting powers to crush the mastermind, winning both success and love.
6a4387feb66c41e77c0b918d.title: I Gain New Superpowers Every Week

6a438c92310497e68508c01d.synopsis: Six years ago, top lawyer Madeline met wealthy heir Nicholas at a masquerade ball and later gave birth to a clever daughter Isla. Her half-sister Vivienne stole keepsakes to pretend to be Nicholas's lover, coveting wealth and status. Later, Madeline worked at Nicholas's group and reunited with him. Romance bloomed between them amid constant workplace schemes and threats. Clues including a rare hereditary disease and identical birthmarks revealed the truth. Eventually, Vivienne's fraud was exposed. All misunderstandings were cleared up. Madeline and Nicholas chose each other, and the three lived a happy life together.
6a438c92310497e68508c01d.title: Wrong Heir, Right Her

6a447059145090621d0deffa.synopsis: Leo made Maisie the queen of Wall Street, only to be pushed off a roof by Maisie and Brad at his wedding to Maisie. When Leo opens his eyes again, he finds himself reborn in his college years. Living this life over, Leo swears to live only for himself, no more "Maisie's simp." He even finds someone new, the young heiress of the Hale family.
6a447059145090621d0deffa.title: The Simp Claps Back

6a447d9cf05c392bdd0adf8c.synopsis: I reborn the day I picked my beast mate, right after my jealous sister Lyra snatched the B-rank snake Voss I once married in my past life. She framed me to be exiled into deadly wilds, but I saved a wounded white lion no clan dared accept. Everyone mocks him rankless trash, until I bear two S-rank lion cubs. The priest uncovers his hidden S-rank blood, brands me the reborn Sacred Daughter. Lyra's fake saint dream crumbles with weak snake cubs, yet she screams I stole her glory. Who will pay for all her bloody betrayals?
6a447d9cf05c392bdd0adf8c.title: My S Rank Beast Mate

6a4491f1f5e3d358340e1e02.synopsis: Sunny star quarterback Seth hides a love-starved heart behind his perfect facade. When violent ex-linebacker "Mad Dog" Matthew transfers into his team and becomes his forced roommate, their explosive fights bleed into charged, unbearable tension. Seth falls hard, until he spots his rival Ethan's birthday carved into Matthew’s necklace, convinced he's just a stand-in...
6a4491f1f5e3d358340e1e02.title: Blitzed by My Rival's Obsession

6a44c5b20d88d645ea03d86c.synopsis: Seraphina and I both died once. In my last life, she stole my face, pretended to be the Oracle, and was exposed by the king. Then she poisoned me in the dungeon, screaming that I had stolen her fate. When we were reborn, she changed her plan. In front of the royal proclamation, she pointed at me and sent me to the palace, certain the fake Oracle would be executed. But I was never fake. I was the true Oracle, and this time, I would make the king kneel before the future she tried to steal.
6a44c5b20d88d645ea03d86c.title: The Sister Who Stole My Fate

6a44df67f4949bd09c0a007d.synopsis: After years of learning mystic arts, Killian proves his skills by saving Pete from death. To repay Grace for saving his life, he leaves the sect to protect her and uses his powers to break her deadly curse.
6a44df67f4949bd09c0a007d.title: Fate's Betrayer: Saving Grace

6a45c77e2fdd0135260e2dea.synopsis: Alex Carter is humiliated when his girlfriend Eva dumps him on a livestream for Brandon, a flashy rich boy with a Lamborghini. But at his lowest moment, a mysterious system binds itself to Leah, his sharp-tongued roommate and luxury real estate agent. Every emotional reaction she has because of Alex triggers huge rewards. With Leah by his side, Alex buys a McLaren, luxury properties, rare gems, a nightclub and casino shares. As Eva regrets leaving too soon and Brandon's fake wealth collapses, Alex rises from broke delivery driver to capital power player.
6a45c77e2fdd0135260e2dea.title: The Day You Dumped Me, I Became a Millionaire

6a45ccbcd0d3ada53d0ec66d.synopsis: On the night before her eighteenth birthday, Mara Scott is searched in public, stripped of her ID, and locked inside an abandoned gym by the boy she once loved. They think they’re silencing her—but Mara has already lived this night once before. In her previous life, she tried to stop them from attending a party, only to be framed for a horrific crime, murdered, and forced to watch her parents die in a fire. Reborn with a second chance, Mara says nothing. Instead, she secretly records everything and lets the night unfold. This time, when the sun rises, the truth will be impossible to bury—and everyone who betrayed her will face the consequences.
6a45ccbcd0d3ada53d0ec66d.title: You Never Saw Me

6a45ccbe1a807de4160b433b.synopsis: Ava Lin’s Manhattan wedding turns into a nightmare when a voice from three years in the future warns her not to marry Ryan Hall. Her groom has secretly registered a marriage with her best friend, Mia Chen, who is already pregnant with his child. In the original timeline, Ava was framed as unstable, stripped of her career and trust, and forced into psychiatric evaluation. This time, she refuses to break down for their cameras. Guided by her future self, Ava gathers marriage records, recordings, legal proof, and the hidden safeguards left by her parents. As Ryan, Mia, and the powerful Hall family try to silence her and seize control of her inheritance, Ava turns the fake wedding into a public reckoning, exposes their fraud, freezes the Hall Group’s IPO, and finally saves herself from the future that once destroyed her.
6a45ccbe1a807de4160b433b.title: Don't say I do

6a45d01328354989cc0a6e09.synopsis: Murdered by her family, billionaire Kay Fuller is reborn as a nobody actress, Karina. She once paid $30 million for a sham marriage to Wilbur. Devastated by her death, Wilbur discovers Karina's true identity and vows to win her back. As Karina, she destroys scumbags, takes down her enemies, and rises to stardom. Clearing up past misunderstandings, Wilbur and Kay finally confess their love.
6a45d01328354989cc0a6e09.title: Love Found Her After She Died

6a469b12d3f5c65f7f095b8a.synopsis: To Jason, Tessa was only a disposable practice run for the girl he actually wanted. After the blood on the sheets became a public
6a469b12d3f5c65f7f095b8a.title: You've Been Replaced, First Love

6a475fdf9f947b4b4a08677a.synopsis: Jennifer, a celebrated Best Actress, was killed in a fire at an awards ceremony in her past life — a plot masterminded by her scumbag boyfriend Aidan and her backstabbing best friend Beatrice. Reborn on the very night she was supposed to elope with Aidan, she resolutely dumps the worthless man and boldly pursues Cassian, a paranoid and domineering CEO. She gives both the sanctimonious hypocrite and the scumbag a taste of their own medicine, dishing out ruthless retribution. Furthermore, during a life-or-death showdown aboard a luxury cruise ship, her shocking secret lineage — granddaughter of a powerful mafia kingpin — is unveiled. Ultimately, she and her beloved share a fully reciprocated, deeply devoted love, and their story culminates in a warm, perfect proposal.
6a475fdf9f947b4b4a08677a.title: Second Chance With My Mr.CEO

6a4a1e217879c28b1103d650.synopsis: Reborn on the Empire’s Matching Day, S-Class Guide Veda refuses to repeat her tragic fate. In her past life, she sacrificed five years of her power for Dane, only to be abandoned to die for another woman. This time, she rejects their 90% match and chooses Ryker, the Empire’s feared SSS-Class commander with a perfect 100% bond. As their legendary connection awakens, Veda exposes Dane and Vera’s betrayal while helping Ryker conquer his madness. When Dane remembers his past life, it’s already too late. Bound forever, Veda and Ryker rewrite destiny, and find the love they were always meant to share.
6a4a1e217879c28b1103d650.title: Fated to the Feral Lion

6a4a1e227879c28b1103d653.synopsis: Mara Quinn agrees when her amnesiac Alpha husband asks for divorce. Rowan Hale has forgotten their marriage, but not his body's reaction to her: one collision at the clerk's office and he wants to court her "properly, with marriage as the goal." Mara tries a gentle cat orc, yet only Rowan can make her burn. During rut, the strongest Apex commander cuffs himself and gives her the key, proving he can stop when she says stop. When his memories return, the truth hits: he chose Mara before, and without memories, chose her again.
6a4a1e227879c28b1103d653.title: Dumped by My Amnesiac Wolf Alpha

6a4bde37cdb434b20e085b0a.synopsis: Clara fakes amnesia to test her boyfriend—only to catch him cheating and watch him toss her aside for his best friend, Ethan. Big mistake. For the ultimate payback, Clara starts fake-dating Ethan to drive her ex insane with jealousy. But what happens when Ethan’s fake kisses start to feel dangerously real?
6a4bde37cdb434b20e085b0a.title: Faking It with My Ex's Best Friend

6a4c5d39cc86de7d8509ed0a.synopsis: Maeve is a defective Omega with no Wolf Spirit, a slum scavenger who once trusted her toxic friend Faye, swallowed wolfsbane, lost her unborn child, and died in flames set by Knox’s noble first love, Blair. Reborn on the night Alpha King Knox seeks her as the cure to his dark curse, Maeve hears the fierce little voice of her unborn telepathic pup and finally makes the smart choice: accept the Moonstones, the black card, and her place inside the Pack House. With her pup warning her of every trap, Maeve trains, wins the Queen Mother’s heart, exposes Faye and Blair, proves her child is pureblood, and rises from rejected Omega to Luna Queen.
6a4c5d39cc86de7d8509ed0a.title: My Telepathic Pup Made Me Luna

6a4c5d3bdf67096a3205139c.synopsis: My scholar husband Edmund sold me for 300 bucks to hunter Rowan, a cruel fate every village woman feared. I waited for brutal mistreatment, but he brought wild flowers, stewed chicken and swore to give me time. My greedy in-laws sneaked in at night, beat me and stole his rare white pheasants, ruining Edmund’s exam future. Broken-handed, drunk and drowning, he begged for forgiveness at our grand wedding. Yet I held Rowan’s hand—this contracted wife finally earned a real, warm marriage of my own.
6a4c5d3bdf67096a3205139c.title: Trapped by the Hunter

6a4c5d3dc2d6e00a6300278b.synopsis: Ava Hart once used her family fortune and connections to build Ethan Black’s empire, only to be betrayed on their wedding anniversary when he drugs her, steals her assets, and sends her to the underground Black Rose auction as revenge for humiliating his lover, Serena. Bound onstage and priced piece by piece before powerful criminals, Ava secretly activates the emergency chip hidden in her wedding ring, unlocking the Hart family’s protection clause and a $20 billion trust. When Adrian Cross, the man she once left behind, storms the island to save her, Ava refuses to simply escape. She buys out the entire auction, gathers every record, destroys Ethan’s company, dismantles the Black Rose exchange, and sends both Ethan and Serena to prison. Years later, Ava stands as a powerful investor in her own right, no longer anyone’s wife, prize, or property.
6a4c5d3dc2d6e00a6300278b.title: My Husband Auctioned Me Off

6a4c5f016de432c9700fa3e9.synopsis: Scorned by her husband, Kate drowns her sorrows in a bar—and wakes up next to a gorgeous escort named Felix. She pays him off. He won't let it go. When he shows up at her door, she offers a deal: "How much?" But Felix isn't just any gigolo—he's a billionaire duke in disguise. Soon she's riding private jets, dripping in jewels, and watching her cheating ex get publicly destroyed. Then comes the pregnancy—and her ex's desperate plea for forgiveness. Now Kate must choose: the gilded cage of marriage, or the wild, impossible truth of a love she never saw coming. Too bad Felix isn't giving her a choice. The ultimate showdown between two worlds is about to begin.
6a4c5f016de432c9700fa3e9.title: One Night or Forever

6a4c5f084d9dcf6d260cde6d.synopsis: In Now His Secret Is My Weapon movie, after a failed overdose, housewife Sophia wakes up in her husband Matthew’s body—and he’s stuck in hers. She fights his battles at work, destroys his mistress Christy, and turns his career around. He suffers her monster‑in‑law Janet and the cruel weight of domestic life. But when cheating accusations and secrets ignite a full‑blown crisis, they realize swapping bodies might be the least of their problems. Will they ever get back to themselves—or is this curse their new reality? The countdown is on.
6a4c5f084d9dcf6d260cde6d.title: Now His Secret Is My Weapon

6a4c61c6cf07db22cb0c583c.synopsis: "I'd rather you had let me bleed out." Those were my Alpha's last words after I spent a lifetime loving the man whose life I saved. Reborn, I ask for only one thing—freedom. Instead, he forces me to mate his younger brother. What he doesn't know is that his brother has spent three years searching for the mysterious girl who once saved him... and she's me. When the truth finally comes out, which brother will regret losing me first?
6a4c61c6cf07db22cb0c583c.title: The Alpha Heir Gave Me to His Brother

6a4c61c8f65994e6e60b46b1.synopsis: When Supreme Goddess Aurelia returns from war, the child waiting in her temple is not her daughter, but a Siren wearing stolen Phoenix skin, divinity, and holy feathers. The lie leads back to Apathe, Aurelia’s own sister, who coveted the Supreme Throne and hated the daughter born from Aurelia and the Storm Titan she loved in vain. After forcing the truth from three traitorous demigods, Aurelia descends into Tartarus, finds only a fragment of her baby Arora’s soul, and brings it home. She destroys the stolen powers, abandons the throne, and waits centuries for her daughter to rise again as Phoenix.
6a4c61c8f65994e6e60b46b1.title: The Usurped Divine Daughter

6a4c61cb027db4929d012bcd.synopsis: At her engagement ceremony, Evadne is slapped, shamed, and rejected by Valerius, the Black Dragon prince, after her scheming twin sister steals the sacred power meant to protect her future. Branded impure before the entire realm, Evadne makes one impossible choice: she marries Aurelius, the cursed god-king everyone fears. But her sister’s stolen power hides a cruel secret—every shameful child she conceives can be forced into Evadne’s body. What they don’t know is Evadne’s own gift can purify any bloodline and awaken extinct Titans. The more they try to ruin her, the more divine monsters she gives birth to.
6a4c61cb027db4929d012bcd.title: Betrayed, Then Birthed Titans

6a4c61cdf256862bc209762c.synopsis: On her wedding day, Selene was framed, rejected by the Alpha King, stripped of her crest, and exiled by her own mother. Everyone believed the cursed silver-eyed girl had disappeared forever. Fifteen years later, she returns as the Empress of the Sacred Dominion, ruling the continent’s richest crystal mines from a dragonbone throne. But when her adopted son brings home the daughter of the woman who stole her life, Selene refuses to forgive. Old enemies gather, buried lies surface, and one by one, those who betrayed her discover that the girl they destroyed has become the queen they must fear.
6a4c61cdf256862bc209762c.title: The Alpha Rejected Me, But the Dragon King Claimed Me

6a4c61cf5d4805a1ea03b4ef.synopsis: At the engagement banquet, the Dark Lord Darius lifted my veil, his eyes filled with disgust. “The woman I wanted to marry is dead. Yet you are still alive.” He blindfolded me, forbidding me to speak, forbidding me to raise my head. That night, I cried away all the tears of my past life. Reborn, I returned to the day he mistook someone else for the one who had saved him. My sister Elise was pretending to be me, accepting his marriage contract in my place. This time, I knelt before the Duchess first. “Please, Madam, arrange my marriage as soon as possible too.” Later, I married the northern Frost Lord, a man infamous for his cold-blooded cruelty. On the day of my wedding, Darius fought his way to my bridal carriage.
6a4c61cf5d4805a1ea03b4ef.title: The Vampire Lord's Lost Salvation

6a4c631a1a588877650016ed.synopsis: To win dignity for his people, commoner Clint awakens the Kung Fu Boost System —one day of training gifts him one year's power. Defying all odds, he rises from a nobody to the ultimate backbone of kung fu!
6a4c631a1a588877650016ed.title: Rise of the Kung Fu King

6a4c65459ed73db2bf073c2d.synopsis: At my own Mate Claim Ceremony, Cassian rejected me and took my sister Maris’s hand, claiming he only wanted to save her from the Council. Then he tried to rip my dead mother’s moonstone necklace from my neck so Maris could wear it as his chosen Luna. The chain broke. So did the last reason I had to wait for him. In three days, the Council would send me to Rowan Vale, the Lycan king’s dying heir. Everyone pitied me. But Rowan was the first man to ask if I chose him freely.
6a4c65459ed73db2bf073c2d.title: My Sister Stole My Mate, So I Married a King

6a4ca45b25dd0f249d0b958b.synopsis: Serena Reed discovers that her husband, Caleb Whitmore, has turned her pregnancy into a cruel million-dollar bet with his friends, all to entertain Chloe Lane, the woman he always protected. After being humiliated, forced into a dangerous paternity test, pushed down the stairs, and threatened with private photos at an auction, Serena finally calls her parents and walks away. With her family’s protection, she exposes Caleb’s crimes, ends the marriage, and watches the Whitmore empire collapse while she rebuilds herself into a sharper, freer woman.
6a4ca45b25dd0f249d0b958b.title: Tears on the Pillow of Regret

6a4ca4e785b721cc250fe4de.synopsis: At eight, I watched low-rank Brett torture my mad mom, a stolen pureblood wolf princess, while the whole clan praised him as a devoted mate. I dug up her family crest pendant, stopped Alpha Ryker’s convoy to beg rescue. We exposed his cruel restraints, but Brett threatened revenge. Sneaking into his cell, I killed him alone. Later, hidden letters uncovered official Slade’s trafficking plot. I regained my Shen royal name, married gentle Prince Caden, yet I still hide the bloody secret buried deep inside me.
6a4ca4e785b721cc250fe4de.title: Stolen Princess and Her Wolf Daughter

6a4ca532a5047eb34a0b2a65.synopsis: I was born blind, but I could see every soul. In my last life, I used that gift to put Leon on the throne. He repaid me with poisoned wine, buried my sister as queen, and left my body for wild dogs. When I woke at the ball where princes chose brides, Leon had been reborn too. He chose Vanessa and laughed at the “useless blind girl.” Good. This time, I picked Duke Silas, the so-called cripple with the soul of a true king, and put the right man on the throne beside me.
6a4ca532a5047eb34a0b2a65.title: The Blind Girl Who Sees Souls

6a4e06dd86fc57d4b107b16c.synopsis: I gave my virginity to save my drugged stepbrother. He married me because I was pregnant... then killed me on our wedding night. When I woke up, I was back to the night everything began. This time, I sent his beloved woman to his bed, gave up my inheritance, and fell for the man who truly loved me. But just when I stopped loving him, my stepbrother uncovered the truth. “I was wrong… Please marry me.” I smiled. “Too late. The woman who died in that fire will never love you again.”
6a4e06dd86fc57d4b107b16c.title: The Ice Hockey Star Regrets Deeply

6a4f08df981c10287204edc2.synopsis: Meteorologist Julian Parker discovers that a catastrophic megastorm will cripple the city's power grid within hours. After interrupting a live news broadcast to warn the public, he is fired and dismissed as a conspiracy theorist. Refusing to give up, Julian races against the clock to deliver portable power stations to hospitals, first responders, and vulnerable families, enduring ridicule, arrest, and rejection along the way.
6a4f08df981c10287204edc2.title: When The Black Out Comes

6a4f11aeb9b840d064021976.synopsis: Mira Vale once believed being Kael Blackwood’s Luna meant she finally had a home. Instead, five years in Ironpeak taught her that a mate bond could become a cage: every dress, carriage, and medical request passed through Sienna Frost, the graceful steward Kael trusted more than his own wife. When Mira’s human adoptive mother dies after Sienna blocks the Moonwell serum and Kael ignores eleven desperate calls, Mira asks to sever their bond. Kael only realizes the truth after Mira leaves for North Ridge, rebuilds her life as a wolf researcher, and turns her grief into a law that saves outsiders like her mother. By the time he finally hears her, Mira no longer needs him.
6a4f11aeb9b840d064021976.title: The Alpha Heard Her Too Late

6a4f11af0c87f5b3aa0e31c4.synopsis: Leah was the soft, obedient heir everyone thought they could break. But when she is nearly drowned, Vera, the dangerous soul sealed inside her body, finally awakens. Betrayed by family, framed by a fake daughter, and abandoned by her mate, Leah has lost almost everything. Now Vera is back to expose every lie, punish every traitor, and reclaim the throne they were both born to rule.
6a4f11af0c87f5b3aa0e31c4.title: Double Souls Under the Moon

6a4f34b3b0d1ee9f560c3f6e.synopsis: I’ve been dreading my eighteenth birthday for as long as I can remember. My mating day was even worse than I could have imagined. Not only was I mated to the Alpha and the Beta, they don’t want me. Publicly cast aside for another woman, I fled into the wilderness, entirely unaware that I was actually a forbidden wolf-vampire hybrid. To protect me from a corrupt Council, my family wiped my memories, leaving me stranded in a rogue town as "Katie"—heavily pregnant and completely lost. But my past violently caught up when my mates and their secret Alpha brother, Mason, tracked me down. With a dark conspiracy now targeting my newborn daughter to breed a lethal hybrid army, I must survive a volatile web of dangerous desires to protect my child before a brutal war consumes us all.
6a4f34b3b0d1ee9f560c3f6e.title: The Alpha and Beta's Shared Mate

6a4f6baef257157a3f0ac0be.synopsis: Lila Wilson is reborn back in time after her evil adoptive sister Paris tricked her six brothers into sending her to her death. With her second chance in life, Lila is determined to not make the same mistakes she ignoring her brothers, choosing to focus on her studies and robot fighting and streaming career. However, this time, Lila isn’t alone. Seth Campbell, the secret heir of Campbell family and the man who caused the car accident that took her parent’s lives, is determined to take care of her and support her career and dream of getting into her parents’ university. With his help, Lila is able to get a good score in her ACT test, get a leg up into the AI robot streaming industry, and get into her parents’ university. Seeing this, Paris tries to enact her original plan of pretending to be sick and making the brothers force Lila to donate her kidney to her, so that she can kill Lila on the operating table. But this time, Lila and Seth successfully prove that Paris bribed the doctors into faking her medical condition, her father who the brothers thought saved Lila’s life actually planned to kidnap their parents, and she has been lying about Lila to ruin the brothers’ relationship with her. Lila cuts ties with her abusive and unsupportive brothers and earns her own happy ending with Seth.
6a4f6baef257157a3f0ac0be.title: Reborn Heiress Strikes Back

6a500e84492dec4b5a02f556.synopsis: In Nothing Escapes My Eyes movie, Liam is a delivery driver cuckolded by his gold-digging girlfriend. One day, he gets hit by a car belonging to Ivy, a gorgeous CEO. From the accident, he gains the superpower of "God's Sight', allowing him to see how much time is left in people’s lives, as well as the true value of things.
6a500e84492dec4b5a02f556.title: Nothing Escapes My Eyes

6a50162231243f4ece0229b8.synopsis: In I'll Make Your Daddy Mine movie, all her life, farm girl Lenore Williams has been bullied by spoiled heiress Ada Thornton. When Ada steals Lenore's fiance and kills her father, Lenore swears revenge - by seducing Ada's hot bachelor father, the mysterious mogul of Thornton Estates. It's all for revenge, so why does he make her feel things she's never felt before?
6a50162231243f4ece0229b8.title: I'll Make Your Daddy Mine

6a504ec0bfc970e7d80c7049.synopsis: Olivia saved Adam, the silent serpent shapeshifter no one wanted, and spent years nursing him back to health. Yet when fire trapped her and her sister Chloe, Adam chose Chloe and left Olivia to die. Reborn on the day the twin serpent guards are chosen, Olivia gives both brothers to Chloe and fights her way into the family business. When Chloe arranges Olivia's kidnapping, Adam once again sacrifices her safety for Chloe's birthday. But this time, Olivia has planned her escape. Declared dead, she becomes the secret ally of Jason Astor, the ruthless Serpent King and her family's greatest enemy. As Olivia destroys the family that treated her as disposable, Adam returns desperate for forgiveness, only to find she no longer belongs to him.
6a504ec0bfc970e7d80c7049.title: He Chose My Sister, So I Chose the Serpent King

6a504eca5f279ed27700197a.synopsis: I am the eldest daughter of the Duke of Anjou. Six years ago, I eloped to a farmstead with Julian, a penniless knight. I cut the umbilical cord with my own hands and gave birth to our daughter, trading everything for the vow he sealed with a copper ring. When we met again, he had been ennobled as a count. With his arm around the waist of his widowed sister-in-law, Cecilia, he kicked away the hand I stretched out, begging him to save our daughter. "Drag this madwoman and that little bastard out. Beat them to death." Poisoned blood spilled across the carpet as Adele and I closed our eyes, dying with hatred in our hearts. When I opened them again, I had returned to the day he received his title. I sold the farmstead and went back to my father, kneeling before him to admit my mistake. Rumors spread through every street of the royal capital. That night, his captain of the guard set fire to the empty farmstead. What he did not know was this: the moment he sent men to silence me, the crimes of bigamy and murdering his wife had already been sealed in the Church's records.
6a504eca5f279ed27700197a.title: A Duke's Daughter Strikes Back

6a5062a2cfe82f6004003dad.synopsis: My husband drowned me while I was pregnant, calling me nothing more than a gold-digging maid. When I opened my eyes, I was back before the nightmare began. This time, I refused to become his mistress. Instead, I climbed into the bed of the one man he could never defeat—his billionaire adoptive father. “You're mine now,” Marcus said. I thought I was only using him for revenge... until the day my ex knelt before us in tears, and I realized I'd fallen for the only man who had ever truly protected me.
6a5062a2cfe82f6004003dad.title: I Seduced My Husband’s Adoptive Father

6a5191d8fa9f9f7a09081789.synopsis: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition, Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.
6a5191d8fa9f9f7a09081789.title: The Great and Powerful Genie

6a5443012428cc08d00c9d79.synopsis: In Base 72, Carl is looked down on for his low-ranked gift. But he discovers his power can restore resources corrupted by the wasteland's pollution. After absorbing a mysterious Black Crystal, his gift evolves, granting him the powerful Mechanical Pulse Cannon. As Carl's strength grows, he resolves conflicts, protects the settlement, and rises from an overlooked outcast to the leader of Base 72, guiding its survivors toward a safer future.
6a5443012428cc08d00c9d79.title: The Apocalypse Gave Me a Cheat Skill

6a544e264e8edf02280ca29d.synopsis: Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business.Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business. But Jasper never expected his fake wife to get under his skin. And Khloe never planned to want a man she's only pretending to love. The contract had one rule — don't fall in love. Breaking it could cost them everything.
6a544e264e8edf02280ca29d.title: A Marriage Deal with the Billionaire

6a544e2b68ff54a82a095030.synopsis: On her wedding day, Ava discovers the truth: her father has been pushed to the back of the room while a rich girl’s dog gets a seat at the main table. One public humiliation exposes her fiancé’s family for who they really are. So Ava walks away from the perfect wedding and chooses the man who gave her everything, building a future where her father finally stands in the light.
6a544e2b68ff54a82a095030.title: My Father Outside the Spotlight

6a544f954199bdefcb07d765.synopsis: At her sacred bonding ceremony, snow leopard princess Diana is rejected by all three fated mates and betrayed by the maid who stole her first love. Desperate to protect her dying tribe, she invokes an ancient Moonstone law and chooses Carl, a chained arena slave, as her beast husband. Everyone mocks her for marrying beneath her, until Carl’s Silver Tiger bloodline awakens and Diana carries his legendary heir. As jealous ex-lovers, rival tribes, and royal conspiracies close in, Diana rises from public disgrace to unstoppable queen, while the man everyone called a slave reveals himself as Emperor Yuan.
6a544f954199bdefcb07d765.title: The Silver Tiger Mate's Gentle Pampering

6a546302e533929b890b34c5.synopsis: After my parents died, I was raised by Aunt Sandra, my mother's best friend, and cherished by her two sons, the Miller brothers. I believed I would one day marry one of them. But when maid's daughter, Lola, arrived, everything changed. The Miller brothers cruelly broke my heart. Only after I left did they realize what they had lost and desperately search for me.
6a546302e533929b890b34c5.title: Dear My Cruel Brothers

6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.synopsis: To protect his wife, God King Kairos sealed his divine powers and feigned being a worthless mortal. Instead of gratitude, Cassia r
6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.title: The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War

6a549b2451cf0e4d6c0a153d.synopsis: "I had been switched at birth for seventeen years. When my wealthy biological parents finally found me, they showed up in patched shirts, pretending to be poor. Together with the fake heiress, Seraphina, they threw me into a condemned building and forced me to repay them fifty thousand dollars every month. Then one day, my mother publicly cursed whoever had framed me, saying they would “go blind and have their legs broken.” The next morning, on the red carpet at a ball, Seraphina’s eyes bled and both her legs snapped. Only then did they fall to their knees before me, screaming, “Who the hell are you?” I lowered my eyes. A flash of dark gold passed through my pupils. “The witch who didn’t burn on the Salem stake three hundred years ago.”"
6a549b2451cf0e4d6c0a153d.title: The Karmic Heiress

6a549b295a4a5345b00e507f.synopsis: Ava Reed is accused of murdering Lilian Winslow, the precious baby heiress of a billion-dollar family trust. Surrounded by guns, fake evidence, and a flatlining monitor, Ava suddenly hears Lilian’s tiny voice begging for help. From poisonous perfume to forged medical records, fake pregnancy schemes, and trust-fund murder plots, Ava follows the baby’s clues and tears the whole conspiracy apart.
6a549b295a4a5345b00e507f.title: Mind-Reading Ultimate Guardian

6a549d9551cf0e4d6c0a1540.synopsis: In her past life, the female lead saved a homeless man — actually the Wine God in disguise. He gave her a goblet. Drinking from it gave her the Midas Touch, but each use cost her life force. Used as a pawn by a power hungry prince, she was exploited and ultimately killed by her jealous sister. With her last breath, she turned her sister's family to gold — and died. After her death, the Wine God revealed she was his daughter. He reversed time and gave her a second chance. This time, her sister stole the goblet first, gaining the Midas Touch herself. The prince still chased power, and the curse remained: the sister's body decayed, greed consumed the family and the court, and all were destroyed by their own desires. The female lead watched from the shadows — and let them destroy themselves.
6a549d9551cf0e4d6c0a1540.title: The Curse of the Midas Touch

6a54aab7320378451205e865.synopsis: When her childhood best friend Leo ties her to the school goalpost as a prank to impress another girl, Eleanor Vance transfers to a California high school to start over. As she heals, excels academically, and finds new love, Leo spirals into regret—but some betrayals can never be undone.
6a54aab7320378451205e865.title: He Pulled a Prank on Me and Lost Everything

6a54dceea398b25e350d0c8b.synopsis: Ava Russell on the eve of her arranged marriage, is drugged by her fiancé Nico Moretti and has her hair brutally shaved off by his comrade Scarlett. Refusing to swallow this humiliation, Ava secretly contacts Damian Costello, the powerful heir of the Costello family who has secretly loved her for twelve years. On the wedding day, when Nico tries to sneak Ava into his family through a shabby, hidden ceremony and Scarlett publicly strips off her wig to mock her, Damian arrives with a magnificent fleet to marry Ava in style. With the help of Damian and the Commission, Nico and Scarlett are stripped of their power and arrested for violating family laws, while Ava finally finds her true protector and happiness.
6a54dceea398b25e350d0c8b.title: His Partner, Her Revenge

6a55ac24485f9d5b0506785a.title: Dying After Ten Years for His Sin

6a55aca583cb75e34b0eb4bf.synopsis: Aria once loved Damon Hayes as the boy who saved her. Then he became Alpha, let Vivienne Sutton mark him, and forced wolfsbane down Aria's throat to erase their pup. Worse, he dragged her bleeding to Crescent Hall so Vivienne could call her a mate-thief before every Alpha. Damon thought Aria was still the packless stray he used to feed. He was wrong. Hollow Ridge had searched twenty years for its lost daughter, and her father arrived just in time. Once Aria finally rejects Damon, the Alpha who threw her away starts losing everything.
6a55aca583cb75e34b0eb4bf.title: My Alpha Forced Me to Lose Our Pup

6a55acffff7e4a3926091ed7.synopsis: Ava begged her husband to hear her, but every time life got hard, Lucas simply turned off his hearing aid. After one devastating night, she realizes the cruelest silence is not being unheard, but being ignored by the person who promised to protect you. Now she’s done waiting for him to listen, and ready to reclaim her voice, her name, and her life.
6a55acffff7e4a3926091ed7.title: After The Soundproof Wall

6a55ad545c3b1759bb023db4.synopsis: Ava crosses thousands of miles to watch Nolan's final, only to be humiliated by him and his new fiancee, Chloe. Armed with forum posts, access logs, model permissions, deepfake evidence, and hearing records, she exposes the theft of her research and the campaign to destroy her name. By the final whistle, she has taken back her future, built her own sports data company, and chosen the man who truly hears her.
6a55ad545c3b1759bb023db4.title: I'm not waiting for you at the end

6a55ae26aefa8bda590dd413.synopsis: Elena and her son Noah spend a year collecting scrap energy cans just to afford one night at the Moonlight Carnival, only to find her husband Kyle has secretly rented the entire place for his first love, Selena, and her son. For seven years, Kyle claimed he was a penniless outcast, while saving his money, tenderness, and public status for another family. Elena finally files for divorce, takes Noah away, exposes Selena’s lies, and makes Kyle learn that late compensation may help his son, but it will never win back his wife.
6a55ae26aefa8bda590dd413.title: Leaving the Fake-Poor Alpha

6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.synopsis: Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.
6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.title: The Lycan's Savage Luna

6a55d76bef68ac498703dd1b.synopsis: Lian Vier has spent his life hiding at Sanctum Academy as a harmless mixed-blood student, while in truth he is the last pure-blood male incubus under a kill-on-sight order. When a loss of control throws him into the arms of Lance Silverwood, the exorcist heir born to destroy him, blackmail, black-market hunters, and an abyss ritual close in. Lance chooses to feed him, bind himself to him, and fight beside him; when the buried truth about the demon purge is exposed, Lian stops being prey and becomes the one who judges the hunters.
6a55d76bef68ac498703dd1b.title: Bite the Exorcist Heir

6a55eb34abf3824e3a08be70.synopsis: Five years married, and he kicked me out for his "amnesiac" sister. After I miscarried, he said, "Let's get divorced, just pretend, to keep her calm." So I signed the real papers, blocked him. Her fake amnesia got exposed, she ended up in a psych ward. He faked cancer, then a car crash. Years later, I'm on Forbes, my sister's insane, my mother lives on the $200 a month I give her, and the man who threw me away is just someone I don't even bother to name anymore. They tried to destroy me, now I'm out of their reach.
6a55eb34abf3824e3a08be70.title: The Wife He Gave Away

6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.synopsis: In Zero to Alpha Return of the Wolf King movie, exiled for failing to awaken his wolf form, Nory trained twenty years under three Masters beyond Sacred Rank. Returning to see his mother, he enters the Clan Tournament, shatters the test stone, crushes every foe, and is revealed as the savior three Gold Leaders sought. When vampires invade, he slams the Legendary First Sire through seven walls. Learning his mother was injured saving him, he gathers three sacred relics to heal her. But crimson eyes in distant mist hint a greater threat.
6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.title: Zero to Alpha: Return of the Wolf King

6a56ddb45c65371f2b0a3f8a.synopsis: Kyle is the son of a wealthy family. His biological mother died early. At home, he's constantly excluded and framed by his stepmother Alicia and his half-brother Ryan. His father Robert banishes him to live in a backyard tool shed. At school, his family background makes him a target as well. He's mocked as "Trash Boy" and subjected to relentless bullying. One day, an alien spacecraft crashes into the backyard. Inside the shed, Kyle discovers an injured alien observer named Zorp. The two strike a deal: Kyle will wear Zorp's energy wristband and, by overcoming adversity and generating emotional energy, help Zorp repair his ship. In return, the wristband awakens Kyle's own latent potential. With heightened perception and physical abilities, Kyle begins fighting back against his bullies, enraging Ryan. In the school cafeteria, Ryan publicly accuses Kyle of stealing a valuable watch and, together with his lackeys, subjects him to brutal humiliation. As his dignity and spirit come under critical fire, Kyle makes a desperate plea for Zorp's help.
6a56ddb45c65371f2b0a3f8a.title: Trash Boy's Super Watch

6a56e53710cf0d2533014cfd.synopsis: Before I left for the Rogue Wars, my best friend Selene made me memorize one warning: if I ever came home and saw her eating almonds, that woman was not her. Three months later, I returned to Blood Moon Pack and found the Luna smiling at the dinner table, chewing the one food that should have killed her. Same face. Same scent. Same memories. She even called me by our childhood nickname. But Selene had never given false warnings. If the woman in front of me was not her, then where was my real Luna?
6a56e53710cf0d2533014cfd.title: The Silent Luna’s Secret

6a56fdb294a9400558057de0.synopsis: Elana gave everything to her husband, her children, and a family that never protected her. On the day she gives birth, her babies are taken from her and handed to another woman. Even her most precious dragon scale is ripped away in the name of “atonement.” When regret finally comes, it is already too late. Reborn far from the palace, Elana becomes a healer, finds warmth again, and leaves the ashes of her old life behind.
6a56fdb294a9400558057de0.title: She Left The Ashes Behind

6a571f2c1e9758b002077f74.synopsis: Stan Shaw, a skilled master of medicine and martial arts, disguises himself as a beggar to escape a marriage contract with the Miller family. Contrary to his plan, they insist on the marriage. Yet the one they want him to marry isn't necessarily the one he thought.
6a571f2c1e9758b002077f74.title: That Beggar Wants Out

6a5724f41fd2b06f5e0142b5.synopsis: Eve helped Noah build Black Tech from nothing, only to discover he has married the intern Mia and plans to hand her Eve's biggest project. At the Grant signing ceremony, Eve reveals her true identity as the Grant Group heiress and exposes Mia's leak, Noah's entitlement, and the cost of eight wasted years. Walking away from his collapse, she signs back the life that always belonged to her.
6a5724f41fd2b06f5e0142b5.title: Eight Years Gone Down the Drain

6a5750f712e78a1707083f40.synopsis: On their anniversary night, Serena Vale comes to renew her mating bond, only to find a rescued Omega wrapped in her Alpha’s coat and wearing her Luna mark. Instead of apologizing, Adrian Cross freezes Serena’s Luna rights so Nora won’t be punished. In front of the pack, Serena loses her place as wife, Luna, and future queen. But she does not beg. At the Moon Court, Serena reveals the secret that breaks him: she is carrying his heir, but the child will never belong to him. If Adrian can give her place to another woman, Serena can take away his bloodline.
6a5750f712e78a1707083f40.title: He Gave Her My Luna Mark

6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.synopsis: One drunken night, one humiliating ex, fake-date her worst enemy Blake or watch the Greenharts lose every point because of her. Ha
6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.title: The Fake Dating Spell

6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.synopsis: She came to town for a fresh start. Instead, Penelope Harris got pregnant by her ex’s powerful older brother, Knox Grant– the rugg
6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.title: Keeping the Cowboy's Baby

6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.synopsis: In How to Wreck My Bully's Heart movie, Kristina Cooper's a scholarship student by day, online masked singer by night. She's got the perfect internet boyfriend in Dax – sweet, caring, and supportive – until she finds out he's Daxter, the monsterous thug who's been bullying her at school! Will she forgive Dexter, the damaged, broken boy she once loved, or will their anonymous love end in Dexter's never ending regret as Kristina choses a brighter future without him?
6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.title: How to Wreck My Bully's Heart

6a5840e92769ac7896097977.synopsis: I followed my lady through three rebirths. When she married the commander, I was drowned; when she married the duke, I was stabbed through the heart. In the third life, she set her sights on the Elf King. To survive, I slipped into the earl’s study, only to find a female elf sealed inside heartwood amber, dressed in green, with the exact same face as Calem. Then the lock clicked behind me. “Elara, you saw her.”
6a5840e92769ac7896097977.title: Max Maid’s Survival Rules

6a586d61f1819245a007809e.synopsis: An injury brings Ian, the cold and distant team doctor, and Noah, the hot-shot rugby captain, together. Forced into a 24-hour close-contact physical therapy session, they survive homophobic backlash, a terrifying rescue, and a toxic ex-boyfriend’s dark obsession. In a dramatic rainstorm, they finally lay their hearts bare, embracing a love they fought so hard for. But heartbreak strikes when Noah lands a multi-million-dollar pro contract. Threatened by a blackmailing cheerleader, Ian chooses to sacrifice his own happiness. To save Noah’s career, Ian breaks his heart with a brutal lie. While Noah numbly signs his life away under the spotlight, Ian quietly drops out of school and disappears into a raging blizzard. Will their love survive the ultimate sacrifice, or have they lost each other forever?
6a586d61f1819245a007809e.title: Illegal Touching

6a589b96716ca7d47a0a97f4.synopsis: Blinded by tragedy, genius musician Ciel Frost survived the dark by clinging to the suffocating love of a brilliant director, Marco Kingsley. But a conspiracy tore them apart. a sighted Ciel falls into a web of lies—mistaking Marco's manipulative nephew, Liam, for the savior from his past. Three years later, Marco returns as an all-powerful capitalist tyrant. Concealing his identity as the chief investor and "family elder," he closes in on Ciel’s world. When the familiar, dangerous breath and scalding touch overlap once more, Ciel’s memory floods back in a shiver of shock, instantly tearing through the lies. Ultimately, Liam faces utter ruin for his deceit, while Marco and Ciel shatter all barriers to reunite in an unstoppable destiny.
6a589b96716ca7d47a0a97f4.title: Seduced by My Boyfriend’s Uncle

6a58d32795d3f308540031d8.synopsis: Dumped by his ex-wife Kyla, Osbert's fortunes change with the Everything Plus System, letting him add 5cm to anything he touches — from finances to sports cars. Overnight, he rises as a top plastic surgeon, rescues the stunning Julia, and outshines Kyla at a reunion. As his powers grow, Osbert transforms from a ridiculed loser to a business titan, finding true love and ultimate respect along the way.
6a58d32795d3f308540031d8.title: Everything Plus, Everyone Else Shuts

6a598ba60bcf6849150ba5bd.synopsis: The Last Stand sets in a near-future deep-cold winter apocalypse. Wealthy heiress Lily Carter awakens on the live finale stage of a reality show, retaining memories of a previous life where her stepsister Sue Bishop betrayed her, hired strangers to seize her cabin, and left her to freeze. Armed with foreknowledge of the coming catastrophe, Lily claims her grand prize — a luxury Newmar King Aire RV — and secretly transforms it into an armored mobile fortress. As the freeze descends, she navigates sisterhood rivalry, a fanatical doomsday preacher, roving survivors, and buried family secrets.
6a598ba60bcf6849150ba5bd.title: The Last Stand: Iron RV, Ice Plains

6a598bdc118ac35b290f065a.synopsis: I‘m Elowen, the only rabbit shifter with purifying blood, destined to be Alpha King Kael’s Luna. But on our bonding altar, he brought his pregnant snake mistress, ordering me to raise their child as their servant. I revoked our bond and offered myself to any shifter willing to claim me. Everyone feared Kael—until cursed, discarded Prince Rowan stepped forward. I chose him, my pure blood suppressing his deadly curse. The old prophecy shifted to us. Kael lost all power and begged me back, while his serpent lover sank into dark corruption. Can Rowan and I stop the feral beast tide sweeping the realm?
6a598bdc118ac35b290f065a.title: The Rabbit Bride Who Rejected Her Alpha King

6a598bde89a94812de0b87db.synopsis: On her big day, she caught her fiancé with her best friend in bed. Furious, she married a random guy on the spot. But guess what? this "nobody" was her ex's uncle—and the richest man alive!
6a598bde89a94812de0b87db.title: Married Ex-Fiancé's Uncle

6a5d843ab4f9e8fd9c05c8b2.synopsis: Twenty-five years after being left at a New York City hospital as a brand new infant, Jacqueline Frost has defied the odds and is now thriving as a young woman. She might not have a lot of friends, or any family, but she has a job she excels at and she’s finally going to get her big break. Cherry picked by her supervisor to present her ideas to the CEO of Vaughan Professional Consulting, she is excited to finally get a chance to play with the big boys. Wilder Vaughn is the CEO of a consulting firm which helps repair the images of screwed up celebrities, athletes and politicians and frankly anyone else who will spend money to make their problems go away with some decent PR tweaking. When one of his directors tells him over and over about the brilliant woman named Jacqueline in his department, he finally agrees to let her pitch to him on a major client. He wished he’d agreed sooner. Jacqueline Frost walks into his office and he immediately knows she’s special. One shake of her hand and the CEO, who also happens to be a prince to the queen of all the Southern Realm fae-folk, finally finds his mate after years of searching for her. The problem? She doesn’t know she’s fae. When Rafferty Vaughn is called to an emergency meeting in his twin brother’s office where he lords over humans like some kind of prick with a superiority complex, he is immediately jealous of the fact his twin found his mate first. Then she walks in and when he introduces himself, a single touch of her hand reveals she is his mate too. The fates are playing an irritating game. The brothers need to decide quickly what their next moves are. They haven’t gotten along since they were teenagers and haven’t shared a meal in peace let alone a mate. Will they try to force one or the other to sever the bond to allow one brother to have their mate to themselves or will they work together? To complicate matters all the more Jacqueline is the missing princess to the king of the Northern Realm, Jack Frost. Since the king has blamed the Vaughn family all along for the loss of his daughter, the twins are fighting an uphill battle against a woman who thinks they are crazy and a king who wants his daughter to go home with him instead of staying in the human world or with spoiled princes who can’t agree on anything. Jacqueline is freaking out. When her biological family come out of the woodwork, she finds her father is the Jack Frost, her mother apparently suffered some kind of mental break when she was kidnapped as an infant moments after her birth, and she has two siblings who don’t seem to like her very much, despite what they claim. Her boss and his brother are calling her mate. She’d give anything to just let things go back to the way they were. So what does she do? She insists on working with the client she was pitching for and ends up following the troubled skier to a small idyllic town in Colorado to help him fix his image. She doesn’t expect, however, that her two new mates, her entire biological family and the twins’ families to follow her. What ensues is a comedic, romantic, free-for-all where Jacqueline dodges every attempt at everyone trying to seduce her to their side. The seduction of Jac Frost has begun and it’s every man for himself, until someone starts causing trouble and Jacqueline’s life might be on the line. Then it’s a show of solidarity between a group of people who never wanted to work together but they’ll do anything to keep their princess safe. They’re going to have to figure out how to make it all work or they may lose her forever.
6a5d843ab4f9e8fd9c05c8b2.title: The Seduction of Jac Frost

6a5d84c66c05476ac30ef75f.synopsis: Emma is alone after her husband leaves on a mafia mission, trapped by a painful blocked milk duct and a crying baby. Then Dante Vella, her husband’s wounded mafia boss, breaks into her home, hiding from killers outside. To keep the baby quiet, Emma has no choice but to let him help relieve her most private pain. But his steady hands and dangerous closeness awaken feelings she should never have. When her husband suddenly video-calls, Dante stays just outside the frame, his hand moving from the ache he was supposed to soothe toward the shadow beneath her skirt. As her husband talks about hunting Dante for a bounty, Emma realizes the real danger is no longer outside the door.
6a5d84c66c05476ac30ef75f.title: The Mafia Boss My Husband Betrayed

6a5d856b50f13fa4a20836b1.synopsis: Aria hides her identity as the sole heiress of America's richest family and enters college disguised as a scholarship student to evaluate her arranged fiancé. Instead, she becomes the target of a cruel dating game where wealthy students compete to break girls' hearts for money. She plays along until the night they publicly dump and humiliate her. Just when everyone expects tears, Aria ends the game with a single phone call. Their fortunes, reputations, and futures begin collapsing one by one. But the revenge she prepared is far from over.
6a5d856b50f13fa4a20836b1.title: They Bet I'd Cry, I Bet They'd Fall

6a5db3ec49ae13222f0ca5dc.synopsis: The moment the Alpha King pins me onto the bed, I slap him. "You’re my wife." He growls dangerously. "The wife you refused to touch for three years? I'm not that pathetic woman." I'm not, for real. I went to sleep a college girl, and woke up a Queen. Servants said the King hates his Queen, so his mistress rules the palace—but that was before me.
6a5db3ec49ae13222f0ca5dc.title: I AM THE LUNA QUEEN

6a5db3ef3a92735f1a059d89.synopsis: Wren Calloway spent three years saving Dorian, a voiceless siren heir. He calls Wren a worthless null and tears their bond apart to protect Wren'sister, Celeste. But Wren was never worthless. Her devouring aura had been suppressed, and Celeste's genius was stolen from her. The unwanted white lion sent as Wren's replacement bond-partner is Kane, the kitten she once loved, now the beast king the rift monsters obey. When Wren takes back every stolen power, Dorian learns too late he was only holding Kane's light.
6a5db3ef3a92735f1a059d89.title: The Beast King Worships the Worthless

6a5db4b9d2d51395fd03a48b.synopsis: After being betrayed by her Alpha mate and watching him lead the pack to slaughter both her and her newborn daughter, Lyra is given a second life. This time, she rejects fate, chooses a new mate, and awakens the legendary White Wolf. As the truth behind the pureblood bloodline unravels, the Alpha realizes he destroyed the very bloodline his family hunted for generations. But when Lyra becomes pregnant again, the hunt begins once more.
6a5db4b9d2d51395fd03a48b.title: I Married the Alpha They Threw Away

6a5db4bdb72949b20d0fdcb9.synopsis: Aria Voss lost her voice and scarred her face dragging Alpha Damon Kade out of a wolfsbane fire. Three years later, Damon believes Vivienne, the woman wearing Aria's stolen pendant, is his savior. He calls Aria a liar, gives her to his warriors as a reward, and ties her to the border for execution. Aria has no voice, no wolf, and no pack left to trust. Then Frostfang's Caleb cuts her free. With her voice returning and her pendant back in hand, Aria walks into Blackthorn as Ravyn Vale to expose the fraud and reject the Alpha who ruined her.
6a5db4bdb72949b20d0fdcb9.title: The Alpha Made His Savior the Pack's Slave

6a5db5c7607675185a0af2fb.synopsis: After five years stranded on Mars, Evelyn Carter returns to Earth expecting a reunion, only to be branded unstable by Ethan, Mia, and the powerful Vaughn family. Her mother's final message was hidden, her commendation was suppressed, and her sacrifice was rewritten as a scandal. With Noah's help, Evelyn restores the black box records, exposes the cover-up, and takes back the name they tried to bury.
6a5db5c7607675185a0af2fb.title: Stardust and Lies

6a5dc49f92835bc7bb000b61.synopsis: Ann’s family destroyed Dane’s entire pack. Dane hates her, but he is forced to marry her. On their wedding night, he marks her in front of everyone, throws morning-after pills at her feet, and leaves her for another woman. But Ann is already pregnant with his twins. Heartbroken, she breaks their bond, fakes her death, and runs away. When Dane finally realizes he loves her, it is too late. Now he must spend his life chasing the wife and children he threw away.
6a5dc49f92835bc7bb000b61.title: Blood and Silver

6a5dc4a1b30cbe1ede0594fe.synopsis: Ann’s family destroyed Dane’s entire pack. Dane hates her, but he is forced to marry her. On their wedding night, he marks her in front of everyone, throws morning-after pills at her feet, and leaves her for another woman. But Ann is already pregnant with his twins. Heartbroken, she breaks their bond, fakes her death, and runs away. When Dane finally realizes he loves her, it is too late. Now he must spend his life chasing the wife and children he threw away.
6a5dc4a1b30cbe1ede0594fe.title: Silver Curse

6a5de4cb2eb293969e01b197.synopsis: Princess Helena is ordered to share her wedding day, her husband, and her throne with Damon, Leah, and a child passed off as his heir. Instead of yielding, she removes her ring and activates the Black Shield Guard left by her late father. With Cassius at her side, Helena exposes treason, stolen army grain, a false heir, and the murder of the king, then rebuilds Sparta on her own terms.
6a5de4cb2eb293969e01b197.title: Share a husband? You're not worthy

6a5ed3717990cea9e702b93f.synopsis: An ordinary guy, Max, gets a system that grants him all sorts of skills. Just as he's about to win the ultimate prize, one bad review from Rita resets everything. Desperate to fix his rating, he goes all out to win her over!
6a5ed3717990cea9e702b93f.title: Final Skill: Win Her Heart

6a5f0760f7da29c9930dd433.synopsis: Gideon chained Cora to an altar and fed her to the Deep King. The monster didn't tear her apart. Soren unlocked her chains, kissed her, and gave her half his heart-stone so she could breathe the sea. She married him. She loved him. Then Gideon returned. He cut out Soren's heart and crushed the stone in front of her. Cora woke in the enemy's camp, poisoned again, stripped of everything—until she felt a kick inside her belly. Soren's child. The one they said could never exist. Now she carries the last of the Deep King's blood. The sea is calling her home. And this time, she's not coming back as a sacrifice. She's coming back as their queen.
6a5f0760f7da29c9930dd433.title: The Monster Made Her Queen

6a5f0823b6b9ea5a800376f0.synopsis: After ten years with her childhood love Adrian, Evelyn is repeatedly blamed and humiliated because of Sienna's schemes. Adrian keeps threatening to break up with her through posts saying "100 likes and we’re done." This time, Evelyn gives the post its 100th like and leaves for Stanford. When Adrian finally sees the truth and begs for another chance, Evelyn has already chosen her own future.
6a5f0823b6b9ea5a800376f0.title: I Liked Our Breakup Post

6a5f1057e2a59d2e2605759e.synopsis: Massimo Livoti is the most dangerous mafioso in the country… and he’s your bitter enemy. When you accidentally sleep with him, you’re shocked that it turns into an unwanted marriage. Forced into enemy territory, you don’t know who you can trust. With everything you love under threat, will you step up and take your place by Massimo's side?
6a5f1057e2a59d2e2605759e.title: His Mafia Queen

6a5f32b02d9c74faad04b00c.synopsis: Twenty-four years after Ethan Holt abandoned her, Ava Stone returns with power, capital, and one impossible demand: she wants his son, Noah, as her fiance. Their engagement becomes the blade that opens old crimes inside the Holt Group, from stolen trust funds to a deadly family cover-up. Ava came back for revenge, but she leaves with justice and a man who chooses freedom with her.
6a5f32b02d9c74faad04b00c.title: The Queen's Revenge

6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.synopsis: Karter, the legendary Poker King lost everything when he reported Aaron for money laundering 3 years ago. He was rescued by Elena, the daughter of a small casino's owner. When Aaron returns to put Elena and the casino in danger, Karter gives up his disguise as a humble waiter, and reveals his true identity.
6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.title: The Poker King Returns

6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.synopsis: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod disguised as a beggar finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must reveal his true identity to protect her, risking the secret he was bound to keep.
6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.title: Her Man Is the Son of Death

6a6030ba1ee6c0486900da8c.synopsis: Evelyn Shaw believed Adrian Grant loved her. To the world, he was the devoted husband who kissed her at galas and called her his only weakness. But after years of kidnappings, scars, and a lost child, Evelyn discovers the truth: Adrian built their marriage to make her a decoy wife, a public target meant to keep his real love, Maya Cole, safe. When she uncovers his diary, hidden money transfers, and the lies behind every “rescue,” Evelyn uses Maya’s arrogance to secure Adrian’s signature, files for divorce, erases her trail, and disappears. By the time Adrian realizes what he destroyed, Evelyn has already chosen herself.
6a6030ba1ee6c0486900da8c.title: His Decoy Wife

6a60312dd082ebff8b06879a.synopsis: “Did you get rejected?!” My sister Jade laughs at me. “I knew it! I told you that you would. No one would ever want you. A wolfless. But I’m more surprised that you, of all people, found a fated mate. Kind of unfair if you ask me.” It stings to hear this. It’s exactly what happened. She was right. “Well, let’s not let this bring us down.” Mother smiles and claps. “It’s been decided that Jade is to be mated to the fourth wolf prince. ” Jade smirks. “One of the bastard illegitimate princes, but I’m not complaining.” She smiles with pride. “He’s still a prince.” The crowd suddenly grow noisy. The princes arrive. “Alpha Prince Dorian, the fourth prince, Antonio the fifth, and Emmet the sixth—all of them illegitimate.” All three men wave with broad smiles. Suddenly, another man hurries past them. “That’s Alpha Prince Raphael! Second born to a true royal‑blooded Luna.” The stunning blond man—his hair lighter than even my mother’s or sister’s—strides forward with an imposing pace. His bright blue eyes gleam beneath the black suit and satin shirt, half‑unbuttoned to reveal the edge of his tattoos. I freeze as his gaze locks onto mine. Time itself seems to stop, because that man… is him. The one who broke my heart. The one who rejected me. The one who shattered our bond. My fated mate.
6a60312dd082ebff8b06879a.title: The Raven Wolf King: Wolfless

6a6031b4b2718b63ba0debeb.synopsis: Elena has been quietly supplying Lionheart with royal-grade dragon gear, helping them win two championships while charging only a fraction of its value. But when newcomer Vivienne calls her work overpriced, Captain Arthur believes the lie, kicks Elena out, and chooses cheap five-silver gear instead. At the royal dragon race, the fake equipment fails inside the lightning gate, while Elena’s real gear carries the rival Silver Wolf team to a record-breaking win. With the evidence made public, the kingdom learns the real scam was never her price, but their greed and betrayal.
6a6031b4b2718b63ba0debeb.title: They Called My Dragon Gear a Scam

6a6031b6939b5006a8001c1b.synopsis: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.
6a6031b6939b5006a8001c1b.title: The Boy the QB Used in Bed

6a6032183c861b8b8805cd9d.synopsis: Before my Alpha husband poisoned me, he said, “You’ve fulfilled your purpose.” I was reborn on the day he came to our door with the marriage contract. In front of everyone, I tore it apart and refused him. My mother called me insane, but my younger sister dragged me into a room, trembling all over. “Sister, after you died, he married me too. He cut off my limbs, gouged out my eyes, and left me only my voice, so I could sing for him every night.” In our last life, both of us sisters were nothing but his tools. In this life, he won’t get either of us.
6a6032183c861b8b8805cd9d.title: Two Husbands, Three Lives

6a603335b43f3ec5e80e092a.synopsis: I am Wren, an Omega. My Alpha mate, Kade, lost his memory after falling from a cliff. He fell in love with the nurse who saved him and completely forgot me. After being reborn, I stopped trying to awaken his memories. I watched him burn my silver wolf hunting knife, smash the moonstone wall engraved with our names, and place the wolf-fang necklace he had once carved for me around her neck. When she faked a fall into the water, he shoved me under. When the kidnappers sank us into the lake and forced him to choose one of us, he chose her to live. I sank beneath the surface, and the mate mark on the side of my neck split open. Kade, the life-saving debt from my past life and my letting go in this one are both fully repaid. Let’s never meet again.
6a603335b43f3ec5e80e092a.title: The Alpha Forgot Me, So I Let Him Go

6a6033a807e23079ca015d8b.synopsis: Elara Weir was born with Sunblood, but in her powerful family, she was never treated like a daughter. She was made into a scapegoat: whenever her gifted brother Kaylan failed, Elara paid the price. On the night before the Solar Crown Trial, their mother locks her inside the Moonfrost Chamber, a forbidden room that can freeze Sunblood magic from the inside out. Kaylan begs, their father arrives too late, and Elara dies betrayed by the family she tried to survive. But the scapegoat ritual does not end with death, and her next life may finally set her free.
6a6033a807e23079ca015d8b.title: The Sunblood Girl Frozen to Death

6a6033aa2ba345fe32007a6a.synopsis: After being accused of betraying her Alpha, Evelyn is publicly rejected by Kane White Lion, the powerful leader of the White Lion clan. He offers her a hundred million dollars to disappear, unaware that she is carrying his four rare silver-maned cubs. Refusing to be bought or humiliated, Evelyn runs to an Omega sanctuary, determined to protect her unborn children alone. But when the truth comes out, Kane’s regret arrives too late. As his clan, his enemies, and his own guilt close in, Evelyn must decide whether a broken bond can ever be repaired.
6a6033aa2ba345fe32007a6a.title: Broken contract and four cubs

6a6035c0f2b19bb318052a0b.synopsis: I ran from my arranged wedding after catching my fiancé in bed with another woman. That same night, I lost my virginity to a stranger—only to discover he was my fiancé all along. When I became pregnant, he looked me in the eye and said, “Get rid of the baby.” I walked away for good... until his powerful rival offered me a new life. Now two mafia heirs are fighting for me, but only one deserves my heart. The problem? The man who broke me refuses to let me go.
6a6035c0f2b19bb318052a0b.title: Two Mafia Bosses Begging Me For Love

6a603610db0b2f6baa08d6de.synopsis: Elara is the Moon's Voice—whatever she speaks becomes real. To save the world, she swore silence for ten years. Her husband Roman believed Vanessa's lies that Elara betrayed him. He cut off her hand, blinded her eyes, slaughtered her entire family—all to force her blessing. When her seven-year-old sister's head rolled to her feet, Elara finally screamed her first words in a decade. But she didn't speak a blessing. She spoke a curse: “The Lycan King's reign is rotten. The world will break.” Roman's kingdom crumbled. Frostmoon crushed him. Vanessa's heir was exposed as a bastard. Roman burned his own hall to let Elara escape. Ten years later, a new Lycan King united all packs—a strong age built without any Moon's Voice at all.
6a603610db0b2f6baa08d6de.title: The Mute Luna and Her Cursed Word

6a6059c96a805ace3109c7e6.synopsis: When a future version of her rival crashes into the present with a terrifying warning, motocross star Tessa learns that falling in love with Riggs Heartstone will end in tragedy. Now she's stuck as his racing partner, fighting their chemistry while racing toward the biggest competition of her life. But the harder she tries to save him, the harder she falls.
6a6059c96a805ace3109c7e6.title: Boyfriend from the Future

6a6095f6d9ab3292c807c4ff.synopsis: She discovers her mob boss husband's affair and loses one of her twin babies due to his adopted sister's schemes. She reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, she runs into him on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when he drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth. Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. The ruthless mafia boss only wants one thing—to win her love back.
6a6095f6d9ab3292c807c4ff.title: Torn Between the Mafia Twins

6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.synopsis: Exiled half-beast prince Cassian storms back from the dead, slaughters his father, and seizes the throne in a bloodbath. His first
6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.title: Crowned in His Claws

6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.synopsis: In 2006, Marcel "The Sniper" Wallace wins THE LEAGUE title, then loses his wife to rival Tyler Murray's hitman. He vanishes into a fast-food job for twenty years. Lured back as coach, he reunites with his resentful son Mars, a LEAGUE star. Marcel proves himself through impossible shots while Murray escalates to kidnapping and blackmail. At the Hall of Fame, Marcel reveals his identity and Murray confesses to murder. Victory comes when Mars accepts twenty unsent birthday letters and they embrace.
6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.title: Full Court Legend

6a617638677231413606d68b.synopsis: Ravena Mooncrest, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Draven Nightfang. But Draven mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Ravena cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Draven to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?
6a617638677231413606d68b.title: You Betrayed the Wrong Alpha Queen

6a61fcc096fa2a8c010882d3.synopsis: On the night of her dream wedding, Silicon Valley heiress Avery Stone learns her new husband, Ethan Vale, slept with another woman “to practice” and is leaving their bridal suite to legally marry her. When Ethan uses a secret intimate video to trap Avery in their billion-dollar merger marriage, she stops crying and starts planning. His mistress tries to expose Avery online, but Avery flips the trap, turning Ethan’s own verified account into a global scandal. As his empire collapses, obsession, pregnancy, blackmail, and revenge spiral into a deadly final confrontation, while Avery fights to reclaim her name, power, and heart.
