6a61fcc096fa2a8c010882d3.title: The Bride He Betrayed

6a61fcc5e1c7863b130cc0eb.synopsis: Nora Hayes is a brilliant drug researcher and the true daughter of the Hayes family, but her brother Mason, her best friend Emma, and the adopted Lily all choose to erase her. To steal Nora’s drug launch and hand the spotlight to Lily, Mason arranges a brutal attack, destroys Nora’s reputation, and even delays the surgery that could save her future. After uncovering years of stolen credit, including the kidney she gave Emma and the fire where she saved Mason, Nora stops begging to be believed. With Professor Voss’s help, she disappears into a protected life in France, relearns how to work, creates a breakthrough drug, and returns as someone they can no longer break.
6a61fcc5e1c7863b130cc0eb.title: The Second Wound

6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.synopsis: Everyone's always told Nora to keep her head down and stay silent, but there's one exception — Vince Grant, her husband. As their
6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.title: Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant

6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.synopsis: A lifetime ago, figure skating prodigy Gwen Tyler was at the top of her game and on her way to Olympic gold. But ten years later,
6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.title: Take Me Back to the Night We Met

6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.synopsis: In Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival movie, after ten years of loving Ryan, Jade Gray is asked to seduce his billionaire rival, Asher Blackwood, to help save Ryan’s first love, Eleanor. But Asher secretly has feelings for Jade, turning Ryan’s carefully planned scheme into a dangerous love triangle. As Jade grows closer to Asher, she begins to question who truly deserves her love.
6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.title: Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival

6a62c99877ad3657000aa34d.synopsis: Bullied for ten years, human girl Lia turns sixteen — and the two most dangerous Alphas in town both claim her as their fated mate. One has secretly protected her for a decade, never daring to come close. The other cuts a deal with werewolf hunters to make her his. A forced mark. Hunters in the dark. Nights she vanishes from her bed — and wakes up covered in blood. As every conspiracy points back to her birth, the truth surfaces: she is the Moon Goddess's lost daughter. On the night of the Blood Moon, war swallows the town, and the man she loves takes the fatal shot meant for her. Grief awakens the goddess within — the battlefield freezes, wolves kneel, and a single command shatters an entire army. She rips him back from death itself. But something else came back with him…
6a62c99877ad3657000aa34d.title: Mated to Two Bad Boy Alphas

6a62cf6aaa2d9518cb09947d.synopsis: Yale's younger brother steals the coveted SSS-class mech core, believing it will make him humanity's savior, unaware it's actually bait for disaster. Seeing through the trap, Yale chooses the ridiculed F-class "junk" core and is exiled to a frontier star system. Teaming up with three fellow outcasts, he unlocks its hidden power and builds the galaxy's strongest mech squad. When the false hero falls, Yale becomes humanity's only hope.
6a62cf6aaa2d9518cb09947d.title: The Fake Hero Never Saw Me Coming

6a62f9e7063e662fac0cdd13.synopsis: Ivy endured two years of cold marriage to Commander Ian, a wolf shifter who never wanted a human wife. When the Marriage Bureau reveals their perfect match was a system error, she finally asks for a divorce—only for Ian to refuse. The distant husband who once barely came home now won't stay away. As the truth about her real perfect match emerges, Ivy must choose: return to her own world, or stay with the man fighting fate to prove their bond was never a mistake.
6a62f9e7063e662fac0cdd13.title: The Wolf Commander's Wrong Bride

6a62fae10fe809fbcb097c73.synopsis: Ava is reborn on the day of her parents' divorce hearing, determined not to drag her powerful CEO mother into ruin again. She pretends to choose her gambling father while secretly exposing her illness, Lily's manipulation, and the family's boardroom schemes. This time, her mother refuses to sacrifice either her daughter or herself.
6a62fae10fe809fbcb097c73.title: Mom, I will protect you this time

6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.synopsis: Leo, the legendary surfing champion, loses his title to a mysterious newcomer named Ruslan. But the biggest shock comes when he discovers that Ruslan is the man from his unforgettable night. Forced into an uneasy partnership, the two rivals find themselves drawn to each other as secrets, danger, and betrayal close in. Behind their battle for glory lies a hidden truth about Ruslan—and their forbidden desire has only just begun...
6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.title: Caught in His Current

6a63772875b2eafae30ae376.synopsis: Ava once saved Ethan after he was drugged, only to be forced into a marriage that made him hate her until her death. Reborn on the same night, she refuses to be his antidote, cuts him out of her life, protects her grandfather, and exposes Chloe's lies. This life is not about making Ethan regret her; it is about walking toward someone who truly catches her.
6a63772875b2eafae30ae376.title: Uncle, I don't want you anymore

6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.synopsis: Reese Calder orders a custom companion android, 006, with the face of Nolan Vance, her spoiled, maddening lifelong rival. By day,
6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.title: My Sex Robot Has My Enemy's Face

6a66b7bc7fa17f5a61022469.synopsis: Mira's betrothed spent three years taming a wild dragon for their wedding—but he trained it to obey Lia, her family's adopted daughter. They took everything from her: her place in the clan, her inheritance, even her mother's dragon. When they demanded she kneel and wipe Lia's boots, Mira walked barefoot across burning coals instead. She broke the betrothal. Then a column of black war-dragons descended, and their lord claimed her—with a bloodwing dragon and three thousand acres of dragonland. He was the man who had waited eight years for her answer. On her wedding day, her old betrothed watched from the crowd as Mira married another man. And the dragon he had stolen finally threw Lia to the ground and flew home—to Mira.
6a66b7bc7fa17f5a61022469.title: My Dragon, Not Hers

6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.synopsis: Cora took in three wounded wolves and raised them. The moment her sister Vivian appeared, the wolves couldn't look away—they turned cold and rough, trying to break Cora. She overheard them mocking her. So she offered a trade: three wolves for Vivian's snake. Silas the snake was ice-cold, yet he stayed—doing chores, guarding her. When her family forced an arranged marriage, Cora faked agreement, then fled through a window on her wedding day. Silas tracked her to the airport, injuring two wolves who tried to stop him. “You'll never get rid of me,” he said. Cora took over the family business and bonded with Silas. The cold snake was truer than any wolf.
6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.title: Traded My Wolves for a Snake

6a66b7bf7fa17f5a6102246f.synopsis: On the night before her engagement, Celeste Yarrow is locked inside a rooftop glass greenhouse by Ingrid Sloane, drenched in freezing water while the guests film and laugh. Damien Thorne, the man she spent three years saving, refuses to protect her and even exposes her deepest trauma for Ingrid’s amusement. Everyone thinks Celeste is just a small-town woman clinging to power, but she is the real force behind Yarrow Capital and the projects that made Thorne rise. After shattering the glass cage herself, Celeste cancels the engagement, pulls her investment, releases the evidence, and makes every betrayer pay.
6a66b7bf7fa17f5a6102246f.title: The Glass Cage

6a66b7c17fa17f5a61022472.synopsis: Xanthea Plath, an illegitimate child of the Alpha of Virgo pack, was an omega and omegas weren't allowed to dream, yet she never stopped dreaming. She wanted to be a doctor just like her mother but the luna of the pack, her stepmother would break her physically and mentally and stop at nothing to crush all her dreams. Xanthea had still found a way though all the abuse her steps put her through. But one day her world came crashing down right before her entrance in a medical college when she found out that she was being offered as a bride to the ruthless triplet alphas also known as the demon lords of the Infernal pack of the underworld. Xanthea had heard the horrifying stories of several suitors who had come before her, all of whom had met a gruesome end.
6a66b7c17fa17f5a61022472.title: Offered to the triplet Alpha

6a66b7c47fa17f5a61022478.synopsis: Hazel is dragged back to House Vance as the lost daughter Seraphine, but they only see a rogue-marked woman with two children. Her parents shame her, Roman rejects their birth contract for Celeste, and House Vance even tries to sell Hazel to a councilman by using her children as leverage. They all think her mate is a nameless rogue. Then the Alpha King's gala begins. Lucian arrives, names Hazel his only Luna and the mother of his heirs, and reveals the truth: the woman they called filthy is the War-Marshal who saved the Vale.
6a66b7c47fa17f5a61022478.title: The Rogue-Marked Mom Is the Alpha King’s Luna

6a66b7c57fa17f5a6102247b.synopsis: Alpha Derek storms into Chloe's empty cabin, demanding she take the blame for Selena again. He doesn't know Chloe, his rejected mate, died three years ago after he forced Selena's crimes onto her. Her ghost watches him threaten her dead sister, believe Selena's lies, and finally uncover the truth: Chloe lost her Healer title, Zoe lost her medicine, and both sisters died because Derek chose the wrong woman. Now he can expose Selena and clear Chloe's name, but he can never bring his mate back.
6a66b7c57fa17f5a6102247b.title: Rejected Mate, Restless Ghost

6a66bb4ca2a3e3cefd03bf4a.synopsis: In my past life, I was a pure-blooded white dragon who gave everything to help him seize the throne—only to have that hypocrite Igon sever my wings, steal my child, shatter my egg, and summon heavenly thunder to strike me down. With my dying breath, I swore on my blood: if I ever returned, I would make him pay a hundredfold! I open my eyes to find myself back at the royal consort selection ceremony—the very day he chose my half-sister Jean instead, and tried to ruin my name with a so-called "divine prophecy." Fine. I sneak straight into the forbidden depths and claim the legendary ancient Golden Dragon, Cedric, as my mate—conceiving the supreme dragon heir! The scumbag gloats as his egg hatches a golden dragon, taunting me that my black egg could only produce a lowly black dragon. But when my egg cracks open—a rainbow-colored Supreme Saint Dragon emerges, crushing his shadowy black dragon whelp in an instant! With our bet sealed, I raise my blade and sever his wings, ripping off his false golden dragon disguise for all to see— Wait. The "black dragon" mate I picked up on a whim… is the undisputed pinnacle of all dragonkind?! "My dear, for the sake of saving dragon bloodline, we'll just have to try a few more times." He chuckles, pulling me closer by the waist. This rebirth? Totally worth it.
6a66bb4ca2a3e3cefd03bf4a.title: Golden Dragon Mother’s Rampage

6a66bbf41925a6ea440cc029.synopsis: Married To The Devil is an original short-form drama that blends modern fantasy, dark romance, and a story of destiny and redemption. The story follows Angela, a young woman whose life is shattered by betrayal, suffering, and forces beyond her control. At the darkest point of her journey, she encounters Lucifer — a mysterious and powerful man who carries the loneliness of eternity and possesses a hidden identity that will change everything. As their fates become intertwined, Angela discovers that Lucifer is not an ordinary human, but the ruler of Hell. Caught between Heaven, humanity, and his own destiny, Lucifer must choose between the overwhelming power he possesses and the love that has awakened something within him. Meanwhile, Angela transforms from someone defined by her pain into a woman who finds her own strength and chooses her own destiny. Centered around the forbidden love between a demon and a human, Married To The Devil explores themes of identity, sacrifice, redemption, and the power of choice through dramatic revelations, emotional conflicts, and supernatural challenges. With a gothic visual aesthetic, a modern fantasy mythology, and an intense emotional core, the series reimagines the legend of the Devil — revealing that the greatest power is not the ability to destroy the world, but the courage to change for someone you love.
6a66bbf41925a6ea440cc029.title: Married to the Devil

6a66bcda57f05e0f510c12da.synopsis: 1994 Chicago. Lucy bandages a stranger, not knowing he is Ace Cavallo, a feared mafia boss who claims her as his wife. When her fiancé and uncle sell her at her wedding, Ace saves her, offering 30 days as his wife for her mother's surgery. She accepts, learns he already paid. Through betrayals and attacks, Lucy finds devotion beneath his violence and confesses love. The Carters kidnap her. Ace wins a deadly blackjack gamble but takes a bullet. They wed in an empty church and ride into the night.
6a66bcda57f05e0f510c12da.title: The Mafia Boss Who Loves Me

6a66bd9349bced6d830bf871.synopsis: Emily’s late husband Ethan was a decorated war hero. Their teen daughter Ava is kidnapped, tortured and framed for theft by rich heir Jason and his corrupt father Richard. Emily pleads with police and school for help yet gets shut out. She carries Ethan's coffin and medals to a military base to beg for justice. Supported by a general and Ethan's surviving ally Marcus, they expose a big plot. The Whitmores steal veterans' funds. With surveillance proof presented at the hearing, all villains get arrested. Ava proves her innocence...
6a66bd9349bced6d830bf871.title: When the Hero's Daughter Was Bullied, I Carried a Coffin to the Military District

6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.synopsis: Tessa’s crush throws her cinnamon roll in the trash and calls her a fat pig in front of the whole class. When she finally stops be
6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.title: The Ugly Girl Turned Pretty

6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.synopsis: In Sold to the Warlord Born for the Sky movie, a sheltered northern princess who was sold into marriage to the dragon-riding warlord of the brutal Blackclaw horde must decide whether surrendering to the man who bought her is her greatest betrayal or the only thing that can save her dying people.
6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.title: Sold to the Warlord, Born for the Sky

6a6733958d893bb4600e0595.synopsis: Erin Vance’s 18th wedding anniversary turns into a nightmare when she discovers her husband Derek cheating with her best friend Sofia. Betrayed and abandoned, Erin is forced to start over with nothing. With help from Gavin Bower, she enters the “Miss Intercontinental” contest and rises from a housewife to a champion through her talent and determination. Defeating Sofia and exposing her scandals, Erin rebuilds her life. Gavin, secretly the president of K Group, supports her while letting her prove herself. After overcoming betrayal and danger, Erin regains her dignity and begins a new chapter with Gavin.
6a6733958d893bb4600e0595.title: I Became the CEO's Most Beloved

6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.synopsis: Based on the novel by Cora Reilly. As the heir to the Chicago mafia, Dante is logical to a fault. The only thing Valentina has in common with him is being a widow. When Dante chooses her as his next wife, it's a business decision made by a man still haunted from losing the love of his life. But Valentina won't repeat the lovelessness of her first marriage. As she struggles with her own desire for her new husband, little does she know -- his heart may have already started beating for her.
6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.title: Bound by Duty

6a67d06112cc28505607205a.synopsis: In God of Pain movie, a sheltered mafia princess tries to escape an arranged marriage, only to fall for the school’s most dangerous bad boy. But he refuses to love her… Until he can’t let her go.
6a67d06112cc28505607205a.title: God of Pain

6a680a0ee4b3871eb50e9f9b.synopsis: Isabella gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But when he's promoted to Alpha's General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Isabella is the lost wolf princess — destined to be Alpha Queen — and he'll regret letting her go.
6a680a0ee4b3871eb50e9f9b.title: She Bows for No One

6a6840b466a2c8d67608a4c6.synopsis: When disaster threatens their homeland, Jay joins forces with Magnus, Deimos, Winter, and their allies to protect their world and preserve hope. Facing endless challenges, they fight with courage, unity, and selfless sacrifice. Through battles and life-or-death trials, Jay and his companions prove the true meaning of heroism, defeat every threat, and bring peace, renewal, and a new beginning to their world.
6a6840b466a2c8d67608a4c6.title: My Afterlife Tavern Has the World's Strongest Guardians

6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.synopsis: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own pack and hunted
6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.title: Fated to His Brother's Alpha

6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.synopsis: “It’s just a formality.” Reynolds threw those words in Eliot’s face on their wedding day, leaving him behind to greet his comrade. Four years of lies, another Alpha’s scent on Reynolds’ skin.Eliot didn’t cry. He ripped off his ring, threw it at Reynolds’ feet, and walked into the hall across.Vaughn had been waiting there for four years. White roses. Starlight lamps. A ring he’d kept since they were kids. He spent four years climbing four ranks just to rewrite the law that locked Omegas out of the mech bay. He never told Eliot. He just pried the door open and waited.
6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.title: The Alpha Commander’s Long-Awaited Omega

6a6849207434a5b9ed0f8048.synopsis: Lyric, an Alpha’s scarred and wolf-less daughter, was betrayed by her mate and exiled after a one-night stand with a powerful stranger. Five years in the human world cured her face and awakened a forbidden gift: she is a "Siphon," able to absorb any disease. Forced back by family debt, Lyric enters a contract marriage with the ruthless King Jaris—only to realize he was her one-night stranger. Misled by his scheming "wife" Marta into believing Lyric betrayed him, Jaris is cruel by day, yet so obsessed with her body that he drugs her by night for secret intimacy, leaving Lyric believing it’s all a vivid dream. But the secrets run deeper: Lyric’s presumed-dead twins are alive, stolen by Marta to claim the throne. And from the shadows, Jaris’s exiled brother Caden is returning with a blood-drinking army to burn it all down.
6a6849207434a5b9ed0f8048.title: The Rise of the Ugly Luna

6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.synopsis: At Waverly University, the ice rink is split in two: on one side, the hockey team trains with brutal intensity; on the other, the
6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.title: Offside with the Hockey Star

6a68b826e39ad393b709c15b.synopsis: I married mafia heir Vance at twenty and cared for his trauma for five years. He loathed my touch, burned my birthday gift, and let his beloved Iris wander his private study I was banned from. After he was drugged and hurt me cruelly, I begged the godfather for a divorce. When I packed bags and fled to the seaside to grab freedom, Vance broke down without me. He finally spilled his bloody childhood secret and composed a song only for me. Yet he signed divorce papers, gifting me freedom. Will we meet again after I leave everything behind?
6a68b826e39ad393b709c15b.title: Mafia Boss Never Loved Me

6a6961979c32db374502042c.synopsis: Reborn as a serpent outcast, Aurelia is sent to a frozen wasteland as a sacrifice. After a mysterious encounter, she returns with a shocking secret that turns the entire kingdom upside down.
6a6961979c32db374502042c.title: The Serpent Queen's Rebirth

6a6971a0e0753757f40f04d0.synopsis: Betrayed by his fiancée, a poor farmer storms into Steelhaven to uncover the truth. After saving a tycoon’s daughter and facing humiliation, he vows to start over. With nothing but courage, he rises from a laborer to a billionaire legend.
6a6971a0e0753757f40f04d0.title: Rise of a Tycoon

6a6971a2d8c89204f10212bb.synopsis: Mother's mysterious death, stepmother's deadly conspiracy, hateful brother... Thomas decides to pose as a wastrel to fool everyone. But his father hires Harper, a bodyguard known as the God of Slaughter, to protect him. Now, who'll outsmart whom?
6a6971a2d8c89204f10212bb.title: The Wastrel & The Assassin

6a697704372818095101b114.synopsis: Mother's mysterious death, stepmother's deadly conspiracy, hateful brother... Thomas decides to pose as a wastrel to fool everyone. But his father hires Harper, a bodyguard known as the God of Slaughter, to protect him. Now, who'll outsmart whom?
6a697704372818095101b114.title: The Wastrel & The Assassin

6a69770603f1d48a7a07723e.synopsis: Betrayed by his fiancée, a poor farmer storms into Steelhaven to uncover the truth. After saving a tycoon’s daughter and facing humiliation, he vows to start over. With nothing but courage, he rises from a laborer to a billionaire legend.
6a69770603f1d48a7a07723e.title: Rise of a Tycoon

6a69994b1e93a53dfc0ca73e.synopsis: Clara takes the fall for her family's favored adopted daughter, and spends years behind bars. The day she walks free, she makes a devastating discovery. Every song, script and business plans she's ever created has been stolen by her own family. They've disowned her completely. No more begging for love. No more playing nice. With her raw, buried talent, she’s fighting back to reclaim everything. And they will pay.
6a69994b1e93a53dfc0ca73e.title: Rising from theAshes, I Cut All Blood Ties

6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.synopsis: Bankrupt heiress Isolde signs a three-year mistress contract with Savien Thorne, heir to the Thorn Group, just to cover her mother’s life-saving medical bills. The second the contract ends, she’s ready to walk away for good. Until she finds out she’s pregnant. His arranged fiancée learns the secret, and torments her at every turn. Worse — she’s never been anything but a double for the other woman. She moves out and cuts all ties. But he’s not letting her get away.
6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.title: His Caged Love

6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.synopsis: Ethan Cole, a top-tier aviation legend in his previous life, dies as a national aviation legend. He is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. Only this time, he knows the truth: Flight 8236 is going to crash, and everyone on board will die. At 9,000 meters above sea level, fire begins to burn along the wings. The fuselage cracks open into freezing air. As panic spreads across the cabin, Ethan realizes he is the only one who understands what is coming. Trapped in a child’s body, he must stop the disaster and save his father—the man he loves most—before it is too late.
6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.title: The Eight-Year-Old Captain

6a69bbba1893284da90e5a36.synopsis: Joelle believed her husband wanted nothing more than to get rid of her. He demanded divorce again and again, flaunted a pregnant mistress, and even drugged her before sending her back to the ex she once loved. Only after her tragic death did she learn the truth. There was never another woman. Every betrayal was a lie, every cruel word a performance, because Sutton was dying of terminal cancer and wanted her to hate him before he was gone. Reborn on the day he asked for their ninety-ninth divorce, Joelle refuses to let the man who loved her more than his own life sacrifice everything again. This time, she's determined to rewrite their ending before it's too late.
6a69bbba1893284da90e5a36.title: 99 Divorces, Then My Husband Died for Me

6a69bbbb1893284da90e5a39.synopsis: Chloe freezes to death after giving her last food to the husband and son she thinks are trapped in a deadly blizzard. But as her soul leaves the storage room, she sees the truth: there was no disaster, only a cruel punishment staged by her husband, brother, son, and the fake heiress they all protected. While they feast upstairs and call her a liar, Chloe's body becomes the evidence that exposes every betrayal and drags the whole family into ruin.
6a69bbbb1893284da90e5a39.title: Frozen by the Man She Loved

6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.synopsis: A gifted contract mage, Layla, spent her past life collecting ninety-nine sacred cores to help her contracted beast, the Sacred Wh
6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.title: After the Sacred Whale Betrayed Me, I Contracted Poseidon

6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.synopsis: To discover who truly loves them, wealthy couple Hannah and her husband fake bankruptcy, with him pretending to be paralyzed after a stroke. Their test exposes the truth: their biological son Thomas and his wife refuse to help and turn them away, while adopted son Theo and his wife give up everything to save him. After learning the truth, Hannah and her husband leave their $50 million fortune to Theo. Thomas loses everything and finally realizes that true family is built on love, not blood.
6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.title: The Billionaire Parents' Final Test

6a6adc4372e65640410ab2a3.synopsis: I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence.I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence. Everyone here wields real power — vampires, werewolves, dragon clan, witches — while I survive on street performer tricks and sleight of hand. If I'm exposed, what awaits me is worse than death. But I had to come: my sister died here. The academy called it an "accident." I know better — her killer is somewhere on these grounds. I kept my head down, stayed invisible. It wasn't enough. The blood heir, the wolf clan's little prince… the most powerful men in this academy are closing in on me one by one, marking me, declaring in front of everyone: "You're mine." Are they falling for me — or have they already uncovered my secret?
6a6adc4372e65640410ab2a3.title: Fake Witch Claimed by Two Heirs

6a6ae33772acafdfe00daafc.synopsis: Claire Morgan was born to inherit an empire. She married beneath her for love, only to become her husband's stepping stone. His old flame taunts her, his family leeches off her, and even her own family tries to push her around. But they underestimate her. Claire divorces the cheater, crushes every scheme, and sends anyone who tries to kill her to prison! After everything, she finally realizes she doesn't need a man at all.
6a6ae33772acafdfe00daafc.title: Mrs. Grant Is Single Now

6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.synopsis: No mate, no wolf, and raising a pup alone, Ella never expected one act of kindness to tie her fate to Alpha Torin, who is cursed to never touch a woman. When she becomes the wet nurse to his newborn heir, Ella is pulled into a deadly game of jealousy and betrayal inside the Alpha's keep.
6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.title: Thirsty for the Wet Nurse

6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.synopsis: After surviving a month of kidnapping and torture, Claire returns home with severe PTSD, only to be misunderstood and humiliated b
6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.title: Once Love Is Lost, It Never Returns

6a6c022bedfbef3f380fbfb9.synopsis: Eli got busted watching gay porn, and now the whole campus knows he's into guys. One of them is the guy he likes—but he's not the only one watching. The other roommate claims he hates him, yet he keeps falling deeper, step by step. Now both roommates are going feral over him—one with sweet traps, the other with raw possession. Eli's move? He keeps them both in his grip. The rule is simple: he picks no one. Want to stay? Play by his rules.
6a6c022bedfbef3f380fbfb9.title: My Two Dangerous Roommates Crave Me

6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.synopsis: I lied about my age and ghosted my clingy online boyfriend half a year ago. Staying at my best friend’s house for break, I froze—her cold, CEO older brother Rhys was exactly the man I dumped online. He recognized me just by my voice and kept testing me nonstop. Later at a bar, he chugged eight drinks to shield me from a creep guy who drugged me. Trapped in his car, he recited every fake detail I told him online, staring at me: “Did you ever regret leaving me?”
6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.title: The Cold CEO Who Spoiled Me Online

6a6c718e315e5376ba0d263e.synopsis: A woman's vacation plans leave her husband stranded at the airport, despite his years of support. She refuses to buy his $890 ticket but gives $15k to a friend, who turns out to be a scammer. Unbeknownst to all, the "useless moocher" is actually the billionaire chairman of the Loxley Group.
6a6c718e315e5376ba0d263e.title: Ticket Denied, Divorce Filed

6a6ff241989753f010020609.synopsis: Born with super strength, Dorin hid her martial arts talent since women were barred from martial arts. When Sky City and the Mann family were in danger, only Dorin could fight for them. Tricked into destroying her powers to save her kin, she watched them perish. Saved and healed by a master, Dorin returns for revenge.
6a6ff241989753f010020609.title: The Forbidden Fist

6a6ff2460c2b5e76730af127.synopsis: Natalie uncovers a shocking betrayal after her mother is bullied at the plaza. The mastermind's backer turns out to be her own husband. Facing family, lies, and betrayal, Natalie vows to expose the truth and make them pay.
6a6ff2460c2b5e76730af127.title: Nobody Hurts My Mother

6a7002bdf1b7555be101d640.synopsis: Nia, an ordinary 18-year-old, goes viral overnight after posting a video exposing injustice at her school — only to be maliciously re-edited and mobbed online by a top Beverly Hills influencer dynasty. As hidden-camera footage, deepfakes and long-buried dirt surface one piece at a time, she discovers that her school, a PR firm and a wealthy family are jointly weaving an enormous campaign of public deception. To protect her family and find the truth, Nia joins forces with Jax, a rich-kid documentary director, to fight back — only to find that everyone is hiding something, herself included. When the truth can only be told to the world on a live stream, she must decide: stay silent, or bet everything and expose everyone for who they really are.
6a7002bdf1b7555be101d640.title: DRAMA IN HD

6a7002db07b37ca2420bcffe.synopsis: Sebastian Vale, founder and CEO of Vale Tech, was once the son of mafia boss Carmine Rossi. Twenty-five years ago, to escape his family's criminal destiny, he broke with his father, changed his name, built a world-leading technology company from nothing and developed an AI system powerful enough to change the world. But just as the company nears a major breakthrough, Sebastian walks in on his wife and co-founder Claire in a compromising moment with his close friend and COO, Marco, and his marriage collapses. At the same time, the AI system he built spins out of control: power grids, hospitals, transport and aviation fail one after another across the globe, plunging the world into an unprecedented crisis — and every finger points at him. Just as the board prepares to remove him and the world casts him as the villain, the mafia father who vanished twenty-five years ago suddenly reappears and reveals a long-buried truth: it was not his father who betrayed the family, but his mother. And the man who engineered the entire conspiracy to seize control of the company is Sebastian's half-brother — Marco. To take the life he believes should have been his, Marco exploits a bloodline loophole to breach the AI system, steals the company's assets, kidnaps Claire and sets out to destroy Sebastian's business, family and faith entirely. Facing a global crisis, a brother's revenge and old family blood debts, Sebastian must confront his mafia heritage, fight alongside his father to rescue his wife and stop the AI catastrophe, and make a final choice between revenge and justice. Yet just when everything seems settled, the mother who disappeared twenty-five years ago appears at the wedding and reveals an even bigger secret behind it all, leaving Sebastian once again at the crossroads of his family's fate. The true war of the mafia family has only just begun.
6a7002db07b37ca2420bcffe.title: Mafia Son: Unbroken By Betrayal

6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.synopsis: In I’m Pregnant It’s Not Yours movie, husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.
6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.title: I’m Pregnant, It’s Not Yours

6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.synopsis: Evelyn, a senior purser at Atlantic Airways, is reborn with intact memories of her previous life. Drawing on her foreknowledge, she sees through the deadly murder plot hatched by her husband and her trusted best friend. At an altitude of 30,000 feet, she turns the tide against all odds and saves the heir to the Sterling family. After being wrongfully framed and later fully exonerated, she secures the patronage of the Sterling family and is parachuted into the airline’s corporate headquarters. Leveraging her elite risk management expertise, she dismantles the conspiracies of her long-standing career arch-rivals, and ultimately ascends to the absolute pinnacle of power in the aviation industry.
6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.title: Reborn: A Flight Attendant Counterattack

6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.synopsis: For ten years, janitor Maya scrimps and saves while raising her daughter Lily almost entirely on her own—only to discover that her husband, Adrian, is actually a multimillionaire who has lavished all his love and affection on his first love and her son. Completely heartbroken, Maya leaves with Lily. She is later revealed to be the daughter of a fallen war hero, and after reclaiming her true identity, she becomes the long-lost beloved heiress of the powerful Harrington family. When Adrian loses his business, his family, and the wife and daughter he took for granted, he falls to his knees and begs for forgiveness. Lily gives him only one final answer: “Daddy, we’re done.”
6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.title: Daddy We're Done

6a701ec0e75af274da07241f.synopsis: Once the strongest rope guide of the Sacred Mountain, Evelyn was framed after an avalanche by the beloved Saintess Celeste, who claimed Evelyn cut the rescue rope and left her crippled. Her fiancé, Duke Adrian, believed the lie. For three years, Evelyn knelt on frozen steps to pay for her brother Noah’s medicine and keep the orphanage alive. On the final step, Adrian orders her to kneel and lick Celeste’s boots. Then a black raven arrives with Noah’s death notice. With nothing left to lose, Evelyn tears up the atonement contract and drags the Saintess’s perfect lie into the light.
6a701ec0e75af274da07241f.title: He Made Me Kneel Before the Fake Saintess

6a702ff9bfebe859c8010184.synopsis: Olivia, an art student harboring a secret crush on a star hockey player, accidentally stumbles upon the shocking truth: Liam, the campus playboy, is secretly an anonymous adult content creator. To keep his secret safe, the two enter into a dangerous "fake dating" pact. As they navigate endless teasing, power struggles, and joint battles against campus bullying and malicious schemes, their pretend romance begins to blur into real passion. However, just as they finally face their true feelings for each other, a deadly blackmail scheme threatens to destroy everything Liam holds dear...
6a702ff9bfebe859c8010184.title: Puck Perfect: My Sex Education Tutor

6a70478c9dbba6268204e160.synopsis: Vince buried his past with Dante, the mob heir who vanished five years ago. When Dante returns, he's still reckless, still devastating, still determined to win Vince back. But Leo, the fragile younger brother Vince saved, wants him too. Caught between two brothers, Vince must decide if the man who broke him once is worth the risk again.
6a70478c9dbba6268204e160.title: Forbidden Night with the Mafia Heir

6a70478f9dbba6268204e166.synopsis: Willow celebrates a positive pregnancy test until she overhears a monstrous truth: her Alpha husband, Adrian, has never touched her. Every time she trusted him, his Beta took his place behind her blindfold, while Adrian built a lie to brand her unfaithful and crown his mistress Luna. Betrayed, pregnant, and trapped in a pack that calls her wolfless and ugly, Willow plans her escape. But under the full moon, her birthmark vanishes, a legendary white wolf awakens, and the men who used her begin hunting the woman they can no longer recognize.
6a70478f9dbba6268204e166.title: The Alpha Lost His Ugly Luna

6a7047929dbba6268204e16c.synopsis: When billionaire Reid Vale finally wires his six-year-old daughter’s surgery deposit, Annie is already dead. His private finance team marks the payment as a loan. While Annie begged for approval, Reid spent $200,000 on another woman’s daughter and called his own child a liar. But Sloane has the death certificate, the school footage, and every cruel financial record. One upload turns a powerful CEO into the father who let his daughter die.
6a7047929dbba6268204e16c.title: He Called His Dying Daughter a Liar

6a71436c94baf6bde908a282.synopsis: After losing her grandma, Mila meets Xavier, a disgraced rich heir who pays for her grandma's funeral. Mila decides to use her special powers to clear his name. Though not blood-related, they form an unbreakable bond. Two broken hearts start to mend.
6a71436c94baf6bde908a282.title: Mending Hearts

6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.synopsis: Kaelen Ashfell bought me at the Mate Auction for a fortune. Three years later, after I gave him three hatchlings, his first love came back, and he crossed my name out of his Bond Ledger like I was property to return. He handed me and our babies to his brother Roran, then let his first love tear apart my den, my garden, and even hurt our child. Kael thought regret could bring me back. But the mate he discarded was about to learn what it felt like to be protected by someone else.
6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.title: The Auctioned Mate

6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.synopsis: In 1911, amid New York’s Gilded Age, Evelyn Hart, a rural English schoolteacher, voyages across the ocean for love, only to suffer
6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.title: The Atlantic Bride

6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.synopsis: When James loses his daughter Amy and his legs on the same day, he stops believing in magic. Little does he know, Amy is now Mia, a fortune-telling prodigy come to save James from his fatal bad karma.
6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.title: Little Miss Fortune

6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.synopsis: Sawyer is a quarterback prodigy, but his mom Marnie always ignores him in favor of his adopted brother, Ben, even when Ben frames
6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.title: The Son Rises Alone

6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.synopsis: After claiming her fifth World Culinary Championship, the legendary Chef Sage goes undercover as a homeless beggar to find a partner with genuine character. Ignored by the masses and ruthlessly mocked by her ex, she encounters Jasper, a kind-hearted man who offers her his food. Desperate to save his family's failing restaurant from a vicious corporate takeover, Jasper hires Sage to play his wealthy fake fiancée. As rival factions push the Vance family to the brink with a high-stakes "Culinary Death Match," all hope seems lost. But when cornered, the beggar bride sheds her disguise. With a flash of her blade and her signature blue flame, she turns the tables against world-class chefs, exposing her true identity and sparking a legendary romance.
6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.title: My Homeless Bride Is a Culinary Legend

6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.synopsis: Caleb Shaw calls BDSM a cure for his dead marriage, then chains his wife Mara to a tree for his mistress. When Mara says the safe word, he leaves with the key. By sunrise, Nina’s hired men find her. But Caleb never knew what Mara buried for this marriage. She was not just his wife. She was the woman who once owned the West Side docks. Now the collar, the blood, and the betrayal will drag every Shaw secret into the light.
6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.title: My Safe Word Was Revenge

6a72d8b2f2d34be5d20118cb.synopsis: Samantha Hughes waited a whole year for AURA’s final farewell concert, only to find her childhood sweetheart Logan kissing Sierra outside the venue after giving away Sam’s VIP ticket. When Logan keeps choosing Sierra, exposes Sam’s family trauma, and later abandons her during a fire, Sam finally sees the boy she loved is gone. She withdraws from Berkeley, moves to New York, rebuilds her life with her mother, and refuses every attempt Logan makes to drag her back. Even when Sierra tries to ruin her reputation and Logan begs for another chance, Sam chooses peace, dignity, and a new love who actually stays.
6a72d8b2f2d34be5d20118cb.title: Scorched Heart

6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.synopsis: Owen — discarded heir of the Hull family, the one and only disciple of the master of the Dragon Knight Sanctum. He awakens the Ten
6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.title: Abandoned Pawn, Unrivaled Dragon King

6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.synopsis: Five years ago, Elena Hartwell broke up with her college boyfriend Killian Thorne to protect him from her ruthless uncle Victor—ma
6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.title: Mommy's Little Savior

6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.synopsis: Based on the novel by Cora Reilly. 8 years after Dante took a bullet for Valentina, a mafia war rages between Chicago and Las Vega
6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.title: Bound by the Past

6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.synopsis: After a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Nora Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Drake
6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.title: Crowned in Silver Blood

6a740377759fd85b61000861.synopsis: Chris, a low-level Omega werewolf, is brutally murdered during her pregnancy by her mate Alex and former friend Janet. Reborn one year prior to their bonding ceremony, she decisively rejects the scumbag in public and severs their bond, triggering her hidden bloodline as the "True Luna" (Mother of all Werewolves). Guided by a mysterious vision, she must find her true love within a month to fully awaken and survive. Taken in by Leon, the powerful Alpha of the Fire Moon Pack, Chris faces continuous framing by the villains. Ultimately, through numerous trials, she and Leon firmly choose each other, leading to her complete awakening.They cast the evil duo into the dungeon and live happily ever after.
6a740377759fd85b61000861.title: True Luna：On My Terms

6a741db7bf22b9d5b80c238e.synopsis: Lucas Carter is the charismatic captain of his college hockey team. After a concussion leaves him with temporary amnesia, his life begins to unravel. He forgets his complicated rivalry with transfer student Albert Clay, making him the perfect target for Albert’s carefully constructed lie: Albert claims they have secretly been lovers all along. As Lucas struggles to separate truth from deception, he still believes he is straight, yet finds himself irresistibly drawn to Albert. Torn between his girlfriend Jessica, his fading memories, and feelings he can no longer deny, Lucas embarks on a journey to uncover who he truly is. Along the way, he is forced to confront his identity, his buried emotions, and the truth behind Albert’s betrayal.
6a741db7bf22b9d5b80c238e.title: Off the Ice

6a7456d6a4740b6805050945.synopsis: Elite doc Christine catches mafia boss Damon's eye—her eggs are top-tier, and he wants his heir. She hates his guts: same mob that drove her mom to suicide. She rushes a wedding to escape, but Damon crashes the ceremony and snatches her. Locked in his penthouse, he comes at her hard every night; she fights back twice as hard. But slowly she sees past the ice—when someone drugs her, Damon burns it all down to save her. That twisted, obsessed devotion cracks her open. Christine drops the grudge. They end up together, damaged but locked in.
6a7456d6a4740b6805050945.title: The Mob Boss Demands Her Perfect Genes

6a753af15367fbf9d700f349.synopsis: Elena, the sole heir of the Sterling family, is betrayed by her fiancé and biological sister on the eve of her wedding—her fortune seized and her life ended tragically in a mental institution. Reborn from the ashes, she returns to the week before her fate unfolded, shattering her engagement and striking back with bold precision. Seeking revenge, she strikes a deal with Marcus, CEO of the rival Vance Corporation, agreeing to become his contractual fiancée in exchange for 3% of the company's core equity. United in mutual benefit, they team up to settle old scores and uncover buried secrets, rising to the pinnacle of elite power—only to find themselves drawn into an even deeper, more dangerous game of high-stakes political maneuvering at the top.
6a753af15367fbf9d700f349.title: The Heiress's Game

6a753b06b9632278d60f78c9.synopsis: Held under the tyrannical rule of the Holy Church, magic is branded heresy across the North. Elena, a gifted healer and illegitimate daughter, is betrayed by her half-sister Veronica and fiancé Grayson. They rip out her magic core and sentence her to the stake. At death’s door, she bargains with the Ash Goddess for destructive ash magic—yet every spell erases fragments of her soul. Reborn seven days before her arrest, she allies with disgraced knight Marcus. The vengeful Ash Witch will overthrow her betrayers and ignite rebellion against the oppressive Holy Church.
6a753b06b9632278d60f78c9.title: Covenant of the Witch

6a754311338f32d80c0fc293.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Emily is hunted down by her relatives over her massive inheritance. She flees to her family’s rural farm for shelter, only to accidentally discover that their fireplace connects to a dragon‑ruled otherworld. She keeps sending modern supplies to this realm, aiding Kael, the metal dragon lord, in protecting his people and homeland. To the dragons, she becomes the "Dragon God". From firewood and medicine to modern weaponry, she reshapes the dragon‑race war step by step — and rewrites her own destiny.
6a754311338f32d80c0fc293.title: My Fireplace Ships to Dragon Realm

6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.synopsis: On a snowy Thanksgiving, young healer Rita lives with her ungrateful uncle William and his cruel family. They exploit her powers,
6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.title: The Godfather's Guardian Angel

6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.synopsis: When Naomi accidentally summons Thanatos, the God of Death, a desperate kiss awakens his heart after ten thousand years. Revealed
6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.title: My Marriage with the God of Death

6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.synopsis: In Altarboy movie, after getting kicked out for being gay, 18-year-old Theo is dumped at a Catholic church to be "cured" — and finds his new priest is young, hot... and a huge jerk who makes Theo his personal altar boy. What starts as a game of temptation becomes a slow-burn obsession neither can pray away, but as the game turns real, both Theo and Alexander risk losing everything to a love neither of them is supposed to want.
6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.title: Altarboy

6a792d0968014e86ca0a0a79.synopsis: After three years away, Grant returns home with a brooch for his sister Ella—only to witness her fall to her death from the top of Vanguard Tech. In her final moments, Ella reveals that Kane orchestrated her downfall, stole her company, and drove her to her death. Grant gives himself three days to exact revenge. At a merger celebration, he unleashes his lethal skills—while his in-laws, the Richards, and other relatives continue to mock and belittle him, unaware that he has just been sworn in as the new FBI Director. As he protects his wife Laura and systematically dismantles Kane's conspiracy, Grant hunts down every last perpetrator—and reclaims the company his sister built with her own blood and tears.
6a792d0968014e86ca0a0a79.title: A Soldier's Revenge

6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.synopsis: In My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit movie, seeking a fresh start after years of managing crises, Grace takes on a new job, only to be swept into a fake marriage by her enigmatic boss, Mason. As their pretend arrangement blurs into undeniable passion, Grace falls deeper into his spell. But Mason is playing a far more dangerous game—and he has no intention of ever letting her go.
6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.title: My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit

6a792e8f6760fac43a08230d.synopsis: Everyone accuses Faye of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Adam Stone! (And win his heart too)
6a792e8f6760fac43a08230d.title: The Hobo Goddess and Her Billion-Dollar Contract

6a792f892dee9a176102157c.synopsis: In Shattered Vows movie, princess Venessa lived a sheltered life—until her sister was murdered. Stripped of her innocence in a single night, she must confront a devastating betrayal: her husband and best friend just helped the killer escape justice. The pampered princess is gone. Now she's coming for every last one of them, to take back the justice they owe her sister.
6a792f892dee9a176102157c.title: Shattered Vows

6a79352e6aee1ef8c50dd878.synopsis: Wren buried her Ducati, her guitar, and her soul to marry Ethan, who repaid her by telling her to be more like Chloe. That night, she walked out and into the arms of Julian Ashford—billionaire heir and motorsport royalty. He didn't want her small; he wanted her flying. As Julian helped her reclaim every piece of herself, Ethan watched his empire crumble, realizing too late he'd traded a diamond for dust. Wren learned real love doesn't ask you to slow down—it keeps pace.
6a79352e6aee1ef8c50dd878.title: Goodbye, Ex-husband I'm Racing with a Billonaire

6a79353639273200140302fe.synopsis: Vivienne and Adrian are moments away from adopting a sweet little girl when Vivienne notices a pea-sized birthmark on the child's hand. She immediately refuses to sign and demands a divorce. Adrian kneels. His family calls her cruel, barren, and heartless. Even the child begs her not to leave. No one understands why Vivienne would destroy a loving marriage over such a tiny mark, and she refuses to explain. Not until Vivienne unveils three reports at a live press conference does the truth behind that tiny birthmark finally begin to surface.
6a79353639273200140302fe.title: A Birthmark Exposed My Husband’s Secret

6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.synopsis: I’m Seraphina, ocean princess. In my last life, I loved shark lord Kael, yet he held me down while his lover Lira stabbed my heart
6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.title: I Chose The Playboy Eel To Abandon My Shark Lover

6a7937d142b947c10103143a.synopsis: Erotica writer Ivy accidentally stumbles upon the secret between campus heartthrob Noah and a female teacher. After secretly filming the encounter, she becomes his target and is soon pushed into the role of leader of the school-wide "Anti-Noah Alliance." Forced to be paired as mentor and student for Ivy League applications, the two go from hostility to tentative probing, caught in a constant tug-of-war involving lies, power, and collective hysteria. When a campus crisis puts a baseball bat in her hands, the swing she takes hits not only the truth—but herself as well.
6a7937d142b947c10103143a.title: Dangerous Persona

6a79c2c44471e7a7eb06104f.synopsis: In her past life, Jennifer Nolan was betrayed by her maid Bridget and fiancé Michael, whose scheme destroyed her family and left her with nothing. After a tragic fall into a frozen lake, she awakens and returns to the day of her engagement. This time, she exposes Bridget's secret and lets the two traitors choose each other. While Michael mistakes her actions for heartbreak, Jennifer, the once-famous lady of the capital, has returned to reclaim her honor and make them answer for their betrayal.
6a79c2c44471e7a7eb06104f.title: My Maid Stole My Fiancé, But I Stole Back My Fate

6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.synopsis: Cain Hunter, heir to the almighty Godfather, is back! He'll fight past mind-controlling schemers and threats haunting the shadows, whatever it takes to pass the ten trials his grandfather has set for him. But what if it all comes at a cost? What if it means losing the love of his life, Annalise?
6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.title: Super Godfather 2: My Ex Dumped the Wrong Man

6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.synopsis: Five years ago, Tiffany was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, poisoned, and left for dead while pregnant. She survived, but
6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.title: The Alpha and His Nanny Luna

6a7ab985618cb1757a07e666.synopsis: "Lorde, the Daughter of the Sea‑God, was betrayed by her husband Demos and her handmaiden Chloris, who cast her off the cliffs of Mount Olympus. As she lay dying, she finally learned that Helios, the deposed Sun‑God, had always loved her deeply — and he traded his divine status for her rebirth. Returned to the age of eighteen, Lorde rejects her old betrothal to seek out Helios, only to face forced marriage imposed by Zeus once more. The two join forces to hatch a plot, reclaim the Sun‑God’s staff, expose the truth behind the murder in their past life, and make the wrongdoers pay for their crimes. In the end, they hold their wedding on the island of Rhodes and embrace a new beginning."
6a7ab985618cb1757a07e666.title: Daughter of Poseidon Forsakes you

6a7aceebbdf01d86f40cb0e2.synopsis: Clara is trapped in a year‑long sexless marriage. She develops hypersexuality and seeks medical help—only to meet Dr. Killian, a domineering CEO‑physician who humiliates her during a full exam. That night, her husband Julian rejects her advance, and she discovers he gratifies himself to photos of her half‑sister Vivian—exposing the fraud of her marriage. The next day, Killian is revealed as her company's new CEO. He promotes her to his personal assistant, exploiting her condition with constant verbal and physical pressure. During a phone call from her own home, with Julian just outside the door, Killian pushes her into a hysterical orgasm, escalating their forbidden tension. Killian's possessiveness deepens. When his friend shows interest in Clara, he burns with jealousy. At a gala, as he helps her with her zipper, her hysteria ignites. Killian drops all pretense and declares he will "treat her" right there—their relationship teeters on the edge of an irreversible, physical turning point.
6a7aceebbdf01d86f40cb0e2.title: The New CEO Turns Out to Be My Gynecologist

6a7ade3bcccb5af57d0f0ddc.synopsis: Lord Julian Thornfield burns Adeline’s village, turns her into a vampire, and forces her to become his dead wife’s replacement. Even his daughter, Eve, calls her “Mama.” When Adeline tries to die, Eve’s strange power hurls them a hundred years into the past. There, Julian is not a cruel lord yet. He is a scarred human slave in a circus cage, whipped as a monster. Adeline only wants to hand Eve back and escape, but the child’s broken heart ties her to them both. Then the caged man asks who she is, and Adeline answers, “I’m your future wife.”
6a7ade3bcccb5af57d0f0ddc.title: I Was My Vampire Husband's Dead Wife

6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.synopsis: Once a straight A freshman, Emma Lucas lost everything when Adrian Cole filmed her in bed and let her nudes spread across campus.
6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.title: My First Love Pays to Watch Me Strip

6a7ade4b6dd79807440adcb9.synopsis: Born with the sealed bloodline of Hades, Lia Thorne is raised as the lost daughter of the wealthy Lancaster family. But when her return exposes their crimes and shatters their "lucky" adopted daughter Ava's perfect life, Lia is branded a curse. On her twelfth birthday, her parents drug her and leave her at Black Rose Manor, the most feared mafia estate in Black Bay. They expect her to die. Instead, mafia queen Veronica Knight and executioner Damian Wolf protect her as their little princess. As enemies close in, Lia's hidden power awakens, turning every betrayal into deadly karma.
6a7ade4b6dd79807440adcb9.title: Hades' Mafia Princess

6a7ae421b439ccf70a081b47.synopsis: Betrayed by her boyfriend. Hunted down by her father. Forced to mate with a ruthless Alpha King. Cora thought her life was over until she escaped and accidentally marked a dangerous, magnetic stranger. Left with no choice, she accepted a fake mating proposal from that stranger, totally unaware that her "contract mate" is the very Alpha King she’s desperately trying to escape...
6a7ae421b439ccf70a081b47.title: Caught! The Ruthless Alpha's Runaway Luna

6a7b163cc628342bd2004993.synopsis: Princess Serena of Atlantis with golden‑tailed fins was murdered in her past life by her adopted younger sister together with her fiancé. Reborn with burning hatred, she saw through their schemes. To escape the deadly trap, she dived into the abyss and united with Nereus, the sealed ancient Sea God, conceiving nine primeval divine eggs. On the grand birthing ceremony, she exposed the villains' plots. Joining forces with Nereus, she crushed her foes, abolished the hierarchical system separating humans and merfolk, and ascended as the Tidal Sea Queen to rule the deep ocean alongside the Sea God.
6a7b163cc628342bd2004993.title: Ruler of the Ancient Seas

6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.synopsis: Juniper is hopelessly, recklessly in love with Tristan—the dark, intoxicating rockstar who rules their campus. The catch? He’s her
6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.title: The Rockstar's Secret

6a7bd0f9c6914781b809601a.synopsis: A month before the most important piano competition of her life, gifted heiress Evelyn Sterling is kidnapped—and her hands are shattered on her fiancé’s orders. He plans to replace her with her adopted sister, steal her inheritance, and erase her from New York’s music world. Betrayed by everyone she called family, Evelyn undergoes a dangerous surgery and returns to the stage with bleeding fingers. Her impossible perfect score ignites a ruthless war of forged drug tests, stolen identities, and deadly revenge. They broke her hands to silence her, but Evelyn is ready to reclaim her music, her name, and everything they stole.
6a7bd0f9c6914781b809601a.title: He Shattered My Hands for My Sister

6a7be5bdfb41d50b060e897e.synopsis: Beggar Killian, secretly the Crown Prince of the Dragon Clan, saved Eva during his tribulation. Eva's family demanded she choose between Killian and her home; she chose him. Moved by her loyalty, Killian crowns her, sealing their bond.
6a7be5bdfb41d50b060e897e.title: Found A Homeless Dragon Husband

6a7c09eedc4e3cb2b80e4055.synopsis: Princess Isabella of Valen has spent years studying medicine and developing a remedy for the plague. She returns to the capital quietly, hoping to offer it as a birthday gift to her father, King Arthur, who is about to remarry. Arthur's fiancée, Margaret, resents the princess for staying away and delaying the wedding. While riding through the capital, Margaret lets her carriage tear through the streets and nearly runs down commoners. Isabella stops her, only to be publicly humiliated and beaten by Margaret and her daughter, who accuse her of being a witch. The corrupt, fawning captain of the city guard helps them. Margaret burns the portrait of Isabella's mother and the precious herbs Isabella needs for her medicine, then orders her tied to a stake and burned alive. Just in time, King Arthur learns the truth and arrives with his guards in a fury.
6a7c09eedc4e3cb2b80e4055.title: The Gold-Digging Queen's Guillotine

6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.synopsis: Based on the novel by bestselling author Cora Reilly. 21 year old Giulia Rizzo suddenly finds herself engaged to the ruthless crimelord Cassio Moretti against her will. Rumor has it he's responsible for the bloody, untimely death of his wife, whom Giulia is not only replacing as a wife, but as the mother of their two young children. Will rebellious Giulia manage to make a life for herself alongside Cassio, or will his refusal to let her into his heart create yet another broken marriage?
6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.title: Sweet Temptation

6a7d29c9eef07d221a00cda9.synopsis: In her past life, Willow Warner sacrificed herself by marrying the Wolf King Ralph to save her sister Mia, only to die frozen in the northern wasteland. Reborn on her wedding day, Willow swaps places with Mia and enters the dangerous Peacock Valley. With her honey badger powers, fearless spirit, and unmatched strength, she defeats enemies, reforms the clan, protects the realm, and rises from a doomed bride to the unstoppable Queen of Beasts.
6a7d29c9eef07d221a00cda9.title: The Bride Who Could Not Be Tamed

6a7d2bcab1873733e20616ba.synopsis: Reborn after her family’s betrayal, Claire refuses to sacrifice herself for Violet again. With Adrian’s support, she exposes Violet’s schemes and pursues her esports dream. Despite her brothers’ remorse, Claire chooses freedom and a new life.
6a7d2bcab1873733e20616ba.title: KO, The MVP Heiress is Back

6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.synopsis: In 1849, the American West, poor dockworker William is betrayed by his lover and his boss, losing everything and becoming a slave
6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.title: King of Gold

6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by mutant beasts, Kane is humanity's one and only War God — yet he hides his identity, secretl
6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.title: Wasteland Sovereign

6a7d3aae10a933d3cb0c4cbe.synopsis: Maddox, a gifted diver haunted by the trauma of a past accident, makes his comeback. On the night of his return, he mistakes Teo, a younger fellow athlete, for someone else and spends the night with him. The next morning, he discovers Teo is none other than his new synchro springboard partner. What follows is a journey from awkward hostility to budding affection. Tormented by public expectations and lingering trauma, Maddox struggles repeatedly with his feelings. Their rival Tyler secretly films their intimate moments and uses the footage to blackmail them. In the end, Maddox conquers his inner demons. He and Teo claim the championship at the grand finals. Standing on the winner’s podium, they publicly confirm their relationship, achieving fulfilment both in their sporting careers and their love.
6a7d3aae10a933d3cb0c4cbe.title: Never Fall Alone

6a7d84d946113b47740e69e6.synopsis: Reborn before her tragic fate unfolds, Elena falls victim to betrayal in her past life at the hands of her sister Veronica and her fiancé Grayson. They swap her golden‑dragon egg, leaving her to die under false accusations. In this new life, she resolutely turns to the imprisoned Dragon Lord Nidhogg to conceive a child for self‑preservation and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with nine offspring. On the day of her labor, the villains strike again with slander. Nidhogg appears majestically to shield his mate. He exposes Veronica’s true identity as a wyvern and crushes all her foes. Elena rises to become the Divine Mother. She embarks on a sweet‑romance life alongside the Dragon Lord, and her nine dragon‑born children shake the Three Realms.
6a7d84d946113b47740e69e6.title: Doting Snake Lord

6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.synopsis: On her first day at Maple Elite Academy, transfer student Emma Parker does the unthinkable — she picks a fight with The Big Four, the untouchable heirs who rule the school. Tyrannical Rowan Calloway wants to break her. Golden-boy August Langford wants to protect her. But behind their masks, nothing is what it seems. The closer they get, the harder they fall — for the girl who was never meant to belong in their world. Enemies… or childhood friends? When it comes to Rowan and August, the answer is never simple. Who will she choose?
6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.title: Taming My Bullies 1-3

6a7f30edf644260e4c06e96a.synopsis: Axel is a ghost, a Russian operative buried deep inside the underground fighting circuit, sent to infiltrate the empire of Dante, the most feared mafia don on the continent. His ticket in? A brutal cage match where he publicly defies the don, then holds back the killing blow. The bait works. Dante brings him home. But the mansion is a cage of its own. When Axel gets caught cracking the don's safe, his only alibi is a forged love letter, a lie that accidentally ignites Dante's twisted obsession. When assassins strike, Axel sees his moment. He steps in front of the bullet meant for Dante. Bleeds for him. Nearly dies for him. The reward? The don's absolute trust, and an S-level pass to every secret in the empire. Now Axel is inside the heart of the beast. But the deeper he goes, the blurrier the line becomes between mission and something far more dangerous. He came to betray him. He didn't plan to fall for him.
6a7f30edf644260e4c06e96a.title: My Hockey Rival Under Me

6a826c7217a9d582cc0bf55a.synopsis: After Damian chooses his mistress Luna over Serena and their child, Serena is reborn. She exposes their lies, reclaims her family business, and takes back control of her life. Serena divorces Damian, brings Luna to justice, and returns as CEO with Adrian by her side.
6a826c7217a9d582cc0bf55a.title: Reborn Heiress: My Ex Regrets Everything

6a826d6cfbecc43db80d69ac.synopsis: Straight-A bookworm Georgia Pruitt accidentally shoves rockstar Riot Cross off his stage, so her strict father ships her to Silver
6a826d6cfbecc43db80d69ac.title: Summer with a Superstar

6a826e8e44e10020b10b8cae.synopsis: A destitute orphan Layla accidentally stumbles into the Wolf King Kai's suite, and one night soul-binds them. He throws a check at
6a826e8e44e10020b10b8cae.title: A Cinderella for Wolf King

6a827a32afda3505f70a3fd5.synopsis: My cold, ruthless Mafia godfather guardian tore off his mask the night of my twenty-first birthday. He doesn't want me to call him uncle anymore. He wants me as his caged bird.
6a827a32afda3505f70a3fd5.title: Locked by the Mafia Boss

6a82a37cff4c44e98402a664.synopsis: On the Dragon Continent, bloodline is everything. Pure dragon blood grants shifting forms and magic resistance. Those who can't shift are called Exiles — treated as slaves. Kaelen, firstborn of the Red Dragon House, was born unable to shift. On the eve of his coming-of-age, his three brothers cut his tendons, stripped his inheritance, and took his fiancée. His father branded him a slave and exiled him to the Silent Deadfire Volcano. In the volcano's depths, disaster became blessing. The dragon blood within him awakened the ancient Progenitor Dragon God's inheritance. Over ten years, his severed bones regenerated, and he mastered world-destroying Dragon Tongue magic. Ten years later, holy war breaks out. The Red Dragon House faces extinction. Kaelen returns as a cold dragon hunter—identity hidden. One crisis after another forces his enemies to kneel. His former fiancée regrets everything. In the end, before the entire continent, he reveals his true form: the Progenitor Dragon, reclaiming his throne.
6a82a37cff4c44e98402a664.title: The Dragon's Return: Reclaiming My Throne

6a82a75faf43836c55050f31.synopsis: After World War III, I became a scavenger in a chaotic world, surviving by trading salvaged junk for supplies—while being bullied by classmates who would steal what I'd gathered. By chance, I discovered alien technology and rescued three beautiful women who became my wives. Now, I aim to use these assets to become the King of the Wasteland!
6a82a75faf43836c55050f31.title: I Rule the Wasteland Harem

6a82ad6dc5c23b33ea076aa7.synopsis: Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious “Master,” whose commands make her feel safe. But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her. By day, they clash at the hospital. By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only — “Cake.” Enemies in real life. Addicted online.
6a82ad6dc5c23b33ea076aa7.title: My Boss Is My Secret Online Dom

6a82dec8118665dc400e9516.synopsis: Agent Zoe is betrayed by her fiancé and stepsister during a zombie apocalypse, but is unexpectedly saved by the zombie king Ethan on the brink of death. To complete a secret mission, she approaches Ethan to uncover the truth behind the virus, only to discover their fated connection. From using each other to falling deeply in love, they join forces to seek revenge, expose the conspiracy, and end the apocalypse.
6a82dec8118665dc400e9516.title: Date with the Zombie King

6a82e0b7e9eb6dc4dc02e08f.synopsis: On her wedding day, Jagger Hamilton abandons Avery for his adopted sister Tatum. Jagger's uncle Beckett, Manhattan's feared "Ice B
6a82e0b7e9eb6dc4dc02e08f.title: I Married the Groom's Uncle

6a82e6160f8129e8800fbe96.synopsis: Top skaters Arthur and Julian, long-time rivals, are forced to pair skate amid sponsorship woes. Suspecting Julian uses him for singles glory, Arthur remains distrustful despite quiet tender moments. Their agent Lily sabotages Arthur, leaving him injured. Julian abandons the World Championships to care for him. After further misunderstandings, they win the final, Arthur confesses publicly, and their hidden mutual love unfolds amid schemes and commercial pressure.
6a82e6160f8129e8800fbe96.title: Fall for My Icy Rival

6a83582174c9804c810424cc.synopsis: Based on the novel by Sierra Simone. Ex-soldier Tristan becomes bodyguard to his uncle-in-law, a magnetic billionaire who runs an exclusive sex club. Despite his best efforts to stay professional, Tristan's drawn to his boss’s dominance, breaking down his defenses until he finally submits. Under Mark’s seduction, Tristan is pulled into a world of pain and pleasure he never imagined. But his lust for Mark unravels when he’s sent to retrieve Mark’s fiancée… and falls for her too.
6a83582174c9804c810424cc.title: Salt Kiss

6a83ba69f394891af803e5fb.synopsis: Serlanty, East Sea mermaid princess, was drained of golden scales by her family and lover. The bastard Winsil stole her credit. She traded the Heart of the Ocean for human form, defeated evil with the Land King and found true love.
6a83ba69f394891af803e5fb.title: The Mermaid Queen’s Revenge

6a83bdc05777e714af07985d.synopsis: Sold to a drug lord by her foster father, Aurora leaps from a tower and is reborn. She exposes the Harrisons' abuse, then her sealed wolf awakens, revealing her as Alpha King Vincent's long-lost daughter. Vincent brings Aurora home to a noble academy where she crushes every challenger. Three adopted brothers discover they are all her destined mates. At her coronation, Aurora exposes the Harrisons' crimes and Vincent banishes them. All three brothers declare love, leaving her choice open.
6a83bdc05777e714af07985d.title: The Alpha King's True Heiress

6a83eecc862e4975f202e3b3.synopsis: After three years in the hands of the Black Raven pirates, Evelyn returns to find Arthur beside another woman and unwilling to believe her wounds. With poison already in her bones, she gathers rings, ledgers, confessions, and witnesses to expose Vera, destroy Black Raven, and rescue the girls still trapped at sea. When truth finally arrives too late, Evelyn wakes again as a child and chooses a future far from the man who failed her.
6a83eecc862e4975f202e3b3.title: Rose drowned in the Kuroshio Current

6a850ad852dd63c43c0d188a.synopsis: For years, demigod Elena endured the arrogance and cruelty of Alec, Sovereign of Olympus—only to have him reject her on her eighteenth birthday. But fate gives her a second chance when she meets Stefano, the powerful King of the Titans. His choice is immediate and public, "I want her. No one else." Just as Elena finally finds her true match, Alec and his lover set out to destroy them. Can Elena escape their trap, and will Stefano save her in time?
6a850ad852dd63c43c0d188a.title: Forbidden Bonds: Fated to the Ocean God

6a850d12889c4164400b645b.synopsis: In My Immortal Love movie, after being fired and betrayed on her birthday, Lana’s life takes a supernatural turn when she becomes the first person in 2,000 years to see Augustus—a cursed, invisible Roman immortal. Believing Lana is his destined "miracle," Augustus begs her to help break his eternal curse. There's just one deadly catch: to set him free, she must kill him. As they grow closer and undeniable sparks fly, Lana is torn between her deepening love and the cruel fate demanding his sacrifice. Can they defeat the ancient gods and break the curse without losing each other, or is their romance doomed?
6a850d12889c4164400b645b.title: My Immortal Love

6a850fc824d230ed1b0b190d.synopsis: Pampered real alpha princess Evie is framed and sent to the ruthless Werewolf Military Academy by her own family. They believe she is living comfortably, completely unaware that under the fake alpha princess's orders, Evie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she returns, broken inside, yet her family still views her as a spoiled brat. It is only when her father strikes her and her prosthetic limb falls off that they finally realize the horrifying truth...
6a850fc824d230ed1b0b190d.title: The Alpha Princess Is Gone for Good

6a8512e427fe8a27b30e0e9b.synopsis: At a superpower‑fueled academy where strength reigns supreme, ordinary girl Sophie unexpectedly awakens the extremely rare ability of Future Sight. Yet the very first vision she sees of the future shows her locked in a passionate kiss with Damien, the campus’s cold‑hearted, sharp‑tongued student council president! Convinced this could never happen, Sophie is determined to keep her distance from him. But fate plays a cruel joke on her: that very same night, her mother remarries‑‑and Damien suddenly becomes her stepbrother. As the embrace and shared bed from her prophecy start coming true one after another, misunderstandings and romantic tension between them keep building amid their cohabitation and school life.
6a8512e427fe8a27b30e0e9b.title: Fleeing The Future I Saw With Him

6a851b09ab33cb2fc3071f11.synopsis: Wendy, a naturally gifted ballet prodigy, had her identity maliciously swapped at birth by Helena, a former dancer consumed by jealousy. For eighteen years, she endured abuse and suppression, yet quietly clung to her dream of dancing. To cover her grandfather’s medicalsurgery expenses, she took a job at a theatre and signed up for a competition. However, Angela, the impostor heiress, repeatedly framed her. Worse still, her birth mother Sophia wrongfully accused her of plagiarism, getting her blacklisted across the industry.In her darkest hour, Alexander, a corporate CEO, recognized her talent and resilience. He funded her grandfather’s surgery and supported her as she competed in the International Dance Invitational. Wendy triumphed with her outstanding skill and staged a remarkable comeback. As the truth about her birth unfolded, Angela resorted to desperate measures and orchestrated a car crash, only for all her crimes to come to light. In the end, Wendy reunites with her birth mother, rises to the pinnacle of international ballet, and finds sincere loveachieving a double triumph in both her career and life.
6a851b09ab33cb2fc3071f11.title: Revenge of the Black Swan

6a85414c421ba4d3f6041e98.synopsis: I dated Lucien secretly for three years, but he denied me at graduation after a heartbeat test paired him with his rival Seraphina. He even stole my umbrella and altered my overseas academy admission. I cut all contact and flew to Arcadia to rebuild myself. Years later, he traveled thousands of miles to beg for a second chance. Yet I met Nathan, a sincere mage who treats me as an equal. Will I ever forgive the boy who broke me completely?
6a85414c421ba4d3f6041e98.title: Outgrowing My Old Magic Love

6a8544182f75b2fba60697a9.synopsis: "To save his terminally ill younger brother, impoverished basketball prodigy Anderson accidentally wanders into the private testing lab of wealthy heir Campbell. Forced to sign an exclusive, high-value contract, he finds himself trapped in a series of bizarre physical compatibility tests. Convinced he's completely straight, Anderson is repeatedly betrayed by his own body's honest reactions, believing he's fallen into an attraction he never asked for. What he doesn't know is that Campbell, who originally intended nothing more than to tame and control him, is gradually losing control himself. Captivated by Anderson's untamed spirit and fierce resistance, the hunter slowly becomes the one being conquered."
6a8544182f75b2fba60697a9.title: Came For The Money, Stayed For Him

6a8578386aae77f5520dbc8f.synopsis: twenty‑year‑ago, top gambler Alexander was framed by Calvin, losing everything and turned into a puppet. His daughter Ivy, abandoned back then, grows up with extraordinary gambling gifts. She heads to Las Vegas, gambles at the enemy’s casino, reunites with her birth mother and half‑brother. After deadly showdowns including a face‑off against her controlled father, Ivy kills the villain, settles old scores and rises as the new gambling god.
6a8578386aae77f5520dbc8f.title: The Last Ace

6a857d2914793f87470ee412.synopsis: Rejected by his royal family and cast into the ocean as a child, Kai secretly becomes the legendary God of Tides. Years later, he
6a857d2914793f87470ee412.title: The God of Tides

6a859df93f0921fe060bb6c2.synopsis: Five-and-a-half-year-old Wynne was thrown out of her home by her stepmother, Hannah Otto. Wandering the streets late at night, she unexpectedly stopped Silas — CEO of the Lennox Group — and helped ease the illness of his only son, Lucian. Deeply grateful, Silas claimed her as his daughter on the spot and named her Wynne. After entering the Lennox household, Wynne cured her brother's grave illness and, through a dream, helped her father escape a deadly predicament — transforming from a little jinx everyone despised into the little lucky star acclaimed throughout all of Shanghai. The domineering CEO Silas, too, gradually became a fiercely overprotective father.
6a859df93f0921fe060bb6c2.title: The Little Goddess of Family Fortune

6a85ac81d1dc784c210bf0be.synopsis: Sloane was a fake mate assigned to heir Royce. For three years, he never marked her, spiked her drinks with suppressants, and humiliated her in public. His brother Kael, whose Thorne blood Sloane recognized at a ceremony, returned and proposed a deal: “Three months, he never pleased you once. I need one night.” One true bite shattered the fake bond. Sloane carried Kael's pup. Royce killed Magnus for the seat, kidnapped seven-months-pregnant Sloane, and confessed to everything—recorded live by the ring she wore. Royce was caged for life. Kael knelt before the pack and asked Sloane to be his Luna.
6a85ac81d1dc784c210bf0be.title: Pregnant by His Alpha Brother

6a866c985e8777b04a0da2d9.synopsis: After the Iron Sheep Kingdom falls, Prince Leigh is offered to Kaelen, the Blood Lion King cursed by berserker blood, becoming the “remedy” that keeps him alive. Their reunion awakens a bond forged fourteen years ago. From captor and captive to allies, they uncover the truth behind the kingdom’s fall and the curse. After surviving conspiracies, war, and sacrifice, Leigh reclaims his throne and rules alongside Kaelen.
6a866c985e8777b04a0da2d9.title: Blood Lion: The Sacrificial Cage

6a86ae6abe4bd8008005b2c5.synopsis: Thirteen years ago, a traitorous scheme tore the Bloodwolf Clan apart.
