The true-born princess, still just a child, was cast out in the wild, losing all memory of who she really was. At nineteen, she awakens the overpowering Progenitor's Power. Returning home, she finds her Mother tortured, her father paralyzed, and the traitors colluding with the enemy to destroy the clan from the inside. Will the true-born princess be able to reclaim her throne and save her people?
6a86ae6abe4bd8008005b2c5.title: The Wolfless Alpha Queen

6a86ae7ebdc72d00bb0bf1d1.synopsis: After years of being dismissed by her husband, Eric, as uptight, boring, and hopelessly inexperienced, Chloe finally decides she’s had enough. Desperate to save her dying marriage—and prove she can be the woman he wants—she ventures into an exclusive underground club for a private lesson in pleasure. But Chloe walks into the wrong room. What she mistakes for an elite adults-only training session is actually a secret gathering where vampires select their human blood thralls. And the man she approaches for guidance is no ordinary instructor. Victor is a ruthless billionaire, a predator hiding at the very top of human society—and a powerful vampire Dom accustomed to complete obedience. Unaware of what he truly is, Chloe asks him to teach her how to submit. One forbidden night leaves Victor craving far more than her blood. Using her desire to save her marriage as bait, he offers her a dangerous arrangement: become his sub, obey his every command, and serve as his exclusive blood thrall……
6a86ae7ebdc72d00bb0bf1d1.title: Private Lessons with My Vampire Boss

6a86b34714749afb8806c3f2.synopsis: Pierce threw Sloane's newborn into lava, carved out her dragon heart-core, and left her to die on the storm altar. Reborn seven years earlier, Sloane watches him choose her sister, convinced Mira will bear the golden heir Sloane never could. She lets him walk into his own ruin and binds herself to Corvin, a cursed raven everyone mocks. Then Mira's golden egg hatches a black serpent, while Sloane's single egg reveals twins: a Supreme Gold Dragon and a Blackwing royal. Pierce was only a serpent in stolen scales, and the raven he despised was the true Dragon King.
6a86b34714749afb8806c3f2.title: Reborn, I Gave Birth to the True Dragon King's Twins

6a86b3884aa54c3d5100d2f2.synopsis: I’m Aurora Draven, the hidden heir of North America’s deadliest arms syndicate. I came back after three years, only to find my little sister caged and auctioned in my own house—sold by her fiancé and my traitor father. My broke mom fought to buy her with priceless family relics, while those villains mocked her ruthlessly. I stepped out of shadow to crush them all. But the coward Christian survived, plotted with cartels and my dad to leak Lily’s humiliating footage and blow up our charity gala. Can I protect my family and wipe out every betrayer for good?
6a86b3884aa54c3d5100d2f2.title: I'm the Mafia Heiress Who Saved My Auctioned Sister

6a86b964aba8f1d6dc0beb14.synopsis: At the much-anticipated Talent Awakening Ceremony in St. Bitter City, the fallen Duke Arthur is publicly humiliated and trampled upon by his ex-fiancée and mortal enemy, mocked by nobles and commoners alike as a worthless failure, and is about to be stripped of his family's entire legacy. Just when everyone is waiting for him to be utterly ruined and driven out of the city, Arthur's palm strikes the altar and erupts with boundless divine radiance—the supreme divine artifact of the Sea God, lost for a thousand years, suddenly manifests. Its terrifying divine might suppresses the entire crowd, delivering an ultimate reversal and leaving suspense at its peak.
6a86b964aba8f1d6dc0beb14.title: Fallen Duke, Awakening the Trident of the Sea God

6a86c823feaf9677a7003453.synopsis: Briar gave everything to her elite dragon flight and her fiancé, Silas. Her reward? Betrayal. They mocked her unawakened dragon as a useless runt, stripped her of her rank, and left her to die. But death didn't take. Reborn back to a few days ago, Briar turns her back on her toxic ex. While they laugh at her "weak" dragon, Briar is ready to unleash a mythical power unseen for centuries. When the skies clash, Silas will realize too late: they didn't just discard a useless teammate—they threw away the goddess of victory.
6a86c823feaf9677a7003453.title: Reborn to Rule the Sky with My Dragon

6a86cb6b65d0fbfc9a011c55.synopsis: After defeating Pope Pari in a contest of strength, Percy wins his approval—but declines the papacy to search for his origins. Guided by the Pope, he arrives in Crow Territory, rescues his sister, and reaches the Cohen family, only to find them under siege by the Ross family. His mother reveals the truth of his birth and urges him to flee. Moved, Percy defeats the invaders Brienne and Fiona, and encounters Mia of the Outflow Church, who has been searching for him. Brienne and Fiona are rescued and transformed by the fallen mage Cru. Fiona evolves into an evil dragon. Percy is defeated and nearly killed. Mia saves him at the cost of her own life. Percy awakens the Sun God's blessing, heals Mia, transforms into a seraph, and slays Fiona. Cru flees. Percy returns Mia to the Church, refuses the papacy again, and chooses to hunt down Cru.
6a86cb6b65d0fbfc9a011c55.title: Abandoned by the Duke, I'm the Divine Seraph

6a86d7af2cbc4fabd2093406.synopsis: Newlywed wife Emma was on her honeymoon in Hawaii when her husband Jack arranged for her father-in-law Victor to teach her how to surf. The husband was piloting a motorboat ahead, sharing a surfboard with Emma. Victor tightly hugged Emma from behind, experiencing a sustained and secretive desire that gradually spiraled out of control amidst the intense waves. Emma and Victor engaged in a forbidden love affair.
6a86d7af2cbc4fabd2093406.title: Tide of Forbidden Touch

6a86d93f2cf533b6910425ea.synopsis: Framed by her pack, Leila was thrown into the Howling Chasm and lost her arm. Two years later, her cruel family forces her to marry the North’s rumored “mad wolf,” Darian. But Darian is not mad—he is her fiercest protector. When her grandmother reveals that Leila is the true Alpha’s daughter, the impostor’s schemes collapse. Awakening her dormant wolf powers, Leila rejects her unworthy family and walks away with Darian into a new life under the blood moon.
6a86d93f2cf533b6910425ea.title: The Furless One

6a87ad8d444b7845c203ccc2.synopsis: Bound by her late father's dying wish, ex-special forces soldier Hanna Carter buried her past and settled into quiet farm life, ma
6a87ad8d444b7845c203ccc2.title: A Farm Girl's Reckoning

6a87af9a9e28e3c0cf039b2e.synopsis: Princess Valerie marries the ruthless Dragon King Therak to save her kingdom. But their wedding night hides a deadly game. Beneath her pillow lies the dagger meant for his heart. In his veins flows a curse: devour her before the Blood Moon, or die. Yet when danger strikes, Therak risks his life to protect her. Enemies by fate, lovers by choice. The Blood Moon rises. One must die.
6a87af9a9e28e3c0cf039b2e.title: The Virgin Sacrifice the Dragon King Claims

6a87afcf0641e2829b07bd3d.synopsis: At the engagement banquet, the Dark Lord Darius lifted my veil, his eyes filled with disgust. “The woman I wanted to marry is dead. Yet you are still alive.” He blindfolded me, forbidding me to speak, forbidding me to raise my head. That night, I cried away all the tears of my past life. Reborn, I returned to the day he mistook someone else for the one who had saved him. My sister Elise was pretending to be me, accepting his marriage contract in my place. This time, I knelt before the Duchess first. “Please, Madam, arrange my marriage as soon as possible too.” Later, I married the northern Frost Lord, a man infamous for his cold-blooded cruelty. On the day of my wedding, Darius fought his way to my bridal carriage.
6a87afcf0641e2829b07bd3d.title: The Vampire Lord’s Final Salvation

6a87ee06934ea2f4e1022043.synopsis: Ryder and Enzo, F1 rivals for fourteen years, one from the slums, one a billionaire heir. Enzo whispers "I love you" during CPR; Ryder wakes convinced it was sabotage. Handcuffs, saunas, and blindfold drills force them close as Ryder battles desire. Enzo risks his life against a violent rival and quietly pays Ryder's mother's surgery. They confess at the track where it began. In the final race, Enzo pushes Ryder to victory with his own car and crashes. In the wreckage, Ryder says "I love you."
6a87ee06934ea2f4e1022043.title: T-Boning my F1 Rival

6a87fc75cd1a6219260b2137.synopsis: When the Duke dies suddenly, his greedy brother Richard steals the title and fortune. Overnight, Cordelia—the Duke’s only daughter
6a87fc75cd1a6219260b2137.title: Forced to Marry My Ruined Ex: The Duke's Revenge

6a880526b1226d1e92057951.synopsis: The human girl Lena is sacrificed to Draven, a Vampire King afflicted by a petrification curse, and the two unexpectedly forge a life-binding blood pact. To save Draven—who is left dying and drained of his royal blood after the curse is broken—Lena endures seven years of perilous hardships to locate the source of the Blood Spring and rescue her true love. Ultimately, they ascend the throne side by side, ruling over a kingdom where humans and vampires coexist. Yet, just as peace dawns, the sigil of an ancient witch quietly begins to glow red deep within the Blood Spring...
6a880526b1226d1e92057951.title: The Stone-Cursed King’s Blood Bride

6a880a1758adcf20550a8502.synopsis: Serena Hale was a devoted wife. But her husband hadn't touched her in months. So when a stranger pulled her from a bar one night, she surrendered to him - because in her drugged haze, she thought he was her husband. One mistake. That stranger is Evan Knight - the billionaire underworld king now funding her husband's company. He knows she's married. He doesn't care. He's been waiting for her for sixteen years - since the rainy night she saved a beaten boy in an alley and didn't even remember his face. But he remembered everything. Her piano. Her voice. The way the rain clung to her white dress. Now he sits across from her at every dinner, watches her husband fake devotion, and whispers: "You don't belong to him." And the worst part? She's starting to agree. Even as she discovers that her husband murdered her parents. Even as she plans her revenge. There's only one man she trusts with the blade. But trusting him means betraying herself. And she's already fallen for him.
6a880a1758adcf20550a8502.title: My Protective Mafia Lover

6a881516109908ce810c1ce6.synopsis: Once overweight and insecure, Zheng Xiumin is bullied by heiress Kang Yoo-jin at work and pushed off a rooftop to her death. Reborn as orphan Han So-eun, she is granted a "Heart Points Exchange System" that rewards her for winning others' affection. With her mesmerizing voice, she lands a job at an exclusive private club and systematically seduces Kang Yoo-jin's arranged fiancé, her standby suitor, her cousin, and her junior—each conquest earning points that gradually transform her appearance and physique. Using the influence of these four wealthy men, she tears off Kang's mask of hypocrisy, exposes her crimes of assault and oppression, sabotages Sejin Group's partnerships, and forces Kang into overseas "recovery." In the end, the heroine lets go of her bitterness, finds companionship with those she has redeemed, and achieves both self-salvation and total revenge.
6a881516109908ce810c1ce6.title: Rose of Seoul: Revenge Reborn

6a8ba21522043df1630f7069.synopsis: I’m Scarlett Moretti, the hidden heir of North America’s deadliest arms syndicate. I came back after three years, only to find my little sister caged and auctioned in my own house—sold by her fiancé and my traitor father. My broke mom fought to buy her with priceless family relics, while those villains mocked her ruthlessly. I stepped out of shadow to crush them all. But the coward Christian survived, plotted with cartels and my dad to leak Lily’s humiliating footage and blow up our charity gala. Can I protect my family and wipe out every betrayer for good?
6a8ba21522043df1630f7069.title: The Mafia Heiress Crashes Her Sister's Auction

6a8ba46f8b785bc6d401045c.synopsis: Cassia, the Wingless Goddess, was born a scapegoat for fake‑princess Celine. Mis‑prophesied as a doomsday omen at birth, she was abandoned by her birth father. Raised under the protection of her adoptive father, she awakens the legendary divine wings. She exposes that fake‑princess Celine is the real destroyer behind everything. Finally, she overthrows the corrupt Wing‑Caste system and ascends the throne as the new queen.
6a8ba46f8b785bc6d401045c.title: The Wingless God

6a8ba4d6a8896f1ec604191b.synopsis: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.
6a8ba4d6a8896f1ec604191b.title: The Quarterback’s Secret Darling

6a8ba4ddd9c22677010439b2.synopsis: Sold at auction and cast aside by the Alpha who bought her, Omega Elena is handed off to his vanished uncle—the Lycan King and War
6a8ba4ddd9c22677010439b2.title: The Alpha King Sold Me to the War God

6a8ba810915070e93808db35.synopsis: Reborn in a fallen kingdom, Gavin Thorne is captured with a group of female refugees. Then he awakens a nation-building system: the more people he saves, the more powerful his rewards. With his fierce female army by his side, he'll turn a wasteland into an empire.
6a8ba810915070e93808db35.title: Reborn to Build an Empire

6a8ba956743331814f0d4827.synopsis: Winnie once gave up her dream of becoming a doctor for her family, only to be taken for granted by her husband, Owen. Reborn in the 1980s, she refuses to repeat her past. She divorces Owen and heads to Hillwood to pursue brain tumor research. Only after losing her does Owen realize her worth and begin a long journey to win her back. But Winnie is no longer willing to sacrifice herself for love. She devotes herself to medicine, helps drive major breakthroughs, and builds a life of her own.
6a8ba956743331814f0d4827.title: Reborn in the '80s, I Chose Science Over Love

6a8babd69828929ab10d315a.synopsis: Devoting 50 years to her husband meant nothing when Emily discovered his heart belonged to another. Reborn in the '70s with her college letter in hand, she rips up their marriage deal. Leaving romance behind, she sets off to build her own legacy. He's history now.
6a8babd69828929ab10d315a.title: Reborn in the 70s: For Country, Not Love

6a8bafb465f5c507d0050da9.synopsis: In In Bed with My Brother-in-Law movie, Bella's arranged marriage becomes a nightmare when she catches her fiancé cheating. Seeking revenge, she sleeps with a stranger, unwittingly bedding her fiancé's powerful mafia boss brother, Damian Gotti. Forced back into the Gotti family, Bella faces dangerous secrets and forbidden desires. Damian relentlessly pursues her under his brother's nose. Eventually, Damian exposes his brother's crimes, saves Bella, and they unite to defend their mafia throne.
6a8bafb465f5c507d0050da9.title: In Bed with My Brother-in-Law

6a8bb018f862ce484b00710a.synopsis: Tammy is a single mom who needs money to look for her son. Desperate for work, Tammy takes a a wet nurse job in a powerful manor, never guessing the cold, intimidating master is the father of her son. Nor that her touch alone breaks his years-long trauma with women. What he doesn't know is that he's about to hire her.
6a8bb018f862ce484b00710a.title: CEO's Irresistible Wet Nurse

6a8bb563f6d48b075604db4a.synopsis: She faked her death. Three years later, Sierra comes back to her own funeral with a new identity. She takes down her unfaithful ex and her best friend who betrayed her. She vows to take her three-year-old son back. For revenge, she teams up with Julian, the heir to the most powerful family. In a game of power, they go from sworn enemies to each other's only hope. Finally the truth comes out. They take everything back and find their way back to each other.
6a8bb563f6d48b075604db4a.title: Faked My Death, Destroyed The Billionaire

6a8bb9be6d46f8503907eeb8.synopsis: To save her daughter, Harper Reed marries Klaus Wolfe—New York's most feared mafia godfather—in her stepsister's place. On the wedding day, he sees right through her and calls her a gold digger. He gives her one choice: jump into a shark pool, or watch her whole family die. Then she jumps without hesitation. That shatters his frozen heart. But she finds out that—this marriage is way worse than death. Lydia deeply hates her. Uncle Richard wants the Don's chair. And "Black Fox" is dragging everyone to hell...
6a8bb9be6d46f8503907eeb8.title: 100-Day Contract：Mafia’s Dangerous Desire

6a8bbc709c6562e0640a54ee.synopsis: Medieval times. Dragons rule the continent. Lydia is forced by her family to marry the "savage" Dragon King, Lucian, in her sister
6a8bbc709c6562e0640a54ee.title: Fate of the Dragon’s Bride

6a8bdf3ebd867eff6d05018d.synopsis: Lucas returns to LA as the mysterious CEO of Apex Group, ready to marry his beloved girlfriend, Evelyn. But Evelyn mistakes him for a nobody and leaves him for a "richer man." Little does she know, she just dumped the most powerful billionaire in LA. Then, a stunning female CEO enters Lucas’s life and she gets down on one knee and proposes to Lucas. CEO meets CEO. Together, they become the most powerful couple in the world and make every idiot who underestimated them regret it!
6a8bdf3ebd867eff6d05018d.title: Fake Husband, Hidden King

6a8c0f134a3e10865c01146e.synopsis: 10 years ago I begged him to stay. He said: "She'll come crawling back to me." I never did. Now I rule every pack in the South. And that Alpha who ignored me for 10 years? He's been waiting. Alone.
6a8c0f134a3e10865c01146e.title: When I Meet Another Alpha

6a8d03f510f3a4bb8309daa2.synopsis: Samuel Sterling, a secret‑heir wealthy scion, was raised in poverty by his parents and remained completely unaware of his true background. After being humiliated and dumped by his gold‑digging girlfriend, he receives help from the brilliant CEO Irene Thornton. The two agree to pretend to be romantic partners to meet each other’s parents. Unaware of Samuel’s real identity, Irene’s father visits Samuel’s home, intending to humiliate him with money and ostentatious displays of wealth, only to end up thoroughly embarrassed. It is at this moment that Irene Thornton falls for Samuel. Burning with jealousy, the ex‑girlfriend teams up with Julian Lancaster, a rich heir pursuing Irene Thornton, to target Samuel Sterling. Following a high‑stakes contest of connections and social status against the Lancaster family, the true identities of Jonathan Sterling and Margaret Sterling are finally revealed. Samuel Sterling learns the truth about his origins, comes to understand his parents’ well‑intentioned motives, and embarks on a new life as a top‑tier wealthy heir.
6a8d03f510f3a4bb8309daa2.title: Bringing Home the Woman in Black Stockings, My Parents’ Secret Is Exposed

6a8d06be75270972e70133e0.synopsis: Just before college applications are due, Celine Marwood claims her family’s wealth and connections can get every classmate into an Ivy League school. Everyone believes her, including Sabrina Kestrel’s boyfriend. But Sabrina knows the promise is a lie. In her previous life, she tried to warn everyone, only to be betrayed by the very people she wanted to save. Now reborn before the application deadline, Sabrina has one chance to choose differently. This time, she will protect her family, secure her own future, and watch carefully as her classmates decide whose lies are worth trusting.
6a8d06be75270972e70133e0.title: Reborn Before the Deadline

6a8d096d10f3a4bb8309daa7.synopsis: After Dante Conti let his mistress Selena Russo torment their six-year-old daughter Sofia, Isabella Moretti fought back and was locked inside Ashford Sanitarium. Years later, Dante forced her to sign away her rights with Sofia’s urn as a threat, believing he had broken her forever. But Sicily turned the abandoned wife into Don Moretti. Backed by Luca Ricci, the Don of Palermo, and the hidden power of her father Vittorio, Isabella returns to New York’s Five Families banquet to expose Selena’s lies, reclaim her empire, and make Dante watch the Conti throne collapse for every drop of blood he spilled.
6a8d096d10f3a4bb8309daa7.title: The Don's Bloody Bride

6a8d0f21a52fd87cd5018f9a.synopsis: Five years after breaking up with his college sweetheart Nora, successful ad man Ben unexpectedly reunites with her as his new partner at work. But whenever Ben reveals his true feelings, his consciousness is thrown back five years into his younger self. Determined to fix the mistakes that ended their relationship, Ben begins rewriting the past—only to discover that every change can reshape the present. To win Nora back, he must finally face the one thing he has always avoided: telling her the truth.
6a8d0f21a52fd87cd5018f9a.title: Love Has A Deadline

6a8d2ad86a1a600e1306bd6b.synopsis: Winona, a master carpenter, dies saving her military dog, Dash, and wakes in another world as an overweight village woman everyone despises, who has also claimed the handsome Connor as her husband. His mother and sisters-in-law constantly give her a hard time, but Winona refuses to back down. With incredible strength, masterful carpentry, and Dash's treasure-sensing powers, she builds a fortune, helps the village prosper, and finds lasting love with Connor.
6a8d2ad86a1a600e1306bd6b.title: I Got a Magic Dog and a Handsome Husband

6a8d2d531616ebd404056b3e.synopsis: When the apocalypse descended, Anya, a girl with severe social anxiety, deliberately infected herself to escape both survival and socializing. Unexpectedly, she retained her human consciousness and became a “freak zombie” with absolutely no combat power. She shouldered her backpack and embarked on a southbound road trip in search of her family. Along the way, her innate kindness led her to save survivors time and again. She met Zane, a cold and ruthless human killing machine; Leon, a fellow zombie male lead with overwhelming combat prowess; and Mia, a mad virologist. She also adopted an apocalypse-level adorable zombie dog. To find her family and uncover the truth behind the virus, the three people and one dog formed a quirky wasteland team, beginning a trope-defying, laugh-out-loud healing journey through the apocalypse.
6a8d2d531616ebd404056b3e.title: A Zombie Girl’s Journey Home

6a8d59cabdf43642fe0e20ab.synopsis: To the world, Nate Ryder is a failure whose Awakening ended in disgrace. But Nate knows the truth: he awakened the SSS-rank Thunder God—the rarest power on Earth. His father sold his health for a vial of Awakening serum. His mother has been paralyzed for ten years, yet she's the reason he never gives up. At school, the elite bully Tyler—an A-rank prodigy—crushes that serum and works with corrupt administrators to bar Nate from the national tournament. Facing relentless humiliation, Nate hides his power and bides his time. Every insult, every injustice becomes fuel for his training. Then the Federal Awakened Selection Tournament begins. Tyler, determined to defeat Nate in front of thousands, steps into the arena—expecting a hopelessly one-sided fight. Instead, Nate unleashes his SSS-rank Thunder God. In one electrifying moment, the "worthless failure" shocks the world—and begins his unstoppable rise to the top.
6a8d59cabdf43642fe0e20ab.title: SSS-Rank: The Slum-Born Thunder God

6a8d70926587c82f53031da2.synopsis: A devastating family crisis shatters their world of privilege. Stripped of safety nets, ruthless businesswoman Emma plunges into the cutthroat corporate arena for a high-stakes comeback. Meanwhile, her spoiled daughter, Ashley, gets a brutal reality check. As hard knocks force Ashley to pay for her past mistakes, can this fiercely independent mother and daughter settle old scores before their fragile new future collapses?
6a8d70926587c82f53031da2.title: The Mother's Comeback

6a8d881ef77dbccff405a729.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Vivian Sterling publicly breaks her engagement after catching fiancé Bryce with her stepsister. Having secretly recovered from paralysis months ago, she stands from her wheelchair to reclaim her power. That night, she meets Adrian, a dangerous, motorcycle-riding mechanic who saves her from harassment. After a one-night stand, she proposes a contract marriage to escape Bryce's stalking. Vivian believes Adrian is merely a handsome working-class man, unaware he is the true heir to the Hale dynasty—and Bryce's most feared uncle. A decade earlier, Adrian was the one who pulled her from a fatal car crash and bore the scars; Bryce stole the credit and her ten years of devotion. As Vivian falls for Adrian, Bryce and his father Gerald launch a campaign of kidnapping, media manipulation, corporate traps, and assassination. When Adrian is rushed into the ER covered in blood, Vivian finally discovers the man she married for revenge is her real rescuer and only true love. What began as a contract marriage escalates into a high-stakes war for love, fortune, and survival.
6a8d881ef77dbccff405a729.title: I Married My Cheating Ex's Uncle

6a8d8d3da68a8219800ca210.synopsis: Struggling to make ends meet, Haley strikes a one-night deal with Julian, heir to a powerful wealthy family, at a nightclub to fund her gravely ill mother’s treatment. She is convinced they will part ways forever after that night, only to find herself repeatedly drawn into his world. At a high-profile auction, Julian pays an astronomical sum to claim her. It soon emerges that he has been secretly laying the groundwork for years to track down and dismantle a human trafficking syndicate. Her childhood sweetheart Ryan, who comes across as gentle and refined on the surface, is secretly the ruthless kingpin of the criminal ring — and so the fateful entanglement of the three begins to unfold. When gunfire erupts, Haley takes the fatal bullet meant for Julian. As she wakes up to his long-overdue confession, she is left to wonder: should she trust in fate’s design, or is this nothing but fate’s cruel joke? Spanning five years of unspoken affection, this secret love will finally find its answer amid high-society conspiracies and life-and-death trials.
6a8d8d3da68a8219800ca210.title: He Paid for One Night, Then Wanted Forever

6a8e42ef484c07df8a01bcce.synopsis: Catherine, pregnant and controller of FG Group, catches her husband Jesse cheating on video with mistress Mia. She brings his disabled father Walter to the billiard parlor, where Mia shatters Catherine's family crest necklace, smokes illegally, and brutally assaults both the pregnant Catherine and elderly Walter—almost killing the unborn child. When Jesse arrives, he takes Mia's side—until he learns Walter is his biological father and Mia has committed grievous bodily harm. Business tycoon John Morgan, who had cut ties with Jesse, watches Catherine's abuse live. He arrives, reveals his true identity, and shatters Jesse's business hopes. Jesse and Mia slander Catherine, but she files suit with full evidence of assault, adultery, and illegal fund diversion. They are arrested and imprisoned. A year later, Catherine makes the Forbes list. John Morgan proposes publicly. Catherine lets go of the past and begins a new life.
6a8e42ef484c07df8a01bcce.title: Make my cheating husband pay the price

6a8e44fcd712caa73e051f91.synopsis: Raised on her Grandma's one unbreakable rule, stay away from serpents, she never expects to save a heavily wounded man in the forest. Little does she know, the man she's saved is the feared Silver Serpent King, Silvan. He's made up his mind and has marked her as his. On Bella's wedding day, he crashes the ceremony and declares her his in front of everyone. Desperate to escape this possessive monster, Bella decides to run away with her childhood sweetheart. But to her shock, the man she trusts most betrays her and offers her up as a sacrifice. Betrayed, hunted, and on the edge of death, the man she once feared most becomes the only one left protecting her.
6a8e44fcd712caa73e051f91.title: The Silver Serpent's Bride

6a8e4b2d31276c556c080e56.synopsis: A witch cursed Prince Alexander to sleep for a century. Only a Jones daughter's kiss can break it. Catherine, once bound to Prince Arthur who chose her half-sister, enters Vandros Castle and awakens Alexander through a three-night ritual. His soul had escaped as a bat, guarding her since childhood. They fall in love. Arthur storms their wedding, but Catherine rejects him. Two princes duel on a cliff. She chooses Alexander. Arthur falls to a fiery end. They wed, sealed by blood and heart.
6a8e4b2d31276c556c080e56.title: A Hundred Years of You

6a8e4e0c2fbe2915aa00b6f2.synopsis: Six years ago, college student Isabel was framed, leading to an unexpected encounter with billionaire heir Ethan, after which she
6a8e4e0c2fbe2915aa00b6f2.title: Secretly Pregnant with the Billionaire's Daughter

6a8e4fc5e108343d2b01885f.synopsis: Six years ago, heiress Milo left penniless Asher to save her failing family, keeping her pregnancy a secret. Now a ruthless tech b
6a8e4fc5e108343d2b01885f.title: Second Chance: The Tech Billionaire’s Secret Family

6a8e7b7a96ec421187069107.synopsis: Ruby only meant to take a temporary nanny job for quick money, but she accidentally walks into the frozen world of billionaire Eth
6a8e7b7a96ec421187069107.title: Rent-A-Mom for the Billionaire Twins

6a8e7cd3963eb73334012f37.synopsis: Three years after leaving Onyx Stormfire, Serafina meets him again at the Grand Clan Gathering hosted by the Ravenwing clan—only t
6a8e7cd3963eb73334012f37.title: I Gave My Flame Up

6a8e81e782a8d6193b0483fe.synopsis: Duncan, once a renowned master chef, is transported to another world and reduced to a lowly kitchen hand at the Marquis of Farhaven's estate. When a grand banquet is nearly ruined, he saves it with leftover ingredients and catches the Marchioness's eye. After earning a chance to cook, he faces sabotage from powerful food merchants. Undeterred, Duncan turns humble lotus root, cabbage, and crab into exquisite dishes, wins the Golden Key, earns his freedom, and opens a restaurant of his own.
6a8e81e782a8d6193b0483fe.title: Cooking My Way Out of Servitude

6a8e902f9185ccf2230990ab.synopsis: Leon Vance, Son of Zeus, disappeared in the disaster 10 years ago. His daughter Beryl blames him for her mom's death —— a wound that time has only deepened. Now back as janitor, he hides his power to protect his little girl, and endures her cold stares and mockery. But when Lord of Abyss descends once more, the world is stunned to discover that the coward janitor is their almighty savior.
6a8e902f9185ccf2230990ab.title: Wrath of Zeus's Son 2: Secret Protection from the Janitor

6a8ed383fc0a18e4a00e7430.synopsis: Married 10 years, top gynecologist Clara Reynolds wholeheartedly trusted her husband Brian Harrington — until she uncovered his affair, and his mistress Britney is pregnant. On top of this devastating betrayal, she had long endured endless abuse from her mother-in-law Karen Harrington for being infertile. Betrayal, humiliation, unrelenting pressure. She will no longer stay silent. Armed with sharp wits, professional medical knowledge and live-stream public influence, Clara launches an all-out counterattack. She lays bare the Harrington family’s hideous secrets, fights to claim her assets, and takes back every bit of her dignity.
6a8ed383fc0a18e4a00e7430.title: Cheating Husband, Your Secrets Stream Live

6a8f2036ce8478256004c687.synopsis: Fay Thompson thought she understood the mafia world -- but the arrival of a scheming rival, a shocking pregnancy, and her lover's arrest will force her to become the Mafia Queen she was always meant to be, or lose Kent Lippert forever.
6a8f2036ce8478256004c687.title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad 2

6a8f98e0758fb693cf048117.synopsis: Five years of love ended with a cold "we're on a break." Sophia left in a single day, erasing Asher. Driven crazy by regret, the arrogant CEO spent five long years begging for her back—only to hear her gentle rejection: "Now that you're finally serious, I don't love you anymore."
6a8f98e0758fb693cf048117.title: A Touch of Reunion

6a8f9944ad5076b92e00c1b7.synopsis: Killed by Ethan, Vivienne is reborn five years prior. She chooses Richard, Ethan's father and the clan's strongest Alpha. A fated red thread proves them true mates. Carrying his five pups, she passes the Spirit Stele trial, earns divine blessing, and strips Ethan of his title. Ethan takes forbidden drugs, becomes a monster, and kidnaps her. As she falls into the sea, the Ice Lotus awakens the pups' power, lifting them on a golden lotus. Richard slays Ethan, and they wed amid a moonlit flower sea.
6a8f9944ad5076b92e00c1b7.title: I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad

6a8fb0fa833289c5ca079ae2.synopsis: In Atlantis, only godblood mermaids are allowed to live. Mudbloods are crushed at birth. I, Princess Rosalie, am a mudblood. My mother used dark magic to hide it. But on the day I gave birth, my husband Xavier discovered the truth, and I died by his hand. Now I'm reborn. I reject Xavier and choose to marry a mute slave instead. They all laugh. They say I've lost my mind. But they don't know the truth. He's not just a slave. He's Pure Godblood. The rarest, most powerful bloodline in Atlantis."
6a8fb0fa833289c5ca079ae2.title: From Mudblood to Atlantis' Owner

6a8fce5a72320f50d207cd12.synopsis: Former beauty queen Wendy thought marrying into the Carter family was her fairy-tale ending, only to discover it was a living nightmare. Her husband Jonathan sees her only as his "No. 113 collectible" and is secretly having an affair with her sister-in-law, Chloe. Betrayed and belittled, Wendy refuses to suffer in silence. Armed with an IVF pregnancy and a strategically swapped piece of underwear, she ignites a path of calculated revenge. Teaming up with Sean, her husband's scorned illegitimate brother, she exposes Jonathan's litany of sins at the climax of the family's farewell banquet. Just when everyone believes she is only fighting for a divorce, Wendy reveals her true fangs—she demands not just her freedom, but for the entire Carter dynasty to pay for their arrogance.
6a8fce5a72320f50d207cd12.title: The Day of Betrayal, I Took Everything

6a8fd24721a38cbb22013f3d.synopsis: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?
6a8fd24721a38cbb22013f3d.title: A Spicy Text to My Nemesis

6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.synopsis: Laila, a destitute widow, is forced off a cliff by the tyrannical Governor Barrow—only to fall into the sacred dragon realm. There, she spends one fateful night with King Kael, a dragon sovereign bound by a deadly curse that burns any woman he touches. Ten months later, she gives birth to a royal dragon egg. Hunted by Barrow, she desperately entrusts the egg to the dragon clan. When the temple issues a decree seeking one who can hatch the egg, Laila tears down the royal notice and steps forward. Despite scorn and humiliation from the nobles, she reunites with Kael. In the end, it is her unconditional mother's love that awakens the dying egg—and a penniless commoner becomes the mother of the dragon clan's sole heir.
6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.title: Pregnant with the Dragon Lord's Last Heir

6a8fef34c22ec2dd5308633a.synopsis: A modern medical student transmigrated into the body of Theresa, the obese queen of the Kingdom of Bolun in the Middle Ages. The original owner had been publicly humiliated at the blessing ceremony and then strangled to death by the white lotus Lia. After being reborn, the female lead was determined to take revenge. Banished to the desolate cold palace, she relied on a cross-time device to purchase modern supplies online and lose weight scientifically, stunning the palace by shedding fifty kilograms in a single month. Coincidentally, the old king fell gravely ill with abdominal pain, and she saved him with modern surgery, firmly establishing her position. Thereafter, facing successive provocations from Lia, the queen dowager, the biased king, and treasonous nobles, she brought out modern high-tech gadgets such as air conditioners, sports cars, and firearms, crushing foreign enemies in a martial arts competition between the two kingdoms, exposing everyone's treason and conspiracies, and severely punishing the villains. In the end, she let go of palace romance, accompanied the old king on a road trip across various countries, and found freedom.
6a8fef34c22ec2dd5308633a.title: The Counterattack of the Fat Wife Queen

6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.synopsis: Shivon has spent her life dreaming of escaping her cruel family and earning a place at the Royal Academy. But after one reckless night with the mysterious Duke Alaric Blackmoor, she discovers she’s carrying the one thing everyone believed impossible—his child. Alaric was thought incapable of producing an heir, because a wolf can only conceive with his fated mate. Now, as Shivon’s family tries to sell her to the ruthless Lord Greyfang, Alaric will stop at nothing to find the woman who may be his one true mate—and protect the impossible heir growing inside her.
6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.title: Knocked Up by the Wolf Duke

6a900bc7e259af77060af16c.synopsis: Reborn as an Immortal Venerable, Tristan returns to rewrite fate itself. After crushing a deadly illusion and rebuilding his clan, he learns a shocking truth: his mother never died of illness. Behind her death stands a powerful family in the imperial capital. As he heads to Southshire, old mysteries resurface—and this time, nothing will stop him.
6a900bc7e259af77060af16c.title: I Am the Immortal Lord Season 2

6a90e77f3400f6ce3b0fad07.synopsis: Framed by the deceitful adopted daughter Eleanor, Matilda suffered three years of unbearable torment in a dark monastery. Returning home with deep scars and a branded heart, she found only cold violence from her cruel father and blind brother. Cutting all tied blood bonds, Matilda chooses to marry Killian—a seemingly wild, disgraced prince. But behind his reckless guise lies an unwavering loyalty. When her past burns open and long-buried secrets unravel, the vicious imposter is unmasked, and her family is crushed by brutal regret. Matilda steps out of the ashes, no longer a victim, but a queen.
6a90e77f3400f6ce3b0fad07.title: The Branded Witch is the Prince's Bride

6a90ef7b26e6d777480a5e84.synopsis: In a world where elite vampire clans hold supreme power and vast wealth, ordinary girl Raina is saved by noble Justin, falls deeply in love with him and becomes his fiancée. When his ex-girlfriend Ellie returns, she repeatedly frames Raina. Justin always sides with Ellie and even demands Raina give up her hard-earned clan training spot. Heartbroken by his cold betrayal, Raina finally chooses to leave forever...
6a90ef7b26e6d777480a5e84.title: Goodbye Fiancé I Choose the Vampire King

6a9123fa3fc3c5a93a04b399.synopsis: Leo has always been one rank behind Jaxon, the star quarterback who takes everything Leo wants, including his crush, the hottest girl on campus. What Leo doesn't know is that Jaxon is secretly in love with him. So Jaxon tanks an exam on purpose, then makes Leo an offer — Tutor me to keep my captaincy, and I'll teach you how to win your dream girl. Studying calculus by day, dating lessons by night — and one plan Leo never accounted for, falling for his romance coach, his biggest rival.
6a9123fa3fc3c5a93a04b399.title: Romance Lessons with My Quarterback

6a912471533d191e1d0a5726.synopsis: Brynna’s fiancé, Sterling, crashes their wedding with his wealthy mistress, Celina. In front of everyone, they set fire to the wedding dress designs she spent months creating and viciously humiliate her elderly mother. Enraged by their cruelty, her mother suffers a fatal heart attack and dies on the spot. Overnight, Brynna loses her fiancé, her career, and the only family she has left. Heartbroken, she leaves the country. Five years later, Brynna makes a stunning return to the fashion world with her daughter, Mia, and her mysterious “contract husband,” Kane. At a major fashion exhibition, Sterling claims Mia is his daughter. He and Celina publicly slap Brynna and try to snatch the child from her. Just when Brynna is about to lose everything again, Kane steps forward to protect them and reveals his true identity.He is one of Europe’s most powerful financial tycoons. In front of the entire crowd, he declares Brynna his legal wife and Mia his biological daughter. Sterling’s exhibition privileges are immediately revoked.Everyone thinks Brynna has finally turned the tables.But the real revenge has only just begun. And when the dust finally settles, what will become of the contract marriage that has lasted five years?
6a912471533d191e1d0a5726.title: My Kids Ruin My Ex's Fancy Life

6a94da44281fc60a7909373a.synopsis: Eva, a cold-blooded assassin, accidentally triggers a deadly curse after killing the man chosen as her soulmate. Her only chance of survival is Leo—a clumsy Cupid apprentice who has failed his divine exam for ten thousand years. Bound by an invisible life thread, they must stay within three meters of each other or die. With only seven days left, the mismatched pair is forced to run from a powerful assassin organization while uncovering a conspiracy that has been manipulating love itself. Eva has never trusted anyone. But when Leo repeatedly risks his life to save hers, she must decide whether love is her greatest weakness—or her only way out.
6a94da44281fc60a7909373a.title: Clumsy Cupid

6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.synopsis: On the continent of Vester, Iso—Supreme Ruler of the Hidden Dragon Dominion—goes into hiding under a humble identity to investigate his mother Saintess Esara's murder. Disguised as an ordinary man, he takes residence in Silvermoon Castle and, honoring an old betrothal, becomes the fiancé of Sera, heiress to the saintess lineage. Sera, however, is obsessed with the legendary Dragon Lord—a mythical figure she has worshipped from afar—and feels only disappointment toward her unremarkable-looking betrothed. She frequently mocks and belittles him, unaware of his true identity. Cardinal Taren of the Orthodox Church, coveting the saintess's power, secretly hires eight renowned Dragon Slayers and rallies noble conspirators to ambush and assassinate Sera time and again. Each time, Iso secretly intervenes, wielding his silver-dragon might to save her. At Dragon Ridge Altar, he finally reveals his true form as the Dragon Lord—yet Sera fails to recognize him. The perils continue: a tavern trap, a royal council coup, and a siege by dark Dragon Slayers—all quietly thwarted by Iso from the shadows. At the climactic final banquet, the Church launches its all-out assault. Iso summons a thousand dragons before the entire assembly, shattering the enemy's ranks. Only then does Sera realize that the "ordinary" fiancé who stood by her all along is the Dragon Lord she so longed to meet. Together, they join forces to counter the Church's conspiracy and uncover the truth behind the past.
6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.title: Secret Dragon

6a94e906802350a8530a156c.synopsis: Annie, a human, fell in love with Fenrir, the wolf king, and bore twin half-blood children. Yet they were brutally exiled due to blood prejudice and Mara’s malicious schemes. Five years later, the twins’ werewolf blood awakens unexpectedly, dragging the whole family back into power struggles and deadly hunts. Following the clues, Fenrir uncovers the truth of the past. While protecting his wife and daughters, he exacts revenge on the real mastermind behind all the crimes.
6a94e906802350a8530a156c.title: The Alpha King's Half-Blood Twins

6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.synopsis: After his father dies saving the world, he is branded a traitor and his entire clan is destroyed. Ryan vanishes into exile, training in secret for fourteen years. Now Ryan returns to expose the dark mage's conspiracy, clear his father's name.
6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.title: Vindication: Blood of the Archmage

6a94edde525a0f0b05072178.synopsis: Duncan, once a renowned master chef, is transported to another world and reduced to a lowly kitchen hand at the Marquis of Farhaven's estate. When a grand banquet is nearly ruined, he saves it with leftover ingredients and catches the Marchioness's eye. After earning a chance to cook, he faces sabotage from powerful food merchants. Undeterred, Duncan turns humble lotus root, cabbage, and crab into exquisite dishes, wins the Golden Key, earns his freedom, and opens a restaurant of his own.
6a94edde525a0f0b05072178.title: Cooking My Way Out of Servitude

6a94f0cc46d3fb23b6034c95.synopsis: He's the strongest Alpha alive—cursed so that anyone who touches him burns to ash. She's a wolfless mage apprentice who fell from the sky straight into his arms… and didn't burn. Desperate to find her fated mate, Aria takes a job as Kael's personal maid, unaware the cold, dangerous Alpha is already falling for her. But a dark prophecy looms: their child will carry a curse far deadlier than his—and bearing it could cost Aria her life. When rivals attack and Aria's life hangs by a thread, Kael will face the deadliest mountain in the world to save her. Because some fates aren't written—they're fought for.
6a94f0cc46d3fb23b6034c95.title: Cursed Alpha’s Fated Luna

6a954112ffb159a50b0e241a.synopsis: To save his dying daughter, he knelt in the rain begging his ex-wife, only to be pushed into the mud. Left for dead, he was run over by a luxury car—but at that very moment, his royal dragon blood awakened! With golden eyes and giant wings, he became the last living dragon on earth. To escape an arranged marriage, the cold female CEO offered him a contract marriage and saved his daughter. He hid his identity as her assistant, mocked by his ex-wife as a worthless toy boy. Until the night of the elite gala— The city's richest tycoons and the war general knelt before him, shouting: "Welcome back, Your Highness!" His ex-wife spat blood in pure regret. But when the enemies who slaughtered his clan thirty years ago kidnapped his daughter, they crossed the line. Touch the dragon's scale, and prepare to die! No more hiding—his wings blocked the sky, bringing down divine wrath in the storm to crush them all. He saved his child, conquered the cold CEO's heart, and claimed his throne as the only king of this world!
6a954112ffb159a50b0e241a.title: My Hidden Dragon Awakened

6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.synopsis: Four years ago, healer Seraphina saved cursed Infernal Legion commander Drake and gave birth to twins. Unaware of his identity, she was exiled by her family and raised the children alone. Years later, the wounded Drake is found by the kids and brought home. He falls for Seraphina at first sight and proposes firmly. Amid stepmother's persecution, brother's power grab and dark magic crisis, they uncover the truth of their past. Finally Drake inherits the Lord of the North, and the family of four lives happily together.
6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.title: The Inferno Warlord's Secret Healer Bride

6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.synopsis: GT endurance driver Kai Mercer is pushed into a reserve role after refusing his sponsor’s sexual advances, while struggling with h
6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.title: Below the Red Line

6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.synopsis: Desperate to pay for her sick mother’s treatment, restaurant waitress Anna is betrayed by her biological father, Richard, and sent into a deadly trap controlled by an East Side crime boss. Using her combat skills and intelligence, she survives, defeats Victor, and escapes with crucial evidence. With the help of Leo, an undercover operative and Thomas’s son, Anna rises through Los Angeles’ criminal underworld, taking control of casinos and territory. But she soon discovers that her entire rise has been part of Thomas’s larger power game. Together, Anna and Leo expose the money-laundering operation and bring down Thomas and Richard.
6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.title: Blood Rose Crushing the Cartel

6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.synopsis: Odysseus is the secret demigod son of Apollo, bound by a deathbed vow to give his queen, Antigone, a hundred chances to earn his trust — and never seize her throne. He turns white-haired overnight saving her kingdom from a monster, only to catch her in another man's arms. Stripped of power, tortured, framed, betrayed again and again — every wrong she commits burns away one more chance. When the hundredth chance runs out, his true power awakens. He returns for vengeance, spear blazing with divine fire — but victory comes at the ultimate price, his own existence.
6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.title: Demigod Under Oath

6a97be5b7c15673985039ece.synopsis: After vanishing in a time rift during a demonic battle, the beastmaster genius returns to find his sect in ruins. Unbeknownst to all, he brings back five "ordinary" pets— each a divine beast in disguise. Now the strongest beastmaster's ready to show the world his true power.
6a97be5b7c15673985039ece.title: Return of the Strongest Beastmaster

6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.synopsis: Born a commoner, Eleanor has spent years quietly protecting her husband, Duke Adrian, and his kingdom. Yet he has always mistaken her loyalty for ambition, believing she married him only for status and power. After being publicly humiliated and heartlessly cast aside by the man she loves, Eleanor finally gives up on their marriage and walks away. Only after she leaves does Adrian discover that the mysterious masked warrior who repeatedly saved his life was Eleanor all along. What he still does not know is that she is also the long-lost heir to a powerful empire. When Eleanor reclaims her identity and the power that rightfully belongs to her, Adrian finally realizes what he has lost. Meanwhile, an ambitious regent launches a coup, plunging the entire kingdom into crisis. With both his former wife and his realm in danger, Adrian is willing to sacrifice everything to protect Eleanor. But this time, he is no longer fighting to win back her love—only for the chance to earn her forgiveness.
6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.title: The Duchess They Cast Away
